序 言

本栏汇总陈巍、王双、银振强三位老师参与署名的论文，按第一作者整理——也就是组里的学生与博后。栏目的视角始终是「谁做的这篇工作」：一位学生从入学到毕业发表的每一篇，都能在这里按姓名一次找齐。导师本人作为第一作者的文章不在本栏的收录重点之内，除非它同时是学生的成果。收录范围为 ORCID 上可查到的全部年份，第一作者的第一单位须为中国科学技术大学或量子信息重点实验室。每条给出中英文标题、作者、卷页与中文摘要，点击 DOI 可直达原文；中文标题、导读与摘要译文均由模型生成，仅供快速浏览。

No. 01

测量设备无关量子密钥分发中的光源时间不完美性Source temporal imperfections in measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

针对测量设备无关量子密钥分发中时间抖动、脉冲形状不完美与脉冲间干涉三类光源时间缺陷，建立按时间单元离散计算的定量刻画方案，并对四强度协议系统仿真优化参数，提升了密钥率。

在高速量子密钥分发系统中，重复频率是限制系统效率的关键因素。在基于双光子干涉的测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议的实现中，固有的时间不完美性会显著影响系统的重复频率。我们针对时间抖动、脉冲形状不完美和脉冲间干涉这三种时间不完美性建立了一套系统性的方案。通过将时间离散为时间单元并计算每个单元内的干涉，我们定量刻画了时间失配对双光子干涉的影响。利用该方案，我们仿真了一个基于四强度协议的具体实验系统，并通过参数优化获得了更高的密钥率。该方法由此为在高性能系统的实验实现中提升效率提供了一条具体路径。

Abstract (English)
In high-speed quantum key distribution systems, the repetition rate is a critical factor limiting system efficiency. In the implementation of the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution protocol based on two-photon interference, inherent temporal imperfections can significantly impact the system's repetition rate. We establish a systematic scheme for three temporal imperfections: time jitter, pulse shape imperfection, and interpulse interference. By discretizing time into time units and calculating the interference within each, we quantitatively characterize how temporal misalignment affects two-photon interference. Using this scheme, we simulate a specific experimental system based on the four-intensity protocol, and through parameter optimization, achieve a higher key rate. The approach thus offers a concrete pathway for enhancing the efficiency in the experimental realization of high-performance systems.

Zhi-Jian Hu, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Wei-Xin Xie, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Fang-Xiang Wang, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/w55c-w4pg

No. 02

强噪声环境下的高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发High-Rate Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution under Intense Noise

★Phys. Rev. Lett.

报道重复频率达2.5 GHz的高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发系统，结合优势蒸馏方法，在425 kHz噪声计数（比隔离环境高4个数量级）下仍能生成安全密钥，30 dB信道衰减时密钥率达到kbps量级，且无需庞大探测装置。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）是通向实用化量子通信的一条有前景的途径，但目前的高性能演示实验往往代价高昂且只能在隔离环境中实现。本文提出一套高速MDI-QKD系统，其重复频率达到前所未有的2.5 GHz，并通过引入优势蒸馏方法验证了其强大的抗噪声能力。该系统在425 kHz噪声计数下仍能高效生成安全密钥，这一噪声水平比隔离系统高4个数量级。在30 dB信道衰减下，无需庞大且资源密集的探测装置即可获得kbps量级的安全密钥率。本工作为QKD的部署确立了一套完整的实用化方案，并解决了长期以来难以实现的难题——构建兼具高安全性、高密钥率、环境鲁棒性和物理紧凑性的实用量子安全网络。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is a promising path toward practical quantum communication, but current high-performance demonstrations come at prohibitive overhead and isolated environments. Here, we present a high-speed MDI-QKD system operating at an unprecedented repetition frequency of 2.5 GHz and verify its strong noise tolerance by incorporating the advantage distillation method. The secure key is efficiently generated under 425 kHz noise counts, which is 4 orders of magnitude higher than isolated systems. A secure key rate with a kbps level is achieved under 30 dB channel attenuation without bulky, resource-intensive detection devices. Our Letter establishes a complete practical solution for QKD deployment and resolves the persistent difficulty of realizing practical quantum secure networks with advanced security, a high key rate, environmental robustness, and physical compactness.

Hong-Wei Li, Wei-Xin Xie, Chun-Mei Zhang, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yu-Long Wang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Letters

10.1103/1b8r-r248

No. 03

面向可扩展量子网络的全无调制器量子密钥分发架构Fully modulator-free architecture for quantum key distribution in scalable quantum networks

提出并实验演示首个全无调制器、全自由度直接调制量子密钥分发架构，利用光注入锁定与相干干涉同时控制相位和强度，30 dB 信道损耗下安全码率 4.78 kbps，与常规调制器系统相当。

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络是迈向未来量子互联网的基础一步，已成为密集研究的焦点。类比经典光网络架构可以看到，高容量骨干网通常依赖复杂的外部调制，而成本敏感的接入层更偏好更简单、更紧凑、更经济的直接调制。作为量子网络的基石，当今 QKD 网络同样具有这种骨干—接入层级结构，然而其实现仍严重依赖外部调制器，使接入层中直接调制 QKD 的生态位明显空缺。在此，我们提出并实验演示了首个填补这一空缺的全无调制器、全自由度直接调制 QKD 架构。发射端将光注入锁定与相干光干涉相结合，无需外部调制器即可同时实现相位与强度控制，从而能够制备任意量子态，并保持与标准时间仓编码接收端的固有兼容性。我们的实验实现采用相对廉价的激光二极管和无源光学元件，在 30 dB 信道损耗下实现 4.78 kbps 的安全密钥率，与传统基于调制器的系统性能相当。通过填补 QKD 生态中长期存在的直接调制生态位，这项工作为接入层部署难题提供了实用解决方案，并为紧凑、可扩展的 QKD 实现开辟了一条可行新方向。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks represent a foundational step toward the future quantum internet and have become a focus of intensive research. By analogy with the architecture of classical optical networks, we can observe that the high-capacity backbone typically relies on complex external modulation, while the cost-sensitive access layer prefers simpler, more compact, and more economical direct modulation. As the cornerstone of quantum networks, today’s QKD networks share this backbone-access hierarchy, yet their implementations remain heavily reliant on external modulators, leaving a clear ecological niche unfilled for directly modulated QKD in the access layer. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate the first fully modulator-free, full-degree-of-freedom direct-modulation QKD architecture that fills this niche. The transmitter combines optical injection locking with coherent optical interference to achieve simultaneous phase and intensity control without external modulators, enabling arbitrary quantum-state preparation while preserving inherent compatibility with standard time-bin-encoding receivers. Built with relatively inexpensive laser diodes and passive optical components, our experimental implementation achieves a secure key rate of 4.78 kbps at 30 dB channel loss, matching the performance of conventional modulator-based systems. By filling the long-standing direct-modulation niche in the QKD ecosystem, this work delivers a practical solution to the access-layer deployment challenge and opens a viable new direction for compact, scalable QKD implementation.

Feng-Yu Lu, Xiao-Juan Huang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Zi-Tao Liu, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
npj Quantum Information

10.1038/s41534-026-01377-x

No. 04

基于自适应子空间划分的高维纠缠量子网络High-dimensional entangled quantum networks with adaptive subspace division

★Optica

在城域规模上构建高维纠缠量子网络，采用偏振—时间戳混合编码与主动相位补偿，使传输距离比以往网络级高维实现提升三个数量级，并可与经典信号共纤共存。

量子通信网络对于安全信息传输和分布式量子技术至关重要。高维纠缠是此类网络的一种有前景的资源，因为它能够提升信息容量并提供更大的潜力。然而，其实际优势尚未得到充分探索，现有演示在现实条件下也未表现出相对于二维网络的明显优势。在此，我们演示了一个具备主动子空间划分功能的城域规模高维纠缠网络，在密钥率、灵活性和抗噪性方面展现出潜在的实际优势。我们采用偏振—时间戳混合编码，在单模光纤信道上分发高维纠缠。其传输距离比以往网络级高维实现提升了三个数量级，同时主动相位补偿支持长期稳定运行。我们的网络还可与经典信号共存，其可重构的子空间划分提供了实用量子网络所需的适应性。这些结果展示了一条通往大规模、高性能量子通信网络的实用路径。

Abstract (English)
Quantum communication networks are essential for secure information transfer and distributed quantum technologies. High-dimensional entanglement is a promising resource for such networks because it can increase the information capacity and offer greater potential. However, its practical advantages have not been fully explored, and existing demonstrations have not shown clear benefits over two-dimensional networks under realistic conditions. Here, we demonstrate a metropolitan-scale high-dimensional entangled network with active subspace division, showing potential practical benefits in key rate, flexibility, and noise resilience. Using hybrid polarization-time-bin encoding, we distribute high-dimensional entanglement over single-mode fiber channels. The transmission distance exceeds previous network-level high-dimensional implementations by three orders of magnitude, while active phase compensation supports long-term stable operation. Our network can also coexist with classical signals, and its reconfigurable subspace division provides the adaptability needed for practical quantum networks. These results show a practical route toward large-scale, high-performance quantum communication networks.

Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Jia-Lin Chen, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optica

10.1364/OPTICA.596777

No. 05

基于弱相干态的相对论位置验证方案Relativistic position verification with coherent states

★Nat. Phys.

在信息论框架下提出并实验实现结合量子光学与相对论的安全位置验证协议，2 km 间距的两位验证者借助相位随机化弱相干态，以优于 75 m 的精度确认证明者位置。

一种确定实体位置的安全方法可以支撑基于位置的交易授权、高价值目标追踪等方案。然而在证明者不可信的情形下，经典方法无法提供安全的位置验证，这意味着证明者可以就其真实位置误导验证者。我们提出并在信息论框架内实验实现了一种将量子光学与相对论相结合的安全位置验证协议。利用相位随机化弱相干态，相距 2 km 的两位验证者以优于 75 m 的精度安全地验证了证明者的位置。这些结果使安全的位置基认证成为实际可能，为金融交易、灾害响应与可认证的安全通信等应用铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A secure approach to determining the position of an entity can enable schemes such as position-based authorization for transactions and tracking of high-value targets. However, classical methods are incapable of providing secure position verification in the untrusted-prover case, meaning that a prover can mislead verifiers about its actual position. Here we propose and experimentally realize a secure position verification protocol that combines quantum optics and relativity within an information-theoretic framework. Using phase-randomized weak coherent states, two verifiers separated by 2 km securely verify the prover’s position with an accuracy better than 75 m. These results establish secure position-based authentication as a practical possibility, paving the way for applications in financial transactions, disaster response and authenticated secure communications.

Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yang-Guang Shan, Cong Zhang, Yu-Long Wang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Wei-Xin Xie, De-Yong He, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Song-Nian Fu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Nature Physics

10.1038/s41567-026-03439-5

No. 06

微梳驱动的大规模全连接量子网络Microcomb-driven large-scale fully connected quantum network

★Nat. Commun.

基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉构建大规模全连接量子网络，利用集成孤子微梳与光子编码芯片实现大规模并行频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉和MDI量子密钥分发，在200 km范围、不可信网络提供商条件下仍保证严格的信息论安全性。

全连接量子网络可使每个用户同时与其他所有用户相连，是一种高度通用且鲁棒的组网架构。然而，此类网络的可扩展性在实用化应用中仍是巨大挑战。本文基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉构建了一个大规模全连接量子网络，即使网络提供商不可信，用户与用户之间的安全性仍能得到保证。利用集成孤子微梳（SMC）和光子编码芯片，我们实现了精确且大规模并行的频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉以及测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发。所提出的架构可在不可信网络提供商的条件下，实现跨越200公里的、具有严格信息论安全性的全连接量子网络。该组网架构为构建覆盖城域与城际的大规模全连接MDI量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Fully connected quantum networks enable simultaneous connection of every user to every other user and are a highly versatile and robust networking architecture. However, the scalability of such networks remains a great challenge for practical applications. Here we construct a large-scale fully connected quantum network founded on two-photon Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference, where user-to-user security is guaranteed even with an untrusted network provider. Using integrated soliton microcomb (SMC) and photonic encoding chips, we realize precise, massively parallel frequency generation and locking, high-visibility HOM interference and measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution. The proposed architecture enables a fully connected quantum network over 200 kilometers with strict information-theoretic security via an untrusted network provider. The implemented networking architecture paves the way for large-scale fully connected MDI quantum networks across metropolitan and intercity regions.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Sheng-Teng Zheng, Long Huang, Guo-Wei Zhang, Guang-Shu Wang, Wen-Jing Ding, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Chang-Ling Zou, Brent E. Little, Guochao Wang, Lingxiao Zhu, Guang-Can Guo, Weiqiang Wang, Wenfu Zhang, Wei Chen, Zheng-Fu Han
Nature Communications

10.1038/s41467-026-75658-6

No. 07

基于纯度约束的可认证量子随机性Certified quantum randomness within purity constraints

★Sci. Adv.

提出一种基于测量不确定性的半器件无关量子随机数生成方案，在纯度约束下估计条件最小熵，无需对光源和测量装置详细建模即可抵御量子攻击，并在商用光纤系统上实现可组合安全的随机性指数扩张。

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）利用量子力学产生真随机性，但实际实现中的器件缺陷可能破坏安全性。我们提出一种基于纯度约束下测量不确定性的半器件无关 QRNG，用于条件最小熵估计。该协议无需对二维光源和可数维测量进行详细建模，并且对测量设备上的量子攻击仍然安全。我们揭示了一种由自然满足的纯度条件产生的隐含不确定性关系，利用测试态定义随机性参数 C，并通过态与测量的酉旋转对称性将其与可提取随机性的解析界联系起来。利用广义熵积累定理，我们将单轮界推广到多轮，并获得对抗相干攻击的可组合安全性。在标准商用光纤系统上实现后，我们的高容错协议实现了指数级安全随机性扩张，并适用于集成光子平台。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) exploit quantum mechanics to produce true randomness, but practical implementations suffer from device imperfections that can compromise security. We propose a semi–device-independent QRNG based on measurement uncertainty under purity constraints for conditional min-entropy estimation. Our protocol requires no detailed modeling of the two-dimensional source and the countable-dimensional measurement and remains secure against quantum attacks on measurement devices. We uncover an implicit uncertainty relation arising from naturally satisfied purity conditions, define a randomness parameter C using test states, and connect it to an analytical bound on extractable randomness via unitary rotation symmetries of states and measurements. Using the generalized entropy accumulation theorem, we extend the single-round bound to multirounds and obtain composable security against coherent attacks. Implemented on a standard commercial fiber system, our high-tolerance protocol achieves exponential secure randomness expansion and is suitable for integrated-photonic platforms.

Xing Lin, Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang
Science Advances

10.1126/sciadv.aec2555

No. 08

基于后处理时域滤波的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution based on postprocessing time-domain filtering

提出无需额外硬件的时域后处理滤波方案，抑制宣布式单光子源中光子对频谱关联对 HOM 干涉可见度的损害，通过优化滤波器宽度同时提升密钥率与最大传输距离，并可推广至量子隐形传态等协议。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）消除了所有探测器端的漏洞。与弱相干脉冲相比，宣布式单光子源（HSPS）能够标示光子的存在，从而延长 MDI-QKD 的可达距离，并使被动诱骗态实现和量子存储辅助构型等先进协议成为可能。然而在实际中，HSPS 中光子对之间的频谱关联会降低 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉的可见度。尽管窄带滤波可以抑制这一效应，但它依赖专用硬件且缺乏灵活性。在此，我们提出一种基于时域后处理滤波技术的 MDI-QKD 方案，该方案不需要额外硬件，显著提高了密钥率和最大传输距离。通过优化滤波器宽度，该方法可以灵活适应光源或信道的变化。此外，它还可以方便地推广到其他依赖 HOM 干涉的协议，包括量子隐形传态和纠缠交换。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) eliminates all detector-side vulnerabilities. Compared to weak coherent pulses, heralded single-photon sources (HSPSs) signal the presence of photons, thereby extending the achievable distance of MDI-QKD and enabling advanced protocols such as passive decoy-state implementations and quantum-memory-assisted configurations. In practice, however, spectral correlations between photon pairs in HSPS degrade Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference visibility. Although narrowband filtering can suppress this effect, it relies on dedicated hardware and lacks flexibility. Here, we propose an MDI-QKD scheme based on a time-domain postprocessing filtering technique that requires no additional hardware, significantly improving both the key rate and the maximum transmission distance. By optimizing the filter width, this method flexibly adapts to variations in the source or channel. Furthermore, it can be readily extended to other protocols relying on HOM interference, including quantum teleportation and entanglement swapping.

量子密钥分发（QKD）是实现信息论安全通信的一项有前景的技术。QKD 系统的实用性对大规模网络部署至关重要，既需要高密钥生成速率，也需要用于量子态制备与探测的小型化模块。在此我们报道了一套可部署的 QKD 系统，在 10 km 处实现 60.33 ± 0.03 Mbps、在 100 km 处实现 3.08 ± 0.20 Mbps 的安全密钥速率。该系统集成了一个双并联马赫–曾德尔编码器，在紧凑设计中通过单步调制实现对偏振态与诱骗态的高保真、统一制备。同时，我们研制了工作在 2.5 GHz 的小型化单光子雪崩探测器，在保持低噪声的同时实现了高计数率。这一高性能且紧凑的方案为需要高容量与高带宽的城市安全通信网络确立了一条可行的路线。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a promising technology for information-theoretic secure communications. The practicality of QKD systems is critical for large-scale network deployment, requiring both high key generation rate and miniaturized modules for quantum-state preparation and detection. Here, we report a deployable QKD system that achieves secure key rates of 60.33 ± 0.03 Mbps at 10 km and 3.08 ± 0.20 Mbps at 100 km. The system integrates a dual-parallel Mach–Zehnder encoder to achieve high-fidelity, unified preparation of polarization and decoy states via single-step modulation in a compact design. Meanwhile, we developed miniaturized single-photon avalanche detectors operating at 2.5 GHz, achieving high count rates while maintaining low noise. This high-performance and compact solution establishes a feasible roadmap for urban secure communication networks that require high capacity and bandwidth.

Polarization-insensitive photonic devices are essential for mitigating the adverse effects of random polarization evolution during photon transmission and implementing robust quantum manipulation of light. In this work, we design and demonstrate a polarization-insensitive Mach–Zehnder interferometer (MZI) on a nitride platform with the thickness of 650 nm. We design the device by adopting a particle-swarm-optimized multimode interferometer with tailored edge shapes and sub-wavelength grating structures, combined with a segmented width-varied waveguide design in the interferometer arms to compensate for their intrinsic material birefringences. The experimental results of the fabricated MZI maintain a single-photon interference visibility about 98.7% even under active polarization scrambling, while a polarization-dependent loss &lt; 0.3 dB over a 147 nm 1 dB bandwidth has been achieved. These properties make it a promising component for integrated quantum photonic systems such as quantum key distribution.

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides information-theoretic security based on quantum mechanics, yet its implementation is hindered by source imperfections. Among these, correlations between transmitted pulses present a critical but underexplored threat to QKD’s theoretical security. We propose a general framework for QKD security under correlated sources, achieving the first finite-key analysis by extending and reorganizing QKD rounds using the generalized chain rule. Inspired by side-channel-secure QKD, we design a protocol secure against correlated leakage sources, requiring only the correlation range and lower bounds on the vacuum component of the prepared states. Our framework also applies to other QKD protocols, providing a general approach to address correlation-induced vulnerabilities. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of our protocol and its significantly superior tolerance to imperfections compared to existing protocols. This work provides a crucial step toward closing security loopholes in QKD, enhancing its practicality, and ensuring long-distance, high-performance secure communication under real-world constraints.

线宽是反映单频激光器相干性的关键参数。由白噪声贡献的线宽已得到广泛研究，而非白噪声（主要是闪烁噪声）的影响却难以评估。然而，闪烁噪声可造成远大于洛伦兹分量的线宽展宽。考虑到干涉可见度可以作为相位噪声大小的有效指标，本工作将闪烁噪声量化为高斯线宽，并分析干涉可见度与激光线宽之间的关系。我们发现可见度的对数与延时呈二次依赖关系：线性项源于白噪声，二次项则来自闪烁噪声。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种同时测量洛伦兹线宽与高斯线宽的方法。该方法不仅避免了闪烁噪声对洛伦兹线宽测量的干扰，还提供了一种便捷的方式来评估闪烁噪声的大小。此外，该方法有效降低了线宽测量实验对延时光纤长度的依赖，较短的光纤有助于减小环境扰动。更重要的是，高斯线宽的引入为激光线宽提供了更全面的表征。

Abstract (English)
Linewidth is a key parameter reflecting the coherence of single-frequency lasers. While the linewidth contributed by white noise has been widely studied, the effect of nonwhite noise, mainly flicker noise, is hard to evaluate. However, flicker noise can cause linewidth broadening much larger than the Lorentzian component. Considering that interference visibility can serve as an effective indicator of phase noise magnitude, in this work, we quantify flicker noise as Gaussian linewidth and analyze the relation between interference visibility and laser linewidth. We find that the logarithm of visibility depends quadratically on the delay: the linear term is due to white noise, and the quadratic term arises from flicker noise. Based on this finding, we propose a method to simultaneously measure Lorentzian and Gaussian linewidths. This approach not only avoids flicker noise interference in Lorentzian linewidth measurements but also provides a convenient way to assess the magnitude of flicker noise. In addition, this approach effectively reduces the dependence of the linewidth measurement experiment on the length of the delay fiber, with shorter fibers helping to minimize environmental disturbances. More importantly, the introduction of the Gaussian linewidth provides a more comprehensive characterization of the laser linewidth.

Abstract (English)
Currently, quantum-key-distribution (QKD) systems are evolving toward high-speed implementations to meet the demands of large-scale data encryption. High-performance, high-speed gated single-photon detectors (SPDs) are essential for enabling such systems. However, the practical security of these detectors remains a critical concern. Recently, an attack targeting high-speed sine-gated SPDs was reported, in which the detector was blinded by deceiving the width discrimination mechanism. Inspired by this work, we further optimize the attack strategy by customizing the blinding pulse and modifying the temporal offset between the blinding pulse and the gate signal, thereby achieving a more effective attack. Experimental and simulation results show that in short-distance communication scenarios, the additional quantum bit error rate (QBER) introduced by our proposed attack strategy is less than 0.5%. Of note, we propose and evaluate three practical countermeasures to defend against such attacks, which include auxiliary conventional discrimination monitoring, avalanche current monitoring, and temporal distribution analysis of detection events. These defense strategies enhance the robustness of high-speed SPDs and contribute to the development of more secure and reliable QKD systems.

Abstract (English)
The quantum internet promises unparalleled capabilities that are provably impossible with the classical internet. However, current quantum networks are often designed with dedicated systems for specified tasks, which hinders the openness and diversity of future quantum internet. To address these limitations, this work proposes a fully heterogeneous quantum network accompanied with several techniques. Our proposal allows users to access the network using any mainstream systems or even partial systems. The network also enables the execution of multiple distinct quantum tasks and provides opportunities for global optimization and cost-efficient design. A five-node quantum network featuring heterogeneous nodes has been implemented, demonstrating the superiority of our proposal through tasks such as quantum key distribution, quantum digital signature, quantum Byzantine agreement, and quantum conference. Notably, the experiment represents the first demonstration of multi-malicious node quantum Byzantine agreement in a quantum network. This work proposed a fully heterogeneous quantum network that connects diverse user systems and enables multiple quantum tasks. A software-defined quantum network structure is also proposed for coordinating network nodes and optimizing network performance. It paves the way for an open and versatile quantum internet.

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的用户之间能够生成安全密钥。然而，由于实际器件无法以完美精度工作，在真实QKD实现中实现无条件安全仍然是一项挑战。侧信道安全（SCS）QKD为同时实现高实际安全性和高性能提供了良好的解决方案。它保留了测量设备无关的优点，而在源端只需给出各态真空投影概率的上界。然而，SCS QKD针对一般相干攻击的安全性证明具有挑战性。基于后选择方法的现有分析性能较差。为克服这一缺陷，我们不再直接用后选择方法计算密钥率，而是提出一种方法，将相位误差估计在集体攻击与相干攻击下的失败概率相互关联，从而能够在针对相干攻击的参数估计中使用独立同分布假设。我们的仿真表明，我们给出的性能优于先前的分析。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables the generation of secure keys between two distant users. However, since practical devices cannot operate with perfect accuracy, achieving unconditional security in real-world QKD implementations remains a challenge. Side-channel-secure (SCS) QKD gives a good solution to realize both high practical security and performance. It keeps the advantage of measurement-device-independent, and for the source part, it only requires to upper bound the vacuum projecting probability of the states. However, security proof for SCS QKD against general coherent attacks is challenging. The existing analysis based on postselection method gives a bad performance. To overcome this drawback, instead of directly calculating key rate with postselection method, we propose a method correlating the failure probabilities of phase-error estimation against collective and coherent attacks, enabling the usage of the independent and identically distributed assumption in parameter estimation against coherent attacks. Our simulation shows that we give a better performance than previous analysis.

基于非对称光源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with asymmetric sources

提出非对称光源下MDI-QKD的性能分析理论，可处理单模与多时间模情形；以弱相干脉冲和自发参量下转换光源为例建模，发现密钥率在整个研究距离内并不因光源非对称而下降。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）消除了窃听者对测量方的所有攻击，一直被认为是实现端到端量子网络最有前景的技术之一。在实际中，光源与信道的非对称性通常是不可避免的。为此，我们提出一种理论，用于分析网络中任意两个MDI用户使用处于不同单模或多时间模的非对称光源进行通信时的性能。作为一个具体应用，我们对使用弱相干脉冲光源和自发参量下转换光源的MDI QKD进行建模并获得其密钥率，且将其与对称（即完全相同）光源情形下的性能进行比较。结果表明，实际性能并不会因光源的非对称性而下降；相反，在我们所研究的整个距离范围内，它都保持在良好水平。该工作为分析和优化具有非对称光源的MDI-QKD网络提供了理论基础，从而为完全非对称MDI-QKD网络的实际部署铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD), which eliminates all the attacks from the eavesdropper to the measurement party, has been one of the most promising technologies for the implementation of end-to-end quantum networks. In practice, the asymmetry of both sources and channels is generally inevitable. Therefore, we propose a theory to analyze the performance when any two MDI users in networks communicate using asymmetric sources in distinct single or multiple temporal modes. As a specific application, we model to obtain the key rate of MDI QKD with a weak-coherent pulse source and a spontaneous parametric down-conversion source, and compare the performance to the cases with symmetric (i.e., identical) sources. The result demonstrates that the actual performance does not degrade due to the asymmetry of sources. On the contrary, it maintains at a good level over the entire distance we study. This work provides a theoretical basis for analyzing and optimizing MDI-QKD networks with asymmetric sources, thus paving the way for the practical deployment of completely asymmetric MDI-QKD networks.

Jia-Ju Deng, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1103/zw9s-ywd6

No. 04

时间编码量子密钥分发系统的真实探测器模型Realistic detector model for a time-bin-encoding quantum key distribution system

建立了时间编码量子密钥分发系统中探测器的真实响应模型，可准确预测增益、刻画早晚时间格之间的相关性，并据此获得更高的安全密钥率。

鉴于单光子雪崩探测器日益广泛的应用，后脉冲的存在使死时间不可避免。死时间是影响量子密钥分发（QKD）计数率与安全密钥率（SKR）的关键因素。这一问题在时间编码系统中尤为突出，而此前的模型无法准确估计增益。值得注意的是，它引入了早时间格与晚时间格之间的相关性，从而产生强相关比特并带来安全风险。在此，我们提出了一个能够精确刻画时间编码系统中探测器响应的真实模型。该模型不仅提高了增益预测的准确性，与蒙特卡罗模拟结果吻合良好，还为数据处理提供了理论支撑，有助于缓解安全风险。最后，借助我们的模型，我们可以获得远高于先前模型的安全密钥率，并通过调节探测器参数进一步提升实际QKD系统的性能。我们的模拟结果表明，该模型对于QKD系统在实践中的应用与部署至关重要。

Abstract (English)
In light of the growing widely utilized single-photon avalanche detectors, dead time is inevitable due to the presence of afterpulse. Dead time is a critical factor that influences the count rate and the secret key rate (SKR) of quantum key distribution (QKD). It is particularly significant in time-bin-encoding systems, while prior models fail to accurately estimate the gains. Of note, it introduces correlations between early bins and late bins, hence bits with strong correlation and security risks. Here, we put forward a realistic model that precisely characterizes the response of detectors for time-bin-encoding systems. Our model not only improves the accuracy of gain predictions, showing an excellent match with the Monte Carlo simulation results, but also provides theoretical support for data processing, helping to mitigate security risks. Finally, leveraging our model, we can get a much higher SKR than prior models and further enhance the performance of practical QKD systems by adjusting the detector parameters. Our simulation results demonstrate that our model is essential for the application and deployment of QKD systems in practice.

Xiao-Juan Huang, Ze-Hao Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Jiaqi Geng, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yu Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.23.054071

No. 05

基于量子比特的测量设备无关量子密钥分发同步算法Qubit-Based Synchronization Algorithm for Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution

利用 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉特性，在没有额外硬件的情况下实现 MDI-QKD 各方之间的时钟同步，显著降低同步复杂度与成本，有望加速其实际部署。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）因其高性能与安全性被认为是最有前景的协议之一。要在实际中搭建 MDI-QKD 系统，时钟同步是正确生成密钥的关键步骤。然而，随着实际应用的推进，同步的复杂度与成本已成为 MDI-QKD 实施中的重大挑战。本研究提出一种专为 MDI-QKD 设计的基于量子比特的同步算法。利用 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉的特性，我们在无需额外硬件的情况下实现了 MDI-QKD 各方之间的时钟同步。该方法的经济性与简洁性有望显著促进 MDI-QKD 的实际部署。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is considered one of the most promising protocols due to its high performance and security. To implement the MDI-QKD system in practice, clock synchronization is a crucial step to correctly generate the secret keys. However, as practical applications advance, the complexity and cost of synchronization have become significant challenges for the implementation of MDI-QKD. In this study, we introduce a qubit-based synchronization algorithm specifically designed for MDI-QKD. By utilizing the property of Hong-Ou-Mandel interference, we achieve clock synchronization between parties of MDI-QKD without the need for additional hardware. The cost-effectiveness and simplicity of this approach are expected to significantly facilitate the practical deployment of MDI-QKD.

Zheng-Kai Huang, Jia-Xuan Li, Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1109/JLT.2024.3520212

No. 06

飞秒脉冲注入硅光调制器对量子密钥分发安全性的影响Effect of femtosecond-pulse-injection silicon photonic modulators on the security of quantum key distribution

首次揭示硅光强度调制器中的双光子吸收会给窃听者留下可乘之机：实验上通过外部注入飞秒脉冲改变诱骗态强度，使合法方按安全证明预估的密钥率被高估，为集成QKD系统的设计与标准化提供安全性考量。

集成光子学在量子通信器件中发挥着关键作用，具有出色的鲁棒性、可扩展性和性能。硅光子学技术的日益成熟为量子密钥分发（QKD）的小型化和低成本实现提供了巨大潜力。虽然铌酸锂调制器在QKD系统中的实际安全性已被广泛研究，但硅光调制器采用了新的调制机制，因而有必要深入研究其对QKD系统安全性的影响。我们首次揭示，硅光强度调制器中的双光子吸收效应会引入漏洞，使窃听者（Eve）能够对QKD系统实施恶意攻击。通过实验演示，我们表明，借助外部注入飞秒脉冲，Eve可以操控合法用户发送的诱骗态的强度。基于实验结果，我们发现，在存在该攻击的情况下，合法用户会持续高估安全证明所预测的密钥率。我们的工作是对集成QKD系统设计与标准化的一个新安全性层面的初步探索。

Abstract (English)
Integrated photonics plays a pivotal role in quantum communication devices, offering exceptional robustness, scalability, and performance. The growing maturity of silicon photonics technology offers significant potential for miniaturization and cost-effective implementation of quantum key distribution (QKD). While the practical security of lithium niobate modulators in QKD systems has been extensively examined, the adoption of a new modulation mechanism by silicon photonic modulators necessitates a thorough investigation into their impact on the security of QKD systems. For the first time, we reveal that the two-photon absorption effect in silicon photonic intensity modulators will introduce vulnerabilities, enabling an eavesdropper (Eve) to execute malicious attacks on QKD systems. Through experimental demonstration, we show that by externally injecting femtosecond pulses, Eve can manipulate the intensities of decoy states sent by legitimate users. Based on the experimental results, we find that in the presence of the attack, legitimate users consistently overestimate the secret key rate predicted by the security proof. Our work represents an initial exploration into a new security aspect for the design and standardization of integrated QKD systems.

Xiang Kang, Peng Ye, Shuang Wang, Guo-Wei Zhang, Ze-Hao Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

提出了一种新型连续变量量子无源光网络，其中用户可以通过信任其他用户来提高自己的密钥率。这是因为，原本为消除与不可信用户之间的关联而需要丢弃的密钥，在用户可信时可以保留下来。这为提升网络性能提供了新的视角。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A novel continuous-variable quantum passive optical network is proposed in which a user can increase their key rate by trusting other users. This is because the keys, which would be discarded to remove correlations with untrusted users, can be retained when the users are trusted. It provides a new perspective for enhancing network performance.

No. 01

直流至1 GHz门频可调的低噪声InGaAs/InP单光子探测器Low noise InGaAs/InP single-photon detector with DC to 1  GHz tunable gate frequency

提出残余噪声辅助的甄别方法，使雪崩信号最大幅度与残余噪声峰值对齐，实现从直流到1 GHz可调门频，20%效率下暗计数约每门5.0×10⁻⁷、后脉冲低于1.0%。

铟镓砷/磷化铟（InGaAs/InP）单光子探测器（SPD）通常工作在门控模式，但单光子雪崩二极管的电容响应会引入尖峰噪声，掩盖雪崩信号。大多数雪崩信号甄别方案无法完全消除尖峰噪声，从而留下残余噪声。受残余噪声限制，这些方案噪声较大且频率调节范围有限。然而，对于量子密钥分发和激光测距等应用而言，低噪声、频率可调的InGaAs/InP SPD对提升系统性能至关重要。在此，我们提出了一种（残余噪声辅助的）甄别方法，使雪崩信号的最大幅度与残余噪声的峰值对齐。该方法将残余噪声从不利因素转变为信号甄别的优势。利用该方法，我们实现了从直流到1 GHz的可调门控频率。此外，该方法能够甄别微弱雪崩信号，使得在低雪崩增益下也能有效进行单光子探测。在整个调谐范围内，在20%探测效率下，暗计数率约为每门5.0×10⁻⁷，后脉冲概率低于1.0%，显著低于以往的实验结果。所提出的SPD具有低噪声和宽可调门控频率范围，为各类应用提供了可靠基础。

Abstract (English)
An InGaAs/InP single-photon detector (SPD) typically operates in gated mode, but the capacitive response of a single-photon avalanche diode introduces spike noise, obscuring the avalanche signal. Most avalanche signal discrimination schemes cannot completely eliminate spike noise, resulting in residual noise. Limited by residual noise, these schemes have large noise and a limited frequency tuning range. However, for applications like quantum key distribution and laser ranging, a low noise, frequency-tunable InGaAs/InP SPD is crucial for enhancing system performance. Here, we propose a (residual noise assisted) discrimination method that aligns the maximum amplitude of the avalanche signal with the peak of the residual noise. This method turns the residual noise from adversity into an advantage for signal discrimination. With this method, we achieve tunable gating frequency from DC to 1 GHz. Additionally, this method enables the discrimination of weak avalanche signals, allowing effective single-photon detection at low avalanche gain. Across the entire tuning range, at a 20% detection efficiency, the dark count rate is approximately 5.0×10 −7 per gate, and the afterpulse probability is less than 1.0%, significantly lower than in previous experiments. The proposed SPD exhibits low noise and a wide tunable gating frequency range, providing a reliable foundation for various applications.

Jia-Lin Chen, De-Yong He, Shuang Wang, Ying-Liang Shi, Jia-Qi Geng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

利用频率噪声功率谱密度估计激光积分线宽的理论分析Theoretical analysis for estimating laser integrated linewidth via frequency-noise power spectral density

从理论上说明用频率噪声功率谱密度估计积分线宽的合理性，指出以往方法源于高斯近似并给出更一般的结果；提出 Voigt 近似法使估计误差低于 5%，并建立干涉可见度与线宽的关系。

激光线宽的测量在计量学、相干光通信、高分辨率传感和激光雷达中具有重要意义。首先，本研究从理论上解释了为何通过频率噪声功率谱密度（PSD）估计积分线宽是有效的。我们发现，以往通过频率噪声 PSD 估计积分线宽的方法源自高斯近似，并由此得到了更一般的结果。其次，依据该理论，我们提出 Voigt 近似方法以提升估计性能。仿真结果表明，Voigt 近似的估计误差低于 5%。最后，基于 Voigt 近似，我们发现了干涉可见度与激光线宽之间的关系，为测量线宽提供了一种可能的便捷途径。

Abstract (English)
The measurement of a laser linewidth is significant in metrology, coherent optical communications, high-resolution sensing, and LIDAR. Firstly, in this study, we theoretically explain why estimating an integrated linewidth via a frequency-noise power spectral density (PSD) is valid. We find that the previous methods estimating the integrated linewidth via the frequency-noise PSD result from Gaussian approximation and obtain a more general consequence. Secondly, according to the theory, we propose the Voigt approximation method to improve the estimation performance. The simulation results show the Voigt approximation estimation error is lower than 5%. Finally, based on the Voigt approximation, the relationship between the interference visibility and laser linewidth is found, providing a possible convenient approach to measuring the linewidth.

Jian-Yu Ma, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 03

时间仓纠缠可见度优化的理论模型Model for optimizing the visibility of time-bin entanglement

建立可准确描述时间仓纠缠双光子干涉的有效模型，用以定位干涉可见度下降的原因并给出优化实验的策略，并经实验验证。

时间仓纠缠因其在长距离信道上的优异鲁棒性，是量子信息科学中的关键资源。实现高的量子干涉可见度对于基础研究和实际应用都不可或缺。迄今为止，能够准确描述基于时间仓纠缠的双光子干涉的模型仍有待建立。本工作分析了这类干涉的内在机制，并建立了一个可在实验上优化量子干涉可见度的有效模型。我们利用该模型分析了导致干涉可见度下降的各项因素，提出了应对这些问题的策略，并通过实验证明了模型的有效性。该模型可作为基于时间仓纠缠的系统的工具，用于辅助系统设计、预期结果评估以及实验装置优化。

Abstract (English)
Time-bin entanglement is a critical resource in quantum information science owing to its exceptional robustness over long-distance channels. Achieving high quantum interference visibility is indispensable for fundamental research and practical applications. To date, a model that can accurately describe time-bin entanglement-based two-photon interference remains to be established. In this work, we analyze the underlying mechanisms for this type of interference and develop an effective model for experimentally optimizing the quantum interference visibility. We use this model to analyze the factors contributing to the decline in interference visibility and offer strategies to address these issues, and we also demonstrate its effectiveness through experiments. Our model can serve as a tool for time-bin entanglement-based systems, aiding in system design, the evaluation of expected outcomes, and the optimization of experimental setups.

No. 04

离散相位随机化BB84协议的有限密钥分析Finite key analysis for discrete phase randomized BB84 protocol

针对离散相位随机化BB84协议缺乏有限脉冲数安全性分析的问题，给出两种条件下的安全性分析与参数优化，确认相位数超过30时可按连续相位随机化估算密钥率，相位较少时给出数值方法，性能略降但仍可接受。

量子密钥分发（QKD）是一种依赖量子力学内禀随机性来保证信息论安全性的安全通信方法。BB84是最早也是应用最广泛的QKD协议，其安全性证明至关重要。离散相位随机化BB84协议是诱骗态BB84协议的一种变体，已被证明在高速度QKD系统的发展中具有前景。然而，它仍然缺乏针对有限脉冲数的分析。本文对离散相位BB84协议进行了全面的安全性分析，在不同条件下使用两种不同的方法。分析包括仿真与优化，以确定最佳参数设置。研究确认，对于典型场景，如果离散相位的数量超过30，就可以假定运行的是连续相位随机化过程来计算密钥率。另一方面，对于相对较少的离散取值，我们发展了一种数值方法来计算密钥率。我们确认，在有限脉冲数下其性能有所下降，但仍然可以接受。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a secure communication method that relies on the inherent randomness of quantum mechanics to ensure information-theoretic security. The first and most widely used QKD protocol is BB84, and the proof of BB84's security is vital. The Discrete Phase Randomized BB84 protocol is a variant of the decoy BB84 protocol. It has been proven to be promising in the development of high-speed QKD systems. However, it still lacks an analysis with a finite number of pulses. This paper presents a comprehensive security analysis of the discrete phase BB84 protocol, using two different methods under different conditions. The analysis involves simulations and optimizations to determine the optimal parameter settings. It is confirmed that for typical scenarios, if the number of discrete phases exceeds 30, one can calculate the key rate by assuming that a continuous phase randomization process was in operation. On the other hand, for a relatively smaller number of discrete values, we have developed a numerical method to calculate the key rate. We have confirmed that its performance is reduced but still acceptable with a finite number of pulses.

Xiao-Hang Jin, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 05

基于相位后选择的发送或不发送量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending quantum key distribution with phase postselection

该工作在SNS协议中引入相位后选择，大幅提高了选择「发送」的概率；数值模拟显示，无论是否采用主动奇偶配对方法，传输距离都能提升，离散相位随机化下也有类似改善。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可以帮助两个相距遥远的通信方共享安全密钥。近年来，双场（TF）QKD因其长传输距离而受到广泛研究。TF QKD的一个流行变体是发送或不发送（SNS）QKD，实验上已被验证可实现千公里级光纤密钥分发。本文将相位后选择引入SNS协议。通过这一改动，选择「发送」的概率可以大幅提高。数值模拟表明，无论是否采用主动奇偶配对方法，传输距离都能得到提升。文中还分析了离散相位随机化的情形，同样可以看到距离上的类似改善。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) could help to share a secure key between two distant peers. In recent years, twin-field (TF) QKD has been widely investigated because of its long transmission distance. One of the popular variants of TF QKD is sending-or-not-sending (SNS) QKD, which has been experimentally verified to realize 1000-km level fiber key distribution. In this article, we introduce phase postselection into the SNS protocol. With this modification, the probability of selecting ``sending'' can be substantially improved. The numerical simulation shows that the transmission distance can be improved both with and without the actively odd-parity pairing method. The case of discrete phase randomization is also analyzed, a similar improvement on distance can be seen.

50 km 含噪光纤信道上的超纠缠量子通信Hyperentanglement quantum communication over a 50  km noisy fiber channel

利用偏振与时间片超纠缠实现高维编码，在 50 km 含噪光纤信道上完成高维纠缠量子密钥分发，安全密钥率与噪声容限均显著优于量子比特方案。

高维纠缠不仅能为量子通信提供更高的安全等级，还有望提升系统的信息容量与抗噪声能力。然而，由于不同高维自由度各自受到多种限制，这些优势能否在实际实现中带来改善仍缺乏充分证明。我们提出一种在长距离含噪光纤信道上充分利用这些优势的方案。我们利用偏振与时间片超纠缠实现高维编码，并观测到安全密钥率与噪声容限的显著提升，超越了量子比特系统的能力。此外，该演示实现了最远 50 km 的分发距离，据我们所知，这是迄今基于高维纠缠的量子密钥分发所达到的最长距离。该工作验证了高维纠缠在长距离含噪信道量子通信中的潜力，为构建鲁棒且资源高效的量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
High-dimensional entanglement not only offers a high security level for quantum communication but also promises improved information capacity and noise resistance of the system. However, due to various constraints on different high-dimensional degrees of freedom, whether these advantages can bring improvement to the actual implementation is still not well proven. Here we present a scheme to fully utilize these advantages over long-distance noisy fiber channels. We exploit polarization and time-bin hyperentanglement to achieve high-dimensional coding, and observe significant enhancements in secure key rates and noise tolerance that surpass the capabilities of qubit systems. Moreover, the demonstration achieves a distribution up to 50 km, which is the longest distance for high-dimensional entanglement-based quantum key distribution up to date, to our knowledge. Our demonstration validates the potential of high-dimensional entanglement for quantum communications over long-distance noisy channels, paving the way for a resilient and resource-efficient quantum network.

Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Jia-Lin Chen, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Jia-Qi Geng, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optica

No. 07

相位编码双场量子密钥分发安全性分析的改进Improved security analysis for phase-encoding twin-field quantum key distribution

借鉴发送或不发送协议分别计算正确轮与错误轮信息泄漏的思路，改进相位匹配双场量子密钥分发的安全性分析，在无需改动实验的前提下延长传输距离，并推广至四相位部分相位后选择协议。

双场（TF）量子密钥分发（QKD）因其长传输距离而得到广泛研究。相位编码TF-QKD能够同时实现高密钥率和长传输距离，因而备受关注。在本文中，我们受到发送或不发送TF-QKD的启发，该协议分别计算正确轮和错误轮的信息泄漏；同时我们注意到这类方法已被用于许多QKD协议，例如六态QKD。我们将类似的方法应用于相位匹配TF-QKD，并发现其性能有所提升。在新的分析下，无需对实验做任何改动即可提升传输距离。我们还将新的分析应用于四相位部分相位后选择协议，同样可以获得类似的提升。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field (TF) quantum key distribution (QKD) has been extensively researched because of its long transmission distance. The phase-encoding TF-QKD can realize both a high key rate and a long transmission distance, so it has attracted a lot of attention. In this article, we are inspired by the sending-or-not-sending TF-QKD, in which the information leakages of correct rounds and erroneous rounds are calculated separately. And, we notice that this kind of method has been used in many QKD protocols---for example, the six-state QKD. We apply a similar method to the phase-matching TF-QKD and find some improvement in it. With the new analysis, the transmission distance can be improved without any changes in experiments. We also apply the new analysis in the four-phase partial-phase-postselection protocol, and a similar improvement can be achieved.

Yang-Guang Shan, Yao Zhou, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1103/PhysRevA.110.012450

No. 08

全被动测量设备无关量子密钥分发Fully passive measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

提出全被动测量设备无关量子密钥分发方案，用线性光学同时实现被动编码与被动诱骗态调制，可同时抵御光源调制器边信道与测量设备攻击，并给出被动编码策略、诱骗态分析方法及渐近密钥率仿真。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）能够抵御针对探测设备的所有攻击，但源端仍存在一些安全性问题。一种可能的解决方案是采用被动协议，以消除源端主动调制器引入的边信道。最近，有人提出了一种全被动QKD协议，可以利用线性光学同时实现被动编码和被动诱骗态调制。在本工作中，我们提出了一种全被动MDIQKD方案，能够使系统同时免受源调制器的边信道和测量设备攻击，从而显著提高QKD系统的实现安全性。我们给出了具体的被动编码策略和诱骗态分析方法，随后给出了渐近情形下安全密钥率的仿真结果。我们的工作为提高QKD系统的实现安全性提供了一条可行途径，并为利用实际器件实现被动QKD方案提供了参考。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) can resist all attacks on the detection devices, but there are still some security issues related to the source side. One possible solution is to use the passive protocol to eliminate the side channels introduced by active modulators at the source. Recently, a fully passive QKD protocol was proposed that could simultaneously achieve passive encoding and passive decoy-state modulation using linear optics. In this work, we propose a fully passive MDIQKD scheme that can protect the system from both side channels of source modulators and attacks on the measurement devices, which can significantly improve the implementation security of the QKD systems. We provide a specific passive encoding strategy and a method for decoy-state analysis, followed by simulation results for the secure key rate in the asymptotic scenario. Our work offers a feasible way to improve the implementation security of QKD systems and serves as a reference for achieving passive QKD schemes using realistic devices.

Xiang Wang, Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Jia-Qi Geng, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

No. 09

用于高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发的稳定波长可调多波长激光器Stable and wavelength-tunable multiwavelength laser for high-rate measurement device independent quantum key distribution

研制出输出波长覆盖1270至1610 nm的稳定可调多波长激光器，通过精密温控与稳定驱动电流被动锁定波长，显著降低误码率，使安全密钥率较以往实验近乎翻倍。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）因其对测量单元攻击的免疫性而受到越来越多的关注，但其独特结构限制了安全密钥率。利用波分复用（WDM）技术并降低误码率是提高安全密钥率的有效策略。降低误码率通常需要利用精确的外部参考对波长进行主动反馈控制。然而，对于多波长激光器而言，采用多个参考来稳定每一路波长输出对参考提出了严苛要求，并显著增加了系统复杂度。本文展示了一台稳定的、波长可调的多波长激光器，输出波长范围覆盖1270至1610 nm。通过精确的温度控制和稳定的驱动电流，我们被动锁定激光波长，实现了优异的波长稳定性。这显著降低了误码率，使安全密钥率相较以往实验几乎翻倍。此外，我们的多波长激光器所提供的优异波长稳定性与WDM技术相结合，进一步提升了MDI QKD的安全密钥率。凭借5.1 nm的宽波长调谐范围，该多波长激光器可灵活工作在多个密集波分复用信道。结合高波长稳定性和多波长同时输出，该激光器为高速MDI QKD系统提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

Abstract (English)
Measurement device independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) has attracted growing attention for its immunity to attacks at the measurement unit, but its unique structure limits the secret key rate. Utilizing the wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) technique and reducing error rates are effective strategies for enhancing the secret key rate. Reducing error rates often requires active feedback control of wavelengths using precise external references. However, for a multiwavelength laser, employing multiple references to stabilize each wavelength output places stringent demands on these references and significantly increases system complexity. Here, we demonstrate a stable, wavelength-tunable multiwavelength laser with an output wavelength ranging from 1270 to 1610 nm. Through precise temperature control and stable drive current, we passively lock the laser wavelength, achieving remarkable wavelength stability. This significantly reduce the error rate, leading to an almost doubling of the secret key rate compared to previous experiments. Furthermore, the exceptional wavelength stability offered by our multiwavelength laser, combined with the WDM technique, has further boosted the secret key rate of MDI QKD. With a wide wavelength tuning range of 5.1 nm, our multiwavelength laser facilitates flexible operation across multiple dense wavelength division multiplexing channels. Coupled with high wavelength stability and multiple wavelength outputs simultaneously, this laser offers a promising solution for a high-rate MDI QKD system.

Jia-Lin Chen, De-Yong He, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Wen-Jing Ding, Jia-Qi Geng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

模拟动态散射信道中的量子密钥分发Quantum key distribution over a mimicked dynamic-scattering channel

利用快速波前整形技术在模拟动态散射信道中提升量子密钥分发性能，使量子传输效率平均提高10 dB，并成功建立起安全的量子链路。

自由空间量子密钥分发（QKD）在全球量子网络中发挥着重要作用。然而，自由空间信道会受到大气湍流以及霾、雾、尘等散射效应的影响，这些效应会显著削弱QKD的性能，甚至阻断安全的量子链路。在此，我们证明：利用快速波前整形技术，可以显著提升QKD在动态散射信道上的性能。该系统使量子传输效率平均获得10 dB的提升，并建立起用于QKD的安全量子链路。我们的工作证明了在自由空间动态散射信道中实现QKD的可行性，并增强了复杂信道QKD系统的部署能力。

Abstract (English)
Free-space quantum key distribution (QKD) plays an important role in the global quantum network. However, free space channels suffer from the atmospheric turbulence and scattering effects of haze, fog, and dust, which significantly weaken the performance of QKD or even block the secure quantum link. Here, we prove the performance of QKD over a dynamic scattering channel can be enhanced significantly using a fast wavefront shaping technique. The system achieves on average 10-dB enhancement of quantum transmission efficiency and establishes a secure quantum link for QKD. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of QKD through free-space dynamic scattering channels and enhances the deployment capability of complex-channel QKD system.

Qi-Hang Lu, Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Hai-Yang Fu, Yin-Jie Lu, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 11

带相位后选择的量子密钥分发相位误码率分析Phase-error-rate analysis for quantum key distribution with phase postselection

针对相位后选择的非零区间所引入的固有误差，精确分析相位误码率上限，并将其用于SNS-TFQKD与MP-QKD，模拟表明长距离密钥率明显提升且无需改动实验。

量子密钥分发（QKD）利用量子力学原理建立信息论安全的通信信道，是一种开创性的方法。在QKD的安全性证明中，相位误码率是信息泄漏的关键指标，直接影响通信双方Alice与Bob所共享密钥比特的安全性。在估计相位误码率上界时，相位随机化及随后的后选择机制在许多QKD协议中起着关键作用。然而，相位后选择的非零区间会引入固有误差，导致相位误码率被高估。本文对带相位后选择的QKD协议进行精确的相位误码率分析，消除了与非零区间相关的误码率，有助于准确界定窃听者可能获取的信息量。我们进一步将该分析应用于发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发（SNS-TFQKD）和模式配对量子密钥分发（MP-QKD）。仿真结果证实，精确的相位误码分析能够显著改善密钥率性能，尤其是在实际的长距离情形下。需要指出的是，我们的方法无需改动现有实验硬件或协议步骤，可直接应用于当前的SNS-TF-QKD和MP-QKD，以实现更高的密钥率生成。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) stands as a pioneering method for establishing information-theoretically secure communication channels by utilizing the principles of quantum mechanics. In the security proof of QKD, the phase error rate serves as a critical indicator of information leakage and directly influences the security of the shared key bits between communicating parties, Alice and Bob. In estimating the upper bound of the phase error rate, phase randomization and subsequent postselection mechanisms serve pivotal roles across numerous QKD protocols. However, the nonzero interval of phase postselection will introduce intrinsic errors, leading to an overestimation of phase error rate. Here we make a precise phase-error-rate analysis for QKD protocols with phase postselection, which eliminates error rate associated with nonzero interval and helps us to accurately bound the amount of information an eavesdropper may obtain. We further apply our analysis in sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution (SNS-TFQKD) and mode-pairing quantum key distribution (MP-QKD). The simulation results confirm that our precise phase error analysis can noticeably improve the key rate performance especially over long distances in practice. Note that our method does not require alterations to the existing experimental hardware or protocol steps. It can be readily applied within current SNS-TF-QKD and MP-QKD for higher key rate generation.

Yao Zhou, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Yang-Guang Shan, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1103/PhysRevA.109.022416

带优势提取的发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution with advantage distillation

在主动奇宇称配对发送或不发送双场协议中引入优势提取方法，证明比特块大小为2时有限码长下抗相干攻击的可组合安全性，可在不改变实验系统的前提下进一步提升通信距离与密钥率。

发送或不发送（SNS）协议是双场量子密钥分发（TFQKD）中一种非常有前景的变体，因为它在长距离区间具有优势，并且对较大的光学失准具有鲁棒性。主动奇宇称配对（AOPP）方法能够显著提升原始SNS TFQKD的密钥率性能，从而形成AOPP SNS TFQKD协议。本文引入优势提取（AD）方法，以进一步提升AOPP SNS TFQKD的通信距离。我们还针对AD过程中比特块大小为2的情形，在有限码长条件下证明了带AD的AOPP SNS TFQKD对抗相干攻击的可组合安全性。我们针对AOPP SNS TFQKD协议的AD方法有望在不改变SNS TFQKD实验系统的前提下提升实际中的密钥率性能。

Abstract (English)
A sending-or-not-sending (SNS) protocol is a very promising variant in twin-field quantum key distribution (TFQKD) for its advantages at the regime of long distance and the robustness against large optical misalignment. The actively odd-parity pairing (AOPP) method can significantly enhance the key-rate performance of the original SNS TFQKD, which forms the AOPP SNS TFQKD protocol. In this paper, we introduce the advantage distillation (AD) method to further improve the communication distance for AOPP SNS TFQKD. We also prove the composable security against coherent attacks for the AOPP SNS TFQKD with AD in the finite-key regime for bit blocks with a size of 2 in the AD process. Our AD method for AOPP SNS TFQKD protocol is expected to improve the key-rate performance in practice without changing the SNS TFQKD experimental system.

Yao Zhou, Rui-Qiang Wang, Chun-Mei Zhang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.21.014036

No. 13

离散相位随机化BB84协议的有限密钥分析Finite Key Analysis for Discrete Phase Randomized BB84 Protocol

针对离散相位随机化BB84协议完成有限脉冲数下的安全性分析，给出不同条件下的两种计算方法：离散相位数目超过30时可按连续相位随机化估算密钥率，数目较少时采用数值方法。

量子密钥分发（QKD）是一种依赖量子力学内在随机性来保证信息论安全的保密通信方法。最早且应用最广泛的QKD协议是BB84，证明BB84的安全性至关重要。离散相位随机化BB84协议是诱骗态BB84协议的一种变体，已被证明在高速QKD系统的发展中颇具前景。然而，它仍缺乏针对有限脉冲数的分析。本文针对离散相位BB84协议给出了全面的安全性分析，在不同条件下采用两种不同方法。分析包括仿真与优化，以确定最优参数设置。结果证实，在典型场景下，若离散相位数目超过30，可以按连续相位随机化过程来计算密钥率。另一方面，对于离散取值数目相对较少的情形，我们发展了一种数值方法来计算密钥率。我们证实，在有限脉冲数下其性能有所下降，但仍可接受。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a secure communication method that relies on the inherent randomness of quantum mechanics to ensure information-theoretic security. The first and most widely used QKD protocol is BB84, and the proof of BB84's security is vital. The Discrete Phase Randomized BB84 protocol is a variant of the decoy BB84 protocol. It has been proven to be promising in the development of high-speed QKD systems. However, it still lacks an analysis with a finite number of pulses. This paper presents a comprehensive security analysis of the discrete phase BB84 protocol, using two different methods under different conditions. The analysis involves simulations and optimizations to determine the optimal parameter settings. It is confirmed that for typical scenarios, if the number of discrete phases exceeds 30, one can calculate the key rate by assuming that a continuous phase randomization process was in operation. On the other hand, for a relatively smaller number of discrete values, we have developed a numerical method to calculate the key rate. We have confirmed that its performance is reduced but still acceptable with a finite number of pulses.

Xiao-Hang Jin, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.21203/rs.3.rs-3834799/v1

No. 01

QKD 系统中 LiNbO3 马赫-曾德尔强度调制器的任意偏置控制Arbitrary bias control of LiNbO3 based Mach-Zehnder intensity modulators for QKD system

建立 RC 电路模型解释铌酸锂马赫-曾德尔强度调制器的偏置漂移，并提出无需反馈的多步偏置稳定方案，可在任意工作点长时间消除漂移而不增加系统复杂度。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可帮助相距遥远的双方共享无条件安全的密钥，而借助诱骗态协议还能提升可实现的密钥率。要在实验中实现 QKD，双方需要利用基于 LiNbO3 的马赫-曾德尔（LNMZ）强度调制器精确地发送若干不同强度的光脉冲。然而，LNMZ 强度调制器的偏置漂移可能影响 QKD 系统的性能。本文提出一个简单的 RC 电路模型来说明 LNMZ 强度调制器中的偏置漂移，并基于该模型提出一种多步偏置稳定方案来控制偏置工作点。实验结果表明，该方案可在长时间范围内消除任意工作点处的偏置漂移。此外，该方案无需任何反馈机制，这意味着它不会带来系统复杂度的任何增加，因而更适合 QKD 系统。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) can help distant agents to share unconditional secret keys, and the achievable secret key rate can be enhanced with the help of decoy-state protocol. To implement QKD experimentally, the agents are supposed to accurately transmit a number of different intensity pulses with the LiNbO 3 based Mach-Zehnder (LNMZ) intensity modulator. However, the bias drift of LNMZ intensity modulator may affect the performance of a QKD system. In this letter, we reveal a simple RC circuit model to demonstrate the bias drift in the LNMZ intensity modulator. And based on the model, we propose a multi-step bias stable scheme to control the bias working point. Experimental result shows that our scheme can eliminate the bias drift of at arbitrary working point within a long time range. Besides, there is no need of any feedback mechanisms in the scheme. This means our scheme will not lead to any increasement in system complexity, making it more suitable for a QKD system.

Jun Teng, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
EPJ Quantum Technology

10.1140/epjqt/s40507-023-00189-8

No. 02

基于内禀事件的测量设备无关量子密钥分发中的偏振对准Polarization alignment in measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with intrinsic events

利用测量设备无关协议自身的内禀事件直接计算偏振漂移的补偿量，无需参考脉冲或经典激光等额外资源，也不必中断密钥生成，并建立了引入偏振维度后的响应率模型。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是迈向量子互联网的关键一步，它消除了所有探测器侧信道，使得在节点不可信的条件下仍能实现安全的量子密钥分发。然而，MDI QKD 面临偏振对准的重大挑战，因为偏振态的漂移会影响密钥生成效率，尤其是当量子态从远端位置发送时。传统的偏振对准方法要么需要额外资源（如经典激光器或参考脉冲），要么会中断 QKD 过程，从而降低系统效率。本文提出了一种 MDI QKD 中的高效偏振对准方法，它利用 MDI 的内禀事件直接计算如何补偿偏振漂移。所提方法不需要参考脉冲等额外资源，从而消除了带宽限制；同时它速度很快，能够在判据涨落很小的条件下直接计算出偏振校正方式。我们还在编码维度之外引入了偏振维度，并建立了带有附加偏振维度的 MDI QKD 响应率模型。总体而言，所提方法是 MDI QKD 中一种资源高效的偏振漂移校正方案，能够提升 QKD 网络的实用性与可扩展性。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a crucial step for the quantum Internet, as it removes all detector side channels and enables secure QKD with untrusted nodes. However, MDI QKD faces a significant challenge from polarization alignment, since drift of the state of polarization affects the efficiency of key generation, especially when the quantum states are sent from remote locations. Conventional methods for polarization alignment either require additional resources, such as classical lasers or reference pulses, or interrupt the QKD process, which reduces the efficiency of the system. In this paper, an efficient polarization-alignment method in MDI QKD is proposed that leverages intrinsic events from MDI to directly calculate how to compensate for polarization drift. The proposed method does not require additional resources such as reference pulses, thereby eliminating bandwidth limitations, and it is fast, as it can directly calculate how to correct polarization with a small criterion fluctuation. We also introduce the polarization dimension in addition to the encoding dimension and establish a response-rate model for MDI QKD with additional polarization dimensions. Overall, the proposed method is a resource-efficient solution for polarization drift correction in MDI QKD, which can enhance the practicality and scalability of QKD networks.

Jia-Xuan Li, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang, Ze-Hao Wang, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.20.054041

No. 03

非对称量子-经典集成测量设备无关量子密钥分发的更高密钥率Higher key rate in asymmetric quantum-classical integrated measurement-device-independent quantum-key-distribution systems

建立了集成测量设备无关量子密钥分发中非对称效应的机理模型，并分析非对称结构的噪声抑制效应，发现非对称系统的密钥率反而最多提升260%，颠覆了对称系统更优的传统认知。

将测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）与经典网络集成，可兼顾安全性与经济性。遗憾的是，MDI QKD 的性能本就受到网络非对称性的抑制，还会因集成噪声的加入而进一步恶化。因此，人们一直认为对称系统更有利于获得更高的密钥率。然而，我们揭示了一个反直觉的事实：在集成系统中，非对称 MDI QKD 具有更好的性能。我们建立了集成 MDI 系统中非对称效应的机理模型，并分析了非对称结构的噪声抑制效应，观察到密钥率出人意料地提升至多 260%，所得结论与原系统截然相反。所发现的现象及所提出的分析模型为噪声抑制和性能提升提供了一种方法，使其能够很好地适配实际的非对称网络。

Abstract (English)
Integrating measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) with classical networks guarantees security and economy. Unfortunately, the performance of MDI QKD, suppressed though it is by network asymmetry, is further degraded by the addition of integration noise. As a consequence, symmetric systems are always believed to be better for a higher key rate. However, we reveal a counterintuitive fact that asymmetric MDI QKD has better performance in integrated systems. Modeling the mechanism of the asymmetric effect in integrated MDI systems and analyzing the noise-suppression effect of asymmetric structures, we observe an unanticipated increase of the key rate up to 260%, giving a conclusion diametrically opposite that for the original system. The phenomenon found and the proposed analytical model provide a method for noise suppression and performance improvement, permitting high adaptability for realistic asymmetric networks.

Wei-Xin Xie, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Ze-Hao Wang, Feng-Yu Lu, Jia-Xuan Li, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.20.054042

No. 04

基于实用自发参量下转换源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution with Practical Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion Sources

把实际自发参量下转换源的光谱纠缠态分解为施密特本征态，定量计入各本征态对安全密钥率的贡献，修正了以往的高估，并据此精确优化泵浦与滤波条件。

测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）封堵了探测端的全部漏洞，极大提升了QKD的实际安全性。自发参量下转换（SPDC）源在MDI QKD中发挥着重要作用：借助预告（heralding）策略，它可以实现被动诱骗态等独特功能，从而减少源端的边信道信息泄漏。然而，实际SPDC源产生的光子对往往存在光谱纠缠，这会降低Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉可见度，进而抬高QKD误码率。遗憾的是，此前的研究尚未定量考虑这一效应，导致安全密钥率被高估，其结果无法适用于实际光源。本文填补了这一空白：将光谱纠缠态分解为施密特本征态，进而求出它们对安全密钥率的贡献。此外，该工作还允许对泵浦与滤波条件进行精确优化，以最大化最终密钥率。需要指出的是，我们的模型具有普适性，可推广到其他涉及HOM干涉的量子信息过程，如量子隐形传态、纠缠交换和量子计算。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD) closes all the loopholes in the detection side, which greatly improves the practical security of QKD. Spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) sources play a significant role in MDI QKD by using the heralding strategies to achieve unique features, such as the passive-decoy method, which reduces side-channel information leakage from the source. However, photon pairs from realistic SPDC sources are often spectrally entangled. This lowers the Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference visibility, and thus increases the QKD error rate. Unfortunately, research efforts so far have not considered this effect quantitatively. This leads to an overestimation in the secure key rate; therefore their results cannot be applied to practical sources. In this article, we close this gap by decomposing the spectral entangled state into Schmidt eigenstates, then find their contributions to the secure key rate. In addition, our work allows an accurate optimization of pumping and filtering conditions to maximize the final key rate. We note that our model is general and can be applied to other quantum information processes involving HOM interference, such as quantum teleportation, entanglement swapping, and quantum computation.

Xiao-Hai Zhan, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.20.034069

No. 05

模式配对量子密钥分发的紧致有限码长分析Tight finite-key analysis for mode-pairing quantum key distribution

★Commun. Phys.

该工作为模式配对量子密钥分发给出可抵御一般攻击的严格安全性证明与有限码长分析，并提出六态协议；结果显示原协议在典型脉冲数下即可突破无中继速率-透射率界限，六态方案在长距离下显著提升成码率。

模式配对量子密钥分发（MP-QKD）是一种有潜力的协议，它不仅能够免疫所有可能的探测器侧信道攻击，而且无需全局相位锁定即可突破无中继速率-透射率界限。在本项工作中，我们分析了 MP-QKD 协议的有限码长效应，并给出了可抵御一般攻击的严格安全性证明。此外，我们提出了一种六态 MP-QKD 协议并分析了它的有限码长效应。结果表明，原始协议在实际中典型的有限脉冲数下即可突破无中继速率-透射率界限；而我们的六态协议在长距离情形下能够显著提高安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Mode-pairing quantum key distribution (MP-QKD) is a potential protocol that is not only immune to all possible detector side channel attacks, but also breaks the repeaterless rate-transmittance bound without needing global phase locking. Here we analyze the finite-key effect for the MP-QKD protocol with rigorous security proof against general attacks. Moreover, we propose a six-state MP-QKD protocol and analyze its finite-key effect. The results show that the original protocol can break the repeaterless rate-transmittance bound with a typical finite number of pulses in practice. And our six-state protocol can improve the secret key rate significantly in long distance cases.

Ze-Hao Wang, Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Feng-Yu Lu, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Communications Physics

10.1038/s42005-023-01382-y

No. 06

全被动时间箱编码量子密钥分发的实验演示Experimental Demonstration of Fully Passive Quantum Key Distribution

★Phys. Rev. Lett.

在实验中实现全被动时间箱编码量子密钥分发，彻底去除了用户设备中的主动调制与调制器侧信道，原型系统在有限密钥条件下仍可给出有竞争力的安全成码率。

量子密钥分发（QKD）的被动式方案旨在去除用户设备中的所有主动调制，是消除调制器侧信道的一种非常理想的应对措施。然而，由于理论与实际两方面的限制，迄今为止 QKD 系统中的主动调制尚未被完全去除。本文报道了一个全被动时间箱编码 QKD 系统，并成功实现了一条无调制器的 QKD 链路。根据最新的理论分析，我们的原型能够在有限密钥条件下提供具有竞争力的成码率。

Abstract (English)
The passive approach to quantum key distribution (QKD) consists of removing all active modulation from the users' devices, a highly desirable countermeasure to get rid of modulator side channels. Nevertheless, active modulation has not been completely removed in QKD systems so far, due to both theoretical and practical limitations. In this Letter, we present a fully passive time-bin encoding QKD system and report on the successful implementation of a modulator-free QKD link. According to the latest theoretical analysis, our prototype is capable of delivering competitive secret key rates in the finite key regime.

Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Víctor Zapatero, Jia-Lin Chen, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Marcos Curty, De-Yong He, Rong Wang, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Letters

10.1103/PhysRevLett.131.110802

No. 07

面向安全高性能量子密钥分发的强度层析方法Intensity Tomography Method for Secure and High-Performance Quantum Key Distribution

针对随机强度涨落与关联强度涨落造成的调制不精确问题，提出强度层析方法，用本地单光子探测器测量诱骗态以精确标定涨落并紧致界定光子数态的未知密度矩阵，实验与仿真验证其可提升协议性能与实际安全性。

诱骗态方法极大地弥补了量子密钥分发（QKD）领域中多光子脉冲带来的漏洞，近年来几乎被用于所有实际 QKD 系统。然而，实际诱骗态 QKD 的安全性与性能仍受随机强度涨落、关联强度涨落等调制不精确因素的限制。本工作提出一种强度层析方法，用以对抗这些涨落。该方法能够紧致地界定光子数态的未知密度矩阵，并通过用本地单光子探测器测量诱骗态来精确标定涨落。我们通过实验与仿真验证了该层析方法。结果表明，我们的方法能够有效缓解这些涨落带来的缺陷，从而提升协议性能和实际安全性。鉴于这些涨落在实际 QKD 中不可避免，我们的方法将为 QKD 的实际应用铺平道路。

Abstract (English)
Decoy-state method has greatly filled in loopholes from multi-photon pulses in the field of quantum key distribution (QKD) and it has been employed in almost all practical QKD systems in recent years. However, security and performance of the practical decoy-state QKDs are still limited by inaccurate modulations such as random intensity fluctuation and correlated intensity fluctuation. In this work, an intensity tomography method is proposed as a countermeasure against these fluctuations. It has an ability to tightly bound the unknown density matrices of photon-number state and accurately calibrate the fluctuations by measuring the decoy states with a local single-photon detector. We verified the tomography method by experiments and simulations. The results indicated that our method can efficiently mitigate the flaws from these fluctuations to improve the protocol performance and practical security. Noting that these fluctuations are inevitable in practical QKDs, our method would pave the avenue for QKD's practical applications.

Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Jia-Lin Chen, Xiang Kang, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Journal of Lightwave Technology

No. 08

面向可组合量子网络的混合高维量子密钥分发Hybrid High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution for a Composable Quantum Network

通过发展多自由度映射方法，提出并实现了量子比特误码率低至0.57%的高维量子密钥分发系统，可稳定获得高安全密钥率，并能互联不同自由度编码的终端。

高维量子密钥分发（HD-QKD）具有更强的抗噪能力和更高的安全密钥率。在本工作中，我们通过发展一种多自由度（DOF）映射方法，提出并实现了一套量子比特误码率低至0.57%的HD-QKD系统。该系统能够稳定实现高安全密钥率，并且具有可组合性，从而可以构建兼容多种自由度的HD量子网络。结果表明，所提方案能够桥接编码于不同自由度的HD终端与二维终端，并可支撑高性能量子网络的大规模部署。我们的工作显著提升了HD-QKD的性能，并以混合方式增强了大规模量子网络的实际应用能力。

Abstract (English)
High-dimensional quantum key distribution (HD-QKD) possesses a higher noise-tolerance ability and secure key rate. In the work presented here, by developing a mapping method for multiple degrees of freedom (DOFs), we propose and implement a HD-QKD system with a quantum bit error rate as low as 0.57%. Our HD-QKD system can stably achieve high secure key rates and is composable, allowing one to build HD quantum networks compatible with multiple DOFs. The results indicate that the proposed scheme could bridge HD and two-dimensional terminals encoded in different DOFs and could support large-scale deployment of quantum networks with high performance. Our work significantly enhances the performance of HD-QKD and strengthens the practical applications of large-scale quantum networks in a hybrid way.

针对量子密钥分发的诱导光折变攻击Induced-Photorefraction Attack against Quantum Key Distribution

该工作指出铌酸锂器件的光折变效应可被窃听者利用，从而构成量子密钥分发系统的潜在攻击漏洞，并阐明其物理机制与实现技术，提醒器件厂商与用户采取相应对策，为 QKD 安全性分析开辟了新途径。

铌酸锂（LN）器件已被广泛用于量子密钥分发（QKD）系统中，但 LN 器件中的光折变效应可被窃听者利用，成为一种潜在的攻击漏洞。本工作指出了 LN 器件的一个脆弱之处，制造商与用户必须对此有所认识，以便采取适当对策。此外，本工作所提出的物理机制与技术为 QKD 系统的安全性分析开辟了一条重要途径。

Abstract (English)
Lithium niobate (LN) devices have been widely adopted in systems for quantum key distribution (QKD), but the photorefractive effect in LN devices can be exploited as a potential loophole for malicious attacks by eavesdroppers. This work points out a vulnerability of LN devices of which manufacturers and users must become aware, so that appropriate countermeasures may be implemented. Moreover, the physical mechanism and techniques introduced in this work open an important avenue to the security analysis of QKD systems.

Physical Review Applied

No. 10

测量设备无关量子密钥分发的源端攻击实验Hacking measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

★Optica

针对诱骗态调制不准确这一漏洞，提出可实用的攻击方法并给出详细理论分析，实验上攻破了 MDI-QKD 系统并获取全部最终密钥，以警示源端安全的重要性。

诱骗态测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）被认为是最有前景的协议之一，因为它在物理上免疫于所有致命的探测端攻击。然而，源端的漏洞仍然为窃听者敞开着侧信道。此前的工作已表明，若诱骗态调制不准确，系统便不再安全，但窃听者利用调制不准确性的一种实用方法仍然缺失。在本工作中，我们提出了一种实用的攻击方法，并给出了详细的理论分析。利用该方法，我们在实验中攻击了一个 MDI-QKD 系统，并成功获取了全部最终密钥。通过演示这一攻击实验，我们希望引起人们对源端安全性的关注，并为开发源端安全性更好的协议提供启发。

Abstract (English)
Decoy-state measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is regarded as one of the most promising protocols since it is physically immune to all fatal detection-side attacks. However, the loopholes in the source side still open side channels to eavesdroppers. Previous work has indicated that a system is insecure if its decoy-state modulation is inaccurate, but a practical method for Eve to exploit the inaccurate modulation is still absent. In this work, we propose a practical hacking method and provide a detailed theoretical analysis. Using our method, we experimentally hacked a MDI-QKD system and successfully obtained all final keys. By demonstrating the hacking experiment, we hope to bring attention to source-side security and provide inspiration for the development of protocols with better source-side security.

Feng-Yu Lu, Peng Ye, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Xiao-Juan Huang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

无需监测信号扰动的量子密钥分发中的后脉冲效应Afterpulse effects in quantum key distribution without monitoring signal disturbance

首次将后脉冲效应纳入轮转差分相移量子密钥分发的紧致有限码长分析，表明非马尔可夫后脉冲模型可优化系统性能，且 RRDPS 在短时通信下相对诱骗态 BB84 的优势在典型后脉冲取值下依然成立。

轮转差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议是唯一不需要监测信号扰动的协议。此外，已有研究证明 RRDPS 在抵抗有限码长效应和容忍高误码率方面具有优异性能。然而，现有理论与实验均未考虑后脉冲效应，而该效应在高速 QKD 系统中不可忽略。在此，我们提出一种考虑后脉冲效应的紧致有限码长分析。结果表明，非马尔可夫后脉冲 RRDPS 模型在考虑后脉冲效应的情况下优化了系统性能。在典型后脉冲取值下，RRDPS 相对于诱骗态 BB84 在短时通信中的优势依然成立。

Abstract (English)
The round-robin differential phase shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol is the only one that does not require monitoring of signal disturbance. Moreover, it has been proven that RRDPS has excellent performance of resistance to finite-key effects and high error rate tolerance. However, the existing theories and experiments do not take the afterpulse effects into account, which cannot be neglected in high-speed QKD systems. Here, we propose a tight finite-key analysis with afterpulse effects. The results show that the non-Markovian afterpulse RRDPS model optimizes the system performance considering afterpulse effects. The advantage of RRDPS over decoy-state BB84 under short-time communication still holds at typical values of afterpulse.

Hang Liu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Ze-Hao Wang, Yang-Guang Shan, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Chen Dong, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于三个互不偏基的双场量子密钥分发Twin-field quantum key distribution with three mutually unbiased bases

推导二维希尔伯特空间中X、Y、Z三个互不偏基下的误码率，据此提升双场量子密钥分发的长距离密钥率与最大可达距离；无需改动物理实现，仅需对实验数据做后处理。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体无需量子中继即可突破速率—透射率的根本极限，为城际用户之间共享信息论安全的密钥提供了颇具前景的解决方案。本文提出，通过推导二维希尔伯特空间中三个互不偏基，即$\sigma_{X}$、$\sigma_{Y}$和$\sigma_{Z}$下的误码率，来提升TF-QKD在长距离下的密钥率以及最大可达距离。此外，在获知这些误码率后，可以引入含噪预处理以进一步提升其性能。我们还观察到，在加入含噪预处理时，较高的比特误码率并不必然意味着较低的密钥率。我们的方法不改变现有的物理实现或实验操作，只需对实验数据进行简单的后处理，因而可直接用于提升现有QKD系统的密钥率性能。仿真结果表明，对于相位编码TF-QKD协议，该方法在长距离密钥率和最大可达距离方面均有显著提升。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variants provide a promising solution for sharing information-theoretic secure keys between intercity peers since they are able to overcome the fundamental rate-transmittance bound without quantum repeaters. In this paper, we propose to improve the key rate at long distances and the maximum achievable distance for TF-QKD by deriving the error rates under three mutually unbiased bases, i.e., ${\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{X}, {\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{Y}$, and ${\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{Z}$ in two-dimensional Hilbert space. Moreover, learning these error rates, one can add noisy preprocessing to further improve its performance. We also observe that higher bit error rates do not necessarily imply lower key rates when noisy preprocessing is added. Our method does not change the existing physical implementation or experimental operation, but only requires simple postprocessing of the experimental data, which can be directly used to improve the key rate performance of the existing QKD system. The simulation results demonstrate its notable enhancements in terms of key rate at long distances and the maximum achievable distance for the phase-encoded TF-QKD protocol.

Yao Zhou, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于连续波泵浦自发参量下转换预报单光子源的量子密钥分发Quantum Key Distribution with a Continuous-Wave-Pumped Spontaneous-Parametric-Down-Conversion Heralded Single-Photon Source

该工作建立了计入探测器时间抖动与死时间等实际缺陷的连续波泵浦预报单光子源 QKD 模型，表明其传输距离比当前最快的脉冲泵浦系统长约 31%，且运行更稳定、光谱特性更优。

量子密钥分发（QKD）协议利用单光子进行密钥交换。基于自发参量下转换（SPDC）的预报单光子源（HSPS）是产生高保真单光子的一种实用而有效的方式，尤其在长距离下能带来额外的性能提升。HSPS QKD 通常使用脉冲激光作为泵浦，但与连续波泵浦相比，其在运行稳定性和实用性方面存在不足。另一方面，目前仍缺乏描述连续波泵浦 HSPS 性能的精确模型。将脉冲泵浦 HSPS QKD 的成码率模型直接套用于连续波情形既不准确也不安全，而且会忽略单光子探测器的时间抖动与死时间。本文详细研究了连续波情形，并计入了实验仪器的实际非理想因素。我们的模型表明，连续波泵浦方案可达到比目前最快的脉冲泵浦 HSPS QKD 系统长得多的传输距离（长 31%），并具有运行稳定性更高、光谱特性更好等优点。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols utilize single photons for key exchanging. Heralded single-photon sources (HSPSs) with spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) is a practical and effective way of producing single photons of high fidelity, bringing extra performance especially at long distances. A pulsed laser is usually used as the pump for HSPS QKD, but it has disadvantages in operational stability and practicality compared to a cw one. On the other hand, a precise model describing the performance of HSPS with a cw pump is still missing. It is inaccurate and unsafe to apply the key rate model of the pulse-pumped HSPS QKD directly to the cw one, and it also overlooks the timing jitter and dead time of the single-photon detectors. In this paper, we study the cw case in detail, including practical imperfections of the experimental instruments. Our model shows that a cw-pumped setup can reach a much longer transmission distance (31 % longer) than the fastest pulsed HSPS QKD system at present, together with other advantages such as higher operational stability and better spectral characteristics.

Xiao-Hai Zhan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

离散相位随机化量子密钥分发的有限码长分析Finite-Key Analysis for Quantum Key Distribution with Discrete-Phase Randomization

针对实验难以实现连续相位随机化的问题，基于共轭测量与量子态区分首次给出离散相位随机化双场量子密钥分发的有限码长安全性证明，指出取8个离散相位即可获得满意性能，但有限尺寸效应更显著。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个远程用户能够共享信息论安全的密钥。许多QKD协议假设编码态的相位可以在0到2π范围内连续随机化，然而这在实验中可能难以成立。最近提出的双场（TF）QKD尤其如此，它因能显著提高密钥率、甚至突破某些理论上的速率-损耗极限而备受关注。作为直观的解决方案，可以采用离散相位随机化替代连续随机化。然而，针对采用离散相位随机化的QKD协议，有限码长区域的安全性证明仍然缺失。这里，我们发展了一种基于共轭测量与量子态区分的技术，用于分析这种情况下的安全性。结果表明，TF-QKD采用合理数目的离散随机相位，例如来自{0,π/4,π/2,…,7π/4}的8个相位，即可获得令人满意的性能。另一方面，我们发现有限尺寸效应比以往更加显著，这意味着此时应发射更多脉冲。更重要的是，作为TF-QKD在有限码长区域采用离散相位随机化的首个证明，我们的方法同样适用于其他QKD协议。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) allows two remote parties to share information-theoretic secret keys. Many QKD protocols assume the phase of encoding state can be continuous randomized from 0 to 2π, which, however, may be questionable in the experiment. This is particularly the case in the recently proposed twin-field (TF) QKD, which has received a lot of attention since it can increase the key rate significantly and even beat some theoretical rate-loss limits. As an intuitive solution, one may introduce discrete-phase randomization instead of continuous randomization. However, a security proof for a QKD protocol with discrete-phase randomization in the finite-key region is still missing. Here, we develop a technique based on conjugate measurement and quantum state distinguishment to analyze the security in this case. Our results show that TF-QKD with a reasonable number of discrete random phases, e.g., 8 phases from {0,π/4,π/2,…,7π/4}, can achieve satisfactory performance. On the other hand, we find the finite-size effects become more notable than before, which implies that more pulses should be emit in this case. More importantly, as a the first proof for TF-QKD with discrete-phase randomization in the finite-key region, our method is also applicable in other QKD protocols.

针对LiNbO3马赫-曾德尔强度调制器的偏置漂移，建立简单的RC电路模型，并提出无需反馈的多步偏置稳定方案，实验表明可在长时间内消除任意工作点的偏置漂移。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可帮助相距遥远的双方共享无条件安全的密钥，而借助诱骗态协议还能提升可达成的安全密钥率。在实验上实现QKD时，双方需要利用基于LiNbO3的马赫-曾德尔（LNMZ）强度调制器准确地发送若干不同强度的脉冲。然而，LNMZ强度调制器的偏置漂移可能影响QKD系统的性能。本文提出一个简单的RC电路模型来说明LNMZ强度调制器中的偏置漂移，并基于该模型提出一种多步偏置稳定方案来控制偏置工作点。实验结果表明，该方案可在长时间范围内消除任意工作点的偏置漂移。此外，该方案无需任何反馈机制，这意味着它不会增加系统复杂度，因而更适合QKD系统。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) can help distant agents to share unconditional secret keys, andthe achievable secret key rate can be enhanced with the help of decoy-state protocol. To implementQKD experimentally, the agents are supposed to accurately transmit a number of different intensitypulses with the LiNbO3 based Mach-Zehnder (LNMZ) intensity modulator. However, the bias driftof LNMZ intensity modulator may affect the performance of a QKD system. In this letter, we reveala simple RC circuit model to demonstrate the bias drift in the LNMZ intensity modulator. Andbased on the model, we propose a multi-step bias stable scheme to control the bias working point.Experimental result shows that our scheme can eliminate the bias drift of at arbitrary working pointwithin a long time range. Besides, there is no need of any feedback mechanisms in the scheme. Thismeans our scheme will not lead to any increasement in system complexity, making it more suitablefor a QKD system.

Jun Teng, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

安全诱骗态量子密钥分发的图样效应标定算法Patterning-Effect Calibration Algorithm for Secure Decoy-State Quantum Key Distribution

针对实际诱骗态量子密钥分发中强度关联涨落引起的图样效应，把研究拓展到关联范围更大的高阶情形，提出通过标定驱动电压来抑制该效应的算法，并在实验上观测到高阶图样效应且成功将其压制。

量子密钥分发（QKD）中的诱骗态方法是抵御致命的光子数分离攻击的有力对策。目前，诱骗态方法已被广泛应用于实际QKD系统。然而，图样效应，即实际QKD系统中强度涨落之间的关联，违背了诱骗态方法的重要假设，严重威胁协议的安全性。此前的工作研究了相邻脉冲之间的图样效应，并从后选择和调制器两个层面提出了应对措施。本工作研究关联范围更大的图样效应，并提出一种通过标定驱动电压来抑制图样效应的算法。按照我们的方法，实验上观测到了高阶图样效应，并利用所提出的标定算法成功将其抑制。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效提升了协议安全性，有望在实际诱骗态QKD系统中得到广泛应用。

Abstract (English)
The decoy-state method for the quantum key distribution (QKD) is a great countermeasure against the fatal photon number splitting attack. At present, the decoy-state method has been widely employed in practical QKD systems. However, the patterning effect, namely the correlated intensity fluctuations in practical QKD systems, violates the important assumption of the decoy-state method and seriously threatens the protocol security. The previous works investigated the patterning effect between the adjacent pulses and proposed the countermeasures from the degree of post selection and modulators. In this work, we investigate the patterning effect with larger correlation range and present an algorithm to calibrate the driving voltages to mitigate the patterning effect. According to our methods, we experimentally observe the higher-order patterning effect and successfully mitigate it by our calibration algorithm. The experiment results indicate that our methods efficiently improve the protocol security and are expected to be widely employed in practical decoy-state QKD systems.

Xiang Kang, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Ze-Hao Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
