2.5 GHz 门控 InGaAs/InP 单光子雪崩二极管实现 44 ps 时间抖动2.5 GHz Gated InGaAs/InP Single-Photon Avalanche Diode with 44 ps Time Jitter

针对高频门控下时间抖动与后脉冲相互制约的难题，指出滤波器失真与信号幅度变化是抖动主因，用专门设计的低通滤波器配合过零鉴别器，在 21% 探测效率下把时间抖动压到 44 ps、后脉冲概率降至 1.4%。

门控单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）是量子密钥分发（QKD）应用中的实用方案。然而，当 SPAD 工作在高于 2 GHz 的频率时，门控频率受到时间抖动和后脉冲概率的限制。我们发现，滤波器失真与信号幅度变化是高频场景下时间抖动的主要机制，并设计了特定的低通滤波器（LPF）和过零鉴别器来有效降低时间抖动。具体而言，LPF 提取雪崩信号并借助其冲激响应形成精确的过零点，过零鉴别器则正确鉴别雪崩信号以实现低时间抖动。当 SPAD 在 2.5 GHz 门控频率、21% 探测效率下工作时，时间抖动与后脉冲概率分别为 44 ps 和 1.4%。我们的结果为更高时钟率的实用 QKD 系统铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Gated single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are practical solutions for quantum key distribution (QKD) applications. However, the gating frequency is limited by time jitter and afterpulse probability when SPADs operate at a frequency higher than 2 GHz. We find that filter distortion and variation of signal amplitude are the dominant mechanisms for time jitter in high-frequency scenarios, and design a specific low-pass filter (LPF) and a zero crossing discriminator to reduce the time jitter effectively. Specifically, the LPF extracts avalanche signals and forms accurate zero crossing points by its impulse response, and the zero crossing discriminator correctly discriminates avalanche signals to achieve low time jitter. When the SPAD is operated at a gating frequency of 2.5 GHz with a detection efficiency of 21%, the time jitter and afterpulse probability are 44 ps and 1.4%, respectively. Our results pave the way to practical QKD systems at higher clock rates.

高性能量子密钥分发系统中的探测响应依赖模型Dependency model for high-performance quantum-key-distribution systems

针对单光子雪崩二极管死时间与后脉冲导致增益估计有偏的问题，建立探测器响应依赖模型，可更准确地优化参数并指导死时间选取，仿真表明其对系统实用部署具有重要作用。

精确估计探测响应对于高性能且安全的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统至关重要。单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）被广泛用于估计单光子产额。然而，在SPAD存在死时间和后脉冲的情况下，以往模型对增益的估计存在偏差，这将导致优化参数拟合不佳，并大幅降低系统性能。这里，我们建立了一个依赖性模型，可提供更精确的优化，从而实现更高性能的QKD系统。此外，为进一步提升系统性能，我们的模型可指导用户选择合适的死时间。仿真结果表明，该模型在QKD系统的实际应用与部署中发挥着重要作用。

Abstract (English)
A precise estimation of the detection response is essential for a high-performance and secure quantum-key-distribution (QKD) system. Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are widely applied to estimate the single-photon yields. However, in the presence of the dead time and afterpulse of the SPADs, the estimations of gains in previous models are biased, which will lead to ill-fitting optimized parameters and greatly degrade the system performance. Here, we develop a dependency model for providing more accurate optimization to achieve higher-performance QKD systems. Moreover, to further improve the system performance, our model guides users to choose proper dead time. Our simulation results indicate that our model plays an important role in the practical application and deployment of QKD systems.

Xiao-Juan Huang, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Ze-Hao Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

基于纠缠光子源的量子密钥分发的实用通用模型Realistic and general model for quantum key distribution with entangled-photon sources

指出现有模型将脉冲泵浦纠缠源的光子数分布视为热分布、忽略光谱模式会高估安全密钥率，通过分析光子数分布与联合光谱分布的关系重写光子对量子态，给出适用于脉冲乃至连续波泵浦系统的通用密钥率模型。

基于纠缠的量子密钥分发（EB-QKD）相较制备-测量类协议具有若干优势，例如无需诱骗态和主动调制器。目前，基于自发参量下转换过程的纠缠源已被广泛用于EB-QKD实验。已有模型大多把脉冲泵浦纠缠源的光子数分布视为热分布，但这样做忽略了光谱模式的任何影响，会导致安全密钥率被高估。本文分析了光子数分布与联合光谱分布之间的关联，并重写了光子对的量子态。随后我们将结果应用于EB-QKD，给出了一个通用模型，它不仅能用于任何脉冲泵浦系统，甚至可用于连续波泵浦系统来计算安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Entanglement-based quantum key distribution (EB-QKD) has several advantages over prepare-and-measure protocols, such as eliminating the need for decoy states and active modulators. At present, entanglement sources based on the spontaneous parametric down-conversion process have been widely used in EB-QKD experiments. Most of the existing models regard the photon-number distribution of pulse-pumped entanglement sources as thermal. However, doing so ignores any effects of spectral modes, which will lead to the overestimation of the secure key rate. In this paper, we analyze the correlation between the photon-number distribution and the joint spectral distribution and rewrite the quantum state of the photon pairs. Then we apply the results to EB-QKD and present a general model which can be used to calculate the secure key rate not only for any pulse-pumped systems but even for cw-pumped systems.

No. 03

基于部分相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution with Partial Phase Postselection

提出部分相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发方案：编码模式免除全局相位随机化与后选择，以保持高成码率优势；诱骗模式则引入相位后选择来改善性能，并借助算符支配条件证明了有限码长下相干攻击时的普适安全性。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的用户能够共享信息论安全的密钥。近年来，一种被称为双场（TF）QKD的革命性突破被提出，用以克服成码率受线性限制的问题，并大幅提升了可达距离。相位随机化及随后的后选择在其安全性证明中发挥作用。此后，无相位后选择的TF QKD被提出，并成为流行的变体，因为去掉相位后选择可以获得更高的成码率；但与原始方案相比，其可达距离有所下降。本文提出一种部分相位后选择的TF QKD协议。即，其编码模式仍不依赖全局相位随机化和后选择，以保证高成码率的优势得以保留；另一方面，在诱骗模式中引入相位后选择以改善性能。应用算符支配条件，我们证明了所提协议的普适安全性：在有限码长情形下，它能在相干攻击下保持安全。数值模拟证实了该协议在成码率和可达距离方面的潜在优势。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) allows two remote parties to share information-theoretically secure keys. In recent years, a revolutionary breakthrough called twin-field (TF) QKD has been developed to overcome the linear key-rate constraint and greatly increases the achievable distance. Phase randomization and subsequent postselection play roles in its security proof. Later, no-phase-postselection TF QKD was proposed and became a popular variant, since the removal of phase postselection leads to a higher key rate. However, the achievable distance is decreased compared to the original one. Here, we propose a TF QKD protocol with partial phase postselection. Namely, its code mode is still free from global phase randomization and postselection to make sure the advantage of the high key rate remain. On the other hand, phase postselection is introduced in the decoy mode to improve the performance. Applying an operator dominance condition, we prove universal security of the proposed protocol in the finite-key case under coherent attacks, and numerical simulations confirm its potential advantages in terms of key rate and achievable distance.

Yao Zhou, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rui-Qiang Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.18.054026

No. 04

双场量子密钥分发中的信号处理Signal Processing in Twin-field Quantum Key Distribution

梳理双场量子密钥分发走向实用时的两项信号处理难题，即双场的远程产生与快速相位漂移的完美补偿，并结合包括 833.8 km 光纤实验在内的近期工作，归纳了典型的应对方法与策略。

双场量子密钥分发能够突破线性界限，并有望在更长距离上提供更高的密钥率。但在实现双场协议时，信号处理面临两个主要挑战：一是双场的远程产生，二是快速相位漂移的完美补偿。这里，我们通过分析近期实验，特别是最新的 833.8 km 光纤双场实验，介绍了应对这些挑战的典型方法与策略。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field quantum key distribution can break through the linear bound, and promises higher key rate over longer distance. But there are two main challenges of signal processing when the twin-field protocol is implemented. One is remote generation of twin fields, the other is perfect compensation of the fast phase drift. Here, we introduce the typical methods and strategies to deal with these challenges by analysis of recent experiments, especially the latest twin-field experiment over 833.8 km fiber.

在芯片化量子密钥分发（QKD）系统中，不理想的电光相位调制器（EOPM）导致非理想量子态制备，会降低安全密钥率并引入潜在安全性漏洞。我们提出并实现了一种片上透射率不变相位调制器（TIPM）来解决该问题。仿真与实验结果表明，TIPM能够消除相位相关损耗所造成的量子态相位、强度与偏振之间的关联。该设计可容忍显著的制备偏差，且对多材料平台具有普适性。此外，TIPM提高了标准工艺设计套件（PDK）中EOPM可达到的调制深度。TIPM的提出可提升芯片化QKD系统的实际安全性与性能。

Abstract (English)
In chip-based quantum key distribution (QKD) systems, the non-ideal quantum state preparation due to the imperfect electro-optic phase modulators (EOPM) decreases the secret key rate and introduces potential vulnerabilities. We propose and implement an on-chip transmittance-invariant phase modulator (TIPM) to solve this problem. Simulated and experimental results show that TIPM can eliminate the correlation between phase, intensity, and polarization of quantum states caused by phase-dependent loss. The design can tolerate a significant fabrication mismatch and is universal to multi-material platforms. Furthermore, TIPM increases the modulation depth achievable by EOPMs in standard process design kit (PDK). The proposal of TIPM can improve the practical security and performance of the chip-based QKD systems.

量子密钥分发（QKD）系统的自稳定对于准确评估窃听者所获取的信息至关重要。我们研制并验证了一种用于QKD的偏振不敏感时间比特解码芯片，它基于平面光波回路（PLC）的混合非对称法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪（AFMI）。与现有基于芯片的QKD工作相比，该方案能够从本质上补偿量子信号所受的偏振扰动，因而可在任意温度下工作。我们在时钟频率为1.25 GHz的时间比特QKD系统中对芯片进行了实验验证，并借助优化的分析模型，在50 km光纤信道上获得1.34 Mbps的平均安全密钥率（SKR）。量子比特误码率和SKR在随机偏振扰动下均保持稳定变化，这表明基于PLC的AFMI可用于发展自稳定的QKD系统。

Abstract (English)
Self-stabilizing the quantum key distribution (QKD) system is essential to evaluate eavesdroppers’ information accurately. We develop and verify a polarization-insensitive time-bin decoder chip for QKD with the hybrid asymmetric Faraday-Michelson interferometer (AFMI) based on the planar lightwave circuit (PLC). Compared with existing chip-based QKD works, the scheme can intrinsically compensate for the polarization perturbation to quantum signals and thus work at arbitrary temperatures. We experimentally verify the chips in a time-bin QKD system at the clocking rate of 1.25 GHz and obtain an average secure key rate (SKR) of 1.34 Mbps over a 50 km fiber channel with an optimized analysis model. The steady variations of the quantum bit error and SKR with random polarization disturbance demonstrate that PLC-based AFMIs are available for developing self-stable QKD systems.

提出一种对不均衡基失配更宽容的测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议，降低了对编码系统的先验要求，以抵抗棘手的调制误差与涨落，并完成实验验证，在保持安全性的同时获得高性能。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）是一种革命性的协议，因为它在物理上免疫探测端的所有攻击。然而，该协议对源端仍保留严格假设，要求四个 BB84 态必须被完美制备才能保证安全性。一些协议放宽了编码系统中的部分假设以保持实际安全性，但性能会显著下降。在本工作中，我们提出一种 MDIQKD 协议，它只需要较少关于编码系统的先验知识，即可对抗棘手的调制误差与涨落。我们还对该协议进行了实验演示。结果表明，它具有高性能以及面向实际应用的良好安全性。其鲁棒性与灵活性对于 QKD 网络等复杂场景也展现出良好价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) is a revolutionary protocol since it is physically immune to all attacks on the detection side. However, the protocol still keeps the strict assumptions on the source side that specify that the four BB84 states must be perfectly prepared to ensure security. Some protocols release part of the assumptions in the encoding system to keep the practical security, but the performance would be dramatically reduced. In this work, we present a MDIQKD protocol that requires less knowledge of the encoding system to combat the troublesome modulation errors and fluctuations. We have also experimentally demonstrated the protocol. The result indicates a high performance and good security for practical applications. Its robustness and flexibility also exhibit a good value for complex scenarios such as the QKD networks.

针对高速量子密钥分发中单光子雪崩光电二极管固有的后脉冲效应，建立了将后脉冲纳入考虑的测量设备无关量子密钥分发模型并据此重新优化系统参数，所得安全密钥率明显高于忽略后脉冲的原有模型。

毫无疑问，测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）是一种能够免疫所有可能的探测器侧信道攻击的关键协议。在准备阶段，通常采用仿真模型得到一组优化参数，并利用这组参数在实际系统中获得更高的安全密钥率。随着高速量子密钥分发的实现，作为单光子雪崩光电二极管固有特性的后脉冲效应已不再可以忽略，这将使实际结果与现有解析模型之间产生很大偏差。本文建立了一个兼容后脉冲效应的 MDI-QKD 模型，用以获得优化参数。结果表明，使用这一兼容后脉冲效应的模型，可以得到比此前忽略后脉冲的模型高得多的密钥率。由于系统工作频率不断提高，将后脉冲效应纳入考虑具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
There is no doubt that measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is a crucial protocol that is immune to all possible detector side channel attacks. In the preparation phase, a simulation model is usually employed to get a set of optimized parameters, which is utilized for getting a higher secure key rate in reality. With the implementation of high-speed QKD, the afterpulse effect which is an intrinsic characteristic of the single-photon avalanche photodiode is no longer ignorable, this will lead to a great deviation compared with the existing analytical model. Here we develop an afterpulse-compatible MDI-QKD model to get the optimized parameters. Our results indicate that by using our afterpulse-compatible model, we can get a much higher key rate than the prior afterpulse-omitted model. It is significant to take the afterpulse effect into consideration because of the improvement of the system working frequency.

提出无需假设源的量子随机数生成协议，仅对可信二维测量作合理假设而无需详细表征，在通用量子攻击下实现超过1 Mbps的生成速率，可组合安全参数达10^{-10}。

随机数的生成在许多科学应用中发挥着重要作用。与伪随机数生成器相比，量子器件能够依据量子力学定律生成真随机数。然而，信息论安全的随机数通常建立在完美的器件模型之上，而该模型可能与现实器件存在偏差。为弥合这一差距，我们提出并实验演示了一种量子随机数生成协议。在我们的协议中，不对源作任何假设；需要对可信的二维测量作出一些合理假设，但不要求对其进行详细表征。即使考虑最一般的量子攻击并使用一般源，我们仍以10^{-10}的通用可组合安全参数实现了超过1 Mbps的随机数生成速率。

Abstract (English)
Generating random numbers plays an important role in many scientific applications. Compared to pseudorandom number generators, a quantum device is capable of generating true random numbers by the laws of quantum mechanics. However, information-theoretical secure random numbers are regularly based on a perfect device model, which may deviate from a real-world device. To close this gap, we propose a quantum random number generation protocol and experimentally demonstrate it. In our protocol, we make no assumptions about the source. Some reasonable assumptions on the trusted two-dimensional measurement are needed, but we do not require a detailed characterization. Even if considering the most general quantum attack and using the general sources, we achieve a randomness generation rate of over 1 Mbps with a universal composable security parameter of 10^{-10}.

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络有望为大量用户提供信息论安全的通信。在 QKD 网络中，被称为测量设备无关（MDI）QKD 的检测安全协议通过支持不可信测量节点，能够自然地增强现实安全性。然而，环境对量子态的扰动会降低多用户通信的性能。我们提出一种 MDI-QKD 组网方案，它对环境扰动具有鲁棒性，并对多用户接入具有适应性：两个以上的用户无需校准参考系，也无需补偿信道的偏振扰动，即可同时生成密钥。为实现这一点，我们引入参考系无关协议以及免偏振补偿方法，设计了多用户测量单元，并将其与原有的双用户单元相结合。该方案在多用户场景中实验演示了网络鲁棒性与适应性的提升；对于 N 用户网络，扰动补偿所需的时间与器件成本可从 O(N) 降至 O(1)。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks are promising to serve large numbers of users with information-theoretic secure communication. In QKD networks, the detection-safe protocol, termed measurement-device-independent (MDI) QKD, can naturally enhance realistic security by supporting untrusted measurement nodes. However, the environmental disturbances to quantum states degrade the performance of multi-user communication. Here we propose an MDI-QKD networking scheme with robustness against environmental disturbance and adaptability to multi-user access, where more than two users can generate keys simultaneously regardless of aligning reference frames and compensating channel disturbance on polarization. To achieve this, we introduce the reference-frame-independent protocol as well as a polarization-compensation-free method, design a multi-user measurement unit, and combine it with original two-user units. The scheme is experimentally demonstrated for the improvement of network robustness and adaptability in multi-user scenarios, and the time and device costs of disturbance compensation can be saved from O ( N ) to O ( 1 ) for an N-user network.

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）基于量子力学的基本不可预测性，有望实现安全的随机数生成。然而，理论模型与实际器件之间不可避免的差距可能导致安全性失效。最近，人们提出了源无关量子随机数发生器（SI-QRNG），以解决光源特性无法表征的问题。然而，在目前大多数SI-QRNG协议的分析中，针对不完美测量的安全性证明是分别针对不同因素给出的，并且对偏离理论模型的微小偏差极为敏感。在此，我们针对SI-QRNG中的不完美测量建立了统一模型，并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系给出了紧致的速率界。随后我们评估了器件不完美度较大时的性能，结果表明，在我们的模型中，随机数速率可以达到常用离散变量QRNG速率上限的相近数量级。此外，利用日常光照和具有较大不完美度的测量器件，我们在实验上以Mbps量级演示了该方案。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) promise secure randomness generation based on the foundational unpredictability of quantum mechanics. However, the unavoidable gaps between theoretical models and practical devices could lead to security invalidation. Recently, a source-independent quantum random number generator (SI-QRNG) has been proposed to solve the issue of uncharacteristic sources. However, in most current analyses of SI-QRNG protocols, the security proofs with imperfect measurements are individual for different factors and very sensitive to small deviations from theoretical models. Here, we establish a unified model for imperfect measurements in the SI-QRNG and provide a tight rate bound based on the uncertainty relation for smooth entropies. Then the performance with large device imperfections is evaluated and the randomness rate in our model can approach a similar order of magnitude of the rate upper bound in common discrete variable QRNGs. In addition, by utilizing the daily illumination and measurement devices with large imperfections, we experimentally demonstrate our scheme at the rate of the order of magnitude of Mbps.

相位匹配量子密钥分发（PM-QKD）为在没有量子中继器的条件下超越基本的速率—距离极限提供了一种有前景的方案。本文将额外的优势蒸馏（AD）步骤插入量子通信之后，以提升 PM-QKD 的性能。仿真结果表明，通过把原始密钥切分为仅含几个比特的块，从而识别出高度相关的比特对，AD 方法能够容忍较高的系统失配误差，并显著提高安全密钥率和传输距离，这在当前的 PM-QKD 系统中非常有前景。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Phase-matching quantum key distribution (PM-QKD) provides a promising solution to surpass the fundamental rate–distance bound without quantum repeaters. In this paper, we insert an additional advantage distillation (AD) step after quantum communication to improve the performance of PM-QKD. Simulation results show that, by splitting the raw key into blocks of only a few bits so as to identify highly correlated bit pairs, the AD method can tolerate high system misalignment errors and improve the secret key rate and transmission distance significantly, which is very promising in current PM-QKD systems.

在7芯多芯光纤上实现量子与经典信道共存，借助空分复用将经典信道发射功率提升至25 dBm，较此前提高近19倍，且二者最小波长间隔仅1.6 nm，无需窄带滤波器。

量子—经典共存可基于波分复用（WDM）实现，但由于拉曼噪声，量子信号与经典信号之间的波长间隔以及经典信道的发射功率受到限制。如今，多芯光纤（MCF）可有效实现空分复用（SDM），从而降低拉曼噪声，进而放宽同波段共存的限制并获得高通信容量。本文在7芯MCF上实现了量子—经典共存。基于SDM，实现了25 dBm的最高发射功率，较此前工作提升了近19倍。此外，量子信道与经典信道均分配在C波段，二者之间的最小波长间隔仅为1.6 nm。该共存系统无需增加窄带滤波器。

Abstract (English)
The quantum–classical coexistence can be implemented based on wavelength division multiplexing (WDM), but due to Raman noise, the wavelength spacing between quantum and classical signals and launch power from classical channels are restricted. Space division multiplexing (SDM) can now be availably achieved by multicore fiber (MCF) to reduce Raman noise, thereby loosening the restriction for coexistence in the same band and obtaining a high communication capacity. In this paper, we realize the quantum–classical coexistence over a 7-core MCF. Based on the SDM, the highest launch power of 25 dBm is achieved which has been extended nearly 19 times in previous work. Moreover, both the quantum and classical channels are allocated in the C-band and the minimum wavelength spacing between them is only 1.6 nm. The coexistence system eliminates the need for adding a narrowband filter.

随机数在从密码任务到数值模拟的各类应用中都有价值。真正的随机性通常被认为只能来自用量子力学描述的量子系统。维度见证使我们能够区分经典与量子情形，并从实验数据评估系统维度。因此，基于维度见证的量子随机数发生器（QRNG）引起了大量研究。这里我们把 Brunner 等人 [Phys. Rev. Lett. 112, 140407 (2014).] 提出的制备-测量型 QRNG 协议推广为一个更一般、更优的协议。在我们的协议中，二维希尔伯特空间的全部互无偏基均可用于约束最小熵，从而在不同的光路损耗和不同的环境扰动下获得更高的随机数产生速率。我们还给出了该协议的原理性实验实现，与先前的方案相比，通过增加光子偏振互无偏基使随机数速率得到提升。我们的方法也可能适用于更高维的量子系统。

Abstract (English)
Random numbers are valuable for applications ranging from cryptographic tasks to numerical simulations. Genuine randomness is generally considered possible only with a quantum system described by quantum mechanics. The dimension witness allows us to distinguish between classical and quantum scenarios, and assess the system dimensions from experimental data. Accordingly, a quantum random number generator (QRNG) based on dimension witnesses has attracted intensive study. Here we extend the prepare-and-measure QRNG protocol proposed by Brunner et al. [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 112 , 140407 ( 2014 ). PRLTAO 0031-9007 10.1103/PhysRevLett.112.140407 ] to a more general and better one. In our protocol, all the mutually unbiased bases of two-dimensional Hilbert space can be used to bound the min-entropy, which leads to a higher random number generation rate in different optical path losses and different environmental disturbances. We also demonstrate a proof-of-principle realization of our protocol, in which the random number rate increases by more photon polarization mutually unbiased bases compared with the previous one. Our method may also be applicable in higher-dimensional quantum systems.

散射信道中的量子密钥分发：波前整形补偿Quantum Key Distribution Over a Channel with Scattering

用波前整形技术补偿高损耗散射量子信道中畸变的光信号，完成偏振编码BB84协议实验，传输效率典型提升约250倍，考虑有限码长效应后仍可建立安全密钥链路。

云、霾和雾对光的散射会降低量子密钥分发（QKD）中通信信道的传输效率，削弱系统的实际安全性，从而制约自由空间QKD的部署。在此，我们采用波前整形技术来补偿高损耗散射量子信道中畸变的光信号，并完成了偏振编码的BB84 QKD实验。借助这一量子信道补偿技术，我们实现了约250倍的典型传输效率提升，并且在考虑有限码长效应的条件下仍能建立安全的通信链路，而在优化之前该链路无法共享安全密钥。该方法应用于QKD系统，表明QKD系统的适用范围有望从无损信道扩展到强散射信道，从而增强全球量子通信网络的部署能力。

Abstract (English)
Scattering of light by cloud, haze, and fog decreases the transmission efficiency of communication channels in quantum key distribution (QKD), reduces the system's practical security, and thus constrains the deployment of free-space QKD. Here, we employ wave-front shaping technology to compensate distorted optical signals in high-loss scattering quantum channels and fulfill a polarization-encoded BB84 QKD experiment. With this quantum-channel compensation technology, we achieve a typical enhancement of about 250 in transmission efficiency and build a secure communication link even considering finite key length effect, while the link is impossible to share secure keys before optimization. The method applied in the QKD system shows the potential to expand the application range of QKD systems from lossless channels to highly scattered ones and therefore enhances the deployment ability of a global quantum communication network.

Qi-Hang Lu, Fang-Xiang Wang, Kun Huang, Xin Wu, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Wei Chen, Zheng-Fu Han

830公里光纤上的双场量子密钥分发Twin-field quantum key distribution over 830-km fibre

★Nat. Photon.

实验实现可容忍超过140 dB信道损耗的双场量子密钥分发系统，安全距离达833.8 km，创下光纤QKD的新纪录，在相近距离上的安全密钥率较此前纪录高出两个数量级以上。

量子密钥分发（QKD）为远程对等方之间基于物理协议共享信息论安全的密钥提供了一种很有前景的解决方案。根据量子物理规律，携带信号的光子不能通过经典光学技术进行放大或中继，否则就无法维持量子安全性。因此，信道的传输损耗限制了其可达距离，这一直是构建大规模量子安全网络的一大障碍。在此，我们展示了一套能够容忍超过140 dB信道损耗的实验QKD系统，实现了833.8 km的安全距离，创造了光纤QKD的新纪录。此外，优化的四相位双场协议和高质量的装置使该系统在相近距离上的安全密钥率比此前纪录高出两个数量级以上。我们的结果标志着朝着在1000 km尺度上构建可靠、高效的地面量子安全网络迈出了突破性的一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides a promising solution for sharing information-theoretic secure keys between remote peers with physics-based protocols. According to the law of quantum physics, the photons carrying signals cannot be amplified or relayed via classical optical techniques to maintain quantum security. As a result, the transmission loss of the channel limits its achievable distance, and this has been a huge barrier towards building large-scale quantum-secure networks. Here we present an experimental QKD system that could tolerate a channel loss beyond 140 dB and obtain a secure distance of 833.8 km, setting a new record for fibre-based QKD. Furthermore, the optimized four-phase twin-field protocol and high-quality set-up make its secure key rate more than two orders of magnitude greater than previous records over similar distances. Our results mark a breakthrough towards building reliable and efficient terrestrial quantum-secure networks over a scale of 1,000 km.

多光子态发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution with multiphoton states

证明发送或不发送双场协议中多光子干涉同样可贡献密钥生成，并将双光子发射事件纳入有效事件，提出改进方案使密钥率高于仅利用单光子干涉的原方案。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议因其克服速率—距离极限的能力而受到广泛研究。人们还提出了TF-QKD的一种变体，称为发送或不发送（SNS）TF-QKD。SNS-TF-QKD将经典密钥0和1编码在发送或不发送相位随机化相干态中，这有助于容忍由光学相位涨落引起的大失准误差。然而，原始SNS-TF-QKD方案仅利用单光子干涉来生成密钥，这似乎与其他TF-QKD协议颇为不同。本文证明，在SNS TF-QKD协议中，多光子干涉也可对密钥生成作出贡献。据此，提出了一种具有更高密钥率的改进SNS-TF-QKD方案，其中不仅单光子发射事件，双光子发射事件也被视为有效事件。

Abstract (English)
The twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) protocol has led to extensive investigation for its capacity of overcoming the rate-distance limit. One variant for TF-QKD named sending-or-not-sending (SNS) TF-QKD has also been proposed. The SNS-TF-QKD encodes the classical keys 0 and 1 in sending or not sending the phase-randomized coherent states, which helps it to tolerate large misalignment errors due to optical phase fluctuations. Nevertheless, the original SNS-TF-QKD scheme utilizes only single-photon interference in generating secret keys, which seems quite different from other TF-QKD protocols. In this paper, we prove that multiphoton interference in the SNS TF-QKD protocol can also contribute to key generation. Accordingly, an improved SNS-TF-QKD scheme with higher key rate is proposed, where events of not only single-photon but also two-photon emissions are considered as effective events.

Jun Teng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Feng-Yu Lu, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

基于超低损耗光纤的量子密钥分发与超高功率经典光通信融合Quantum key distribution integrating with ultra-high-power classical optical communications based on ultra-low-loss fiber

在 75 km 超低损耗光纤上结合有限密钥安全分析与经典信号噪声模型，实现经典信道 25 dBm 发射功率下的离散变量量子密钥分发，为共纤共存报道的最高功率。

考虑到光纤资源与实际应用的灵活性，在同一光纤介质中融合量子密钥分发（QKD）与经典光通信的需求大幅增长。为满足融合 QKD 的经典光网络大规模部署所需的超高功率，我们将有限密钥安全性分析方法与经典信号噪声模型相结合，在 75 km 的超低损耗（ULL）光纤上实现了经典信道发射功率高达 25 dBm 条件下的离散变量量子密钥分发（DV-QKD）。据我们所知，这是 DV-QKD 与经典通信共存时经典信号所达到的最高功率。结果表明，我们的 QKD 系统用于超高功率经典通信是可行的，并且具备耐受性。

Abstract (English)
The demand for the integration of quantum key distribution (QKD) and classical optical communication in the same optical fiber medium greatly increases as fiber resources and the flexibility of practical applications are taken into consideration. To satisfy the needs of the mass deployment of ultra-high power required for classical optical networks integrating QKD, we implement the discrete variable quantum key distribution (DV-QKD) under up to 25 dBm launch power from classical channels over 75 km on an ultra-low-loss (ULL) fiber by combining a finite-key security analysis method with the noise model of classical signals. To the best of our knowledge, this is the highest power launched by classical signals on the coexistence of DV-QKD and classical communication. The results exhibit the feasibility and tolerance of our QKD system for use in ultra-high-power classical communications.

基于混合集成平面光波电路的偏振无关干涉仪Polarization-insensitive interferometer based on a hybrid integrated planar light-wave circuit

将石英平面光波电路芯片与法拉第旋转镜结合实现偏振无关干涉仪，两片带温控的非对称干涉仪串联评估单光子干涉，12小时平均可见度高于99%，起伏小于0.5%。

干涉仪是经典光学系统和量子光学系统中的基本元件。提取光子相位时所需的严格稳定性容易受到偏振变化以及环境扰动所引起相移的影响。在此，我们将石英平面光波电路芯片与法拉第旋转镜相结合，实现了偏振无关的干涉仪。两个带有温度控制器的非对称干涉仪串联连接，用以评估单光子干涉。即使存在主动的随机偏振扰动，12小时内的平均干涉可见度仍高于99%，且起伏小于0.5%。实验结果证实，该混合芯片可满足量子密钥分发和纠缠测量等高要求应用的需要。

Abstract (English)
Interferometers are essential elements in classical and quantum optical systems. The strictly required stability when extracting the phase of photons is vulnerable to polarization variation and phase shift induced by environment disturbance. Here, we implement polarization-insensitive interferometers by combining silica planar light-wave circuit chips and Faraday rotator mirrors. Two asymmetric interferometers with temperature controllers are connected in series to evaluate the single-photon interference. Average interference visibility over 12 h is above 99%, and the variations are less than 0.5%, even with active random polarization disturbance. The experiment results verify that the hybrid chip is available for high-demand applications like quantum key distribution and entanglement measurement.

面向非独立组网网络的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution for nonstandalone networks

提出借鉴5G非独立组网的NSA-MDI方案，使现有各类相位编码BB84网络与终端无需更换硬件即可升级支持测量设备无关量子密钥分发，兼顾安全与带宽需求并提升网络生存性。

最初由测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议实现的不受信节点网络，是通往量子互联网路线图中的关键一步。考虑到可信节点网络已大量部署QKD，需要明确一条将现有网络升级为MDI网络的可行路线。参照5G的非独立组网（NSA）架构，这里提出NSA-MDI方案，作为现有相位编码BB84网络的演进选择。该方案可在不改变硬件的情况下，将采用各种相位编码方案的BB84网络和终端立即升级为支持MDI。这种高性价比的升级在充分利用现有网络的同时，有效推动了作为不受信节点网络一步的MDI网络部署。此外，它还满足了差异化的安全与带宽需求，并提高了网络生存性。

Abstract (English)
Untrusted node networks initially implemented by measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol are a crucial step on the roadmap of the quantum Internet. Considering extensive QKD implementations of trusted node networks, a workable upgrading tactic of existing networks toward MDI networks needs to be explicit. Here, referring to the nonstandalone (NSA) network of 5G, we propose an NSA-MDI scheme as an evolutionary selection for existing phase-encoding BB84 networks. Our solution can upgrade the BB84 networks and terminals that employ various phase-encoding schemes to immediately support MDI without hardware changes. This cost-effective upgrade effectively promotes the deployment of MDI networks as a step of untrusted node networks while taking full advantage of existing networks. In addition, the diversified demands on security and bandwidth are satisfied, and network survivability is improved.

利用非光子数分辨探测器表征量子密钥分发脉冲光源的光子数分布Characterizing photon-number distribution of pulsed sources using non–photon-number-resolving detectors for quantum key distribution

提出一种用非光子数分辨探测器测量脉冲光源光子数分布的方法，通过数值模拟验证了方案可行性，并在泊松光源上完成实验检验，可用于评估未知光源与新型光源。

量子密钥分发（QKD）有望实现无条件安全通信，但许多实际系统问题仍待解决。发射端安全性是量子密钥分发安全性的重要组成部分，而测量光子数分布有助于提升这一安全性。该测量对于测量未知光源或测试新设计的光源同样有用。本文提出一种利用非光子数分辨探测器测量脉冲光子数分布的方法，并通过数值模拟对该方案进行检验，表现良好；同时还在泊松光源上开展了实验以检验该方法。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) has a prospect to realize unconditional secure communication. However, many real system problems should be solved. Transmitters security is an important part of QKD security. And measuring photon number distribution could help improve it. This measurement is also useful for measuring unknown sources or testing newly designed sources. In this article, a method to measure the photon number distribution of pulses using non-photon-number-resolving detectors is proposed. Numerical simulation is conducted to test this scheme and performs well. Experiment on Poisson source is also used to test this method.

基于线性光耦合器的紧凑型量子随机数产生Compact quantum random number generation using a linear optocoupler

利用发光二极管与光电探测器构成的集成线性光耦结构，直接测量输出光强噪声来产生随机比特，经 SHA-256 后处理后速率达 43 Mbps，序列通过 NIST 随机性检验。

迄今为止，已有多种量子随机数方案得到演示。然而，成本、体积以及最终的随机比特产生速率通常限制了它们作为现成产品被广泛应用。为克服这些限制，我们提出并演示了一种基于线性光耦合器的紧凑、简单且低成本的量子随机数产生方案。其集成结构主要由一个发光二极管和一个光电探测器构成。随机比特通过直接测量输出光的强度噪声来产生，该噪声源于发光二极管中 p 区空穴与 n 区电子之间的随机复合。此外，我们的系统对工作环境的涨落具有鲁棒性，并可扩展为并行结构，这对量子随机数产生的实用化与商业化应用具有重要意义。经 SHA-256 算法后处理后，获得 43 Mbps 的随机数产生速率。最终随机比特序列的自相关系数很低，其标准差为 3.16 × 10 − 4，并通过了 NIST 统计测试套件测试。

Abstract (English)
To date, various quantum random number schemes have been demonstrated. However, the cost, size, and final random bit generation rate usually limits their wide application on-shelf. To overcome these limitations, we propose and demonstrate a compact, simple, and low-cost quantum random number generation based on a linear optocoupler. Its integrated structure consists mainly of a light emitting diode and a photodetector. Random bits are generated by directly measuring the intensity noise of the output light, which originates from the random recombination between holes of the p region and electrons of the n region in a light emitting diode. Moreover, our system is robust against fluctuation of the operating environment, and can be extended to a parallel structure, which will be of great significance for the practical and commercial application of quantum random number generation. After post-processing by the SHA-256 algorithm, a random number generation rate of 43 Mbps is obtained. Finally, the final random bit sequences have low autocorrelation coefficients with a standard deviation of 3.16 × 10 − 4 and pass the NIST-Statistical Test Suite test.

无需监测信号扰动的量子密钥分发紧致有限密钥分析Tight finite-key analysis for quantum key distribution without monitoring signal disturbance

基于熵不确定关系与 Azuma 不等式，为轮询差分相移协议给出可抵御最一般相干攻击的紧致有限密钥安全性证明，表明相位随机化光源下实验可及的脉冲数即可逼近渐近极限。

与传统通信不同，量子密钥分发（QKD）能够达到无条件安全，因而受到大量研究关注。在现有各类 QKD 协议中，轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议无需监测信号扰动即可运行，这显著简化了其流程并提高了对误码率的容忍度。尽管已有若干 RRDPS 的安全性证明，但针对实际相位随机化光源的紧致有限密钥分析仍然缺失。本文基于熵不确定关系，提出了一种改进的 RRDPS 安全性证明，可抵御最一般的相干攻击。此外，借助 Azuma 不等式，我们的证明能够很好地处理有限密钥效应。所提出的有限密钥分析保持了相位随机化光源的优势，并表明实验上可接受的脉冲数足以接近渐近极限。这些结果有助于实现无需监测信号扰动的实用化 QKD。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Unlike traditional communication, quantum key distribution (QKD) can reach unconditional security and thus attracts intensive studies. Among all existing QKD protocols, round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) protocol can be running without monitoring signal disturbance, which significantly simplifies its flow and improves its tolerance of error rate. Although several security proofs of RRDPS have been given, a tight finite-key analysis with a practical phase-randomized source is still missing. In this paper, we propose an improved security proof of RRDPS against the most general coherent attack based on the entropic uncertainty relation. What’s more, with the help of Azuma’s inequality, our proof can tackle finite-key effects primely. The proposed finite-key analysis keeps the advantages of phase randomization source and indicates experimentally acceptable numbers of pulses are sufficient to approach the asymptotical bound closely. The results shed light on practical QKD without monitoring signal disturbance.

Hang Liu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1038/s41534-021-00428-9

No. 08

高发射功率下基于标准单模光纤的量子密钥分发与光传送网共存Coexistence of quantum key distribution and optical transport network based on standard single-mode fiber at high launch power

在50 km标准G.652光纤上以15 dBm发射功率实现量子密钥分发与80 Gbps经典数据共存，20 km处安全密钥率达11 Kbps，并验证了对160 Gbps经典光功率高达18 dBm的容忍度。

考虑到城域光网络中的高成本和实际应用，单纤中量子密钥分发与光通信的复用需求日益增长。这里，我们在50 km广泛使用的标准（国际电信联盟电信标准化部门G.652建议）电信光纤上，以15 dBm发射功率实现了量子密钥分发与80 Gbps经典数据光传送网的集成，在20 km处获得11 Kbps的安全密钥率。通过容忍单模光纤上高达18 dBm的160 Gbps经典数据光功率，我们的结果表明量子密钥分发在未来大容量传输系统（如城域网和数据中心）中应用的潜力与容忍度。该量子密钥分发系统采用基于法拉第–米歇尔森干涉仪的相位编码方案，稳定、实用且对信道偏振扰动不敏感。我们还讨论了复用环境下量子密钥分发性能的基本极限。

Abstract (English)
There is an increasing demand for multiplexing of quantum key distribution with optical communications in single fiber in consideration of high costs and practical applications in the metropolitan optical network. Here, we realize the integration of quantum key distribution and an optical transport network of 80 Gbps classical data at 15 dBm launch power over 50 km of the widely used standard (G.652 Recommendation of the International Telecom Union Telecom Standardization Sector) telecom fiber. A secure key rate of 11 Kbps over 20 km is obtained. By tolerating a high classical optical power up to 18 dBm of 160 Gbps classical data on single-mode fiber, our result shows the potential and tolerance of quantum key distribution being used in future large capacity transmission systems, such as metropolitan area networks and data centers. The quantum key distribution system is stable, practical, and insensitive to the polarization disturbance of channels by using a phase coding system based on a Faraday–Michelson interferometer. We also discuss the fundamental limit for quantum key distribution performance in the multiplexing environment.

Jia-Qi Geng, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang, Qi-Fa Zhang, Ying-Ying Hu, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 09

用于安全稳定高性能诱骗态量子密钥分发的强度调制器Intensity modulator for secure, stable, and high-performance decoy-state quantum key distribution

设计并实验验证了一种专用强度调制器及其配套调制方法，其强度稳定可调、支持便捷的两级调制、固有高速且结构紧凑，可抑制传统器件的侧信道，提升诱骗态量子密钥分发的安全性与稳定性。

诱骗态方法大幅提升了量子密钥分发的性能，并完美解决了多光子脉冲带来的关键问题。近年来，诱骗态方法在实用性方面占据关键地位，几乎所有QKD系统都采用了诱骗态方法。然而，传统强度调制器的不完美性限制了诱骗态方法的性能并引入侧信道。本工作设计了一种特殊的强度调制器及其配套调制方法，并进行了实验验证，以实现安全、稳定、高性能的诱骗态QKD。实验结果表明，其稳定且可调的强度、便捷的两级调制、固有的高速特性以及紧凑结构非常契合未来发展趋势，将有助于诱骗态方法完美地应用于QKD系统。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The decoy-state method substantially improves the performance of quantum key distribution (QKD) and perfectly solves crucial issues caused by multiphoton pulses. In recent years, the decoy-state method has occupied a key position in practicality, and almost all the QKD systems have employed the decoy-state method. However, the imperfections of traditional intensity modulators limit the performance of the decoy-state method and bring side channels. In this work, a special intensity modulator and its accompanying modulation method are designed and experimentally verified for the secure, stable, and high-performance decoy-state QKDs. The experimental result indicates that its stable and adjustable intensities, convenient two-level modulation, inherently high speed, and compact structure is extremely fit for future trends and will help the decoy-state method to be perfectly applied to QKD systems.

Feng-Yu Lu, Xing Lin, Shuang Wang, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Peng Ye, Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

广义高维量子密钥分发的紧致有限密钥分析Tight finite-key analysis for generalized high-dimensional quantum key distribution

引入“密钥分类”思想并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系发展相关技术，给出了适用于广义高维量子密钥分发协议的紧致有限密钥分析，使有限资源条件下的高维协议在实验上成为可行。

由于能够容忍较高的误码率并在每次试验中产生更多密钥比特，高维量子密钥分发引起了广泛兴趣。尽管高维量子密钥分发已取得很大进展，理论与实验之间仍存在一些差距。其中之一是密钥的安全性严重依赖于发射信号的数量。迄今为止，现有的安全性证明仅适用于发射信号数量为无穷大或不切实际地大的情形。在此，我们通过引入“密钥分类”的思想，并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系发展相关技术，提出了一种适用于广义高维量子密钥分发协议的紧致有限密钥分析。得益于我们的理论，具有有限资源的高维量子密钥分发协议在实验上变得可行。

Abstract (English)
Due to the capability of tolerating high error rate and generating more key bits per trial, high-dimensional quantum key distribution attracts wide interest.Despite great progresses in high-dimensional quantum key distribution, there are still some gaps between theory and experiment.One of these is that the security of the secret key heavily depends on the number of the emitted signals.So far, the existing security proofs are only suitable in the case with an infinite or unpractically large number of emitted signals.Here, by introducing the idea of "key classification" and developing relevant techniques based on the uncertainty relation for smooth entropies, we propose a tight finite-key analysis suitable for generalized high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocols.Benefitting from our theory, high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocols with finite resources become experimentally feasible.

系统梳理诱骗态方法在方案设计、有限尺寸分析与参数估计等方面的进展，用粒子群优化算法在五种系统参数变化下比较 38 种协议的密钥率，给出不同场景下最优协议的选择指南。

诱骗态协议使量子密钥分发（QKD）系统无需使用单光子源即可获得高性能。在诱骗态协议提出后的十余年里，方案设计、有限尺寸分析、系统建模和参数估计等方面取得了一系列进展。遗憾的是，这些进展大多基于不同的出发点，缺乏综合比较以找出诱骗态方法的最优协议。本文回顾了诱骗态方法的各项进展，并对其进行综合，利用粒子群优化（PSO）算法比较了 38 种诱骗态协议的密钥率性能。为给实用 QKD 系统提供指导，我们在五个系统参数（传输损耗、后处理块大小、失准误差概率、暗计数概率和后脉冲率）变化的情况下找出了最优诱骗态协议。期望本工作能够回答不同诱骗态协议在各种场景下的实际性能如何，以及对于各类 QKD 系统哪种诱骗态协议是最优选择的问题。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The decoy‐state protocol enables quantum key distribution (QKD) systems to achieve high performance without using the single‐photon source. In the dozen years since the decoy‐state protocol has been proposed, a series of advances in scheme design, finite‐size analysis, system modelling, and parameter estimation has developed. Unfortunately, most advances are based on different starting points and lack a synthesis to figure out the optimal protocol of decoy‐state method. Here, the advances in decoy‐state method are reviewed and they are synthesized to compare the key‐rate performance of 38 decoy‐state protocols using the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. To form a guideline for practical QKD systems, the optimal decoy‐state protocols are found with the change of five system parameters (the transmission loss, the block size of postprocessing, the misalignment‐error probability, the dark‐count probability, and the afterpulse rate). It is expected that this work can answer the questions of what the actual performance is for different decoy‐state protocol in various scenarios and which decoy‐state protocol is the optimal choice for various QKD systems.

利用时间鬼成像感知量子密钥分发中的量子黑客攻击Perceiving Quantum Hacking for Quantum Key Distribution Using Temporal Ghost Imaging

提出用时间鬼成像获取量子信号、量子信道与QKD系统的时间指纹，从而感知量子黑客攻击，并实验验证了其有效性，从信号与系统视角为提升实际安全性提供通用途径。

量子密钥分发（QKD）能够利用量子力学在远程用户之间生成安全密钥比特。然而，理论模型与实际实现之间的差距为窃听者提供了截获密钥的机会。最隐蔽的攻击被称为量子黑客攻击，即利用QKD系统的边信道漏洞使测量结果没有明显偏差的攻击。刻画量子信号、量子信道和QKD系统的全时间尺度特性，可以为合法用户提供击败恶意攻击的额外能力。这里，我们提出一种利用时间鬼成像（TGI）方案、以时间指纹感知量子黑客攻击的方法，并实验验证了其有效性。该方案从信号与系统的独特视角，提供了一条提升QKD实际安全性的通用途径。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can generate secure key bits between remote users with quantum mechanics. However, the gap between the theoretical model and practical realizations gives eavesdroppers opportunities to intercept the secret key. The most insidious attacks, known as quantum hacking, are the ones with no significant discrepancy of the measurement results using side-channel loopholes of QKD systems. Depicting full-time-scale characteristics of the quantum signals, the quantum channel, and the QKD system can provide legitimate users extra capabilities to defeat malicious attacks. Here, we propose the method exploring a temporal ghost-imaging (TGI) scheme to perceive quantum hacking with temporal fingerprints and experimentally verify its validity. The scheme presents a common approach to promote QKD's practical security from a unique perspective of signals and systems.

用强关联修正的密度泛函理论结合电导弛豫与程序升温脱附实验，揭示Ni10-CeO2(111)上氢氧化以伴随氢溢流的界面路径为主，界面反应贡献达98%，浸渍Ni形成界面使800°C活性提升72%。

Ni–二氧化铈金属陶瓷因其催化活性以及二氧化铈基材料因铈的可变价态而具有的混合电导，是中温固体氧化物燃料电池的潜在阳极。然而，Ni–二氧化铈体系中的阳极反应机理仍需进一步揭示。本工作采用强关联修正的密度泛函理论，深入研究了在Ni10-CeO2(111)模型体系上氢氧化反应的反应路径。计算表明，电子倾向于从Ni10团簇转移到铈表面，形成表面氧空位。考虑不同吸附位点后提出了六条路径，发现伴随氢溢流进行的界面路径是主导过程，其吸附能高达−1.859 eV，能垒为0.885 eV。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结果通过电导弛豫和程序升温脱附等实验测量得到验证。界面反应对总氢氧化反应的贡献高达98%，而通过将Ni浸渍到多孔二氧化铈中形成Ni–二氧化铈界面，使800°C下的电化学活性提高了72%。

Abstract (English)
Ni–ceria cermets are potential anodes for intermediate-temperature solid oxide fuel cells, thanks to the catalytic activity and mixed conductivities of ceria-based materials associated with the variable valence states of cerium. However, the anodic reaction mechanism in the Ni–ceria systems needs to be further revealed. Via density functional theory with strong correlated correction method, this work gains insight into reaction pathways of hydrogen oxidation on a model system of Ni 10 -CeO 2 (111). The calculation shows that electrons tend to be transferred from Ni 10 cluster to cerium surface, creating surface oxygen vacancies. Six pathways are proposed considering different adsorption sites, and the interface pathway proceeding with hydrogen spillover is found to be the prevailing process, which includes a high adsorption energy of −1.859 eV and an energy barrier of 0.885 eV. The density functional theory (DFT) calculation results are verified through experimental measurements including electrical conductivity relaxation and temperature programmed desorption. The contribution of interface reaction to the total hydrogen oxidation reaction reaches up to 98%, and the formation of Ni–ceria interface by infiltrating Ni to porous ceria improves the electrochemical activity by 72% at 800°C.

综述飞机与无人机平台量子密钥分发的最新进展，梳理自由空间信道传输与移动平台链路等关键技术，并展望机载量子通信在天地一体化网络中承担灵活中继的作用。

自由空间量子密钥分发（QKD）已取得令人瞩目的成就，它是扩展量子通信传输距离的一种可行途径。借助卫星、飞机、无人机（UAV）等移动平台经由自由空间信道传输量子比特的可行性已得到验证。鉴于星基 QKD 的工作时间与资源消耗有限，且卫星节点与地面网络之间存在最后一公里难题，机载 QKD 有望为大规模一体化网络提供灵活的链路与中继。本文综述了基于飞机或无人机的 QKD 近期的重要进展，重点介绍其关键技术，并展望机载量子通信的未来。

Abstract (English)
Remarkable achievements have been witnessed in free-space quantum key distribution (QKD), which acts as an available approach to extend the transmission range of quantum communications.The feasibility of transmitting qubits through the free-space channel with the aid of moving platforms like satellites, aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has been verified.In view of the limited working time and resource consumption of the satellite-based QKD and the last-mile challenges of connecting satellite nodes with terrestrial networks, the airborne QKD is expected to provide flexible and relay links for the large-scale integrated network.This paper reviews the recent significant progress of QKD based on aircraft or UAVs, highlights their critical techniques, and prospects the future of airborne quantum communications.

器件非完美条件下源无关量子随机数发生器的安全性分析与改进Security analysis and improvement of source independent quantum random number generators with imperfect devices

指出源无关量子随机数发生器中可信但非完美测量器件的安全漏洞，通过重算条件最小熵并加装监测器加以修补，并发现采样轮数很大时后脉冲的影响可超过有限尺寸效应。

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）作为一种真正的随机性来源，在数值模拟和密码学等许多应用中不可或缺。最近，一种源无关量子随机数发生器（SI-QRNG）已经实现，它可以在光源不可信的情况下产生安全的随机数。然而，SI-QRNG 中所使用的可信但非完美器件的测量漏洞尚未被充分探究，这会带来安全性问题，尤其是在高速系统中。在此，我们指出并评估了 SI-QRNG 中实际非完美测量器件的安全漏洞。我们还给出了相应的对策，通过重新计算条件最小熵并增加监测器来防止这些信息泄露。此外，在考虑有限尺寸效应的情况下，我们表明当采样轮数很大时，后脉冲的影响可能超过有限尺寸效应的影响。我们的协议简单而有效，提升了 SI-QRNG 在实际中的安全性以及与高速测量器件的兼容性，从而为构建超快且安全性可认证的商用 SI-QRNG 系统铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A quantum random number generator (QRNG) as a genuine source of randomness is essential in many applications, such as number simulation and cryptography. Recently, a source-independent quantum random number generator (SI-QRNG), which can generate secure random numbers with untrusted sources, has been realized. However, the measurement loopholes of the trusted but imperfect devices used in SI-QRNGs have not yet been fully explored, which will cause security problems, especially in high-speed systems. Here, we point out and evaluate the security loopholes of practical imperfect measurement devices in SI-QRNGs. We also provide corresponding countermeasures to prevent these information leakages by recalculating the conditional minimum entropy and adding a monitor. Furthermore, by taking into account the finite-size effect, we show that the influence of the afterpulse can exceed that of the finite-size effect with the large number of sampled rounds. Our protocol is simple and effective, and it promotes the security of SI-QRNG in practice as well as the compatibility with high-speed measurement devices, thus paving the way for constructing ultrafast and security-certified commercial SI-QRNG systems.

Xing Lin, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Rong Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

利用标准单模光纤中的后向自发拉曼散射，同时提取光子波长叠加与到达时间的随机性；每个有效探测得到5比特原始数据，含2.87比特最小熵，经后处理后通过NIST检验。

我们研究了基于标准单模光纤中后向自发拉曼散射的量子随机数产生方案，其中同时利用了光子波长叠加与到达时间的随机性。实验采用四个工作在门控盖革模式下的雪崩光电二极管，探测来自四个不同波长通道的后向拉曼散射光子，并在探测器之后放置时间数字转换器以记录其到达时间。来自不同通道的光子的波长信息与到达时间间隔信息均被用于产生随机比特。由于这两种熵源彼此独立，本系统的随机数资源得到了充分利用。每次有效探测可获得5比特原始数据，其中包含2.87比特最小熵。为获得随机比特的最佳产生速率，选用了合适的泵浦功率与光纤长度。采用SHA-256哈希算法进行后处理以消除原始数据的偏置，最终得到的随机比特序列通过了NIST统计检验。

Abstract (English)
We investigate quantum random number generation based on backward spontaneous Raman scattering in standard single-mode fiber, where the randomness of photon wavelength superposition and arrival time is simultaneously utilized. The experiment uses four avalanche photodiodes working in gated Geiger mode to detect backward Raman scattering photons from four different wavelength channels and a time-to-digital converter placed behind the detectors to record their arrival time. Both information of the wavelength and arrival time interval of photons from different channels are applied to generate random bits. Due to the independence of these two entropy sources, the random number resource of the present system is fully utilized. Five-bit raw data can be obtained for every effective click, which contains 2.87-bit min-entropy. To obtain the optimal generation rate of random bits, appropriate pump power and fiber length are adopted. The post-processing method by the SHA-256 hashing algorithm is used to remove the bias of the raw data, after which the final random bit sequences pass the NIST statistical test.

基于被动诱骗态的双场量子密钥分发Twin-field quantum key distribution with passive-decoy state

提出将双场量子密钥分发与被动诱骗态方法相结合，以规避主动调制光衰减器带来的侧信道风险；仿真表明其密钥率与主动诱骗方案相当，且仅需少量光子探测器即可获得令人满意的密钥率。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体，例如相位匹配QKD、发送或不发送QKD以及无相位后选择TF-QKD，有望在长距离上实现高密钥率，从而无需中继器即可突破速率-距离极限。这些协议的安全性证明基于诱骗态方法，而在实际实验中，诱骗态方法通常通过主动调制可变光衰减器并结合随机数发生器来实现；然而，这类主动诱骗方案可能引入侧信道，从而打开安全漏洞。为增强TF-QKD的源端安全性，本文提出基于被动诱骗态的TF-QKD，即将TF-QKD与被动诱骗方法相结合。我们通过仿真将其密钥生成率与主动诱骗情形进行比较，结果表明该方案的表现与主动诱骗TF-QKD一样好，并且仅需少量光子探测器即可达到令人满意的密钥率。这表明我们的工作具有实际意义。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Twin-Field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variants, e.g. phase-maching QKD, sending-or-not-sending QKD, and no phase post-selection TFQKD promise high key rates at long distance to beat the rate distance limit without a repeater. The security proof of these protocols are based on decoy-state method, which is usually performed by actively modulating a variable optical attenuator together with a random number generator in practical experiments, however, active-decoy schemes like this may lead to side channel and could open a security loophole. To enhance the source security of TF-QKD, in this paper, we propose passive-decoy based TF-QKD, in which we combine TF-QKD with the passive-decoy method. And we present a simulation comparing the key generation rate with that in active-decoy, the result shows our scheme performs as good as active decoy TF-QKD, and our scheme could reach satisfactory secret key rates with just a few photon detectors. This shows our work is meaningful in practice.

将编码模式中全局相位的数目离散化，由此统一了前两类双场量子密钥分发协议，并揭示增加离散相位数目可延长可达距离，但短距离密钥率会因相位后选择而下降。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体协议极具吸引力，因为它们具有克服点对点 QKD 协议密钥率-损耗极限的优势。对于 TF-QKD 的各种变体而言，确保安全性的关键在于在编码模式与测试模式之间随机切换。在所有 TF-QKD 协议中，它们的编码模式差别很大，例如调制连续相位、仅调制两个相反相位，以及发送或不发送信号脉冲。在这里我们表明，通过对编码模式中全局相位的数目进行离散化，我们可以对前两类 TF-QKD 协议给出统一的视角，并证明增加离散相位的数目可以延长可达距离；而作为权衡，由于相位后选择，短距离下的密钥率会降低。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variant protocols are highly attractive due to the advantage of overcoming the rate-loss limit for secret key rates of point-to-point QKD protocols. For variations of TF-QKD, the key point to ensure security is switching randomly between a code mode and a test mode. Among all TF-QKD protocols, their code modes are very different, e.g. modulating continuous phases, modulating only two opposite phases, and sending or not sending signal pulses. Here we show that, by discretizing the number of global phases in the code mode, we can give a unified view on the first two types of TF-QKD protocols, and demonstrate that increasing the number of discrete phases extends the achievable distance, and as a trade-off, lowers the secret key rate at short distances due to the phase post-selection.

量子密钥分发系统的通用仿真框架A universal simulating framework for quantum key distribution systems

建立了基于量子算符描述与事件驱动机制的通用 QKD 系统仿真框架，光学器件可自由组合并计入器件缺陷与量子非局域特性，单光子与 HOM 干涉仿真结果与理论吻合。

量子密钥分发（QKD）提供了一种基于物理原理的方式，使远程用户能够安全地协商密钥。仿真是设计和优化 QKD 系统的重要手段。我们基于光子信号与光学器件的量子算符描述，开发了一个通用仿真框架。光学器件可以自由组合，并由光子激发事件驱动，这使其原则上适用于任意 QKD 系统。我们的框架关注光学器件与系统结构的真实特性，在建模时考虑了器件的不完美性以及量子系统的非局域性质。我们仿真了单光子和 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉光学单元，它们是 QKD 系统的基础。使用这一事件驱动框架得到的结果与理论结果吻合良好，表明其用于 QKD 的可行性。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides a physical-based way to conciliate keys between remote users securely. Simulation is an essential method for designing and optimizing QKD systems. We develop a universal simulation framework based on quantum operator descriptions of photon signals and optical devices. The optical devices can be freely combined and driven by the photon excitation events, which make it appropriate for arbitrary QKD systems in principle. Our framework focuses on realistic characters of optical devices and system structures. The imperfections of the devices and the non-local properties of a quantum system are taken into account when modeling. We simulate the single-photon and Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference optical units, which are fundamental of QKD systems. The results using this event-driven framework agree well with the theoretical results, which indicate its feasibility for QKD.

基于广义算符支配条件的双场量子密钥分发有限密钥分析Finite-key analysis for twin-field quantum key distribution based on generalized operator dominance condition

针对现有基于算符支配条件的双场QKD有限密钥分析只适用于三诱骗态、无法靠增加诱骗态提升密钥率的局限，设计了新的算符支配条件，使密钥率随诱骗态数目增加而提高并逼近渐近界。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可以帮助两个相距遥远的通信方共享密钥比特，其安全性由物理定律保证。在实际中，QKD协议的密钥率总是随信道距离的增加而降低，这严重限制了QKD的应用。近来，双场（TF）QKD被提出并得到深入研究，因为它能够突破速率-距离极限，并大幅提高QKD可达到的距离。值得注意的是，K. Maeda等人基于算符支配条件提出了一种简单的TF-QKD有限密钥分析。尽管他们证明其方法足以突破速率-距离极限，但其算符支配条件并不具有一般性，即只能应用于三诱骗态情形，这意味着其密钥率无法通过引入更多诱骗态而提高，即使在制备无穷多诱骗态和光脉冲的情况下也无法达到渐近界。为弥补这一空白，我们通过设计新的算符支配条件，提出了改进的TF-QKD有限密钥分析。我们表明，增加诱骗态数目可以进一步提高密钥率并逼近渐近界。我们的理论可直接用于TF-QKD实验以获得更高的密钥率。我们的结果可直接用于实验以获得更高的密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can help two distant peers to share secret key bits, whose security is guaranteed by the law of physics. In practice, the secret key rate of a QKD protocol is always lowered with the increasing of channel distance, which severely limits the applications of QKD. Recently, twin-field (TF) QKD has been proposed and intensively studied, since it can beat the rate-distance limit and greatly increase the achievable distance of QKD. Remarkalebly, K. Maeda et. al. proposed a simple finite-key analysis for TF-QKD based on operator dominance condition. Although they showed that their method is sufficient to beat the rate-distance limit, their operator dominance condition is not general, i.e. it can be only applied in three decoy states scenarios, which implies that its key rate cannot be increased by introducing more decoy states, and also cannot reach the asymptotic bound even in case of preparing infinite decoy states and optical pulses. Here, to bridge this gap, we propose an improved finite-key analysis of TF-QKD through devising new operator dominance condition. We show that by adding the number of decoy states, the secret key rate can be furtherly improved and approach the asymptotic bound. Our theory can be directly used in TF-QKD experiment to obtain higher secret key rate. Our results can be directly used in experiments to obtain higher key rates.

面向动态量子密钥分发网络的单光子雪崩光电二极管优化Optimizing Single-Photon Avalanche Photodiodes for Dynamic Quantum Key Distribution Networks

把单光子雪崩二极管的探测效率、暗计数概率与后脉冲率纳入参数优化，通过调节电压与温度提升动态量子密钥分发网络的安全密钥率及其对信道变化与不对称性的适应能力。

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络可以在众多远程用户之间提供无条件安全的通信。在实际 QKD 网络中，随着节点的动态接入与退出，各用户链路的品质以及不同用户之间的链路长度（例如传输损耗）各不相同并且不断变化。针对各种信道环境进行定制化优化能够带来网络性能收益。在本文中，我们将单光子雪崩光电二极管（SPAD）的探测效率、暗计数概率和后脉冲率纳入参数优化，通过控制其电压和温度来优化动态 QKD 网络中的安全密钥率。结果表明，我们的方法提高了网络对信道变化与不对称性的适应能力，并且有利于在复杂信道环境中建立 QKD 网络。该方法适用于任意基于 SPAD 的 QKD 系统与网络架构。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks can provide unconditional secure communications among many remote users. In real QKD networks, with the dynamic access and quit of nodes, qualities of various user links and the link lengths among different users, such as transmission loss, are different and changing. Customized optimization that aims at various channel environments offers a network performance benefit. In this paper, we propose including the detection efficiency, dark-count probability, and afterpulse rate of the single-photon avalanche photodiode (SPAD) into the parameter optimization by controlling its voltage and temperature to optimize the secure key rates in dynamic QKD networks. The result shows that our method improves the network adaptability to the variation and asymmetry of channel and profits the establishment of QKD networks in a complex channel environment. This method is suitable for arbitrary SPAD-based QKD system and network architecture.

参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发的高效诱骗态Efficient decoy states for the reference-frame-independent measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

针对参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发，指出原始诱骗态方法因忽略不同基之间的潜在关联而过于悲观地估计相关产额，联合处理各基参数后显著提升了统计涨落下的密钥率与可达距离。

参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发（RFI-MDI-QKD）是一种新颖的协议，它消除了探测器端一切可能的攻击，也消除了源端进行参考系校准的必要性。然而，由于需要积累更多参数（例如失配基事件的产额与误码率）来监测安全性，统计涨落可能使其性能明显下降。本工作发现，原始诱骗态方法由于忽略了不同基之间的潜在关联，对这些产额的估计过于悲观。通过联合处理不同基的参数，在考虑统计涨落的情况下（统计涨落分析是最终分析有限码长效应的第一步），RFI-MDI-QKD 在密钥率和可达距离方面均得到大幅改善。我们的结果为通向实用化的 RFI-MDI-QKD 开辟了道路。

Abstract (English)
Reference-frame-independent measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (RFI-MDI-QKD) is a novel protocol that eliminates all possible attacks on the detector side and the necessity of reference-frame alignment in source sides. However, its performance may degrade notably due to statistical fluctuations since more parameters, e.g., yields and error rates for mismatched-basis events, must be accumulated to monitor the security. In this work, we find that the original decoy states method estimates these yields overpessimistically since it ignores the potential relations between different bases. Through jointly processing parameters of different bases, the performance of RFI-MDI-QKD is greatly improved in terms of the secret key rate and achievable distance when statistical fluctuations are considered (the statistical fluctuation analysis is the first step to the final analysis of the finite key size effect). Our results pave an avenue towards practical RFI-MDI-QKD.

Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Rong Wang, Hang Liu, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

往返差分相移量子密钥分发协议的有限码长分析Finite-key analysis for round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution

用后选择技术把往返差分相移协议的安全性证明推广到有限码长情形，预言其有限码长密钥率可与渐近情形相比拟。

自往返差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议提出以来，它因具有无需监测信号扰动即可限定信息泄露量这一独特性质而备受关注。最近，Yin 等人发展了一种新理论，可紧致地估计其信息泄露量。然而，有限码长效应尚未被纳入考虑。本文填补这一空白，利用后选择技术把 RRDPS 协议的安全性证明推广到有限码长情形。由此可以预期，在有限码长情形下 RRDPS 的密钥率能够与渐近情形相比拟，这对实际应用具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
Since the round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol was proposed, it has attracted much attention due to its unique characteristic i.e., it can bind the amount of information leakage without monitoring signal disturbance. Recently, Yin et al . have developed a novel theory to estimate its information leakage tightly. However, the finite-sized key effects are not taken into account. Here, we fill this gap and extend the security proof of the RRDPS protocol to the finite-sized regime using post-selection technique. As a consequence, it’s predicted that the key rate of RRDPS in a finite-sized key scenario can be comparable to the asymptotic one, which is meaningful for the real-life applications.

量子密钥分发（QKD）能够在量子力学原理的保证下，在远程合法用户之间分发对称密钥比特。对于实际应用，人们越来越关注将光源、探测器和调制器集成在光子芯片上。该工作将克尔耗散孤子引入微谐振腔，作为GHz量子密钥分发系统的光源；原理性实验表明，利用孤子的相干梳线可以实现并行量子密钥分发。该工作还使用现成的波分复用模块和片上孤子光源验证了并行QKD的性能。由于片上孤子可以提供覆盖C波段和L波段的数百个载波，这些结果表明，通过大规模并行QKD实现超高安全密钥率是可行的，尤其是在与蓬勃发展的光子集成电路技术相结合时。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) can distribute symmetric key bits between remote legitimate users with the guarantee of quantum mechanics principles. For practical applications, there is increasing attention to integrating the source, detectors, and modulators on a photonic chip. Here, the Kerr dissipative soliton is introduced in a microresonator as the light source for GHz QKD systems, and the proof‐of‐principle experiment demonstrates the parallel QKD can be achieved using coherent comb lines from the soliton. The performance of parallel QKD is also verified by using the off‐the‐shelf wavelength division modules and the on‐chip soliton source. Since the on‐chip soliton can provide hundreds of carriers covering the C and L bands, the results exhibit the feasibility to achieve ultra‐high rate secure key bits through massively parallel QKD, especially when incorporated with the thriving photonic integrated circuit technology.

针对对准误差理论模型仅描述单光子行为、与弱相干光源不相容的问题，引入可在实际系统中便捷测得的泄漏光比，构建了包含多光子脉冲传输并能精确刻画双击事件的模型，缩小了理论与实际系统的差距。

在光学量子密码中，对准误差是量子密钥分发（QKD）安全密钥生成中的重要因素，也是错误事件的根源之一。然而，理论建模通常只反映单光子的行为，与弱相干光源不相容。本研究通过定义在实际QKD系统中可以方便获得的泄漏光比，建立了一个更贴近实际的模型，将多光子脉冲的传输纳入失准误差分析。此外，双击事件可以被精确描述，从而缩小了模型与实际系统之间的差距。

Abstract (English)
In optical quantum cryptography, alignment error is important in secure key generation for quantum key distribution (QKD), being one of the roots of error events. However, theoretical modeling typically only reflects the behavior of a single photon, which is incompatible with a weak coherent source. This study develops a realistic model to include the propagation of multiphoton pulses in the misalignment-error analysis by defining the $l\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}e\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}k\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}g\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}e$ $l\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}i\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}g\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}h\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}t$ $r\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}t\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}i\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}o$, which can be obtained conveniently in practical QKD systems. In addition, double-click events can be depicted precisely, and thus the gap between the model and real systems is narrowed.

双场量子密钥分发的若干实用性问题Practical issues of twin-field quantum key distribution

针对无相位后选择双场量子密钥分发在有限码长与光强波动下的理论实践差距，给出有限码长下可抗集体与相干攻击的密钥率，并建立四强度诱骗态解析公式与光强波动模型，仿真表明它仍保持高速率与长距离优势。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议及其变体，如相位匹配 QKD、发送或不发送 QKD 以及无相位后选择 TF-QKD（NPP-TFQKD），在长距离应用中极具前景。然而，这些协议在理论与实际之间仍存在若干差距。具体而言，有限码长分析仍然缺失，且光强波动未被纳入考虑。为处理有限码长效应，我们首先给出有限码长区域中 NPP-TFQKD 抵抗集体攻击的密钥率，随后证明它能够抵抗相干攻击。为处理光强波动，我们给出四强度诱骗态 NPP-TFQKD 的解析公式以及一个实用的光强波动模型。最后，通过详细仿真，我们表明 NPP-TFQKD 仍能保持其高密钥率和长可达距离的优势。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Twin-field quantum key distribution(TF-QKD) protocol and its variants, such as phase-matching QKD, sending-or-not-sending QKD and no phase post-selection TF-QKD(NPP-TFQKD), are very promising for long-distance applications. However, there are still some gaps between theory and practice in these protocols. Concretely, a finite-key size analysis is still missing, and the intensity fluctuations are not taken into account. To address the finite-key size effect, we first give the key rate of NPP-TFQKD against collective attack in finite-key size region and then prove it can be against coherent attack. To deal with the intensity fluctuations, we present an analytical formula of 4-intensity decoy state NPP-TFQKD and a practical intensity fluctuation model. Finally, through detailed simulations, we show NPP-TFQKD can still keep its superiority of high key rate and long achievable distance.

基于Sagnac干涉仪的参考系无关诱骗态BB84量子密钥分发实验实现Experimental realization of a reference-frame-independent decoy BB84 quantum key distribution based on Sagnac interferometer

利用光子偏振与轨道角动量联合编码，结合自补偿光纤Sagnac干涉仪实现高速偏振调制、q-plate无源操控旋转不变态，实验完成了可容忍参考系漂移的诱骗态BB84量子密钥分发。

量子密钥分发（QKD）利用量子物理特性，可在相距遥远的用户之间生成安全密钥比特。然而在大多数场景下，QKD系统都需要一个共享参考系。参考系无关（RFI）方案能够容忍合法远端用户之间参考系的漂移，这对于卫星、飞机等相对运动终端的运行具有重要意义。我们设计并通过实验演示了一套RFI-BB84-QKD系统，该系统利用光子的偏振态与轨道角动量态进行联合编码。我们采用自补偿光纤Sagnac干涉仪实现高速偏振调制，并用q-plate无源操控旋转不变的光子态，从而使该系统可以借助现成的商用器件实现高速运行。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can generate secure key bits between remote users employing the features of quantum physics. However, a shared reference frame is necessary for QKD systems in most scenarios. A reference-frame-independent (RFI) scheme can tolerate the reference frame drifting between legitimate remote users, which is significant in the operation of relative moving terminals such as satellites and aircraft. We design and experimentally demonstrate an RFI-BB84-QKD system by joint encoding with the polarization and orbital angular momentum states of the photons. We use self-compensating fiber Sagnac interferometers to perform high-speed polarization modulation, and q-plates to passively manipulate the rotation-invariant photon states, which makes the system feasible for high-speed operation using off-the-shelf components.

Ya-Ping Li, Wei Chen, Fang-Xiang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Li Zhang, Hang Liu, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.44.004523

No. 04

提升双场量子密钥分发性能的方法Improving the performance of twin-field quantum key distribution

针对Cui等人提出的、无需相位后选择的TF-QKD变体可达距离偏短的问题，该工作引入一个额外的诱骗模式，更紧致地估计信息泄露上界，从而显著提升密钥率与传输距离，且该模式的操作与编码模式相同，不增加实验难度。

在能够突破速率-距离极限的各种双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议版本中，Cui等人提出的无相位后选择TF-QKD是一种简洁的方案，由于去除了全局相位的后选择，它可以提供高密钥率。然而，该变体的可达距离短于原始的相位匹配QKD。本文提出一种通过引入额外诱骗模式来提升其性能的方法。信息泄露的上界可以被更紧致地估计，因此密钥率和可达距离都得到显著提升。有趣的是，所提出的额外诱骗模式的操作与编码模式相同，因此不会给实验系统带来困难。此外，在有限诱骗态下这种提升依然可观，这在实践中具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
Among the various versions of the twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) protocol [M. Lucamarini, Z. Yuan, J. Dynes, and A. Shields, Nature (London) 557, 400 (2018)] that can overcome the rate-distance limit, the TF-QKD without phase postselection proposed by Cui et al. [Phys. Rev. Appl. 11, 034053 (2019)] is an elegant TF-QKD that can provide high key rates since the postselection of global phases has been removed. However, the achievable distance of this variant is shorter than that of the original phase-matching QKD [X. Ma, P. Zeng, and H. Zhou, Phys. Rev. X 8, 031043 (2018)]. In this paper, we propose a method for improving its performance by introducing an additional decoy mode. The upper bound of the information leakage can be more tightly estimated; hence, both the key rate and the achievable distance are significantly improved. Interestingly, the operation of the proposed additional decoy mode is the same as that of the code mode; hence, it does not introduce difficulties into the experimental system. In addition, the improvement is substantial with finite decoy states, which is meaningful in practice.

Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Chao-Han Cui, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.100.022306

No. 05

Pt-CeO2基催化剂上CO2的活化与还原CO<sub>2</sub> Activation and Reduction on Pt-CeO<sub>2</sub>-Based Catalysts

结合密度泛函理论与电导弛豫方法研究三种Pt修饰或未修饰的CeO2基催化剂上的CO2还原，发现Pt团簇促进界面电子转移、拉近d带中心并降低解离能垒，还原速率排序与实验测量一致。

CO2转化在可持续碳循环中起着关键作用。本工作通过密度泛函理论（DFT）和电导弛豫（ECR）两种方法，研究了三种Pt修饰/未修饰的CeO2基催化剂（部分还原的CeO2(111)、Pt修饰的部分还原CeO2(111)，以及Pt修饰的部分还原Sm0.2Ce0.8O1.9(111)（SDC）表面）上的CO2还原。DFT结果表明，CeO2基表面上的Pt团簇能够有效增强CO2的吸附能并降低CO2解离的能垒，有利于CO2的转化。这应归因于电子从CeO2基表面转移到Pt团簇，使Pt的d带中心更靠近费米能级，从而增强了CO2与Pt d电子之间的相互作用。深入研究表明，在没有Pt团簇的情况下，CO2分子需要先形成CO3^2–，然后再解离为CO，这与Pt团簇上CO2的直接活化不同。重要的是，CO2反应的微观动力学分析表明，CO2还原速率遵循Pt修饰的SDC表面 > Pt修饰的CeO2表面 > CeO2表面的顺序。这一结果与ECR测量结果一致。

Abstract (English)
CO 2 conversion plays a critical role in sustainable carbon cycling. In this work, reduction of CO 2 over three Pt-decorated/undecorated CeO 2 -based catalysts (partially reduced CeO 2 (111), Pt decorated partially reduced CeO 2 (111), and Pt decorated partially reduced Sm 0.2 Ce 0.8 O 1.9 (111) (SDC) surfaces) is investigated via both density functional theory (DFT) and electrical conductivity relaxation (ECR) methods. DFT results indicate that a Pt cluster over a CeO 2 -based surface could effectively enhance CO 2 adsorption energies and depress the energy barriers for CO 2 dissociation, beneficial to the CO 2 conversion. This should be ascribed to the electron transferring from the CeO 2 -based surface to the Pt cluster, which makes the Pt d-band center closer to the Fermi level and thus enhances the interaction between CO 2 and Pt d-electrons. Intensive investigation indicates that without the Pt cluster, the CO 2 molecule needs to form CO 3 2– first and then dissociates into CO, different from the direct activation of CO 2 on the Pt cluster. Importantly, the microkinetic analyses of CO 2 reactions suggest that the CO 2 reduction rates follow the sequence of Pt-decorated SDC surface > Pt-decorated CeO 2 surface > CeO 2 surface. This result is consistent with ECR measurements.

Yi Yang, Shuang Wang, Yunan Jiang, Xiaojun Wu, Changrong Xia, Ranran Peng, Yalin Lu

No. 06

在原理验证型量子密钥分发系统中突破基础速率—距离极限Beating the Fundamental Rate-Distance Limit in a Proof-of-Principle Quantum Key Distribution System

★Phys. Rev. X

实现了双场量子密钥分发协议的原型系统之一，采用不假设相位后选择的改进方案，在 300 km 光纤上控制双场相位演化，获得高可见度单光子干涉，从而突破无中继协议的线性界并实现稳定高速率成钥。

借助量子密钥分发（QKD），两个相距遥远的通信方能够共享具有信息论安全性的密钥比特。在有损信道中提高密钥率对 QKD 的应用至关重要。然而，已有证明表明存在一个基础的速率—距离极限，称为线性界，它限制了所有现有无中继协议与实现的性能。令人惊讶的是，最近提出的一种称为双场（TF）QKD 的协议无需量子中继即可突破线性界。在此，我们展示了 TF-QKD 协议的首批实现之一，并证明其在 300 km 的信道距离上具有突破线性界的优势。在我们的实验中，采用了一种不假设相位后选择的改进 TF-QKD 协议，因此预期可获得高于原始协议的密钥率。在控制穿越数百公里光纤的双场相位演化之后，所实现的系统获得了高可见度的单光子干涉，并支持稳定、高速率的测量设备无关 QKD。我们的实验演示与结果证实了 TF-QKD 协议的可行性及其在长距离密钥分发服务中的突出优越性。

Abstract (English)
With the help of quantum key distribution (QKD), two distant peers are able to share informationtheoretical secure key bits.Increasing the key rate is ultimately significant for the applications of QKD in the lossy channel.However, it has been proven that there is a fundamental rate-distance limit, called the linear bound, which restricts the performance of all existing repeaterless protocols and realizations.Surprisingly, a recently proposed protocol, called twin-field (TF) QKD, can beat the linear bound with no need for quantum repeaters.Here, we present one of the first implementations of the TF-QKD protocol and demonstrate its advantage of beating the linear bound at a channel distance of 300 km.In our experiment, a modified TF-QKD protocol that does not assume phase postselection is considered, and thus a higher key rate than the original one is expected.After controlling the phase evolution of the twin fields traveling through hundreds of kilometers of optical fibers, the implemented system achieves high-visibility singlephoton interference and allows stable and high-rate measurement-device-independent QKD.Our experimental demonstration and results confirm the feasibility of the TF-QKD protocol and its prominent superiority in long-distance key distribution services.

Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Feng-Yu Lu, Chao-Han Cui, Wei Chen, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review X

10.1103/PhysRevX.9.021046

No. 07

时间域鬼成像方法及其在量子器件评估中的应用Temporal ghost imaging for quantum device evaluation

把鬼成像思想推广到时间域，通过测量两路信号的关联函数，原理性实验评估了门控模式单光子雪崩探测器的时间探测效率，为量子器件时间特性的实时监测与量子通信安全性评估提供了新工具。

鬼成像（GI）通过测量两路光束的关联函数来重建物体的图像，而这两路光束中的任何一路单独都不携带物体的结构信息。这一强大技术使得即使在存在噪声的情况下也能获得物体的高质量图像。在此，我们把GI方法引入时间域中的量子器件评估。我们完成了一个原理性实验，用于评估门控模式单光子雪崩探测器（SPAD）的时间探测效率。实验结果表明，采用时间鬼成像（TGI）方法可以实现对SPAD时间特性的高质量评估。我们的工作表明，TGI方法是实时监测量子器件时间特性的一种有效工具，并将为量子通信的安全性评估带来新的视角。

Abstract (English)
Ghost imaging (GI) can reconstruct the image of an object by measuring the correlation function of two beams, none of which carries the structure information of the object independently. This powerful technology makes it possible to obtain high-quality imaging of the object even in the presence of noise. Here, we introduce the GI method into quantum device evaluation in the time domain. We realized a proof-of-principle experiment to evaluate the temporal detection efficiency of a gated-mode single-photon avalanche detector (SPAD). The experimental results show that high-quality evaluation of temporal characteristics of the SPAD can be realized by the method of temporal GI (TGI). Our work indicates that the TGI method is an effective tool to monitor the temporal characteristics of quantum devices in real time and will bring a new perspective to the security evaluation of quantum communication.

Juan Wu, Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.44.002522

No. 08

无需相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution without Phase Postselection

该工作提出一种完全不需要后选择的截断型双场量子密钥分发协议，并给出通用安全性证明，表明即使只使用有限诱骗态，其密钥率也可优于其他方案，从而使中距离QKD系统具备更高实用价值。

在量子密码学中，双场（TF）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议可以通过有损信道提升理论密钥率，但其大多数安全性证明需要相位后选择，这使实际系统变得复杂，并严重限制了安全密钥率。本研究提出了一种无需任何后选择的截断TF-QKD协议，给出了通用的安全性证明，并表明即使只采用有限诱骗态，该方案在密钥率方面也可能优于其他协议。该协议表明中距离QKD系统可以达到高得多的密钥率，将使QKD系统在未来的网络安全中更具适用性。

Abstract (English)
In quantum cryptography, the twin-field (TF) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol could extend theoretical key rates through a lossy channel, but most of its security proofs require phase postselection, which complicates practical systems and severely limits secure key rates. This study presents a truncated TF-QKD protocol without any postselection, gives a general security proof, and shows that this scheme may beat other protocols in terms of key rate, even when only finite decoy states are employed. By showing that a medium-range QKD system can reach much higher key rates, this protocol will make QKD systems more applicable in tomorrow's cybersecurity.

Chaohan Cui, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 10

利用不同自由度间的态映射刻画高质量高维量子密钥分发Characterizing High-Quality High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution by State Mapping Between Different Degrees of Freedom

利用轨道角动量与自旋这两个自由度之间的非干涉态映射，同时解决高维量子密钥分发中高维态制备与传输的技术难题，为实用化高维量子密钥分发系统提供了可行路径。

在量子安全通信中，利用高维（HD）资源是提高安全密钥率的重要手段，尤其在量子密钥分发（QKD）中更是如此。然而，由于高维态制备、传输与测量方面的技术困难，高维量子密钥分发（HDQKD）一直远离实际应用。本研究通过实现光子不同自由度——轨道角动量与自旋——之间的态映射方法，解决了前两个问题。这种非干涉的态映射方法对实用 HDQKD 系统具有直接影响。

Abstract (English)
In quantum secure communication, using high-dimensional (HD) resources is an important approach to increasing the secure key rate, especially in quantum key distribution (QKD). However, high-dimensional quantum key distribution (HDQKD) has remained far from practical applications, due to the technical difficulties in HD state preparation, transmission, and measurement. This study solves the first two issues by realizing a state-mapping approach between different degrees of freedom of a photon: orbital angular momentum and spin. This noninterferometric state-mapping approach offers immediate impact on practical HDQKD systems.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 11

基于吉赫兹BB84量子密钥分发系统的实用化量子数字签名Practical quantum digital signature with a gigahertz BB84 quantum key distribution system

设计了对信道扰动本征稳定的非对称法拉第–Sagnac–Michelson干涉仪结构，使BB84系统重复频率达吉赫兹量级；在25 dB信道损耗、10⁻¹⁰安全等级下实现0.044 bit/s的签名速率。

量子数字签名（QDS）能够以信息论安全保证消息的完整性与不可否认性，近来受到更多关注。自Andersson等人提出[Phys. Rev. A 93, 032325 (2016)]以来，已有若干种不同的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统实现了使用非安全信道的量子数字签名协议。在此我们报道一套基于BB84 QKD系统的QDS实验。我们的系统设计了非对称法拉第–Sagnac–Michelson干涉仪结构，该结构对信道扰动具有本征稳定性。这一创新结构支撑系统高速工作，实际重复频率达到吉赫兹量级。在由25 km已铺设光纤并附加光学衰减构成的25 dB信道损耗下，于10⁻¹⁰安全等级下获得了0.044 bit/s的签名速率。因此，我们的QDS装置稳定且高效。本文为进一步推动QDS的实际应用迈出了一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum digital signature (QDS) can guarantee message integrity and non-repudiation with information-theoretical security, and it has attracted more attention recently. Since proposed by Andersson et al. [Phys. Rev. A93, 032325 (2016)PLRAAN1050-294710.1103/PhysRevA.93.032325], a quantum digital signature protocol using an insecure channel has been realized with several different quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. Here we report an experimental QDS based on a BB84 QKD system. An asymmetric Faraday–Sagnac–Michelson interferometer structure has been designed in our system, which is intrinsically stable against channel disturbance. The innovatory structure supports the system to work at high speed and, in practice, the repetition rate is in gigahertz. A 0.044 bit/s signature rate has been attained with a 25 dB channel loss composed of a 25 km installed fiber with additional optical attenuation in a 10−10 security level. Thus, our QDS device is stable and highly efficient. This Letter provides a further step for the practical application of QDS.

Optics Letters

No. 01

利用单光子探测器雪崩过渡区攻击量子密钥分发系统Hacking the Quantum Key Distribution System by Exploiting the Avalanche-Transition Region of Single-Photon Detectors

提出一种针对门控雪崩光电二极管的雪崩过渡区攻击，窃听引入的量子比特误码率不足 0.5%，攻击前后光电流与后脉冲概率几乎不变，几乎不留痕迹。

作为迈向实用化与安全量子密钥分发的必要步骤，识别并修补可能的攻击是重要且有价值的。本研究讨论一种针对门控模式雪崩光电二极管（APD）探测器的雪崩过渡区（ATR）攻击，此类探测器广泛用于量子密钥分发系统。与其他攻击不同，这种攻击几乎不留痕迹；窃听者引入的量子比特误码率低于 0.5%，攻击前后的光电流与后脉冲概率几乎相同。这些发现凸显了实际量子密钥分发系统中探测信号的重要性，对提升实用化量子密钥分发的安全性至关重要。

Abstract (English)
As necessary steps toward practical and secure quantum key distribution (QKD), identifying and patching possible attacks are important and valuable. This study discusses an avalanche-transition-region (ATR) attack on a gated-mode avalanche photodiode (APD) detector, widely used in QKD systems. Unlike other attacks, this one leaves almost no trace; the eavesdropper introduces less than 0.5% quantum bit-error rate, and the photocurrent and afterpulse probability before and after hacking are nearly identical. These findings highlight the importance of detection signals in real-life QKD systems, and are crucial to enhancing the security of practical QKD.

Yong-Jun Qian, De-Yong He, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.10.064062

No. 02

单光子轮询差分正交相移量子密钥分发的安全性证明Security proof for single-photon round-robin differential-quadrature-phase-shift quantum key distribution

给出单光子RRDQPS协议的安全性证明，表明采用单光子源时可容忍误码率优于原始RRDPS协议，并建立统一理论把BB84协议涵盖为特例。

将差分正交相移（DQPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议与近期提出的轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议相结合，人们提出了轮询差分正交相移（RRDQPS）协议。然而，RRDQPS QKD协议的安全性证明仍然缺失，它相对于原始RRDPS协议的优势也尚不清楚。这里我们给出了单光子RRDQPS协议的安全性证明，借此清楚地表明：若采用单光子源，RRDQPS协议在可容忍误码率方面将优于原始RRDPS协议。更有趣的是，我们的证明给出了一个统一理论，涵盖著名的Bennett-Brassard 1984（BB84）协议与RRDQPS协议。由此确认，BB84协议确实是RRDQPS协议的一个特例。

Abstract (English)
Combining the differential-quadrature-phase-shift (DQPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol and the recently proposed round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS), the round-robin-differential-quadrature-phase-shift (RRDQPS) protocol has been proposed. However, a security proof of the RRDQPS QKD protocol is still missing and its advantage over the original RRDPS protocol is also unknown. Here, we give the security proof of single-photon RRDQPS protocol, by which we clearly show that, if a single photon source is applied, RRDQPS protocol will overwhelm the original RRDPS protocol in terms of tolerable error rate. More interestingly, our proof gives a unified theory covering the well-known Bennett-Brassard 1984 (BB84) protocol and RRDQPS protocol. Thus, it is confirmed that BB84 protocol is indeed a special case of the RRDQPS protocol.

Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Chao-han Cui, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

No. 03

面向量子密钥分发的后脉冲效应分析Afterpulse Analysis for Quantum Key Distribution

针对高速量子密钥分发中后脉冲引入额外误码、使系统严重偏离传统解析模型的问题，利用后脉冲的非马尔可夫性质建立了新的分析模型，显著提升了优化后的密钥率与实际系统对后脉冲的容忍度。

在光学量子密码中，后脉冲效应对量子密钥分发（QKD）的安全密钥生成十分重要，因为它会引入额外误码，并使系统严重偏离传统的解析模型，对高速系统尤为如此。本研究利用后脉冲的非马尔可夫性质，建立了一种不同的解析模型，使QKD系统能更好地与后脉冲相兼容。由此得到的优化密钥率大幅提高，因此在实际QKD系统中，用于安全通信的后脉冲容忍度可显著改善。

Abstract (English)
In optical quantum cryptography, the afterpulse effect is important for secure key generation in quantum key distribution (QKD), because it introduces additional error and leads to great deviation from the traditional analytical model, especially for high-speed systems. This study develops a different analytical model to make QKD systems more afterpulse-compatible, by exploiting the non-Markovian nature of the afterpulse. The optimized key rate obtained here is much higher, and thus the tolerance of the afterpulse effect can be significantly improved in practical QKD systems for secure communication.

借助自发参量下转换产生的双光子态实验验证了量子相位翻转错误抑制码，通过奇偶校验与后选择实现相位翻转抑制，在信道噪声概率低于 25% 时解码后的量子误码率较标准单光子偏振编码 BB84 方案明显降低。

提高信道噪声容限是设计和实现量子密钥分发（QKD）协议的一项重要任务。Wang 提出了量子相位翻转错误抑制（QPFER）码［Phys. Rev. Lett. 92, 077902 (2004)，DOI: 10.1103/PhysRevLett.92.077902］，以提高 QKD 实现所能容忍的相位翻转噪声。然而，迄今仍缺少证明其优势的实验。在此，我们借助自发参量下转换产生的双光子量子态，对 QPFER 码进行了实验验证。协议中引入奇偶校验与后选择方法以实现相位翻转抑制。与单光子偏振编码 BB84 方案的标准实现相比，当信道噪声概率低于 25% 时，解码后的量子误码率明显降低。实验结果还表明，在噪声水平处于合适区间时，QPFER 协议能够降低误码率、获得更高的密钥率，并在含噪信道中保持鲁棒性。

Abstract (English)
Improving the tolerance of channel noise is an important task for devising and implementing quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols. Quantum phase-flip error rejection (QPFER) code [Phys. Rev. Lett.92, 077902 (2004)PRLTAO0031-900710.1103/PhysRevLett.92.077902] has been introduced by Wang to increase the tolerable phase-flip noise of QKD implementations. However, an experiment that demonstrates its advantages is still missing. Here, we experimentally verify the QPFER code with the assistance of two photon quantum states generated by spontaneous parametric downconversion. The methods of parity check and postselection are introduced to the protocol for achieving the phase-flipping rejection. Comparing with the standard realization of the single photon polarization encoding BB84 scheme, the quantum error rate after decoding is obviously reduced when the probability of channel noise is less than 25%. The experiment results also show that QPFER protocol can reduce error rate, obtain a higher key rate, and be robust in the noisy channel when the noise level is in a proper region.

Juan Wu, Xue-Bi An, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
