独立器件下量子随机性认证的最优性Optimality of quantum randomness certification with independent devices

通过构建约化器件模型并证明其与原模型等价来估计最小熵，将问题化为混合整数规划高效求解，并在对称观测概率约束下给出解析形式的最优界，显著提升实际认证性能。

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）在密码系统中发挥着日益重要的作用。具体而言，在独立器件的制备—测量场景中实现的QRNG已引起深入研究，因为它本质上可容忍损耗，且其对器件的假设看起来相当自然。然而，先前工作中给出的最小熵估计并非最优，因此量子随机性认证在实际中的性能仍受到严重压制。这里我们提出一种估计最小熵的新方法：构建一个约化器件模型，并证明它与原模型等价。得益于这一约化，我们能够用混合整数规划有效地求解最小熵估计问题。此外，我们推导出当约束由对称的观测概率构成时一个解析形式的最优界。模拟结果表明，我们的工作在这一情形下给出最优解，并且相比先前工作带来了显著的性能提升。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) play an increasingly important role in cryptography systems. Specifically, QRNG performed in prepare-and-measure scenarios with independent devices has attracted intensive study, since it can be intrinsically loss tolerant and its assumptions on devices seem to be quite natural. However, the estimations of min-entropy given in previous works are not optimal. As a result, the performance of quantum randomness certification in practice is still severely depressed. Here, we present a novel method to estimate the min-entropy through developing a reduced device model and proving its equivalence to the original one. Benefitting from this reduction, we can solve the min-entropy estimation problem using mixed integer programming effectively. Furthermore, we derive an optimal bound of analytic form in the case that constraints are made up of symmetric observed probabilities. Simulation results show that our work gives an optimal solution in this case and brings a significant performance improvement compared to previous works.

带信号扰动监测的轮询差分相移量子密钥分发Round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution with monitoring signal disturbance

模拟研究了同时用诱骗态与误码率统计监测信号扰动时的RRDPS协议，发现在典型实验参数下采用无穷诱骗态时其信道长度可超过BB84协议，而仅需两个诱骗态和一个信号态即可逼近该性能。

近年来，轮询差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）因其独特性质而备受关注，即无需获知比特误码率即可界定信息泄露。尽管RRDPS QKD已取得突破，但在监测信号扰动（例如同时使用诱骗态和误码率统计）时其表现如何仍是一个问题。这里，我们通过模拟研究了监测信号扰动情况下的RRDPS协议。令人兴奋的是，当采用无穷诱骗态方法时，在典型实验参数下RRDPS协议在信道长度方面可以优于常用的Bennett和Brassard 1984（BB84）协议。在有限诱骗态情形下，我们发现仅需两个诱骗态和一个信号态就足以获得非常接近无穷诱骗态情形的性能。我们的模拟证明，RRDPS在实际情况下是一种具有竞争力的协议。

Abstract (English)
In recent years, round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) has attracted great attention for its unique characteristics, i.e., the information leakage can be bounded without learning bit error rate. Though the RRDPS QKD has made a breakthrough, it is still a question of how RRDPS will perform with monitoring signal disturbance, e.g., decoy-state and error rate statistics are both used. Here, we present simulations to study RRDPS protocol while monitoring signal disturbance. To our excitement, when using the infinite decoy-states method, RRDPS protocol can outperform the commonly used Bennett and Brassard 1984 (BB84) protocol in terms of channel length under typical experimental parameters. In the case of finite decoy states, we find that only two decoy-states and one signal state are sufficient to obtain performance very close to the infinite decoy-states case. Our simulations prove that RRDPS is a competitive protocol in real-life situations.

Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 08

基于维度见证违反与弱测量的实验三方量子随机数发生器Experimental three-party quantum random number generator based on dimension witness violation and weak measurement

基于弱测量技术提出并实验实现三名观测者共享的量子随机数发生器，首次观测到基于行列式值的双经典维度见证违反，并借助预告式单光子源同时满足独立性与维度假设，达到半设备无关级别。

随机数产生是现代科学中的一项重要任务。人们已提出并实现了多种量子随机数产生协议。然而，这些协议都基于两方。基于弱测量技术，我们提出并实现了三名观测者之间的量子随机数发生器。实验中首次观测到基于行列式值的双经典维度见证的违反。借助预告式单光子源，我们的实验装置满足了独立性假设与维度假设，这意味着我们的装置是半设备无关（semi-DI）的。本文为在多用户之间产生设备无关型随机数提供了新的思路，并在网络环境下的量子密码与量子随机数方面具有潜在应用前景。

Abstract (English)
Random number generation is an important task in modern science. A variety of quantum random number generation protocols have been proposed and realized. These protocols, however, are all based on two parties. Based on the weak measurement technique, we propose and realize a quantum random number generator among three observers. The violation of a double classical dimension witness based on the determinant value is first observed in experiment. With the heralding single-photon source, our experimental setup attains the independent assumption and the dimension assumption, which means our setup is semi-device-independent (DI). This Letter sheds new light on generating DI-type random number among multi-user and it has potential application prospect on the quantum cryptography and quantum random number in network environment.

可抗信道扰动的实用化吉赫兹量子密钥分发系统Practical gigahertz quantum key distribution robust against channel disturbance

提出高速法拉第–萨格纳克–迈克尔逊量子密钥分发系统，可自动补偿信道偏振扰动；在 50 km 光纤、30 Hz 偏振加扰下，24 小时干涉条纹可见度达 99.35%，七天安全密钥率稳定在 306 kbit/s 且无需主动偏振对准。

量子密钥分发（QKD）为安全通信提供了颇具吸引力的解决方案。然而，当 QKD 系统从实验室走向现场时，信道扰动严重限制了其应用。这里提出一种高速法拉第–萨格纳克–迈克尔逊 QKD 系统，可自动补偿信道偏振扰动，从而在很大程度上避免环境突变带来的间歇性限制。在具有 30 Hz 偏振加扰的 50 km 光纤信道上，该相位编码 QKD 系统的实用性得到了表征：24 小时内干涉条纹可见度达 99.35%，并在无需主动偏振对准的情况下，七天里保持 306 kbit/s 的稳定安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides an attractive solution for secure communication. However, channel disturbance severely limits its application when a QKD system is transferred from the laboratory to the field. Here a high-speed Faraday-Sagnac-Michelson QKD system is proposed that can automatically compensate for the channel polarization disturbance, which largely avoids the intermittency limitations of environment mutation. Over a 50 km fiber channel with 30 Hz polarization scrambling, the practicality of this phase-coding QKD system was characterized with an interference fringe visibility of 99.35% over 24 h and a stable secure key rate of 306 k bits/s over seven days without active polarization alignment.

类量子比特qudit量子密钥分发方案的原理性实验验证Proof-of-principle experimental realization of a qubit-like qudit-based quantum key distribution scheme

首次原理性演示高容错Chau15协议，以相位编码类量子比特态和可变延迟干涉仪完成制备与测量，后处理采用实用单向方案，避免原提案的复杂双向后处理，并验证其可扩展至高维qudit。

与基于量子比特（qubit）的协议相比，基于qudit的量子密钥分发协议通常允许两个合作方在更高的信道噪声下共享无条件安全密钥。然而一般而言，在基于qudit的协议中制备和测量所需的量子态非常困难。一个例外是近期提出的高容错qudit协议，即Chau15（Chau 2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324）。值得注意的是，该协议中的态制备与测量可以相对容易地完成，因为所需态是相位编码的，几乎类似于量子比特的对角基态。这里我们报道Chau15协议的首次原理性演示。我们实验的一个亮点是其后处理基于实用的单向方式，而Chau（2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324）中的原始提案依赖于复杂的双向后处理，这在实验上是一大挑战。此外，通过操控时间仓（time-bin）qudit并用可变延迟干涉仪进行测量，我们的实现可扩展至高维qudit，并证实了Chau15协议的实验可行性。

Abstract (English)
In comparison to qubit-based protocols, qudit-based quantum key distribution ones generally allow two cooperative parties to share unconditionally secure keys under a higher channel noise. However, it is very hard to prepare and measure the required quantum states in qudit-based protocols in general. One exception is the recently proposed highly error tolerant qudit-based protocol known as the Chau15 (Chau 2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324). Remarkably, the state preparation and measurement in this protocol can be done relatively easily since the required states are phase encoded almost like the diagonal basis states of a qubit. Here we report the first proof-of-principle demonstration of the Chau15 protocol. One highlight of our experiment is that its post-processing is based on practical one-way manner, while the original proposal in Chau (2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324) relies on complicated two-way post-processing, which is a great challenge in experiment. In addition, by manipulating time-bin qudit and measurement with a variable delay interferometer, our realization is extensible to qudit with high-dimensionality and confirms the experimental feasibility of the Chau15 protocol.

Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, H F Chau, Wei Chen, Chao Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

轮询差分相移量子密钥分发的改进安全性界限Improved security bound for the round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution

★Nat. Commun.

通过考察编码态的相位随机化与窃听者攻击之间的关联，给出了更紧的信息泄露界，特别适用于短脉冲串实现且无需监测信号扰动，并在140 km光纤上完成验证实验，突破了原理论的悲观预言。

轮询差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议因其独特的安全特性而受到深入研究；例如，无需获知密钥比特的误码率即可界定信息泄露。然而，其实用性和性能仍不尽如人意。这里，通过考察编码态的相位随机化及其与窃听者攻击的联系，我们得到了一个改进的信息泄露界。有趣的是，我们的理论对短脉冲串的实现尤为有用，并且仍然可以在不监测信号扰动的情况下运行。因此，RRDPS的实用性和性能得到提升。此外，我们完成了长达140 km光纤的原理性验证实验，这是迄今RRDPS所能达到的最长距离，而原有理论预言在我们的实验中无法生成任何安全密钥。我们的结果将有助于推动实用化RRDPS更接近实际应用。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol has attracted intensive study due to its distinct security characteristics; e.g., information leakage is bounded without learning the error rate of key bits. Nevertheless, its practicality and performance are still not satisfactory. Here, by observing the phase randomization of the encoding states and its connection with eavesdropper’s attack, we develop an improved bound on information leakage. Interestingly, our theory is especially useful for implementations with short trains of pulses, and running without monitoring signal disturbance is still available. As a result, the practicality and performance of RRDPS are improved. Furthermore, we realize a proof-of-principle experiment with up to 140 km of fiber, which has been the longest achievable distance of RRDPS until now, whereas the original theory predicted that no secret key could be generated in our experiment. Our results will help in bringing practical RRDPS closer to practical implementations.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Yun-Guang Han, Rong Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Nature Communications

10.1038/s41467-017-02211-x

No. 01

实际器件缺陷对弱相干态 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉性能的影响Realistic Device Imperfections Affect the Performance of Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference With Weak Coherent States

分析分束比偏差、探测器效率失配、入射脉冲强度不一致等器件缺陷对 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉可见度的影响，并以计入雪崩历史的非马尔可夫模型刻画 InGaAs 雪崩光电二极管的后脉冲效应，发现后脉冲比其他缺陷影响更大。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是一种有前景且实用的远程密钥共享协议，其中测量端的 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）型干涉为抵御针对测量设备的恶意攻击提供了一种简单而经济的方式。由于 HOM 干涉在很大程度上决定了 MDI QKD 系统的性能，其在实际情形下的干涉行为值得研究。本工作分析了存在若干实际缺陷时的 HOM 可见度，例如分束比偏差、探测器的探测效率失配、两路入射脉冲强度不一致。特别地，我们采用非马尔可夫模型讨论了 InGaAs 雪崩光电二极管探测器的后脉冲效应，其中考虑了雪崩历史，为后脉冲分析提供了新的、更准确的视角。仿真结果表明，实际情形下的后脉冲效应对 HOM 性能的影响大于其他缺陷。这些结果体现了其在实际高速 MDI QKD 系统以及其他基于光纤的 HOM 应用中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a promising and practical protocol for remote secret sharing, where the Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) type interference in the measurement side provides a simple and economic way to resist malicious attacks on the measurement devices. Because the HOM interference greatly indicates the performance of MDI QKD system, its interferential behavior in practical situations deserve to be studied. In this work, we analyzed HOM visibility with several practical imperfections, such as the deviation of the beam splitting ratio, detection efficiency mismatch of detectors, inconsistent intensities of two incident pulses. In particular, we discussed the afterpulse effect of InGaAs avalanche photodiode detectors with a non-Markovian model, where we take the avalanche history into consideration and provide a new and more accurate perspective for afterpulse analysis. Simulation results indicate that the afterpulse effect in practical situation has a greater impact on the HOM performance than other imperfections. The results exhibit its value in realistic high-speed MDI QKD systems as well as other fiber-based HOM applications.

Chao Wang, Fang-Xiang Wang, Hua Chen, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Journal of Lightwave Technology

10.1109/JLT.2017.2764140

No. 02

独立器件场景下量子随机性认证的更紧致界Tighter bound of quantum randomness certification for independent-devices scenario

针对独立器件制备—测量场景中基于维度见证的随机性认证，引入拉格朗日乘子法更紧致地求解平均猜测概率优化问题，给出解析形式的最小熵下界，模拟显示随机数产生速率显著提高。

量子随机数产生因其随机性本质上来源于量子力学而非数学假设而备受关注。随机性认证，例如熵估计，成为量子随机数产生协议中的关键问题。我们研究一种基于维度见证的自检验协议，并假设器件相互独立。它解决了在器件未经表征的实际制备—测量场景中提取随机数的问题。然而，在现有工作中，作为维度见证函数的最小熵下界并不紧致。我们通过引入拉格朗日乘子法，对平均猜测概率上的优化问题进行细致分析，给出了更紧致的解析形式下界。仿真表明，实际中可实现显著更高的随机数产生速率。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum random number generation attracts considerable attention, since its randomness inherently originates in quantum mechanics, but not mathematical assumptions. Randomness certification, e.g. entropy estimation, becomes a key issue in the context of quantum random number generation protocol. We study a self-testing protocol based on dimension witness, with the assumption of independent devices. It addresses the random number extraction problem in a practical prepare-and-measure scenario with uncharacterized devices. However, the lower bound of min-entropy as a function of dimension witness is not tight in existing works. We present a tighter bound of analytic form, by introducing the Lagrangian multiplier method to closely analyze the optimization problem on average guessing probability. Through simulation, it turns out that a significantly higher random number generation rate can be achieved in practice.

已铺设光纤中的偏振变化及其对量子密钥分发系统的影响Polarization variations in installed fibers and their influence on quantum key distribution systems

利用实测光纤偏振漂移数据建立定量评估方法，提出偏振漂移时间与所需跟踪速度两个特征参数，并针对不同长度的埋地与架空光纤给出偏振基对准模块的要求与建议。

已铺设光纤中的偏振变化复杂且易变，会严重影响对偏振敏感的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统的性能。基于所记录的各类已铺设光纤偏振变化数据，我们建立了一种解析方法，用于定量评估偏振变化对偏振敏感 QKD 系统的影响。以偏振变化引起的量子比特误码率上升作为关键判据，我们提出偏振漂移时间和所需跟踪速度两个参数来刻画偏振变化。针对不同长度的埋地与架空光纤，我们定量评估了偏振变化的影响，并就部署于不同类型光纤中的 QKD 系统的偏振基对准模块提出了要求与建议。

Abstract (English)
Polarization variations in the installed fibers are complex and volatile, and would severely affect the performances of polarization-sensitive quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. Based on the recorded data about polarization variations of different installed fibers, we establish an analytical methodology to quantitatively evaluate the influence of polarization variations on polarization-sensitive QKD systems. Using the increased quantum bit error rate induced by polarization variations as a key criteria, we propose two parameters - polarization drift time and required tracking speed - to characterize polarization variations. For field buried and aerial fibers with different length, we quantitatively evaluate the influence of polarization variations, and also provide requirements and suggestions for polarization basis alignment modules of QKD systems deployed in different kind of fibers.

基于道威棱镜的单路Sagnac干涉仪操控轨道角动量光子Single-path Sagnac interferometer with Dove prism for orbital-angular-momentum photon manipulation

分析道威棱镜的偏振依赖效应对单路Sagnac干涉仪的影响，并提出仅需增加两片半波片的改进结构，理论上分束保真度可达100%且与输入偏振及棱镜传输矩阵无关，实验保真度提高约5%~10%。

轨道角动量（OAM）的量子数可以无限大，因而成为高维量子信息处理中的重要资源。道威棱镜（DP）是操控OAM光束最常用的工具。然而，道威棱镜会改变光子态的偏振，从而降低干涉仪的分束保真度。本工作分析了在使用分束器（BS）和偏振分束器（PBS）的常规单路Sagnac干涉仪（SPSI）中，道威棱镜对OAM光操控的偏振依赖效应。结果表明，BS型SPSI对输入偏振和道威棱镜的具体参数更为敏感。我们还提出并实现了一种改进的BS型SPSI，其分束保真度原则上可达100%，并且不依赖于输入偏振和道威棱镜的传输矩阵。实验表明，改进型BS型SPSI的保真度比常规结构高约5%~10%。改进型BS型SPSI易于实现（只需额外两片半波片），并能在自由运行条件下保持数小时量级的稳定。这些优点使该结构适合用于量子密码等关键量子信息处理任务。

Abstract (English)
Orbital angular momentum (OAM) is an important resource in high-dimensional quantum information processing, as its quantum number can be infinite. Dove prism (DP) is a most common tool to manipulate OAM light. However, the Dove prism changes the polarization of the photon states and decreases the sorting fidelity of the interferometer. In this work, we analyze the polarization-dependent effect of the DP on OAM light manipulation in the normal single-path Sagnac interferometers (SPSIs) with beam splitter (BS) and polarizing beam splitter (PBS). The results demonstrate that the BS SPSI is more sensitive to the input polarization and the specific parameters of the DP. We have also proposed and realized a modified BS SPSI, of which the sorting fidelity can be 100% in principle and is independent on the input polarization and the transmission matrix of the DP. The experiments demonstrate that the fidelity of the modified BS SPSI is about 5%~10% higher than that of the normal one. The modified BS SPSI is easy to implement (only two more half-wave plates are required) and is stable for free running at the scale of several hours. These merits make the structure suitable for applications in critical quantum information processing tasks, such as quantum cryptography.

利用预报式单光子源完成 Han16 协议的原理性实验，在独立装置条件下使量子随机数产生率较此前协议几乎翻倍，并验证该协议可容忍损耗与噪声。

随机数是现代科学中的一个核心问题，而如何估计给定装置所产生数据的真实随机性则是一个中心问题。Lunghi 等人提出了一种基于独立装置制备-测量场景的自检验量子随机数发生器。在此文基础上，Han 等人提出了一种更高效的估计真实随机性的方法（简称 Han16 协议）。这里我们报道利用 HSPS 对 Han16 协议进行的原理性实现。实验结果表明，与先前的协议相比，Han16 协议几乎使量子随机数的产生率提高了一倍。此外，实验结果还表明 Han16 协议是实用的，且实验装置能够容忍损耗与噪声。

Abstract (English)
The random number is a paramount issue in modern science. How to estimate the genuine randomness of the data generated by a given device is a central problem. Lunghi et al. proposed a self-testing quantum random number generator from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices. Based on this Letter, Han et al. proposed a more efficient method (Han16 protocol for short) to estimate the genuine randomness. Here we report a proof-of-principle realization of the Han16 protocol with a HSPS. The experimental results demonstrate that the Han16 protocol almost doubles the generation rate of the quantum random number with regard to the previous protocol. In addition, the results of the experiment show that the Han16 protocol is practical, and the experimental device can tolerate loss and noise.

抗环境扰动的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution robust against environmental disturbances

基于偏振扰乱单元实现参考系无关的测量设备无关量子密钥分发，使安全密钥率对偏振随机扰动与相位参考漂移不敏感，无需校准主参考系；原理验证实验结合改进的波动分析方法验证了其可行性与优势。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是消除所有探测器侧信道攻击的一种有前景的协议。然而，参考系，例如偏振参考和相位参考，其变化会对MDI系统的性能构成严峻威胁。在此，我们基于偏振扰乱单元，演示了一种参考系无关的MDI QKD方案，该方案对易变的信道条件具有内在稳定性；因此，最终安全密钥率将对偏振的随机扰动和相位参考的漂移不敏感。这样，我们的方案从根本上免除了对主要参考系的校准，从而实质上减少了潜在漏洞以及整个系统的资源消耗。此外，我们还展示了采用改进的波动分析方法的原理验证实验，以验证所提出方案的可行性和优势。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a promising protocol for removing all detector side channel attacks. However, the variation of reference frames, e.g., polarization and phase reference, would be an acute threat to the performance of MDI systems. Here, based on polarization scrambling units, we demonstrate a reference-frame-independent MDI QKD scheme that is inherently stable against volatile channel conditions; therefore, the final secure key rate will be insensitive to the random disturbances of polarization and the drifts of phase reference. Thus, calibrations of the primary reference frames are intrinsically removed in our scheme, which essentially reduces potential vulnerabilities as well as the resource consumption of the whole system. In addition, a proof-of-principle experiment with an improved fluctuation analysis method is demonstrated to verify the feasibility and advantages of the proposed scheme.

仅使用纠错过程中公开的筛选密钥比特，实现单光子级连续偏振基跟踪，无需参考光也不中断量子信号传输，50 km 光纤 BB84 系统连续运行 24 小时平均量子比特误码率 2.32%、标准差 0.87%。

发射端与接收端之间偏振基的校准是量子密钥分发中的一项重要任务。持续工作的偏振基跟踪方案（PBTS）将有效提升系统效率，并降低在传输与校准模式之间切换时的潜在安全风险。在此，我们提出了一种单光子水平的持续工作 PBTS，仅使用纠错过程中公开的筛选密钥比特，不引入额外的参考光，也不中断量子信号的传输。我们将该方案应用于 50 km 光纤信道中的偏振编码 BB84 QKD 系统，在 24 小时连续运行期间获得了 2.32% 的平均量子比特误码率（QBER）和 0.87% 的标准差。稳定且相对较低的 QBER 验证了该方案的有效性。

Abstract (English)
The calibration of the polarization basis between the transmitter and receiver is an important task in quantum key distribution. A continuously working polarization-basis tracking scheme (PBTS) will effectively promote the efficiency of the system and reduce the potential security risk when switching between the transmission and calibration modes. Here, we proposed a single-photon level continuously working PBTS using only sifted key bits revealed during an error correction procedure, without introducing additional reference light or interrupting the transmission of quantum signals. We applied the scheme to a polarization-encoding BB84 QKD system in a 50 km fiber channel, and obtained an average quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 2.32% and a standard derivation of 0.87% during 24 h of continuous operation. The stable and relatively low QBER validates the effectiveness of the scheme.

正弦波门控方法被广泛用于高速单光子探测（SPD），但与自差分技术相比，它表现出额外的后脉冲概率。在此，我们证明正弦波门控SPD的大部分额外后脉冲来自连续的雪崩信号以及电滤波器的畸变，并提出了一种通过去除较宽的滤波后雪崩信号来降低后脉冲概率的有效方法。在1 GHz门控频率下，当光子探测效率为20.7%和10.9%时，测得的后脉冲概率分别低至1.0%和0.54%。

Abstract (English)
Sine-wave gating method is widely used in high-speed single photon detection (SPD) but shows extra afterpulse probability compared with the self-differencing technique. Here, we demonstrate that most extra afterpulses of the sine-wave gating SPD come from successive avalanche signals and distortion of electrical filters and also propose an effective method by removing the wider filtered avalanche signals to reduce the afterpulse probability. At 1 GHz gating frequency, the ultralow afterpulse probability is characterized as 1.0% and 0.54% for a photon detection efficiency of 20.7% and 10.9%, respectively.

利用电导弛豫与交流阻抗方法解析 SDC-Cu-气相三相边界处 H2 和 CO 的氧化动力学，发现少量 Cu 覆盖即可主导反应并给出各自决速步，CO 氧化速率约为 H2 的五倍。

Cu-二氧化铈金属陶瓷作为以碳氢燃料运行的固体氧化物燃料电池（SOFC）阳极材料已被广泛研究。然而，阳极反应过程仍不清楚，尤其是二氧化铈-Cu-气相三相边界（3PB）处的反应过程。本工作研究了钐掺杂二氧化铈（SDC）-Cu-气相 3PB 处 H2 和 CO 氧化的反应动力学，这两种物质是碳氢化合物经外部重整和内部重整得到的产物。电化学电导弛豫测量表明，Cu 是一种协同催化剂，能够显著提高反应速率。当 5.4% 的 SDC 表面被 Cu 颗粒覆盖时，3PB 处的反应贡献了 H2/CO 氧化的 81.3/66.8%。结合交流阻抗分析，提出了 3PB 处反应的基元步骤。水蒸气结合到氧空位、一氧化碳转化为碳酸盐分别是 H2 和 CO 氧化的决速步。Cu-SDC 对 CO 氧化的催化活性远高于对 H2 的活性，反应速率约为后者的五倍。此外，Cu-SDC 电极对 CO 的电化学氧化表现出更低的界面极化电阻和更低的活化能。因此，当 Cu-二氧化铈阳极使用合成气（碳氢化合物的重整产物）时，CO 比 H2 更容易被氧化。

Abstract (English)
Cu-ceria cermets have been widely investigated as the anode materials for solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) that operated with hydrocarbon fuels. However, the anode reaction processes are not clear yet, especially those at the ceria-Cu-gas three phase boundary (3 PB). This work investigates samaria-doped ceria (SDC)-Cu-gas 3 PB reaction kinetics for the oxidation of H2 and CO, the products from hydrocarbons via external and internal reforming. Electrochemical conductivity relaxation measurement demonstrates that Cu is a synergistic catalyst that can significantly increase the reaction rate. The reaction at 3 PB contributes 81.3/66.8% of H2/CO oxidation when 5.4% SDC surface is covered with Cu particles. Combining with AC impedance analysis, elementary steps are proposed for the reaction at 3 PB. Water vapor combining to oxygen vacancy and carbon monoxide transforming to carbonate are the rate-determining steps for the oxidation of H2 and CO, respectively. Cu-SDC has shown much higher catalytic activity, i.e. about fivefold reaction rate, for the oxidation of CO than H2. In addition, Cu-SDC electrodes exhibit lower interfacial polarization resistance and lower activation energy for the electrochemical oxidation of CO than H2. Consequently, CO is easier to be oxidized than H2 when the Cu-ceria anode is fueled with syngas, the reforming product from hydrocarbons.

基于未表征编码的实验测量设备无关量子密钥分发Experimental measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with uncharacterized encoding

利用失配基统计完成首个编码源未经表征的测量设备无关量子密钥分发原理验证实验，编码态只需限定在二维希尔伯特空间，即使通信双方不清楚编码态细节也能抵御态制备缺陷，系统获得正的安全密钥率。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是利用不可信测量设备共享密钥的一种有效方式。然而，在这一前景广阔的协议中，对编码态表征的假设仍然是必要的，这可能在现实实现中导致不必要的复杂性和潜在漏洞。在此，我们利用失配基统计，首次给出了编码源未经表征的MDI QKD原理验证实验。在该演示中，编码态仅需被约束在二维希尔伯特空间内，即使两个相距遥远的参与方（Alice和Bob）完全不知道其编码态的详细信息，也能抵御态制备缺陷。我们系统所获得的正的最终安全密钥率表明了这种新协议的可行性，并证明了其在与未经表征设备进行安全通信应用中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is an efficient way to share secrets using untrusted measurement devices. However, the assumption on the characterizations of encoding states is still necessary in this promising protocol, which may lead to unnecessary complexity and potential loopholes in realistic implementations. Here, by using the mismatched-basis statistics, we present the first proof-of-principle experiment of MDI QKD with uncharacterized encoding sources. In this demonstration, the encoded states are only required to be constrained in a two-dimensional Hilbert space, and two distant parties (Alice and Bob) are resistant to state preparation flaws even if they have no idea about the detailed information of their encoding states. The positive final secure key rates of our system exhibit the feasibility of this novel protocol, and demonstrate its value for the application of secure communication with uncharacterized devices.

Chao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Hong-Wei Li, Chun-Mei Zhang, Yu-Yang Ding, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.41.005596

No. 02

不破坏光子态的可扩展轨道角动量分选Scalable orbital-angular-momentum sorting without destroying photon states

提出由对称多端口分束器与道威棱镜级联构成的可扩展轨道角动量分选器，可同时分辨不同 OAM 态并保持轨道与自旋角动量，大幅减少高维分选所需的分束器数量。

携带轨道角动量（OAM）的单光子已引起研究人员的广泛关注。理论上单个光子可以携带无限多的 OAM 值。因此，OAM 光子态已被广泛用于量子信息和基础量子力学研究。尽管已有许多对不同 OAM 值量子态进行分选的方法，但高维 OAM 的无损高效分选仍是一项基本挑战。在此，我们提出一种可扩展的 OAM 分选器，能够同时分类不同的 OAM 态，同时保持轨道角动量和自旋角动量。该分选器的基本单元由对称多端口分束器（BS）和具有级联结构的道威棱镜组成，原则上可以灵活有效地组合，以分选任意高维 OAM 光子。这里提出的可扩展结构大大减少了分选高维 OAM 态所需的分束器数量。鉴于其无损和可扩展的特性，该分选器不仅可作为高维量子信息处理的基本器件，也可用于传统光学。

Abstract (English)
Single photons with orbital angular momentum (OAM) have attracted substantial attention from researchers. A single photon can carry infinite OAM values theoretically. Thus, OAM photon states have been widely used in quantum information and fundamental quantum mechanics. Although there have been many methods for sorting quantum states with different OAM values, the nondestructive and efficient sorter of high-dimensional OAM remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we propose a scalable OAM sorter which can categorize different OAM states simultaneously, meanwhile, preserving both OAM and spin angular momentum. Fundamental elements of the sorter are composed of symmetric multiport beam splitters (BSs) and Dove prisms with cascading structure, which in principle can be flexibly and effectively combined to sort arbitrarily high-dimensional OAM photons. The scalable structures proposed here greatly reduce the number of BSs required for sorting high-dimensional OAM states. In view of the nondestructive and extensible features, the sorters can be used as fundamental devices not only for high-dimensional quantum information processing, but also for traditional optics.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.94.033847

No. 03

单光子雪崩探测器后脉冲效应的非马尔可夫特性Non-Markovian Property of Afterpulsing Effect in Single-Photon Avalanche Detector

实测商用InGaAs/InP单光子雪崩二极管，证明后脉冲并非只由前一次点火雪崩决定，而具有雪崩历史记忆效应，后脉冲概率随点火雪崩脉冲数增加而上升，为高计数率器件工艺与后脉冲评估提供依据。

单光子雪崩光电二极管（SPAD）已被广泛用于量子光学研究。后脉冲效应是SPAD的固有特性，在大多数实验中都会影响系统性能，需要谨慎处理。长期以来，人们一直假定后脉冲由前一次点火雪崩所决定。我们研究了一只商用InGaAs/InP SPAD（雪崩光电二极管型号：Princeton Lightwave PGA-300）的后脉冲效应，证明其后脉冲具有非马尔可夫性，即在雪崩历史中存在记忆效应。理论分析与实验结果表明，这种记忆效应的体现就是后脉冲概率：它随点火雪崩脉冲数目的增加而增大。这一结论使后脉冲效应的原理更加清晰，对高计数率SPAD的制造工艺与后脉冲评估具有指导意义，也可以作为量子通信、量子随机数产生等应用中处理后脉冲信号的基本前提。

Abstract (English)
The single-photon avalanche photodiode (SPAD) has been widely used in research on quantum optics. The afterpulsing effect, which is an intrinsic character of SPAD, affects the system performance in most experiments and needs to be carefully handled. For a long time, afterpulsing has been presumed to be determined by the pre-ignition avalanche. We studied the afterpulsing effect of a commercial InGaAs/InP SPAD (The avalanche photodiode model is: Princeton Lightwave PGA-300) and demonstrated that its afterpulsing is non-Markovian, with a memory effect in the avalanching history. Theoretical analysis and experimental results clearly indicate that the embodiment of this memory effect is the afterpulsing probability, which increases as the number of ignition-avalanche pulses increase. This conclusion makes the principle of the afterpulsing effect clearer and is instructive to the manufacturing processes and afterpulsing evaluation of high-count-rate SPADs. It can also be regarded as a fundamental premise to handle the afterpulsing signals in many applications, such as quantum communication and quantum random number generation.

如何从不可信装置中产生真实的量子随机性是量子信息处理中的一个重要问题。受此前关于自检验量子随机数发生器的工作［T. Lunghi 等，Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 150501 (2015)］启发，我们提出了一种在独立装置的制备-测量场景中产生量子随机性的方法。在已有协议中，量子随机性仅依赖于一个见证值（例如 Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt 值），该值由观测到的概率计算得到。与之不同，在我们的方法中，所有观测到的概率都被直接用于计算最小熵。通过数值模拟，我们发现当使用典型的不可信 Bennett-Brassard 1984（BB84）装置时，所提方案的最小熵高于此前的工作。因此，得益于这一方法，有可能获得比以往更多的真实量子随机数。

Abstract (English)
How to generate genuine quantum randomness from untrusted devices is an important problem in quantum information processing. Inspired by previous work on a self-testing quantum random number generator [T. Lunghi et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 150501 (2015)], we present a method to generate quantum randomness from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices. In existing protocols, the quantum randomness depends only on a witness value (e.g., Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt value), which is calculated with the observed probabilities. Differently, here all the observed probabilities are directly used to calculate the min-entropy in our method. Through numerical simulation, we find that the min-entropy of our proposed scheme is higher than that in the previous work when a typical untrusted Bennett-Brassard 1984 (BB84) setup is used. Consequently, thanks to the proposed method, more genuine quantum random numbers may be obtained than before.

作为一种重要资源，纠缠光源已被用于发展量子信息技术，例如量子密钥分发（QKD）。由于现有协议的安全性可能在有损信道中受到损害，迄今很少有实验实现基于纠缠的确定性 QKD 协议。在这项工作中，我们报道了一个遵循改进的“乒乓”（PP）协议的容损确定性 QKD 实验。实验结果首次证明，基于电信波段纠缠光子源，可以在光损耗为 9 dB 的信道中完成一次安全的确定性 QKD 会话。这展示了将纠缠光源用于现实光纤量子通信的可想见前景。

Abstract (English)
Abstract As an important resource, entanglement light source has been used in developing quantum information technologies, such as quantum key distribution(QKD). There are few experiments implementing entanglement-based deterministic QKD protocols since the security of existing protocols may be compromised in lossy channels. In this work, we report on a loss-tolerant deterministic QKD experiment which follows a modified “Ping-Pong”(PP) protocol. The experiment results demonstrate for the first time that a secure deterministic QKD session can be fulfilled in a channel with an optical loss of 9 dB, based on a telecom-band entangled photon source. This exhibits a conceivable prospect of ultilizing entanglement light source in real-life fiber-based quantum communications.

系统梳理并比较了基于辐射或光子到达时间的几种随机性提取方案，分析其鲁棒性、后处理需求与提取效率，为构建高效、紧凑且稳健的物理随机数发生器提供依据。

随机数（RN）在众多领域都有应用：彩票游戏、赌博、计算机模拟，以及最重要的——密码学 [N. Gisin 等，Rev. Mod. Phys. 74 (2002) 145]。在密码学理论中，系统的理论安全性要求使用高质量的随机数。因此，发展能够以足够速度产生不可预测随机数的方法，是一个有吸引力的课题。早期，尽管缺乏理论支持，由算法方法产生的伪随机数表现良好，能够满足合理的统计要求。然而，在实际实现中，这些伪随机序列完全由数学公式和初始种子决定，无法引入额外的熵或信息。在这种情况下，所产生的“随机”比特根本不随机。与算法方法不同，物理随机数发生器（RNG）基于不可预测的物理随机现象，因而引起了大量研究兴趣。然而，从这些物理熵源中提取随机比特的方式，对系统的效率和性能有很大影响。该文回顾并讨论了几种基于辐射或光子到达时间的随机性提取方案，分析了这些方法的鲁棒性、后处理需求，特别是提取效率，以帮助构建高效、紧凑且稳健的物理 RNG 系统。

Abstract (English)
Random numbers (RNs) have applications in many areas: lottery games, gambling, computer simulation, and, most importantly, cryptography [N. Gisin et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 74 (2002) 145]. In cryptography theory, the theoretical security of the system calls for high quality RNs. Therefore, developing methods for producing unpredictable RNs with adequate speed is an attractive topic. Early on, despite the lack of theoretical support, pseudo RNs generated by algorithmic methods performed well and satisfied reasonable statistical requirements. However, as implemented, those pseudorandom sequences were completely determined by mathematical formulas and initial seeds, which cannot introduce extra entropy or information. In these cases, “random” bits are generated that are not at all random. Physical random number generators (RNGs), which, in contrast to algorithmic methods, are based on unpredictable physical random phenomena, have attracted considerable research interest. However, the way that we extract random bits from those physical entropy sources has a large influence on the efficiency and performance of the system. In this manuscript, we will review and discuss several randomness extraction schemes that are based on radiation or photon arrival times. We analyze the robustness, post-processing requirements and, in particular, the extraction efficiency of those methods to aid in the construction of efficient, compact and robust physical RNG systems.

近年来，由于测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）的推动，两个独立弱相干脉冲（WCP）之间的Hong–Ou–Mandel（HOM）干涉受到了广泛关注。此前基于经典波动理论的文献表明，这类HOM型干涉的可见度不超过50%。本工作采用量子光学方法分析这类干涉，相比波动理论揭示了更多细节。分析确认了50%的最大可见度，并得出结论：在不考虑噪声的情况下，50%的最大可见度来源于弱相干脉冲中的双单光子态。实验中，利用由同一皮秒激光源分束得到的弱相干脉冲并结合相位扫描，成功逼近了50%的可见度。由于这类HOM干涉对慢相位涨落不敏感，已实现的与所提出的实验方案均可为高分辨率光学测距提供稳定的途径。

Abstract (English)
Recently, the Hong–Ou–Mandel (HOM) interference between two independent weak coherent pulses (WCPs) has been paid much attention due to the measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD). Using classical wave theory, articles reported before show that the visibility of this kind of HOM-type interference is ≤ 50%. In this work, we analyze this kind of interference using quantum optics, which reveals more details compared to the wave theory. Analyses confirm the maximum visibility of 50%. And we conclude that the maximum visibility of 50% comes from the two single-photon states in WCPs, without considering the noise. In the experiment, we successfully approach the visibility of 50% by using WCPs splitting from the single pico-second laser source and phase scanning. Since this kind of HOM interference is immune to slow phase fluctuations, both the realized and proposed experiment designs can provide stable ways of high-resolution optical distance detection.

固定轴线性延迟器的有限延迟量范围限制了其在偏振控制中的应用。本工作针对这一有限延迟量限制提出了一种简单高效的约束方案，并从几何和数学上给出了其理论基础。新的偏振控制算法将该约束方案与一种广泛使用的最大值搜索算法相结合。仿真和实验均证实了所提方案与控制算法的有效性和实用性。实验中，控制系统采用四个级联的线性延迟器，其快轴交替取向为 0° 和 45°。每个延迟器（光纤挤压器）具有 4π 的有限延迟量范围。在 15 分钟的测试中，系统以 26 rad/s 的平均速度稳定偏振波动，平均（最大）偏振误差角为 0.09（0.28）rad。此外，未出现触及延迟量极限的情况。

Abstract (English)
Finite retardation ranges of linear retarders with fixed axes limit their applications in polarization control. In this work, we present a simple and efficient constraint scheme for this finite-retardation limitation. Its theoretical basis is given geometrically and mathematically. The new polarization control algorithm combines the constraint scheme and a widely-used maximum-search algorithm. Both simulations and experiments confirm the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed scheme and control algorithm. In experiments, the control system uses four cascaded linear retarders with fast axes alternately oriented at 0° and 45°. Each retarder (fiber squeezer) has a finite retardation range of 4π. For a 15-min test, the mean (maximum) polarization error angle is 0.09 (0.28) rad while stabilizing a polarization fluctuation at an average speed of 26 rad/s. Furthermore, no events of hitting retardation limits occur.

测量设备无关的量子抛币协议及其抗探测器侧信道攻击方案Measurement-device-independent quantum coin tossing

针对不诚实 Alice 可借探测器致盲攻击使量子抛币完全失密的问题，提出测量设备无关量子抛币方案，在相干攻击下偏置与原容损协议相同，并可兼容弱相干态光源。

量子抛币（QCT）是量子密码学中的一个重要基本原语，一直受到持续关注。然而在实际的 QCT 中，Bob 的探测器可能遭受不诚实的 Alice 发起的探测器侧信道攻击，这有可能使协议完全不安全。在此，我们基于近期的一项实验报道了一种简单的探测器致盲攻击策略。为消除所有探测器侧信道，我们提出了测量设备无关 QCT（MDI-QCT）的解决方案。该方法类似于测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）的思想。MDI-QCT 在使用单光子源时是容损的，并且在相干攻击下具有与原容损 QCT 相同的偏置。此外，在某些特殊情形下，它还具有使安全距离加倍的潜在优势。最后，MDI-QCT 也可以经修改以适配弱相干态光源。因此，基于实用 MDI-QKD 的快速发展，我们的方案可以容易地实现。

Abstract (English)
Quantum coin tossing (QCT) is an important primitive of quantum cryptography and has received continuous interest. However, in practical QCT, Bob's detectors can be subjected to detector-side channel attacks launched by dishonest Alice, which will possibly make the protocol completely insecure. Here, we report a simple strategy of a detector-blinding attack based on a recent experiment. To remove all the detector side channels, we present a solution of measurement-device-independent QCT (MDI-QCT). This method is similar to the idea of MDI quantum key distribution (QKD). MDI-QCT is loss tolerant with single-photon sources and has the same bias as the original loss-tolerant QCT under a coherent attack. Moreover, it provides the potential advantage of doubling the secure distance for some special cases. Finally, MDI-QCT can also be modified to fit the weak coherent-state sources. Thus, based on the rapid development of practical MDI-QKD, our proposal can be implemented easily.

量子密钥分发（QKD）是一项有望实现信息论安全的技术。相位编码是研制光纤信道实用化QKD系统的重要途径。为提高相位编码的调制速率，本文提出一种新的数字调制方法，并利用实验室现有器件搭建了紧凑、稳健的QKD系统样机，以验证该方法的有效性。系统部署于实验室环境的50 km光纤上，在无人干预的情况下连续运行87 h。系统量子误码率（QBER）保持稳定，平均值为3.22%，安全成码率为8.91 kbps。尽管受法拉第-迈克耳孙干涉仪（FMI）结构限制，演示系统中光子的调制速率仅为200 MHz，但所提方法与基于现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）的电子学方案，对于调制速率达Gbit/s量级的高速QKD系统具有很大潜力。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a technology with the potential capability to achieve information-theoretic security. Phasecoding is an important approach to develop practical QKD systems in fiber channel. In order to improve the phase-coding modulation rate, we proposed a new digital-modulation method in this paper and constructed a compact and robust prototype of QKD system using currently available components in our lab to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method. The system was deployed in laboratory environment over a 50 km fiber and continuously operated during 87 h without manual interaction. The quantum bit error rate (QBER) of the system was stable with an average value of 3.22% and the secure key generation rate is 8.91 kbps. Although the modulation rate of the photon in the demo system was only 200 MHz, which was limited by the Faraday-Michelson interferometer (FMI) structure, the proposed method and the field programmable gate array (FPGA) based electronics scheme have a great potential for high speed QKD systems with Giga-bits/second modulation rate.

无需监测信号扰动的量子密钥分发实验演示Experimental demonstration of a quantum key distribution without signal disturbance monitoring

★Nat. Photon.

首次主动实现轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议：Alice发送每包65个脉冲的脉冲串，Bob用主动控制可变延迟干涉仪随机切换延迟，在90 km距离上成功分发密钥，验证了该协议在高误码情形下的可行性。

在现有量子密钥分发协议中，两个合法用户Alice与Bob必须监测信号扰动，以限定潜在的信息泄露上界。然而，在轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议中，信号扰动的监测是不必要的。在此，我们首次给出了RRDPS协议的主动实现。实验中，Alice制备脉冲串包，每个包由65个脉冲组成，且每个包的全局相位被随机化。Bob使用一种新颖的主动控制可变延迟干涉仪，实现不同延迟的随机切换。得益于每个包中脉冲数目众多以及干涉仪的高稳定性和低插入损耗，该系统可在90 km的距离上分发密钥。我们的实验演示与结果证实了RRDPS协议的可行性，尤其是在高误码情形下。

Abstract (English)
In existing quantum key distribution protocols, two legitimate peers, Alice and Bob, must monitor the signal disturbance to place a bound on the potential information leakage. However, in the round-robin differential phase shift (RRDPS) protocol, monitoring of the signal disturbance is unnecessary. Here, we present the first active implementation of the RRDPS protocol. In our experiment, Alice prepares packets of pulses, where each packet is a train with 65 pulses and the global phase of each packet is randomized. Bob uses a novel actively controlled variable-delay interferometer to realize the random switching of different delays. Benefiting from the large pulse number of each packet, and the high stability and low insertion loss of the interferometer, the system can distribute a secret key over a distance of 90 km. Our experimental demonstration and results confirm the feasibility of the RRDPS protocol, particularly in high-error situations.

把利用不完美器件的实际攻击统一归为木马攻击、强随机性攻击与弱随机性攻击三类，并证明 BB84 协议在随机性攻击模型下仍然安全，为实际系统给出通用的安全性分析框架。

BB84 量子密钥分发协议的无条件安全性已被利用量子力学基本定律加以证明，但实际的量子密钥分发系统若分别考虑不完美的态制备与不完美的测量，则可能被攻破。迄今为止，人们已提出多种利用不完美器件的攻击方案，但针对所有这些实际攻击方案的通用安全分析模型尚未建立。在此，我们证明实际的通用攻击方案可分别划分为木马攻击、强随机性攻击和弱随机性攻击三类。我们证明了 BB84 协议在随机性攻击模型下的安全性，这些结果可用于保障实际量子密钥分发系统的安全。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Unconditional security of the BB84 quantum key distribution protocol has been proved by exploiting the fundamental laws of quantum mechanics, but the practical quantum key distribution system maybe hacked by considering the imperfect state preparation and measurement respectively. Until now, different attacking schemes have been proposed by utilizing imperfect devices, but the general security analysis model against all of the practical attacking schemes has not been proposed. Here, we demonstrate that the general practical attacking schemes can be divided into the Trojan horse attack, strong randomness attack and weak randomness attack respectively. We prove security of BB84 protocol under randomness attacking models and these results can be applied to guarantee the security of the practical quantum key distribution system.

提出相位编码的参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发方案，两个远距离干涉仪之间无需相位对准，在 20 km 光纤、1 MHz 系统上获得 8.309 bps 的平均安全密钥率。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是朝着在远程合法用户（Alice 与 Bob）之间实现实用信息论安全密钥共享迈出的实质性一步。与其他标准的设备相关量子密钥分发协议（如 BB84）一样，MDI QKD 假定 Alice 与 Bob 之间已经共享了参考系。在实践中，往往需要复杂的对准流程，这会占用系统资源并可能显著降低安全密钥生成率。在此，我们提出了一种相位编码的参考系无关 MDI QKD 方案，它不需要两个相距遥远的合法方干涉仪之间的任何相位对准。作为演示，我们给出了使用法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的原理性验证实验。实验系统工作在 1 MHz，在 Alice 与 Bob 之间光纤长度为 20 km 时获得了 8.309 bps 的平均安全密钥率。该系统在正常情况下无需相位补偿即可维持正的密钥生成率。结果显示了我们的系统用于成熟 MDI QKD 器件的可行性及其在网络场景中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a substantial step toward practical information-theoretic security for key sharing between remote legitimate users (Alice and Bob). As with other standard device-dependent quantum key distribution protocols, such as BB84, MDI QKD assumes that the reference frames have been shared between Alice and Bob. In practice, a nontrivial alignment procedure is often necessary, which requires system resources and may significantly reduce the secure key generation rate. Here, we propose a phase-coding reference-frame-independent MDI QKD scheme that requires no phase alignment between the interferometers of two distant legitimate parties. As a demonstration, a proof-of-principle experiment using Faraday-Michelson interferometers is presented. The experimental system worked at 1 MHz, and an average secure key rate of 8.309 bps was obtained at a fiber length of 20 km between Alice and Bob. The system can maintain a positive key generation rate without phase compensation under normal conditions. The results exhibit the feasibility of our system for use in mature MDI QKD devices and its value for network scenarios.

在固态量子存储器中存储量子点发射的多个单光子脉冲Storage of multiple single-photon pulses emitted from a quantum dot in a solid-state quantum memory

★Nat. Commun.

在保偏固态量子存储器中存储量子点确定性发射的单光子，并演示了 1、20 和 100 个窄单光子脉冲的多时间模式存储，每个脉冲至多含一个光子，为全固态量子中继器奠定基础。

量子中继器是不可避免的光学传输损耗下，在远距离分发纠缠的关键部件。受 Duan–Lukin–Cirac–Zoller 协议启发，人们提出了许多基于量子存储器的改进型量子中继器协议，这些协议通常关注纠缠分发速率。在这些协议中，消除多光子（或多光子对）以及使用多模量子存储器已被证明能够大幅提高纠缠分发速率。在此，我们演示了将量子点确定性发射的单光子存储于保偏固态量子存储器中；此外，还演示了具有 1、20 和 100 个窄单光子脉冲的多时间模式存储。多光子被消除，每个脉冲中最多只包含一个光子。而且，两个子系统的固态特性使该构型更加稳定、更易于扩展。我们的工作将有助于构建基于全固态器件的高效量子中继器。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum repeaters are critical components for distributing entanglement over long distances in presence of unavoidable optical losses during transmission. Stimulated by the Duan–Lukin–Cirac–Zoller protocol, many improved quantum repeater protocols based on quantum memories have been proposed, which commonly focus on the entanglement-distribution rate. Among these protocols, the elimination of multiple photons (or multiple photon-pairs) and the use of multimode quantum memory are demonstrated to have the ability to greatly improve the entanglement-distribution rate. Here, we demonstrate the storage of deterministic single photons emitted from a quantum dot in a polarization-maintaining solid-state quantum memory; in addition, multi-temporal-mode memory with 1, 20 and 100 narrow single-photon pulses is also demonstrated. Multi-photons are eliminated, and only one photon at most is contained in each pulse. Moreover, the solid-state properties of both sub-systems make this configuration more stable and easier to be scalable. Our work will be helpful in the construction of efficient quantum repeaters based on all-solid-state devices.

利用雪崩光电二极管的雪崩脉冲配合简单的时间仓编码高效提取器，在室温下实现真量子随机数产生，对脉冲强度与温度等慢变噪声具有鲁棒性，双管方案速率达 0.69 Mb/s。

我们提出并演示了一种在室温下实现高效真量子随机数发生器（RNG）的方案。该方案采用简单的时间仓编码方法构成有效提取器，把雪崩光电二极管（APD）的雪崩脉冲转换为高质量随机数，且对脉冲强度涨落、温度波动等慢变噪声具有鲁棒性。该方案可兼容光源，但光源并非必需，因此系统的鲁棒性得到有效增强。该原理性系统的随机比特产生速率为：双 APD 情形 0.69 Mb/s，单 APD 情形 0.34 Mb/s。结果表明，基于该方案的高速随机数发生器芯片有望借助可集成的 APD 阵列实现。

Abstract (English)
We propose and demonstrate a scheme to realize a high-efficiency truly quantum random number generator (RNG) at room temperature. Using an effective extractor with simple time bin encoding method, the avalanche pulses of avalanche photodiode (APD) are converted into high-quality random numbers that are robust to slow varying noise such as fluctuations of pulse intensity and temperature. A light source is compatible but not necessary in this scheme. Therefor the robustness of the system is effective enhanced. The random bits generation rate of this proof-of-principle system is 0.69 Mb/s with double APDs and 0.34 Mb/s with single APD. The results indicate that a high-speed RNG chip based on the scheme is potentially available with an integrable APD array.

基于单光子贝尔态测量的量子密钥分发简单实现Simple implementation of quantum key distribution based on single-photon Bell-state measurement

提出一种可直接搭建在现有BB84系统上的单光子贝尔态测量量子密钥分发方案，揭示其与传统相位编码协议之间的隐藏物理联系，并实验验证了可行性。

最近，人们提出了一些基于单光子贝尔态测量（SBSM）的测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）替代方案。尽管这些替代方案的安全性并不严格等同于MDI QKD，但它们具备传统类BB84协议成码率高的优势，同时避免了MDI QKD所要求的两光子干涉技术复杂性。然而，与常用的BB84系统相比，这些已提出方案的装置相当复杂。在此我们提出一种基于SBSM的QKD的简单实现，它直接建立在已有的BB84 QKD实现之上。我们的方案揭示了基于SBSM的QKD与传统相位编码QKD协议之间的隐藏联系。这一发现阐明了这两类不同QKD协议背后的物理。此外，我们实验演示了该协议的可行性。

Abstract (English)
Recently some alternatives to the measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD) based on the single-photon Bell-state measurement (SBSM) were proposed. Although these alternatives are not precisely as secure as the MDI QKD, they possess the advantage of a high key rate of the traditional BB84-like protocol and avoid the technical complexity of two-photon interference required in the MDI QKD. However, the setups of these proposed schemes are rather complicated compared to commonly used BB84 systems. Here we propose a simple implementation of SBSM-based QKD that is directly built on the existing realization of the BB84 QKD. Our proposal exhibits the hidden connection between the SBSM-based QKD and traditional phase-encoding QKD protocols. This finding discloses the physics behind these two different types of QKD protocols. In addition, we experimentally demonstrate the feasibility of our protocol.

No. 01

电磁干扰对智能电网中实用量子密钥分发系统的影响Effect of electromagnetic disturbance on the practical QKD system in the smart grid

研究了变电站电磁干扰对智能电网中法拉第—迈克尔逊相位编码QKD系统的影响，推导出干扰引起的条纹可见度变化与附加量子误码率，最坏情况下平均值仅增加约0.17%，并给出了抑制该干扰的途径。

为提高智能电网的安全性，量子密钥分发（QKD）是一个极佳的选择。电力架空光缆上的快速波动以及变电站中的电磁干扰，是QKD实施面临的两大主要挑战。由于对信道的双折射不敏感，稳定的相位编码法拉第—迈克尔逊QKD系统在智能电网中非常实用。然而，必须考虑变电站中的电磁干扰对这一实用QKD系统的影响。这种干扰可能改变法拉第镜的旋转角，从而引入额外的量子比特误码率（QBER）。我们推导了该系统在电磁干扰下的新条纹可见度以及附加QBER。在最坏情况下，干扰导致的平均附加QBER仅增加约0.17%，相对于正常QBER值而言较小。我们还找到了降低电磁干扰对QKD系统影响的方法。

Abstract (English)
To improve the security of the smart grid, quantum key distribution (QKD) is an excellent choice. The rapid fluctuations on the power aerial optical cable and electromagnetic disturbance in substations are two main challenges for implementation of QKD. Due to insensitivity to birefringence of the channel, the stable phase-coding Faraday—Michelson QKD system is very practical in the smart grid. However, the electromagnetic disturbance in substations on this practical QKD system should be considered. The disturbance might change the rotation angle of the Faraday mirror, and would introduce an additional quantum bit error rate (QBER). We derive the new fringe visibility of the system and the additional QBER from the electromagnetic disturbance. In the worst case, the average additional QBER only increases about 0.17% due to the disturbance, which is relatively small to normal QBER values. We also find the way to degrade the electromagnetic disturbance on the QKD system.

Fang-Yi Li, Dong Wang, Shuang Wang, Mo Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Wei Chen, Zheng-Fu Han
Chinese Physics B

10.1088/1674-1056/23/12/124201

No. 02

失配基统计使未表征量子比特源可用于量子密钥分发Mismatched-basis statistics enable quantum key distribution with uncharacterized qubit sources

提出一种后处理方法，利用双方选用不同基时的测量统计，证明纳入这些统计后，未表征的量子比特源也能用于测量设备无关量子密钥分发与 BB84 协议，而此前这被认为不可能。

在量子密钥分发的后处理中，来自失配基测量（即双方使用不同基）的原始密钥比特通常被丢弃。这里我们提出一种利用失配基情形下测量统计的后处理方法，并证明：纳入这些统计后，未表征的量子比特源可以被用于测量设备无关的量子密钥分发协议以及 Bennett-Brassard 1984 协议，而这在其他情况下是不可能的。

Abstract (English)
In the postprocessing of quantum key distribution, the raw key bits from the mismatched-basis measurements, where two parties use different bases, are normally discarded. Here, we propose a postprocessing method that exploits measurement statistics from mismatched-basis cases and prove that incorporating these statistics enables uncharacterized qubit sources to be used in the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution protocol and the Bennett-Brassard 1984 protocol, which is otherwise impossible.

No. 03

基于Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt不等式的诱骗态测量设备无关量子密钥分发Decoy-state measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution based on the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt inequality

在仅要求量子态制备于二维希尔伯特空间、器件相互独立的假设下，分析含一个信号态与s−1个诱骗态的CHSH-MDI-QKD协议，并计入五强度情形的有限码长效应，仿真显示方案具有实用性。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议的提出旨在消除探测器侧信道攻击，但其安全性依赖于编码系统被完美刻画这一假设。相比之下，基于Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt不等式（CHSH）的MDI-QKD协议（CHSH-MDI-QKD）弱化了这一假设，它只要求量子态在二维希尔伯特空间中制备、且各器件相互独立。在实验实现中，由于缺乏理想的单光子源，QKD系统通常采用弱相干态，而弱相干态可能被制备于高维空间。本文研究采用 s（3≤s≤5）个强度的诱骗态CHSH-MDI-QKD协议，其中包括一个信号态和 s−1 个诱骗态；同时我们还考虑了五强度情形下诱骗态CHSH-MDI-QKD协议的有限码长效应。仿真结果表明该方案非常实用。

Abstract (English)
The measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol is proposed to remove the detector side channel attacks, while its security relies on the assumption that the encoding systems are perfectly characterized. In contrast, the MDI-QKD protocol based on the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt inequality (CHSH-MDI-QKD) weakens this assumption, which only requires the quantum state to be prepared in the two-dimensional Hilbert space and the devices are independent. In experimental realizations, the weak coherent state, which is always used in QKD systems due to the lack of an ideal single-photon source, may be prepared in the high-dimensional space. In this paper, we investigate the decoy-state CHSH-MDI-QKD protocol with $s(3\ensuremath{\le}s\ensuremath{\le}5)$ intensities, including one signal state and $s\ensuremath{-}1$ decoy states, and we also consider the finite-size effect on the decoy-state CHSH-MDI-QKD protocol with five intensities. Simulation results show that this scheme is very practical.

Chun-Mei Zhang, Mo Li, Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Dong Wang, Jing-Zheng Huang, Yun-Guang Han, Man-Li Xu, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Patcharapong Treeviriyanupab, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

广域量子密钥分发网络的现场与长期演示Field and long-term demonstration of a wide area quantum key distribution network

在中国移动通信基础设施上建成覆盖合肥、巢湖、芜湖三地、面积逾150公里的广域量子密钥分发网络，连续运行5000余小时，验证了点对点QKD技术与组网方案的有效融合。

演示了一个部署在中国移动通信有限公司提供的通信基础设施上的广域量子密钥分发（QKD）网络。三个城市和两个城域QKD网络被连接起来，组成覆盖面积超过150公里的合肥—巢湖—芜湖广域QKD网络，其中合肥城域QKD网络是典型的全网状核心网络，可提供全互联；芜湖城域QKD网络则是具有点对多点配置的代表性量子接入网络。整个广域QKD网络从2011年12月21日至2012年7月19日运行了5000多小时，部分网络一直运行到去年12月。为适应复杂多变的现场环境，我们在设计QKD设备时采用了带有多项稳定措施的Faraday-Michelson QKD系统。通过QKD设备的标准化设计、QKD设备对称性问题的解决以及动态QKD网络中的无缝切换，我们实现了点对点QKD技术与组网方案的有效融合。

Abstract (English)
A wide area quantum key distribution (QKD) network deployed on communication infrastructures provided by China Mobile Ltd. is demonstrated. Three cities and two metropolitan area QKD networks were linked up to form the Hefei-Chaohu-Wuhu wide area QKD network with over 150 kilometers coverage area, in which Hefei metropolitan area QKD network was a typical full-mesh core network to offer all-to-all interconnections, and Wuhu metropolitan area QKD network was a representative quantum access network with point-to-multipoint configuration. The whole wide area QKD network ran for more than 5000 hours, from 21 December 2011 to 19 July 2012, and part of the network stopped until last December. To adapt to the complex and volatile field environment, the Faraday-Michelson QKD system with several stability measures was adopted when we designed QKD devices. Through standardized design of QKD devices, resolution of symmetry problem of QKD devices, and seamless switching in dynamic QKD network, we realized the effective integration between point-to-point QKD techniques and networking schemes.

测量设备无关量子密钥分发的安全性证明：信息论视角A Security Proof of Measurement Device Independent Quantum Key Distribution: From the View of Information Theory

从量子信息论出发给出测量设备无关量子密钥分发的安全性证明，界定了窃听者对筛选后密钥比特所掌握信息的上界，并据此得到最终的安全密钥比特率。

尽管一些理想量子密钥分发协议已被证明是安全的，但已有若干演示表明，实际量子密钥分发实现会因现实中的不完美性而遭到攻击。在这些攻击中，探测器侧信道攻击可能是最严重的。最近，一种测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议［Phys. Rev. Lett. 108 (2012) 130503］被提出，该方案消除了所有探测器侧信道攻击。这里给出一个基于量子信息论的新安全性证明。窃听者对筛选后密钥比特所掌握的信息被给出上界。进而利用该上界，可以得到最终的安全密钥比特率。

Abstract (English)
Although some ideal quantum key distribution protocols have been proved to be secure, there have been some demonstrations that practical quantum key distribution implementations were hacked due to some real-life imperfections. Among these attacks, detector side channel attacks may be the most serious. Recently, a measurement device independent quantum key distribution protocol [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 108 (2012) 130503 ] was proposed and all detector side channel attacks are removed in this scheme. Here a new security proof based on quantum information theory is given. The eavesdropper's information of the sifted key bits is bounded. Then with this bound, the final secure key bit rate can be obtained.

No. 06

噪声与损耗信道下改进型乒乓协议的安全性Security of modified Ping-Pong protocol in noisy and lossy channel

针对 2002 年提出的基于纠缠的双向量子密钥协议给出一处简单且实验可行的修改，并证明在噪声与损耗信道下该改进协议可抵御集体攻击，仿真结果表明方案具有实用性。

“乒乓”（PP）协议是一种基于纠缠的双向量子密钥协议。在该协议中，Bob 制备一对最大纠缠量子比特，并把其中一个量子比特发送给 Alice；随后 Alice 对该量子比特进行一些必要的操作，再将其发回 Bob。尽管该协议早在 2002 年就已提出，但其在噪声与损耗信道中的安全性一直未被证明。在本报告中，我们对原始 PP 协议加入一处简单且实验上可行的修改，并在考虑噪声与损耗信道的情形下，证明这一改进型 PP 协议抵御集体攻击的安全性。仿真结果表明我们的协议是实用的。

Abstract (English)
The "Ping-Pong" (PP) protocol is a two-way quantum key protocol based on entanglement. In this protocol, Bob prepares one maximally entangled pair of qubits, and sends one qubit to Alice. Then, Alice performs some necessary operations on this qubit and sends it back to Bob. Although this protocol was proposed in 2002, its security in the noisy and lossy channel has not been proven. In this report, we add a simple and experimentally feasible modification to the original PP protocol, and prove the security of this modified PP protocol against collective attacks when the noisy and lossy channel is taken into account. Simulation results show that our protocol is practical.

免疫探测器侧信道攻击的无参考系无关量子密钥分发Reference-free-independent quantum key distribution immune to detector side channel attacks

提出一种新的无参考系无关（RFI）QKD协议，移除了全部探测器侧信道，且无需主动对准参考系即可容忍其未知慢漂移，数值模拟表明该协议有望实现较长的安全距离。

通常，共享参考系对实用化量子密钥分发（QKD）系统不可或缺。因此，由于环境引入的参考系未知且缓慢变化，大多数QKD系统需要主动对准参考系。颇为有趣的是，无参考系无关（RFI）QKD无需对准参考系即可生成密钥比特。然而，RFI QKD仍可能易受探测器侧信道攻击。在此，我们提出一种新的RFI QKD协议，其中所有探测器侧信道均被移除。此外，我们的协议仍能在不主动对准的情况下容忍参考系的未知慢变。数值模拟表明，该协议有望实现较长的安全距离。

Abstract (English)
Usually, a shared reference frame is indispensable for practical quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. As a result, most QKD systems need active alignment of reference frame due to the unknown and slowly variances of reference frame introduced by environment. Quite interestingly, reference-free-independent (RFI) QKD can generate secret-key bits without alignment of reference frame. However, RFI QKD may be still vulnerable to detector side channel attacks. Here, we propose a new RFI QKD protocol, in which all detector side channels are removed. Furthermore, our protocol can still tolerate unknown and slow variance of reference frame without active alignment. And a numerical simulation shows that long security distance is probable in this protocol.

No. 08

针对采用零差探测的量子密钥分发的量子黑客攻击Quantum hacking on quantum key distribution using homodyne detection

利用光纤分束器耦合比随波长变化这一器件不完美，提出针对零差探测连续变量量子密钥分发的波长攻击，可使实时散粒噪声估计产生偏差，并给出改进的防御方案。

商用量子密钥分发系统中的不完美器件会留下安全漏洞，窃听者可能加以利用。这类不完美的一个例子是光纤分束器的耦合比依赖于波长。利用这一漏洞，窃听者可以通过注入与通常使用波长不同的光，来改变接收端光纤分束器的透射率。在此，我们针对采用零差探测的实际连续变量量子密钥分发系统提出一种波长攻击。通过注入不同波长的光脉冲，该攻击使窃听者即使在进行实时散粒噪声估计时也能使其产生偏差。基于实验数据，我们讨论了该攻击的可行性，并通过改进此前提出的对策给出了一种防御方案。

Abstract (English)
Imperfect devices in commercial quantum key distribution systems open security loopholes that an eavesdropper may exploit. An example of one such imperfection is the wavelength-dependent coupling ratio of the fiber beam splitter. Utilizing this loophole, the eavesdropper can vary the transmittances of the fiber beam splitter at the receiver's side by inserting lights with wavelengths different from what is normally used. Here, we propose a wavelength attack on a practical continuous-variable quantum key distribution system using homodyne detection. By inserting light pulses at different wavelengths, this attack allows the eavesdropper to bias the shot-noise estimation even if it is done in real time. Based on experimental data, we discuss the feasibility of this attack and suggest a prevention scheme by improving the previously proposed countermeasures.

Jing-Zheng Huang, Sébastien Kunz-Jacques, Paul Jouguet, Christian Weedbrook, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.89.032304

No. 09

基于量子维数和独立器件的量子密钥分发Quantum key distribution based on quantum dimension and independent devices

提出仅用二维希尔伯特空间编码量子态、且态制备与测量设备相互独立的QKD协议，既弱化了原始MDI-QKD的态制备假设，又能克服限制FDI-QKD应用的探测漏洞问题，可用实际光学元件实现。

本文提出一种量子密钥分发（QKD）协议，它仅基于编码量子系统的二维希尔伯特空间，并要求态制备设备与测量设备相互独立。我们的协议受到完全设备无关量子密钥分发（FDI-QKD）协议和测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议的启发。我们的协议只要求态在二维希尔伯特空间中制备，这弱化了原始MDI-QKD协议中的态制备假设。更有趣的是，我们的协议能够克服FDI-QKD协议中的探测漏洞问题，而该问题极大地限制了FDI-QKD的应用。因此，我们的协议可以用实际的光学元件实现。

Abstract (English)
In this paper, we propose a quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol based on only a two-dimensional Hilbert space encoding a quantum system and independent devices between the equipment for state preparation and measurement. Our protocol is inspired by the fully device-independent quantum key distribution (FDI-QKD) protocol and the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol. Our protocol only requires the state to be prepared in the two-dimensional Hilbert space, which weakens the state preparation assumption in the original MDI-QKD protocol. More interestingly, our protocol can overcome the detection loophole problem in the FDI-QKD protocol, which greatly limits the application of FDI-QKD. Hence our protocol can be implemented with practical optical components.

Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.89.032302

No. 10

采用改进相干态的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with modified coherent state

提出以改进相干态光源取代弱相干态来实现带诱骗态的测量设备无关量子密钥分发，模拟显示安全密钥率与传输距离均明显提升，原因在于多光子事件概率更低而单光子概率更高。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议是为消除探测器侧信道攻击而提出的。由于相干态光源存在多光子事件，MDI-QKD 协议的实际实现必须采用诱骗态来抵御光子数分离攻击。近来已有基于弱相干态（WCS）的 MDI-QKD 诱骗态研究。在本快报中，我们提出用改进相干态（MCS）光源来执行 MDI-QKD 协议。我们模拟了基于 MCS 光源的诱骗态 MDI-QKD 的性能，模拟表明，采用 MCS 光源可显著提升安全密钥率与传输距离。这一提升背后的物理原因是：MCS 的多光子事件概率低于 WCS，同时其单光子概率更高。

Abstract (English)
The measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol has been proposed for the purpose of removing the detector side channel attacks. Due to the multiphoton events of coherent states sources, real-life implementations of MDI-QKD protocol must employ decoy states to beat the photon-number-splitting attack. Decoy states for MDI-QKD based on the weak coherent states (WCSs) have been studied recently. In this Letter, we propose to perform MDI-QKD protocol with modified coherent states (MCS) sources. We simulate the performance of MDI-QKD with the decoy states based on MCS sources. And our simulation indicates that both the secure-key rate and transmission distance can be improved evidently with MCS sources. The physics behind this improvement is that the probability of multiphoton events of the MCS is lower than that of WCSs while at the same time the probability of single-photon is higher.

Mo Li, Chun-Mei Zhang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 11

相位编码参考系无关量子密钥分发的原理性验证实验Proof-of-principle experiment of reference-frame-independent quantum key distribution with phase coding

在80 km光纤上完成相位编码参考系无关QKD原理性实验，计入有限码长后仍可达50 km；并提出适用于弱相干源的诱骗态方法以抵抗光子数分离攻击。

我们展示了在80 km光纤链路上进行的相位编码参考系无关量子密钥分发（RFI-QKD）原理性实验。在考虑有限码长界之后，仍可实现50 km的传输距离。在此情形下，各基矢态的相位之间由一种缓慢时变的变换相联系。此外，我们针对采用弱相干源的RFI-QKD系统提出并实现了一种新的诱骗态方法，用以抵御光子数分离攻击。借助参考系无关协议以及带有法拉第旋转镜的迈克耳孙干涉仪，我们的系统对干涉仪的慢相位变化和信道的偏振扰动均免疫，使整个流程具有很强的鲁棒性。

Abstract (English)
We have demonstrated a proof-of-principle experiment of reference-frame-independent phase coding quantum key distribution (RFI-QKD) over an 80-km optical fiber. After considering the finite-key bound, we still achieve a distance of 50 km. In this scenario, the phases of the basis states are related by a slowly time-varying transformation. Furthermore, we developed and realized a new decoy state method for RFI-QKD systems with weak coherent sources to counteract the photon-number-splitting attack. With the help of a reference-frame-independent protocol and a Michelson interferometer with Faraday rotator mirrors, our system is rendered immune to the slow phase changes of the interferometer and the polarization disturbances of the channel, making the procedure very robust.

Wen-Ye Liang, Shuang Wang, Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Yao Yao, Jing-Zheng Huang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

基于未表征量子比特源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with uncharacterized qubit sources

该工作放宽了对编码系统的刻画要求：只要使用量子比特源，即便编码系统完全未表征也能保证安全性，并给出无需知晓编码态的安全证明与实用性模拟结果。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）被提出以抵御任何可能的探测攻击。原始方案的安全性依赖于如下假设：合法用户能够完全刻画包括源在内的编码系统。在此我们提出一种MDIQKD协议，只要使用量子比特源，就允许编码系统未被表征。我们给出了该MDIQKD协议的安全性证明，它不需要关于编码态的任何知识。模拟结果表明该方案具有实用性。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) is proposed to be secure against any possible detection attacks. The security of the original proposal relies on the assumption that the legitimate users can fully characterize the encoding systems including sources. Here, we propose a MDIQKD protocol where we allow uncharacterized encoding systems as long as qubit sources are used. A security proof of the MDIQKD protocol is presented that does not need the knowledge of the encoding states. Simulation results show that the scheme is practical.

No. 02

部分光子数分离攻击下诱骗态协议的安全性The security of decoy state protocol in the partial photon number splitting attack

构建了包含原始攻击的部分光子数分离攻击模型，证明即使信号态与诱骗态脉冲的增益比几乎不变，诱骗态协议依然有效。

诱骗态协议是为克服原始的光子数分离攻击而提出的。当采用更优策略时，攻击者可以使信号态脉冲与诱骗态脉冲的总增益之比变化很小，甚至可使信号态脉冲的总增益与没有攻击者时相同。本文首先给出一个包含原始攻击的部分光子数分离攻击模型，进而发现诱骗态协议在部分光子数分离攻击下仍然有效。

Abstract (English)
The decoy state protocol was proposed to overcome the primitive photon number splitting attack. When using a better strategy, the attacker can ensure that the ratio of the overall gain of the signal state pulse against the decoy state pulse changes very little, even to keep the overall gain of the signal state pulses equal to that obtained without attacker. In this paper we first give a model of the partial photon number splitting attack which contains the original one, and then find that the decoy state protocol still works effectively under the partial photon number splitting attack.

Dong Liu, Shuang Wang, ZhenQiang Yin, Wei Chen, ZhengFu Han
Chinese Science Bulletin

10.1007/s11434-013-6037-2

No. 03

量子密钥分发网络：从城域网到广域网The QKD network: From metropolitan to wide area

介绍了量子密钥分发从城域网走向广域网的网络架构与关键技术，并梳理了BB84协议提出以来传输距离由32厘米提升至260公里、成码速率由200赫兹提升至10吉赫兹的发展历程。

在现代社会，安全通信与信息保护日益重要。量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个远程合法用户能够共享无条件安全的密钥。与此前的方案不同，这些密钥的安全性基于量子物理学原理，并且可以被证明。结合一次性密码本加密，QKD可为安全通信和信息保护提供有效途径[1, 2]。自Bennett和Brassard提出著名的BB84协议[3]以来，QKD或量子密码学已成为最具活力的研究领域之一。经过约二十年的发展，实验QKD取得了显著进步，例如传输距离从32 cm[4]提高到260 km[5]，速率从200 Hz[4]提高到10 GHz[6]。

Abstract (English)
Secure communication and information protection become more and more important in the modern society. Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables two remote legitimate users to share unconditionally secure keys. Different from the former ones, the security of these keys is based on the principles of quantum physics and could be proved. Combined with one-time pad encryption, QKD can provide us an effective way for secure communication and information protection[1, 2]. Since Bennett and Brassard proposed the famous BB84 protocol[3], QKD or quantum cryptography has become one of the most dynamic research fields. After about twenty years of development, experimental QKD has achieved significant improvements, such as the transmission distance increased from 32 cm[4]to 260 km[5], the speed increased from 200 Hz[4]to 10 GHz[6].

Shuang Wang, Zheng-Fu Han, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo

No. 04

利用波长攻击对连续变量量子密钥分发系统实施量子黑客攻击Quantum hacking of a continuous-variable quantum-key-distribution system using a wavelength attack

提出一种波长攻击，通过切换输入光波长控制Bob分束器的强度透过率，可攻破采用外差探测的连续变量量子密钥分发系统，即使监测了本地振荡光强度，最终密钥仍不安全。

连续变量量子密钥分发的安全性证明基于以下假设：窃听者既不能作用于本地振荡光，也不能控制Bob的分束器。由于此类协议在实现中可能存在不完美之处，这些假设在实际中可能并不成立。本文考虑本地振荡光在公共信道中传输的情形，提出一种波长攻击，使窃听者能够通过切换输入光的波长来控制Bob分束器的强度透过率。具体而言，我们针对采用外差探测协议、并使用直接协商或逆向协商的连续变量量子密钥分发系统。我们证明该攻击是可行的，并使得合法双方共享的所有最终密钥都不再安全，即使他们已监测了本地振荡光的强度。为在商用系统上防范该攻击，应在执行监测探测之前随机加入一个简单的波长滤波器。

Abstract (English)
The security proofs of continuous-variable quantum key distribution are based on the assumptions that the eavesdropper can neither act on the local oscillator nor control Bob's beam splitter. These assumptions may be invalid in practice due to potential imperfections in the implementations of such protocols. In this paper, we consider the problem of transmitting the local oscillator in a public channel and propose a wavelength attack which allows the eavesdropper to control the intensity transmission of Bob's beam splitter by switching the wavelength of the input light. Specifically we target continuous-variable quantum key distribution systems that use the heterodyne detection protocol using either direct or reverse reconciliation. Our attack is proved to be feasible and renders all of the final keys shared between the legitimate parties insecure, even if they have monitored the intensity of the local oscillator. To prevent our attack on commercial systems, a simple wavelength filter should be randomly added before performing monitoring detection.

Jing-Zheng Huang, Christian Weedbrook, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Hong-Wei Li, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 05

半设备无关与全设备无关协议之间的关系Relationship between semi- and fully-device-independent protocols

以贝尔不等式与维度见证之间的对应关系为工具，建立了半设备无关与全设备无关协议之间的相互转换方法，并由此得到两类情形下比特率更高的随机数生成协议，还给出了若干类贝尔不等式与维度见证。

我们研究了半设备无关协议与全设备无关协议之间的关系。作为工具，我们利用了贝尔不等式与维度见证之间的对应关系。我们提出了一种把前者转换为后者、以及反向转换的方法。这一关系为两种场景都带来了有趣的结果。首先，我们在半设备无关与全设备无关两种情形下都找到了比特率更高的随机数生成协议。作为副产品，我们得到了若干类贝尔不等式和维度见证。随后，我们展示了贝尔不等式研究中使用的优化方法如何能够被用于维度见证。

Abstract (English)
We study the relation between semi- and fully-device-independent protocols. As a tool, we use the correspondence between Bell inequalities and dimension witnesses. We present a method for converting the former into the latter, and vice versa. This relation provides us with interesting results for both scenarios. First, we find random-number-generation protocols with higher bit rates for both the semi- and fully-device-independent cases. As a byproduct, we obtain classes of Bell inequalities and dimension witnesses. Then, we show how optimization methods used in studies on Bell inequalities can be adopted for dimension witnesses.

提出改进模型来模拟采用弱相干光源的被动诱骗态量子密钥分发，该模型在实际系统中性能更优，并完成了信道损耗超过 22.0 dB 的实验演示。

被动诱骗态量子密钥分发（PDS-QKD）在高速场景中具有优势。基于 Curty 的理论[Opt. Lett. 34, 3238 (2009)]，我们提出一个改进模型，用于模拟采用弱相干光源的 PDS-QKD。该改进模型能在实际 PDS-QKD 系统中提供更好的性能。此外，我们报道了信道损耗超过 22.0 dB 的 PDS-QKD 实验演示。

Abstract (English)
Passive decoy state quantum key distribution (PDS-QKD) has advantages in high-speed scenarios. We propose a modified model to simulate the PDS-QKD with a weak coherent light source based on Curty's theory [ Opt. Lett. 34 3238 (2009) ]. The modified model can provide better performance in a practical PDS-QKD system. Moreover, we report an experimental demonstration of the PDS-QKD of over 22.0-dB channel loss.

基于弱相干态的反事实量子密码学Counterfactual quantum cryptography based on weak coherent states

在反事实量子密码方案中，信息载体无需在量子信道中传播即可共享密钥；该工作针对常用弱相干激光源，在一般集体攻击下证明了方案安全性，并给出密钥率下界与实际性能分析。

在“反事实量子密码学”方案[T.-G. Noh, Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 230501 (2009)]中，即使信息载体不在量子信道中传输，两个合法远端用户仍可共享密钥比特。Yin等人[Z.-Q. Yin, H. W. Li, W. Chen, Z. F. Han, and G. C. Guo, Phys. Rev. A 82, 042335 (2010)]已证明采用理想单光子源的该协议的安全性。本文证明基于常用弱相干激光源的反事实量子密码方案在一般集体攻击下的安全性。此证明的基本假设是：单光子探测器的效率和暗计数率对任意$n$光子Fock态均保持一致。随后，通过对编码弱相干态的相位进行随机化，Eve的辅助量子态将转化为经典混合态。最后，给出了秘密密钥比特率的下界以及实际实现下的性能分析。

Abstract (English)
In the ``counterfactual quantum cryptography'' scheme [T.-G. Noh, Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 230501 (2009)], two legitimate distant peers may share secret-key bits even when the information carriers do not travel in the quantum channel. The security of this protocol with an ideal single-photon source has been proved by Yin et al. [Z.-Q. Yin, H. W. Li, W. Chen, Z. F. Han, and G. C. Guo, Phys. Rev. A 82, 042335 (2010)]. In this paper, we prove the security of the counterfactual-quantum-cryptography scheme based on a commonly used weak-coherent-laser source by considering a general collective attack. The basic assumption of this proof is that the efficiency and dark-counting rate of a single-photon detector are consistent for any $n$-photon Fock states. Then through randomizing the phases of the encoding weak coherent states, Eve's ancilla will be transformed into a classical mixture. Finally, the lower bound of the secret-key-bit rate and a performance analysis for the practical implementation are both given.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Yao Yao, Chun-Mei Zhang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

密钥率的估计是量子密钥分发过程的一个重要方面，尤其是在使用死时间时。本文通过数值模拟来估计平均探测概率与密钥率。采用我们的方法，所估计的平均探测概率优于先前的结果。此外，我们能够方便地找到最佳死时间，特别是在考虑后脉冲影响时。

Abstract (English)
The estimation of key rate is an important aspect of the quantum key distribution process, especially in the use of dead time. In this paper, we demonstrate a numerical simulation to estimate the average detection probability and the key rate. Using our method, the estimated average detection probability is better than the previous result. Besides, we can easily find the best dead time, especially when considering the impact of after pulse.
