2 GHz时钟速率下260 km标准通信光纤上的量子密钥分发2 GHz clock quantum key distribution over 260 km of standard telecom fiber

采用2 GHz系统时钟的差分相移量子密钥分发协议，结合1 bit延迟法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的优化与超导单光子探测器，在损耗52.9 dB的260 km光纤上实现了3.45%的量子比特误码率，并提升了50 km处的密钥率。

我们报道了在损耗超过50 dB、长度超过250 km的标准通信光纤上进行的量子密钥分发（QKD）演示。我们选用了差分相移QKD协议，并以2 GHz的系统时钟速率实现。通过对1 bit延迟法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的细致优化以及超导单光子探测器（SSPD）的使用，我们在光纤长度不超过205 km时实现了低于2%的量子比特误码率，在损耗为52.9 dB的260 km光纤上则为3.45%。我们还提高了SSPD的量子效率，以在50 km长度上获得高密钥率。

Abstract (English)
We report a demonstration of quantum key distribution (QKD) over a standard telecom fiber exceeding 50 dB in loss and 250 km in length. The differential phase shift QKD protocol was chosen and implemented with a 2 GHz system clock rate. By careful optimization of the 1 bit delayed Faraday-Michelson interferometer and the use of the superconducting single photon detector (SSPD), we achieved a quantum bit error rate below 2% when the fiber length was no more than 205 km, and of 3.45% for a 260 km fiber with 52.9 dB loss. We also improved the quantum efficiency of SSPD to obtain a high key rate for 50 km length.

Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Jun-Fu Guo, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.37.001008

2011 年6 篇

No. 01

利用波长相关分束器与多波长光源攻击实际量子密钥分发系统Attacking a practical quantum-key-distribution system with wavelength-dependent beam-splitter and multiwavelength sources

针对熔融双锥分束器的波长相关特性这一安全漏洞，提出可适用于所有被动状态调制 QKD 系统的攻击方案，并在偏振编码系统上仅以误码率从 1.3% 升至 1.4% 的代价窃取全部密钥。

众所周知，量子密钥分发（QKD）的无条件安全性可由量子力学保证。然而，实际 QKD 系统存在一些不完美之处，窃听者可以利用这些不完美来攻击密钥。以当前的实验技术，采用熔融双锥工艺制作的实际分束器具有波长相关特性。基于这一致命的安全漏洞，我们提出一种波长相关攻击方案，它可应用于所有采用被动状态调制的实际 QKD 系统。此外，我们对一个实际的偏振编码 QKD 系统进行了实验攻击，仅以将量子比特错误率从 1.3% 提高到 1.4% 为代价，就获取了全部密钥信息。

Abstract (English)
It is well known that the unconditional security of quantum-key distribution (QKD) can be guaranteed by quantum mechanics. However, practical QKD systems have some imperfections, which can be controlled by the eavesdropper to attack the secret key. With current experimental technology, a realistic beam splitter, made by fused biconical technology, has a wavelength-dependent property. Based on this fatal security loophole, we propose a wavelength-dependent attacking protocol, which can be applied to all practical QKD systems with passive state modulation. Moreover, we experimentally attack a practical polarization encoding QKD system to obtain all the secret key information at the cost of only increasing the quantum bit error rate from $1.3$ to $1.4%$.

Hong-Wei Li, Shuang Wang, Jing-Zheng Huang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Fang-Yi Li, Zheng Zhou, Dong Liu, Yang Zhang, Guang-Can Guo, Wan-Su Bao, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.84.062308

No. 02

差分相移量子密钥分发抗单脉冲攻击的安全性下界Lower bound for the security of differential phase shift quantum key distribution against a one-pulse-attack

针对差分相移量子密钥分发尚无无条件安全性证明的问题，利用冯·诺依曼熵的锐连续性等工具估计窃听者信息上界，并基于Devatak—Winter密钥率公式给出单脉冲攻击下的安全性下界。

量子密钥分发是在两个相距遥远的参与方之间共享密钥的技术，因其无条件安全性而备受关注。与其他量子密钥分发协议相比，差分相移量子密钥分发协议具有更高的效率和更简单的装置。遗憾的是，差分相移量子密钥分发的无条件安全性尚未得到证明。利用冯·诺依曼熵的锐连续性以及一些基本不等式，我们估计了窃听者Eve所获信息的上界。随后，我们借助Devatak—Winter的秘密密钥率公式，证明了差分相移量子密钥分发协议在单脉冲攻击下的安全性下界。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution is the art of sharing secret keys between two distant parties, and has attracted a lot of attention due to its unconditional security. Compared with other quantum key distribution protocols, the differential phase shift quantum key distribution protocol has higher efficiency and simpler apparatus. Unfortunately, the unconditional security of differential phase shift quantum key distribution has not been proved. Utilizing the sharp continuity of the von Neuman entropy and some basic inequalities, we estimate the upper bound for the eavesdropper Eve's information. We then prove the lower bound for the security of the differential phase shift quantum key distribution protocol against a one-pulse attack with Devatak—Winter's secret key rate formula.

Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wan-Su Bao, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Chinese Physics B

10.1088/1674-1056/20/10/100306

No. 03

无需纠缠的半设备无关随机数扩展协议Semi-device-independent random-number expansion without entanglement

提出无需纠缠的真随机数扩展协议，随机性仅由二维量子见证的违背保证，只需假设系统维度有紧致上界，属半设备无关黑箱情形，比基于纠缠的设备无关方案更易实现和检验。

通过检验两个系统之间的经典关联违背，无需借助经典统计方法即可生成并认证真随机数。本工作提出一种无需纠缠的真随机数扩展协议，其中随机性仅由二维量子见证的违背来保证。此外，我们只假设协议所用系统的维度具有紧致的上界，整个协议可视为半设备无关的黑箱情形。与基于纠缠的设备无关随机数扩展协议相比，我们的协议在实现与检验上都要容易得多。

Abstract (English)
By testing the classical correlation violation between two systems, true random numbers can be generated and certified without applying classical statistical method. In this work, we propose a true random-number expansion protocol without entanglement, where the randomness can be guaranteed only by the two-dimensional quantum witness violation. Furthermore, we only assume that the dimensionality of the system used in the protocol has a tight bound, and the whole protocol can be regarded as a semi-device-independent black-box scenario. Compared with the device-independent random-number expansion protocol based on entanglement, our protocol is much easier to implement and test.

Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Yu-Chun Wu, Xu-Bo Zou, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.84.034301

No. 04

相位编码量子密钥分发系统相位漂移的实时补偿Real-time compensation of phase drift for phase-encoded quantum key distribution systems

针对相位调制存在非线性时主动相位跟踪难以适用的问题，提出四相位扫描法，由四条干涉条纹与编码矩阵自动算出相位调制器的驱动电压，可实时补偿环境变化与系统非线性引起的相位漂移。

相位漂移是相位编码量子密钥分发（QKD）系统固有的问题。现有的主动相位跟踪与补偿方案无法满足相位调制存在非线性的系统的要求。本文提出一种四相位扫描方法，该方法建立在对相位漂移所致量子比特误码率（QBER）的定量分析以及相位补偿的性能要求之上。通过获取四条干涉条纹并调整系统的编码矩阵，该方法可自动计算出相位调制器的精确驱动电压。实现方案与实验测试表明，所提方法能够补偿由环境变化和系统非线性引起的相位漂移，并适用于大规模QKD网络。

Abstract (English)
Phase drift is an inherent problem in phase-encoded quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. The current active phase tracking and compensation solutions cannot satisfy the requirements of a system with nonlinearity in phase modulation. This paper presents a four-phase scanning method, which is based on the quantitative analysis of the quantum bit error rate (QBER) from phase drift and the performance requirements of phase compensation. By obtaining the four interference fringes and adjusting the coding matrix of the system, this method automatically calculates the accurate driving voltages for the phase modulator. The implementation and experimental tests show that the proposed method can compensate phase drift caused by environmental changes and the system’s nonlinearity, and is applicable to large-scale QKD networks.

LiJun Zhang, YongGang Wang, ZhenQiang Yin, Wei Chen, Yang Yang, Tao Zhang, DaJun Huang, Shuang Wang, FangYi Li, ZhengFu Han
Chinese Science Bulletin

10.1007/s11434-011-4570-4

No. 05

网络环境下密钥的量子秘密共享方案Quantum Secret Sharing of Key in Networks

分析了两类无需纠缠的实用量子秘密共享协议，并指出二者的组合可构成量子秘密共享网络的基本单元，具有实际应用潜力。

量子秘密共享是量子密码学中的一个重要问题。我们分析了两类无需纠缠的实用量子秘密共享协议，而它们的组合可以作为量子秘密共享网络中的一个基本单元，在实际应用中具有潜力。

Abstract (English)
Quantum secret sharing is a important problem in the quantum cryptography. We analyzed two kinds of practical quantum secret sharing protocols without entanglement. And their combination could be a basic unit in the quantum secret sharing network, which is potential in practical applications.

Yang Zhang, Wei Chen, Hong-Wei Li, Shuang Wang, Zheng-Fu Han, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo
2011 Symposium on Photonics and Optoelectronics (SOPO)

10.1109/SOPO.2011.5780519

No. 06

改进型相干单向量子密钥分发抗单脉冲攻击的安全下界Lower bounds for the security of modified coherent-one-way quantum key distribution against one-pulse-attack

针对BGS的安全性分析仅适用于50 km以上长距离情形的局限，利用冯·诺依曼熵的尖锐连续性等基本不等式，给出改进型相干单向协议在最一般单脉冲攻击下的安全下界，且只需接收端使用光子数分辨探测器，可适用于任意传输距离。

已有研究通过考虑单脉冲攻击，分析了相干单向（COW）量子密钥分发协议安全性的上界[Branciard C, Gisin N and Scarani V (BGS) New J.Phys. (2008) 10 013031]。然而，他们的安全性分析基于长距离情形，其传输距离的典型值大于50 km。本文利用冯·诺依曼熵的尖锐连续性以及一些基本不等式，仅考虑接收端将会使用的光子数分辨探测器，给出了改进型相干单向量子密钥分发协议在最一般的单脉冲攻击下的安全性下界。与BGS的安全性分析相比，我们的安全性分析可以满足任意距离的情形。

Abstract (English)
Upper bounds for the security of coherent-one-way (COW) quantum key distribution protocols have been analyzed by considering the one-pulse-attack [Branciard C, Gisin N and Scarani V (BGS) New J.Phys. (2008) 10 013031]. However, their security analysis was based on long distance case, and the typical value of the transmission distance is larger than 50km. Applying the sharp continuity for the von Neumann entropy and some basic inequalities, we provide lower bounds for the security of modified coherent-one-way quantum key distribution protocol against the most general one-pulse-attack by only considering photon number resolved detectors that will be used in the receiver's side. Comparing with BGS's security analysis, our security analysis can be satisfied with arbitrary distance case.

Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zheng-Fu Han, Wan-Su Bao, Guang-Can Guo
Optics Communications

10.1016/j.optcom.2010.09.081

2010 年4 篇

No. 01

用于被动诱骗态量子密钥分发的实用非泊松光源Practical non-Poissonian light source for passive decoy state quantum key distribution

利用法拉第镜构建出本征稳定的非泊松光源，并以 Hanbury Brown-Twiss 实验测得稳定的 g(2)(0)，结果与 Curty 等人的理论预言吻合，为被动诱骗态量子密钥分发提供了关键器件。

被动诱骗态量子密钥分发（QKD）在高速应用中具有巨大潜力。本工作利用法拉第镜实现了一种本征稳定的非泊松光源，它有望成为实现被动诱骗态 QKD 的关键元件。通过 Hanbury Brown-Twiss 实验获得了稳定的 g(2)(0)，所得结果与依据 Curty 等人理论 [Opt. Lett. 34, 3238 (2009)] 给出的理论值符合良好。

Abstract (English)
Passive decoy state quantum key distribution (QKD) has enormous potential in high-speed applications. In this Letter, an intrinsic-stable non-Poissonian light source was implemented with Faraday mirrors and could be a crucial element in realizing passive decoy state QKD. The stable g((2))(0) was obtained through a Hanbury Brown-Twiss experiment, and the results fit well with the theoretical value according to Curty et al.'s theory [Opt. Lett.34, 3238 (2009)].

Yang Zhang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Fang-Xing Xu, Xiao-Wei Wu, Chun-Hua Dong, Hong-Wei Li, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.35.003393

No. 02

节省波长的量子密钥分发网络现场试验Field test of wavelength-saving quantum key distribution network

提出基于无源光器件的省波长QKD网络拓扑，并在商用电信光纤上以20 MHz频率完成现场试验：两个波长支持五个节点，任意两节点可同时直接共享密钥，还表征了组网引入的插入损耗与串扰对点对点系统的影响。

我们提出一种基于无源光器件的节省波长的量子密钥分发（QKD）网络拓扑，并报道了该网络在商用电信光纤上以20 MHz频率进行的现场试验。在该网络中，两个波长支持五个节点，任意两个节点均可同时直接共享安全密钥。我们还表征了引入该QKD网络之后，插入损耗与串扰效应对点对点QKD系统的影响。

Abstract (English)
We propose a wavelength-saving topology of a quantum key distribution (QKD) network based on passive optical elements, and we report on the field test of this network on commercial telecom optical fiber at the frequency of 20 MHz. In this network, five nodes are supported with two wavelengths, and every two nodes can share secure keys directly at the same time. We also characterized the insertion loss and cross talk effects on the point-to-point QKD system after introducing this QKD network.

Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Yang Zhang, Tao Zhang, Hong-Wei Li, Fang-Xing Xu, Zheng Zhou, Yang Yang, Da-Jun Huang, Li-Jun Zhang, Fang-Yi Li, Dong Liu, Yong-Gang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 03

一种有限资源下诱骗态量子密钥分发安全性证明的简便方法A Simple Method for Security Proof of Decoy States QKD with Finite Resources

针对有限资源下的量子密钥分发提出一种比以往分析更简洁的安全性分析方法，数值模拟表明该分析在实际有限资源QKD实现中是合理的。

有限资源下实用量子密钥分发的安全性证明近年来受到广泛关注。本文对有限资源情形下的量子密钥分发给出了一种安全性分析，与以往有限资源情形下的安全性分析相比，我们的方法要简单得多；模拟结果表明，该安全性分析在有限资源的实际量子密钥分发实现中是合理的。

Abstract (English)
Security proof of practical quantum key distribution with finite resources has attracted a lot of attentions in recent years. We give a security analysis about finite resources QKD in this paper, our method is much simper comparing with previous security analysis in finite resources case,the simulation result shows that the security analysis is reasonable in practical QKD realizations with finite resources.

No. 01

有限资源下诱骗态量子密钥分发对抗集体攻击的安全性Security of decoy states QKD with finite resources against collective attacks

考虑不同脉冲源（信号源与诱骗源）中量子态的产额与误码率的统计涨落，分析有限资源下诱骗态量子密钥分发协议在集体攻击下的安全性，并结合实验结果给出交换量子信号数与正密钥生成率之间的关系。

在实际的量子密钥分发（QKD）协议中，传输的信号数总是有限的。本文通过考虑不同脉冲源（信号源和诱骗源）中量子态的产额和误码率的统计涨落，讨论了有限资源下诱骗态QKD协议的安全性。结合实验结果，给出了交换的量子信号数与正的密钥生成率之间的关系。

Abstract (English)
The number of transmitted signals in practical quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol is always finite. We discuss the security of decoy states QKD protocol with finite resources by considering the statistical fluctuation for the yield and error rate of the quantum state in different sources of pulses (signal sources and decoy sources). The number of exchanged quantum signals vs positive key generation rate is given with experiment results.

Hong-Wei Li, Yi-Bo Zhao, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Zheng-Fu Han, Wan-Su Bao, Guang-Can Guo
Optics Communications

10.1016/j.optcom.2009.07.011

No. 02

面向实际部署的分层城域量子密码网络外场实验Field experiment on a robust hierarchical metropolitan quantum cryptography network

基于市区商用电信光纤，用法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪装置搭建含七个用户的城域分层量子密码网络，集成量子路由器、光开关与可信中继，并在政府部门之间实现即时视频、声音、文本消息与机密文件的安全传输。

本文报道了一个架设在市区商用电信光纤上的分层城域量子密码网络。该七用户网络包含一个四节点骨干网（其中一个节点充当子网网关）、一个两用户子网以及一条单光纤接入链路，它们均由法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪装置实现。这里集成了量子路由器、光开关和可信中继等技术，以保证量子密码网络的可行性与可扩展性。网络中有五个节点位于政府部门，量子密钥分发网络所生成的密钥被用于加密这些部门之间传输的即时视频、声音、文本消息和机密文件。包括分层量子密码通信网络链路及相应应用软件在内的整体实现，标志着朝着具有高安全水平的实用用户导向网络迈出了一大步。

Abstract (English)
A hierarchical metropolitan quantum cryptography network upon the inner-city commercial telecom fiber cables is reported in this paper. The seven-user network contains a four-node backbone net with one node acting as the subnet gateway, a two-user subnet and a single-fiber access link, which is realized by the Faraday-Michelson interferometer set-ups. The techniques of the quantum router, optical switch and trusted relay are assembled here to guarantee the feasibility and expandability of the quantum cryptography network. Five nodes of the network are located in the government departments and the secure keys generated by the quantum key distribution network are utilized to encrypt the instant video, sound, text messages and confidential files transmitting between these bureaus. The whole implementation including the hierarchical quantum cryptographic communication network links and the corresponding application software shows a big step toward the practical user-oriented network with a high security level.

FangXing Xu, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, ZhenQiang Yin, Yang Zhang, Yun Liu, Zheng Zhou, YiBo Zhao, HongWei Li, Dong Liu, ZhengFu Han, GuangCan Guo

No. 03

考虑强度涨落的预告式单光子源诱骗态理论Decoy-state theory for the heralded single-photon source with intensity fluctuations

在存在强度涨落的情形下重新计算了采用预告式单光子源的诱骗态量子密钥分发安全密钥率，模拟表明该光源不仅传输距离上界高于弱相干光源，而且对强度涨落更稳健。

在存在强度涨落的情况下，重新计算了采用预告式单光子源（HSPS）的诱骗态量子密钥分发（QKD）的安全密钥率。通过数值模拟，我们表明HSPS是诱骗态QKD实验的一种良好光源，这不仅因为它比通常的弱相干光源（WCS）具有更大的传输距离上界，而且还因为它比WCS对强度涨落更为稳健。

Abstract (English)
The secure key rates of decoy-state quantum key distribution (QKD) using the heralded single-photon source (HSPS) are recalculated in the case of intensity fluctuations. By numerical simulations, we show that the HSPS is a good source for decoy-state QKD experiments not only because it has larger upper bound of transmission distance than the usual weak-coherent source (WCS) but also because it is more robust against intensity fluctuations than the WCS.

No. 01

基于后处理时域滤波的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution based on postprocessing time-domain filtering

提出无需额外硬件的时域后处理滤波方案，抑制宣布式单光子源中光子对频谱关联对 HOM 干涉可见度的损害，通过优化滤波器宽度同时提升密钥率与最大传输距离，并可推广至量子隐形传态等协议。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）消除了所有探测器端的漏洞。与弱相干脉冲相比，宣布式单光子源（HSPS）能够标示光子的存在，从而延长 MDI-QKD 的可达距离，并使被动诱骗态实现和量子存储辅助构型等先进协议成为可能。然而在实际中，HSPS 中光子对之间的频谱关联会降低 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉的可见度。尽管窄带滤波可以抑制这一效应，但它依赖专用硬件且缺乏灵活性。在此，我们提出一种基于时域后处理滤波技术的 MDI-QKD 方案，该方案不需要额外硬件，显著提高了密钥率和最大传输距离。通过优化滤波器宽度，该方法可以灵活适应光源或信道的变化。此外，它还可以方便地推广到其他依赖 HOM 干涉的协议，包括量子隐形传态和纠缠交换。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) eliminates all detector-side vulnerabilities. Compared to weak coherent pulses, heralded single-photon sources (HSPSs) signal the presence of photons, thereby extending the achievable distance of MDI-QKD and enabling advanced protocols such as passive decoy-state implementations and quantum-memory-assisted configurations. In practice, however, spectral correlations between photon pairs in HSPS degrade Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference visibility. Although narrowband filtering can suppress this effect, it relies on dedicated hardware and lacks flexibility. Here, we propose an MDI-QKD scheme based on a time-domain postprocessing filtering technique that requires no additional hardware, significantly improving both the key rate and the maximum transmission distance. By optimizing the filter width, this method flexibly adapts to variations in the source or channel. Furthermore, it can be readily extended to other protocols relying on HOM interference, including quantum teleportation and entanglement swapping.

Hao-Yu Chen, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

陈佳林Jia-Lin Chen2 篇

No. 01

直流至1 GHz门频可调的低噪声InGaAs/InP单光子探测器Low noise InGaAs/InP single-photon detector with DC to 1  GHz tunable gate frequency

提出残余噪声辅助的甄别方法，使雪崩信号最大幅度与残余噪声峰值对齐，实现从直流到1 GHz可调门频，20%效率下暗计数约每门5.0×10⁻⁷、后脉冲低于1.0%。

铟镓砷/磷化铟（InGaAs/InP）单光子探测器（SPD）通常工作在门控模式，但单光子雪崩二极管的电容响应会引入尖峰噪声，掩盖雪崩信号。大多数雪崩信号甄别方案无法完全消除尖峰噪声，从而留下残余噪声。受残余噪声限制，这些方案噪声较大且频率调节范围有限。然而，对于量子密钥分发和激光测距等应用而言，低噪声、频率可调的InGaAs/InP SPD对提升系统性能至关重要。在此，我们提出了一种（残余噪声辅助的）甄别方法，使雪崩信号的最大幅度与残余噪声的峰值对齐。该方法将残余噪声从不利因素转变为信号甄别的优势。利用该方法，我们实现了从直流到1 GHz的可调门控频率。此外，该方法能够甄别微弱雪崩信号，使得在低雪崩增益下也能有效进行单光子探测。在整个调谐范围内，在20%探测效率下，暗计数率约为每门5.0×10⁻⁷，后脉冲概率低于1.0%，显著低于以往的实验结果。所提出的SPD具有低噪声和宽可调门控频率范围，为各类应用提供了可靠基础。

Abstract (English)
An InGaAs/InP single-photon detector (SPD) typically operates in gated mode, but the capacitive response of a single-photon avalanche diode introduces spike noise, obscuring the avalanche signal. Most avalanche signal discrimination schemes cannot completely eliminate spike noise, resulting in residual noise. Limited by residual noise, these schemes have large noise and a limited frequency tuning range. However, for applications like quantum key distribution and laser ranging, a low noise, frequency-tunable InGaAs/InP SPD is crucial for enhancing system performance. Here, we propose a (residual noise assisted) discrimination method that aligns the maximum amplitude of the avalanche signal with the peak of the residual noise. This method turns the residual noise from adversity into an advantage for signal discrimination. With this method, we achieve tunable gating frequency from DC to 1 GHz. Additionally, this method enables the discrimination of weak avalanche signals, allowing effective single-photon detection at low avalanche gain. Across the entire tuning range, at a 20% detection efficiency, the dark count rate is approximately 5.0×10 −7 per gate, and the afterpulse probability is less than 1.0%, significantly lower than in previous experiments. The proposed SPD exhibits low noise and a wide tunable gating frequency range, providing a reliable foundation for various applications.

Jia-Lin Chen, De-Yong He, Shuang Wang, Ying-Liang Shi, Jia-Qi Geng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Photonics Research

10.1364/PRJ.539065

No. 02

用于高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发的稳定波长可调多波长激光器Stable and wavelength-tunable multiwavelength laser for high-rate measurement device independent quantum key distribution

研制出输出波长覆盖1270至1610 nm的稳定可调多波长激光器，通过精密温控与稳定驱动电流被动锁定波长，显著降低误码率，使安全密钥率较以往实验近乎翻倍。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）因其对测量单元攻击的免疫性而受到越来越多的关注，但其独特结构限制了安全密钥率。利用波分复用（WDM）技术并降低误码率是提高安全密钥率的有效策略。降低误码率通常需要利用精确的外部参考对波长进行主动反馈控制。然而，对于多波长激光器而言，采用多个参考来稳定每一路波长输出对参考提出了严苛要求，并显著增加了系统复杂度。本文展示了一台稳定的、波长可调的多波长激光器，输出波长范围覆盖1270至1610 nm。通过精确的温度控制和稳定的驱动电流，我们被动锁定激光波长，实现了优异的波长稳定性。这显著降低了误码率，使安全密钥率相较以往实验几乎翻倍。此外，我们的多波长激光器所提供的优异波长稳定性与WDM技术相结合，进一步提升了MDI QKD的安全密钥率。凭借5.1 nm的宽波长调谐范围，该多波长激光器可灵活工作在多个密集波分复用信道。结合高波长稳定性和多波长同时输出，该激光器为高速MDI QKD系统提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

Abstract (English)
Measurement device independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) has attracted growing attention for its immunity to attacks at the measurement unit, but its unique structure limits the secret key rate. Utilizing the wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) technique and reducing error rates are effective strategies for enhancing the secret key rate. Reducing error rates often requires active feedback control of wavelengths using precise external references. However, for a multiwavelength laser, employing multiple references to stabilize each wavelength output places stringent demands on these references and significantly increases system complexity. Here, we demonstrate a stable, wavelength-tunable multiwavelength laser with an output wavelength ranging from 1270 to 1610 nm. Through precise temperature control and stable drive current, we passively lock the laser wavelength, achieving remarkable wavelength stability. This significantly reduce the error rate, leading to an almost doubling of the secret key rate compared to previous experiments. Furthermore, the exceptional wavelength stability offered by our multiwavelength laser, combined with the WDM technique, has further boosted the secret key rate of MDI QKD. With a wide wavelength tuning range of 5.1 nm, our multiwavelength laser facilitates flexible operation across multiple dense wavelength division multiplexing channels. Coupled with high wavelength stability and multiple wavelength outputs simultaneously, this laser offers a promising solution for a high-rate MDI QKD system.

Jia-Lin Chen, De-Yong He, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Wen-Jing Ding, Jia-Qi Geng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Review of Scientific Instruments

No. 01

可见光波段非悬空铌酸锂波导中的前向布里渊散射Forward Brillouin scattering in non-suspended lithium niobate waveguides at visible wavelengths

在蓝宝石衬底薄膜铌酸锂平台上，用周期调制波导宽度实现准相位匹配，在0.36毫米长度内以仅5毫瓦声功率获得69.9%的模态间光转换效率。

蓝宝石上的薄膜铌酸锂提供了一个无需悬空结构即可同时限制声学模式和光学模式的优异平台，借助强压电耦合可实现高效声光调制。本文分析了在可见光波段实现前向布里渊相互作用所面临的挑战，并通过周期性波导宽度调制引入准相位匹配方案克服了这一限制。我们预测，仅使用5 mW声功率，在0.36 mm长度上即可实现69.9%的模态间光转换效率。我们的研究为集成平台上的高性能可见光波段声光器件开辟了道路。

Abstract (English)
Thin-film lithium niobate on sapphire provides an excellent platform for simultaneously confining acoustic and optical modes without suspended structures, enabling efficient acousto-optic modulation through strong piezoelectric coupling. Here, we identify the challenges in realizing the forward Brillouin interaction at visible wavelengths and overcome the limitation by introducing a quasi-phase-matching scheme through periodic waveguide width modulation. We predict a 69.9% inter-modal optical conversion efficiency over 0.36 mm using only 5 mW acoustic power. Our study paves the way for high-performance visible-wavelength acousto-optic devices on integrated platforms.

Jia-Lin Chen, Yuan-Hao Yang, Zheng-Xu Zhu, Jia-Qi Wang, Xin-Biao Xu, Ming Li, Zheng-Fu Han, Guang-Can Guo, Wei Chen, Chang-Ling Zou

No. 01

基于非对称光源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with asymmetric sources

提出非对称光源下MDI-QKD的性能分析理论，可处理单模与多时间模情形；以弱相干脉冲和自发参量下转换光源为例建模，发现密钥率在整个研究距离内并不因光源非对称而下降。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）消除了窃听者对测量方的所有攻击，一直被认为是实现端到端量子网络最有前景的技术之一。在实际中，光源与信道的非对称性通常是不可避免的。为此，我们提出一种理论，用于分析网络中任意两个MDI用户使用处于不同单模或多时间模的非对称光源进行通信时的性能。作为一个具体应用，我们对使用弱相干脉冲光源和自发参量下转换光源的MDI QKD进行建模并获得其密钥率，且将其与对称（即完全相同）光源情形下的性能进行比较。结果表明，实际性能并不会因光源的非对称性而下降；相反，在我们所研究的整个距离范围内，它都保持在良好水平。该工作为分析和优化具有非对称光源的MDI-QKD网络提供了理论基础，从而为完全非对称MDI-QKD网络的实际部署铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD), which eliminates all the attacks from the eavesdropper to the measurement party, has been one of the most promising technologies for the implementation of end-to-end quantum networks. In practice, the asymmetry of both sources and channels is generally inevitable. Therefore, we propose a theory to analyze the performance when any two MDI users in networks communicate using asymmetric sources in distinct single or multiple temporal modes. As a specific application, we model to obtain the key rate of MDI QKD with a weak-coherent pulse source and a spontaneous parametric down-conversion source, and compare the performance to the cases with symmetric (i.e., identical) sources. The result demonstrates that the actual performance does not degrade due to the asymmetry of sources. On the contrary, it maintains at a good level over the entire distance we study. This work provides a theoretical basis for analyzing and optimizing MDI-QKD networks with asymmetric sources, thus paving the way for the practical deployment of completely asymmetric MDI-QKD networks.

Jia-Ju Deng, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

基于弱相干态的相对论位置验证方案Relativistic position verification with coherent states

★Nat. Phys.

在信息论框架下提出并实验实现结合量子光学与相对论的安全位置验证协议，2 km 间距的两位验证者借助相位随机化弱相干态，以优于 75 m 的精度确认证明者位置。

一种确定实体位置的安全方法可以支撑基于位置的交易授权、高价值目标追踪等方案。然而在证明者不可信的情形下，经典方法无法提供安全的位置验证，这意味着证明者可以就其真实位置误导验证者。我们提出并在信息论框架内实验实现了一种将量子光学与相对论相结合的安全位置验证协议。利用相位随机化弱相干态，相距 2 km 的两位验证者以优于 75 m 的精度安全地验证了证明者的位置。这些结果使安全的位置基认证成为实际可能，为金融交易、灾害响应与可认证的安全通信等应用铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A secure approach to determining the position of an entity can enable schemes such as position-based authorization for transactions and tracking of high-value targets. However, classical methods are incapable of providing secure position verification in the untrusted-prover case, meaning that a prover can mislead verifiers about its actual position. Here we propose and experimentally realize a secure position verification protocol that combines quantum optics and relativity within an information-theoretic framework. Using phase-randomized weak coherent states, two verifiers separated by 2 km securely verify the prover’s position with an accuracy better than 75 m. These results establish secure position-based authentication as a practical possibility, paving the way for applications in financial transactions, disaster response and authenticated secure communications.

Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yang-Guang Shan, Cong Zhang, Yu-Long Wang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Wei-Xin Xie, De-Yong He, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Song-Nian Fu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

紧凑态制备与探测的高速量子密钥分发High-rate quantum key distribution with compact state preparation and detection

★PNAS

报道一套可部署的量子密钥分发系统，用双并联马赫–曾德尔编码器单步统一制备偏振态与诱骗态，配合 2.5 GHz 小型化单光子雪崩探测器，在 10 km 与 100 km 处分别实现 60.33 Mbps 与 3.08 Mbps 的安全成码率。

量子密钥分发（QKD）是实现信息论安全通信的一项有前景的技术。QKD 系统的实用性对大规模网络部署至关重要，既需要高密钥生成速率，也需要用于量子态制备与探测的小型化模块。在此我们报道了一套可部署的 QKD 系统，在 10 km 处实现 60.33 ± 0.03 Mbps、在 100 km 处实现 3.08 ± 0.20 Mbps 的安全密钥速率。该系统集成了一个双并联马赫–曾德尔编码器，在紧凑设计中通过单步调制实现对偏振态与诱骗态的高保真、统一制备。同时，我们研制了工作在 2.5 GHz 的小型化单光子雪崩探测器，在保持低噪声的同时实现了高计数率。这一高性能且紧凑的方案为需要高容量与高带宽的城市安全通信网络确立了一条可行的路线。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a promising technology for information-theoretic secure communications. The practicality of QKD systems is critical for large-scale network deployment, requiring both high key generation rate and miniaturized modules for quantum-state preparation and detection. Here, we report a deployable QKD system that achieves secure key rates of 60.33 ± 0.03 Mbps at 10 km and 3.08 ± 0.20 Mbps at 100 km. The system integrates a dual-parallel Mach–Zehnder encoder to achieve high-fidelity, unified preparation of polarization and decoy states via single-step modulation in a compact design. Meanwhile, we developed miniaturized single-photon avalanche detectors operating at 2.5 GHz, achieving high count rates while maintaining low noise. This high-performance and compact solution establishes a feasible roadmap for urban secure communication networks that require high capacity and bandwidth.

信任更多网络用户即可获得更安全的密钥More trust in networks, more secure keys

提出一种连续变量量子无源光网络方案：用户信任其他用户时，原本为消除与不可信用户之间的关联而丢弃的密钥可以被保留下来，从而提升自身密钥率，为网络性能优化提供新思路。

提出了一种新型连续变量量子无源光网络，其中用户可以通过信任其他用户来提高自己的密钥率。这是因为，原本为消除与不可信用户之间的关联而需要丢弃的密钥，在用户可信时可以保留下来。这为提升网络性能提供了新的视角。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A novel continuous-variable quantum passive optical network is proposed in which a user can increase their key rate by trusting other users. This is because the keys, which would be discarded to remove correlations with untrusted users, can be retained when the users are trusted. It provides a new perspective for enhancing network performance.

Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang
Light: Science & Applications

10.1038/s41377-024-01693-x

No. 04

无需可信节点的鲁棒自适应量子密钥分发网络Robust and adaptable quantum key distribution network without trusted nodes

★Optica

提出对量子态扰动鲁棒、支持多用户接入的测量设备无关量子密钥分发组网方案，用户无需校准参考系和补偿偏振即可同时生成密钥，N 用户网络的扰动补偿成本由 O(N) 降至 O(1)。

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络有望为大量用户提供信息论安全的通信。在 QKD 网络中，被称为测量设备无关（MDI）QKD 的检测安全协议通过支持不可信测量节点，能够自然地增强现实安全性。然而，环境对量子态的扰动会降低多用户通信的性能。我们提出一种 MDI-QKD 组网方案，它对环境扰动具有鲁棒性，并对多用户接入具有适应性：两个以上的用户无需校准参考系，也无需补偿信道的偏振扰动，即可同时生成密钥。为实现这一点，我们引入参考系无关协议以及免偏振补偿方法，设计了多用户测量单元，并将其与原有的双用户单元相结合。该方案在多用户场景中实验演示了网络鲁棒性与适应性的提升；对于 N 用户网络，扰动补偿所需的时间与器件成本可从 O(N) 降至 O(1)。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks are promising to serve large numbers of users with information-theoretic secure communication. In QKD networks, the detection-safe protocol, termed measurement-device-independent (MDI) QKD, can naturally enhance realistic security by supporting untrusted measurement nodes. However, the environmental disturbances to quantum states degrade the performance of multi-user communication. Here we propose an MDI-QKD networking scheme with robustness against environmental disturbance and adaptability to multi-user access, where more than two users can generate keys simultaneously regardless of aligning reference frames and compensating channel disturbance on polarization. To achieve this, we introduce the reference-frame-independent protocol as well as a polarization-compensation-free method, design a multi-user measurement unit, and combine it with original two-user units. The scheme is experimentally demonstrated for the improvement of network robustness and adaptability in multi-user scenarios, and the time and device costs of disturbance compensation can be saved from O ( N ) to O ( 1 ) for an N-user network.

Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Zheng Zhou, Ze-Hao Wang, Jun Teng, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

面向非独立组网网络的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution for nonstandalone networks

提出借鉴5G非独立组网的NSA-MDI方案，使现有各类相位编码BB84网络与终端无需更换硬件即可升级支持测量设备无关量子密钥分发，兼顾安全与带宽需求并提升网络生存性。

最初由测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议实现的不受信节点网络，是通往量子互联网路线图中的关键一步。考虑到可信节点网络已大量部署QKD，需要明确一条将现有网络升级为MDI网络的可行路线。参照5G的非独立组网（NSA）架构，这里提出NSA-MDI方案，作为现有相位编码BB84网络的演进选择。该方案可在不改变硬件的情况下，将采用各种相位编码方案的BB84网络和终端立即升级为支持MDI。这种高性价比的升级在充分利用现有网络的同时，有效推动了作为不受信节点网络一步的MDI网络部署。此外，它还满足了差异化的安全与带宽需求，并提高了网络生存性。

Abstract (English)
Untrusted node networks initially implemented by measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol are a crucial step on the roadmap of the quantum Internet. Considering extensive QKD implementations of trusted node networks, a workable upgrading tactic of existing networks toward MDI networks needs to be explicit. Here, referring to the nonstandalone (NSA) network of 5G, we propose an NSA-MDI scheme as an evolutionary selection for existing phase-encoding BB84 networks. Our solution can upgrade the BB84 networks and terminals that employ various phase-encoding schemes to immediately support MDI without hardware changes. This cost-effective upgrade effectively promotes the deployment of MDI networks as a step of untrusted node networks while taking full advantage of existing networks. In addition, the diversified demands on security and bandwidth are satisfied, and network survivability is improved.

面向实用量子密钥分发系统的诱骗态协议优化Optimizing Decoy‐State Protocols for Practical Quantum Key Distribution Systems

系统梳理诱骗态方法在方案设计、有限尺寸分析与参数估计等方面的进展，用粒子群优化算法在五种系统参数变化下比较 38 种协议的密钥率，给出不同场景下最优协议的选择指南。

诱骗态协议使量子密钥分发（QKD）系统无需使用单光子源即可获得高性能。在诱骗态协议提出后的十余年里，方案设计、有限尺寸分析、系统建模和参数估计等方面取得了一系列进展。遗憾的是，这些进展大多基于不同的出发点，缺乏综合比较以找出诱骗态方法的最优协议。本文回顾了诱骗态方法的各项进展，并对其进行综合，利用粒子群优化（PSO）算法比较了 38 种诱骗态协议的密钥率性能。为给实用 QKD 系统提供指导，我们在五个系统参数（传输损耗、后处理块大小、失准误差概率、暗计数概率和后脉冲率）变化的情况下找出了最优诱骗态协议。期望本工作能够回答不同诱骗态协议在各种场景下的实际性能如何，以及对于各类 QKD 系统哪种诱骗态协议是最优选择的问题。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The decoy‐state protocol enables quantum key distribution (QKD) systems to achieve high performance without using the single‐photon source. In the dozen years since the decoy‐state protocol has been proposed, a series of advances in scheme design, finite‐size analysis, system modelling, and parameter estimation has developed. Unfortunately, most advances are based on different starting points and lack a synthesis to figure out the optimal protocol of decoy‐state method. Here, the advances in decoy‐state method are reviewed and they are synthesized to compare the key‐rate performance of 38 decoy‐state protocols using the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. To form a guideline for practical QKD systems, the optimal decoy‐state protocols are found with the change of five system parameters (the transmission loss, the block size of postprocessing, the misalignment‐error probability, the dark‐count probability, and the afterpulse rate). It is expected that this work can answer the questions of what the actual performance is for different decoy‐state protocol in various scenarios and which decoy‐state protocol is the optimal choice for various QKD systems.

量子密钥分发系统的通用仿真框架A universal simulating framework for quantum key distribution systems

建立了基于量子算符描述与事件驱动机制的通用 QKD 系统仿真框架，光学器件可自由组合并计入器件缺陷与量子非局域特性，单光子与 HOM 干涉仿真结果与理论吻合。

量子密钥分发（QKD）提供了一种基于物理原理的方式，使远程用户能够安全地协商密钥。仿真是设计和优化 QKD 系统的重要手段。我们基于光子信号与光学器件的量子算符描述，开发了一个通用仿真框架。光学器件可以自由组合，并由光子激发事件驱动，这使其原则上适用于任意 QKD 系统。我们的框架关注光学器件与系统结构的真实特性，在建模时考虑了器件的不完美性以及量子系统的非局域性质。我们仿真了单光子和 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉光学单元，它们是 QKD 系统的基础。使用这一事件驱动框架得到的结果与理论结果吻合良好，表明其用于 QKD 的可行性。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides a physical-based way to conciliate keys between remote users securely. Simulation is an essential method for designing and optimizing QKD systems. We develop a universal simulation framework based on quantum operator descriptions of photon signals and optical devices. The optical devices can be freely combined and driven by the photon excitation events, which make it appropriate for arbitrary QKD systems in principle. Our framework focuses on realistic characters of optical devices and system structures. The imperfections of the devices and the non-local properties of a quantum system are taken into account when modeling. We simulate the single-photon and Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference optical units, which are fundamental of QKD systems. The results using this event-driven framework agree well with the theoretical results, which indicate its feasibility for QKD.

把单光子雪崩二极管的探测效率、暗计数概率与后脉冲率纳入参数优化，通过调节电压与温度提升动态量子密钥分发网络的安全密钥率及其对信道变化与不对称性的适应能力。

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络可以在众多远程用户之间提供无条件安全的通信。在实际 QKD 网络中，随着节点的动态接入与退出，各用户链路的品质以及不同用户之间的链路长度（例如传输损耗）各不相同并且不断变化。针对各种信道环境进行定制化优化能够带来网络性能收益。在本文中，我们将单光子雪崩光电二极管（SPAD）的探测效率、暗计数概率和后脉冲率纳入参数优化，通过控制其电压和温度来优化动态 QKD 网络中的安全密钥率。结果表明，我们的方法提高了网络对信道变化与不对称性的适应能力，并且有利于在复杂信道环境中建立 QKD 网络。该方法适用于任意基于 SPAD 的 QKD 系统与网络架构。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks can provide unconditional secure communications among many remote users. In real QKD networks, with the dynamic access and quit of nodes, qualities of various user links and the link lengths among different users, such as transmission loss, are different and changing. Customized optimization that aims at various channel environments offers a network performance benefit. In this paper, we propose including the detection efficiency, dark-count probability, and afterpulse rate of the single-photon avalanche photodiode (SPAD) into the parameter optimization by controlling its voltage and temperature to optimize the secure key rates in dynamic QKD networks. The result shows that our method improves the network adaptability to the variation and asymmetry of channel and profits the establishment of QKD networks in a complex channel environment. This method is suitable for arbitrary SPAD-based QKD system and network architecture.

针对对准误差理论模型仅描述单光子行为、与弱相干光源不相容的问题，引入可在实际系统中便捷测得的泄漏光比，构建了包含多光子脉冲传输并能精确刻画双击事件的模型，缩小了理论与实际系统的差距。

在光学量子密码中，对准误差是量子密钥分发（QKD）安全密钥生成中的重要因素，也是错误事件的根源之一。然而，理论建模通常只反映单光子的行为，与弱相干光源不相容。本研究通过定义在实际QKD系统中可以方便获得的泄漏光比，建立了一个更贴近实际的模型，将多光子脉冲的传输纳入失准误差分析。此外，双击事件可以被精确描述，从而缩小了模型与实际系统之间的差距。

Abstract (English)
In optical quantum cryptography, alignment error is important in secure key generation for quantum key distribution (QKD), being one of the roots of error events. However, theoretical modeling typically only reflects the behavior of a single photon, which is incompatible with a weak coherent source. This study develops a realistic model to include the propagation of multiphoton pulses in the misalignment-error analysis by defining the $l\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}e\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}k\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}g\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}e$ $l\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}i\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}g\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}h\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}t$ $r\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}t\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}i\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}o$, which can be obtained conveniently in practical QKD systems. In addition, double-click events can be depicted precisely, and thus the gap between the model and real systems is narrowed.

面向量子密钥分发的后脉冲效应分析Afterpulse Analysis for Quantum Key Distribution

针对高速量子密钥分发中后脉冲引入额外误码、使系统严重偏离传统解析模型的问题，利用后脉冲的非马尔可夫性质建立了新的分析模型，显著提升了优化后的密钥率与实际系统对后脉冲的容忍度。

在光学量子密码中，后脉冲效应对量子密钥分发（QKD）的安全密钥生成十分重要，因为它会引入额外误码，并使系统严重偏离传统的解析模型，对高速系统尤为如此。本研究利用后脉冲的非马尔可夫性质，建立了一种不同的解析模型，使QKD系统能更好地与后脉冲相兼容。由此得到的优化密钥率大幅提高，因此在实际QKD系统中，用于安全通信的后脉冲容忍度可显著改善。

Abstract (English)
In optical quantum cryptography, the afterpulse effect is important for secure key generation in quantum key distribution (QKD), because it introduces additional error and leads to great deviation from the traditional analytical model, especially for high-speed systems. This study develops a different analytical model to make QKD systems more afterpulse-compatible, by exploiting the non-Markovian nature of the afterpulse. The optimized key rate obtained here is much higher, and thus the tolerance of the afterpulse effect can be significantly improved in practical QKD systems for secure communication.

2.5 GHz 门控 InGaAs/InP 单光子雪崩二极管实现 44 ps 时间抖动2.5 GHz Gated InGaAs/InP Single-Photon Avalanche Diode with 44 ps Time Jitter

针对高频门控下时间抖动与后脉冲相互制约的难题，指出滤波器失真与信号幅度变化是抖动主因，用专门设计的低通滤波器配合过零鉴别器，在 21% 探测效率下把时间抖动压到 44 ps、后脉冲概率降至 1.4%。

门控单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）是量子密钥分发（QKD）应用中的实用方案。然而，当 SPAD 工作在高于 2 GHz 的频率时，门控频率受到时间抖动和后脉冲概率的限制。我们发现，滤波器失真与信号幅度变化是高频场景下时间抖动的主要机制，并设计了特定的低通滤波器（LPF）和过零鉴别器来有效降低时间抖动。具体而言，LPF 提取雪崩信号并借助其冲激响应形成精确的过零点，过零鉴别器则正确鉴别雪崩信号以实现低时间抖动。当 SPAD 在 2.5 GHz 门控频率、21% 探测效率下工作时，时间抖动与后脉冲概率分别为 44 ps 和 1.4%。我们的结果为更高时钟率的实用 QKD 系统铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Gated single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are practical solutions for quantum key distribution (QKD) applications. However, the gating frequency is limited by time jitter and afterpulse probability when SPADs operate at a frequency higher than 2 GHz. We find that filter distortion and variation of signal amplitude are the dominant mechanisms for time jitter in high-frequency scenarios, and design a specific low-pass filter (LPF) and a zero crossing discriminator to reduce the time jitter effectively. Specifically, the LPF extracts avalanche signals and forms accurate zero crossing points by its impulse response, and the zero crossing discriminator correctly discriminates avalanche signals to achieve low time jitter. When the SPAD is operated at a gating frequency of 2.5 GHz with a detection efficiency of 21%, the time jitter and afterpulse probability are 44 ps and 1.4%, respectively. Our results pave the way to practical QKD systems at higher clock rates.

指出正弦波门控单光子探测器的额外后脉冲主要源于连续雪崩信号与电滤波器畸变，并以去除较宽滤波后雪崩信号的方法将其压低，在1 GHz门控下后脉冲概率最低达0.54%。

正弦波门控方法被广泛用于高速单光子探测（SPD），但与自差分技术相比，它表现出额外的后脉冲概率。在此，我们证明正弦波门控SPD的大部分额外后脉冲来自连续的雪崩信号以及电滤波器的畸变，并提出了一种通过去除较宽的滤波后雪崩信号来降低后脉冲概率的有效方法。在1 GHz门控频率下，当光子探测效率为20.7%和10.9%时，测得的后脉冲概率分别低至1.0%和0.54%。

Abstract (English)
Sine-wave gating method is widely used in high-speed single photon detection (SPD) but shows extra afterpulse probability compared with the self-differencing technique. Here, we demonstrate that most extra afterpulses of the sine-wave gating SPD come from successive avalanche signals and distortion of electrical filters and also propose an effective method by removing the wider filtered avalanche signals to reduce the afterpulse probability. At 1 GHz gating frequency, the ultralow afterpulse probability is characterized as 1.0% and 0.54% for a photon detection efficiency of 20.7% and 10.9%, respectively.

测量设备无关量子密钥分发中的光源时间不完美性Source temporal imperfections in measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

针对测量设备无关量子密钥分发中时间抖动、脉冲形状不完美与脉冲间干涉三类光源时间缺陷，建立按时间单元离散计算的定量刻画方案，并对四强度协议系统仿真优化参数，提升了密钥率。

在高速量子密钥分发系统中，重复频率是限制系统效率的关键因素。在基于双光子干涉的测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议的实现中，固有的时间不完美性会显著影响系统的重复频率。我们针对时间抖动、脉冲形状不完美和脉冲间干涉这三种时间不完美性建立了一套系统性的方案。通过将时间离散为时间单元并计算每个单元内的干涉，我们定量刻画了时间失配对双光子干涉的影响。利用该方案，我们仿真了一个基于四强度协议的具体实验系统，并通过参数优化获得了更高的密钥率。该方法由此为在高性能系统的实验实现中提升效率提供了一条具体路径。

Abstract (English)
In high-speed quantum key distribution systems, the repetition rate is a critical factor limiting system efficiency. In the implementation of the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution protocol based on two-photon interference, inherent temporal imperfections can significantly impact the system's repetition rate. We establish a systematic scheme for three temporal imperfections: time jitter, pulse shape imperfection, and interpulse interference. By discretizing time into time units and calculating the interference within each, we quantitatively characterize how temporal misalignment affects two-photon interference. Using this scheme, we simulate a specific experimental system based on the four-intensity protocol, and through parameter optimization, achieve a higher key rate. The approach thus offers a concrete pathway for enhancing the efficiency in the experimental realization of high-performance systems.

用于量子操控的厚氮化硅宽带偏振不敏感马赫-曾德尔干涉仪Broadband polarization-insensitive Mach–Zehnder interferometer for quantum manipulation based on thick silicon nitride

在650 nm厚氮化硅平台上设计并制备偏振不敏感马赫-曾德尔干涉仪，采用粒子群优化的多模干涉器与分段变宽波导补偿材料双折射，主动偏振扰动下单光子干涉可见度仍约98.7%，偏振相关损耗低于0.3 dB、1 dB带宽达147 nm。

偏振不敏感光子器件对于抑制光子在传输过程中随机偏振演化带来的不利影响、实现鲁棒的光量子操控至关重要。本工作在设计并演示了氮化物平台上厚度为650 nm的偏振不敏感马赫-曾德尔干涉仪（MZI）。器件设计中采用了经粒子群优化的多模干涉器，其边缘形状经过剪裁并引入亚波长光栅结构，同时在干涉仪两臂中采用分段变宽波导设计，以补偿其固有的材料双折射。所制备MZI的实验结果表明，即使在主动偏振扰动下，单光子干涉可见度仍保持约98.7%，并且在147 nm的1 dB带宽范围内实现了小于0.3 dB的偏振相关损耗。这些特性使其成为量子密钥分发等集成量子光子系统的理想候选器件。

Abstract (English)
Polarization-insensitive photonic devices are essential for mitigating the adverse effects of random polarization evolution during photon transmission and implementing robust quantum manipulation of light. In this work, we design and demonstrate a polarization-insensitive Mach–Zehnder interferometer (MZI) on a nitride platform with the thickness of 650 nm. We design the device by adopting a particle-swarm-optimized multimode interferometer with tailored edge shapes and sub-wavelength grating structures, combined with a segmented width-varied waveguide design in the interferometer arms to compensate for their intrinsic material birefringences. The experimental results of the fabricated MZI maintain a single-photon interference visibility about 98.7% even under active polarization scrambling, while a polarization-dependent loss &lt; 0.3 dB over a 147 nm 1 dB bandwidth has been achieved. These properties make it a promising component for integrated quantum photonic systems such as quantum key distribution.

时间编码量子密钥分发系统的真实探测器模型Realistic detector model for a time-bin-encoding quantum key distribution system

建立了时间编码量子密钥分发系统中探测器的真实响应模型，可准确预测增益、刻画早晚时间格之间的相关性，并据此获得更高的安全密钥率。

鉴于单光子雪崩探测器日益广泛的应用，后脉冲的存在使死时间不可避免。死时间是影响量子密钥分发（QKD）计数率与安全密钥率（SKR）的关键因素。这一问题在时间编码系统中尤为突出，而此前的模型无法准确估计增益。值得注意的是，它引入了早时间格与晚时间格之间的相关性，从而产生强相关比特并带来安全风险。在此，我们提出了一个能够精确刻画时间编码系统中探测器响应的真实模型。该模型不仅提高了增益预测的准确性，与蒙特卡罗模拟结果吻合良好，还为数据处理提供了理论支撑，有助于缓解安全风险。最后，借助我们的模型，我们可以获得远高于先前模型的安全密钥率，并通过调节探测器参数进一步提升实际QKD系统的性能。我们的模拟结果表明，该模型对于QKD系统在实践中的应用与部署至关重要。

Abstract (English)
In light of the growing widely utilized single-photon avalanche detectors, dead time is inevitable due to the presence of afterpulse. Dead time is a critical factor that influences the count rate and the secret key rate (SKR) of quantum key distribution (QKD). It is particularly significant in time-bin-encoding systems, while prior models fail to accurately estimate the gains. Of note, it introduces correlations between early bins and late bins, hence bits with strong correlation and security risks. Here, we put forward a realistic model that precisely characterizes the response of detectors for time-bin-encoding systems. Our model not only improves the accuracy of gain predictions, showing an excellent match with the Monte Carlo simulation results, but also provides theoretical support for data processing, helping to mitigate security risks. Finally, leveraging our model, we can get a much higher SKR than prior models and further enhance the performance of practical QKD systems by adjusting the detector parameters. Our simulation results demonstrate that our model is essential for the application and deployment of QKD systems in practice.

Xiao-Juan Huang, Ze-Hao Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Jiaqi Geng, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yu Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

No. 02

高性能量子密钥分发系统中的探测响应依赖模型Dependency model for high-performance quantum-key-distribution systems

针对单光子雪崩二极管死时间与后脉冲导致增益估计有偏的问题，建立探测器响应依赖模型，可更准确地优化参数并指导死时间选取，仿真表明其对系统实用部署具有重要作用。

精确估计探测响应对于高性能且安全的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统至关重要。单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）被广泛用于估计单光子产额。然而，在SPAD存在死时间和后脉冲的情况下，以往模型对增益的估计存在偏差，这将导致优化参数拟合不佳，并大幅降低系统性能。这里，我们建立了一个依赖性模型，可提供更精确的优化，从而实现更高性能的QKD系统。此外，为进一步提升系统性能，我们的模型可指导用户选择合适的死时间。仿真结果表明，该模型在QKD系统的实际应用与部署中发挥着重要作用。

Abstract (English)
A precise estimation of the detection response is essential for a high-performance and secure quantum-key-distribution (QKD) system. Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are widely applied to estimate the single-photon yields. However, in the presence of the dead time and afterpulse of the SPADs, the estimations of gains in previous models are biased, which will lead to ill-fitting optimized parameters and greatly degrade the system performance. Here, we develop a dependency model for providing more accurate optimization to achieve higher-performance QKD systems. Moreover, to further improve the system performance, our model guides users to choose proper dead time. Our simulation results indicate that our model plays an important role in the practical application and deployment of QKD systems.

Xiao-Juan Huang, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Ze-Hao Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.106.062607

黄钲凯Zheng-Kai Huang1 篇

No. 01

基于量子比特的测量设备无关量子密钥分发同步算法Qubit-Based Synchronization Algorithm for Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution

利用 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉特性，在没有额外硬件的情况下实现 MDI-QKD 各方之间的时钟同步，显著降低同步复杂度与成本，有望加速其实际部署。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）因其高性能与安全性被认为是最有前景的协议之一。要在实际中搭建 MDI-QKD 系统，时钟同步是正确生成密钥的关键步骤。然而，随着实际应用的推进，同步的复杂度与成本已成为 MDI-QKD 实施中的重大挑战。本研究提出一种专为 MDI-QKD 设计的基于量子比特的同步算法。利用 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉的特性，我们在无需额外硬件的情况下实现了 MDI-QKD 各方之间的时钟同步。该方法的经济性与简洁性有望显著促进 MDI-QKD 的实际部署。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is considered one of the most promising protocols due to its high performance and security. To implement the MDI-QKD system in practice, clock synchronization is a crucial step to correctly generate the secret keys. However, as practical applications advance, the complexity and cost of synchronization have become significant challenges for the implementation of MDI-QKD. In this study, we introduce a qubit-based synchronization algorithm specifically designed for MDI-QKD. By utilizing the property of Hong-Ou-Mandel interference, we achieve clock synchronization between parties of MDI-QKD without the need for additional hardware. The cost-effectiveness and simplicity of this approach are expected to significantly facilitate the practical deployment of MDI-QKD.

Zheng-Kai Huang, Jia-Xuan Li, Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

通过定制致盲脉冲攻击高速量子密钥分发系统Hacking high-speed quantum-key-distribution systems by tailoring the blinding pulse

通过定制致盲脉冲并调整其与门信号的时间偏移，改进了针对高速正弦门控单光子探测器的致盲攻击，短距离下引入的附加误码率低于0.5%，并提出三种实用防御对策。

目前，量子密钥分发（QKD）系统正朝着高速实现的方向发展，以满足大规模数据加密的需求。高性能的高速门控单光子探测器（SPD）是实现此类系统的关键。然而，这些探测器的实际安全性仍然是一个关键问题。最近有报道称，一种针对高速正弦门控 SPD 的攻击通过欺骗宽度鉴别机制使探测器致盲。受这项工作启发，我们通过定制致盲脉冲并改变致盲脉冲与门信号之间的时间偏移，进一步优化了攻击策略，从而实现了更有效的攻击。实验与仿真结果表明，在短距离通信场景下，我们提出的攻击策略所引入的附加量子比特误码率（QBER）低于 0.5%。值得注意的是，我们提出并评估了三种实用对策来防御此类攻击，包括辅助的传统鉴别监测、雪崩电流监测以及探测事件的时间分布分析。这些防御策略增强了高速 SPD 的鲁棒性，并有助于开发更安全、更可靠的 QKD 系统。

Abstract (English)
Currently, quantum-key-distribution (QKD) systems are evolving toward high-speed implementations to meet the demands of large-scale data encryption. High-performance, high-speed gated single-photon detectors (SPDs) are essential for enabling such systems. However, the practical security of these detectors remains a critical concern. Recently, an attack targeting high-speed sine-gated SPDs was reported, in which the detector was blinded by deceiving the width discrimination mechanism. Inspired by this work, we further optimize the attack strategy by customizing the blinding pulse and modifying the temporal offset between the blinding pulse and the gate signal, thereby achieving a more effective attack. Experimental and simulation results show that in short-distance communication scenarios, the additional quantum bit error rate (QBER) introduced by our proposed attack strategy is less than 0.5%. Of note, we propose and evaluate three practical countermeasures to defend against such attacks, which include auxiliary conventional discrimination monitoring, avalanche current monitoring, and temporal distribution analysis of detection events. These defense strategies enhance the robustness of high-speed SPDs and contribute to the development of more secure and reliable QKD systems.

Xiang Kang, Jia-Lin Chen, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

飞秒脉冲注入硅光调制器对量子密钥分发安全性的影响Effect of femtosecond-pulse-injection silicon photonic modulators on the security of quantum key distribution

首次揭示硅光强度调制器中的双光子吸收会给窃听者留下可乘之机：实验上通过外部注入飞秒脉冲改变诱骗态强度，使合法方按安全证明预估的密钥率被高估，为集成QKD系统的设计与标准化提供安全性考量。

集成光子学在量子通信器件中发挥着关键作用，具有出色的鲁棒性、可扩展性和性能。硅光子学技术的日益成熟为量子密钥分发（QKD）的小型化和低成本实现提供了巨大潜力。虽然铌酸锂调制器在QKD系统中的实际安全性已被广泛研究，但硅光调制器采用了新的调制机制，因而有必要深入研究其对QKD系统安全性的影响。我们首次揭示，硅光强度调制器中的双光子吸收效应会引入漏洞，使窃听者（Eve）能够对QKD系统实施恶意攻击。通过实验演示，我们表明，借助外部注入飞秒脉冲，Eve可以操控合法用户发送的诱骗态的强度。基于实验结果，我们发现，在存在该攻击的情况下，合法用户会持续高估安全证明所预测的密钥率。我们的工作是对集成QKD系统设计与标准化的一个新安全性层面的初步探索。

Abstract (English)
Integrated photonics plays a pivotal role in quantum communication devices, offering exceptional robustness, scalability, and performance. The growing maturity of silicon photonics technology offers significant potential for miniaturization and cost-effective implementation of quantum key distribution (QKD). While the practical security of lithium niobate modulators in QKD systems has been extensively examined, the adoption of a new modulation mechanism by silicon photonic modulators necessitates a thorough investigation into their impact on the security of QKD systems. For the first time, we reveal that the two-photon absorption effect in silicon photonic intensity modulators will introduce vulnerabilities, enabling an eavesdropper (Eve) to execute malicious attacks on QKD systems. Through experimental demonstration, we show that by externally injecting femtosecond pulses, Eve can manipulate the intensities of decoy states sent by legitimate users. Based on the experimental results, we find that in the presence of the attack, legitimate users consistently overestimate the secret key rate predicted by the security proof. Our work represents an initial exploration into a new security aspect for the design and standardization of integrated QKD systems.

Xiang Kang, Peng Ye, Shuang Wang, Guo-Wei Zhang, Ze-Hao Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

No. 03

安全诱骗态量子密钥分发的图样效应标定算法Patterning-Effect Calibration Algorithm for Secure Decoy-State Quantum Key Distribution

针对实际诱骗态量子密钥分发中强度关联涨落引起的图样效应，把研究拓展到关联范围更大的高阶情形，提出通过标定驱动电压来抑制该效应的算法，并在实验上观测到高阶图样效应且成功将其压制。

量子密钥分发（QKD）中的诱骗态方法是抵御致命的光子数分离攻击的有力对策。目前，诱骗态方法已被广泛应用于实际QKD系统。然而，图样效应，即实际QKD系统中强度涨落之间的关联，违背了诱骗态方法的重要假设，严重威胁协议的安全性。此前的工作研究了相邻脉冲之间的图样效应，并从后选择和调制器两个层面提出了应对措施。本工作研究关联范围更大的图样效应，并提出一种通过标定驱动电压来抑制图样效应的算法。按照我们的方法，实验上观测到了高阶图样效应，并利用所提出的标定算法成功将其抑制。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效提升了协议安全性，有望在实际诱骗态QKD系统中得到广泛应用。

Abstract (English)
The decoy-state method for the quantum key distribution (QKD) is a great countermeasure against the fatal photon number splitting attack. At present, the decoy-state method has been widely employed in practical QKD systems. However, the patterning effect, namely the correlated intensity fluctuations in practical QKD systems, violates the important assumption of the decoy-state method and seriously threatens the protocol security. The previous works investigated the patterning effect between the adjacent pulses and proposed the countermeasures from the degree of post selection and modulators. In this work, we investigate the patterning effect with larger correlation range and present an algorithm to calibrate the driving voltages to mitigate the patterning effect. According to our methods, we experimentally observe the higher-order patterning effect and successfully mitigate it by our calibration algorithm. The experiment results indicate that our methods efficiently improve the protocol security and are expected to be widely employed in practical decoy-state QKD systems.

Xiang Kang, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Ze-Hao Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Journal of Lightwave Technology

No. 01

强噪声环境下的高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发High-Rate Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution under Intense Noise

★Phys. Rev. Lett.

报道重复频率达2.5 GHz的高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发系统，结合优势蒸馏方法，在425 kHz噪声计数（比隔离环境高4个数量级）下仍能生成安全密钥，30 dB信道衰减时密钥率达到kbps量级，且无需庞大探测装置。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）是通向实用化量子通信的一条有前景的途径，但目前的高性能演示实验往往代价高昂且只能在隔离环境中实现。本文提出一套高速MDI-QKD系统，其重复频率达到前所未有的2.5 GHz，并通过引入优势蒸馏方法验证了其强大的抗噪声能力。该系统在425 kHz噪声计数下仍能高效生成安全密钥，这一噪声水平比隔离系统高4个数量级。在30 dB信道衰减下，无需庞大且资源密集的探测装置即可获得kbps量级的安全密钥率。本工作为QKD的部署确立了一套完整的实用化方案，并解决了长期以来难以实现的难题——构建兼具高安全性、高密钥率、环境鲁棒性和物理紧凑性的实用量子安全网络。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is a promising path toward practical quantum communication, but current high-performance demonstrations come at prohibitive overhead and isolated environments. Here, we present a high-speed MDI-QKD system operating at an unprecedented repetition frequency of 2.5 GHz and verify its strong noise tolerance by incorporating the advantage distillation method. The secure key is efficiently generated under 425 kHz noise counts, which is 4 orders of magnitude higher than isolated systems. A secure key rate with a kbps level is achieved under 30 dB channel attenuation without bulky, resource-intensive detection devices. Our Letter establishes a complete practical solution for QKD deployment and resolves the persistent difficulty of realizing practical quantum secure networks with advanced security, a high key rate, environmental robustness, and physical compactness.

Hong-Wei Li, Wei-Xin Xie, Chun-Mei Zhang, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yu-Long Wang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Letters

No. 02

随机性决定 BB84 量子密钥分发的实际安全性Randomness determines practical security of BB84 quantum key distribution

把利用不完美器件的实际攻击统一归为木马攻击、强随机性攻击与弱随机性攻击三类，并证明 BB84 协议在随机性攻击模型下仍然安全，为实际系统给出通用的安全性分析框架。

BB84 量子密钥分发协议的无条件安全性已被利用量子力学基本定律加以证明，但实际的量子密钥分发系统若分别考虑不完美的态制备与不完美的测量，则可能被攻破。迄今为止，人们已提出多种利用不完美器件的攻击方案，但针对所有这些实际攻击方案的通用安全分析模型尚未建立。在此，我们证明实际的通用攻击方案可分别划分为木马攻击、强随机性攻击和弱随机性攻击三类。我们证明了 BB84 协议在随机性攻击模型下的安全性，这些结果可用于保障实际量子密钥分发系统的安全。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Unconditional security of the BB84 quantum key distribution protocol has been proved by exploiting the fundamental laws of quantum mechanics, but the practical quantum key distribution system maybe hacked by considering the imperfect state preparation and measurement respectively. Until now, different attacking schemes have been proposed by utilizing imperfect devices, but the general security analysis model against all of the practical attacking schemes has not been proposed. Here, we demonstrate that the general practical attacking schemes can be divided into the Trojan horse attack, strong randomness attack and weak randomness attack respectively. We prove security of BB84 protocol under randomness attacking models and these results can be applied to guarantee the security of the practical quantum key distribution system.

Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Yong-Jun Qian, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Scientific Reports

10.1038/srep16200

No. 03

基于量子维数和独立器件的量子密钥分发Quantum key distribution based on quantum dimension and independent devices

提出仅用二维希尔伯特空间编码量子态、且态制备与测量设备相互独立的QKD协议，既弱化了原始MDI-QKD的态制备假设，又能克服限制FDI-QKD应用的探测漏洞问题，可用实际光学元件实现。

本文提出一种量子密钥分发（QKD）协议，它仅基于编码量子系统的二维希尔伯特空间，并要求态制备设备与测量设备相互独立。我们的协议受到完全设备无关量子密钥分发（FDI-QKD）协议和测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议的启发。我们的协议只要求态在二维希尔伯特空间中制备，这弱化了原始MDI-QKD协议中的态制备假设。更有趣的是，我们的协议能够克服FDI-QKD协议中的探测漏洞问题，而该问题极大地限制了FDI-QKD的应用。因此，我们的协议可以用实际的光学元件实现。

Abstract (English)
In this paper, we propose a quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol based on only a two-dimensional Hilbert space encoding a quantum system and independent devices between the equipment for state preparation and measurement. Our protocol is inspired by the fully device-independent quantum key distribution (FDI-QKD) protocol and the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol. Our protocol only requires the state to be prepared in the two-dimensional Hilbert space, which weakens the state preparation assumption in the original MDI-QKD protocol. More interestingly, our protocol can overcome the detection loophole problem in the FDI-QKD protocol, which greatly limits the application of FDI-QKD. Hence our protocol can be implemented with practical optical components.

Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 04

半设备无关与全设备无关协议之间的关系Relationship between semi- and fully-device-independent protocols

以贝尔不等式与维度见证之间的对应关系为工具，建立了半设备无关与全设备无关协议之间的相互转换方法，并由此得到两类情形下比特率更高的随机数生成协议，还给出了若干类贝尔不等式与维度见证。

我们研究了半设备无关协议与全设备无关协议之间的关系。作为工具，我们利用了贝尔不等式与维度见证之间的对应关系。我们提出了一种把前者转换为后者、以及反向转换的方法。这一关系为两种场景都带来了有趣的结果。首先，我们在半设备无关与全设备无关两种情形下都找到了比特率更高的随机数生成协议。作为副产品，我们得到了若干类贝尔不等式和维度见证。随后，我们展示了贝尔不等式研究中使用的优化方法如何能够被用于维度见证。

Abstract (English)
We study the relation between semi- and fully-device-independent protocols. As a tool, we use the correspondence between Bell inequalities and dimension witnesses. We present a method for converting the former into the latter, and vice versa. This relation provides us with interesting results for both scenarios. First, we find random-number-generation protocols with higher bit rates for both the semi- and fully-device-independent cases. As a byproduct, we obtain classes of Bell inequalities and dimension witnesses. Then, we show how optimization methods used in studies on Bell inequalities can be adopted for dimension witnesses.

Hong-Wei Li, Piotr Mironowicz, Marcin Pawłowski, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Yu-Chun Wu, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Hong-Gang Hu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

利用波长相关分束器与多波长光源攻击实际量子密钥分发系统Attacking a practical quantum-key-distribution system with wavelength-dependent beam-splitter and multiwavelength sources

针对熔融双锥分束器的波长相关特性这一安全漏洞，提出可适用于所有被动状态调制 QKD 系统的攻击方案，并在偏振编码系统上仅以误码率从 1.3% 升至 1.4% 的代价窃取全部密钥。

众所周知，量子密钥分发（QKD）的无条件安全性可由量子力学保证。然而，实际 QKD 系统存在一些不完美之处，窃听者可以利用这些不完美来攻击密钥。以当前的实验技术，采用熔融双锥工艺制作的实际分束器具有波长相关特性。基于这一致命的安全漏洞，我们提出一种波长相关攻击方案，它可应用于所有采用被动状态调制的实际 QKD 系统。此外，我们对一个实际的偏振编码 QKD 系统进行了实验攻击，仅以将量子比特错误率从 1.3% 提高到 1.4% 为代价，就获取了全部密钥信息。

Abstract (English)
It is well known that the unconditional security of quantum-key distribution (QKD) can be guaranteed by quantum mechanics. However, practical QKD systems have some imperfections, which can be controlled by the eavesdropper to attack the secret key. With current experimental technology, a realistic beam splitter, made by fused biconical technology, has a wavelength-dependent property. Based on this fatal security loophole, we propose a wavelength-dependent attacking protocol, which can be applied to all practical QKD systems with passive state modulation. Moreover, we experimentally attack a practical polarization encoding QKD system to obtain all the secret key information at the cost of only increasing the quantum bit error rate from $1.3$ to $1.4%$.

Hong-Wei Li, Shuang Wang, Jing-Zheng Huang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Fang-Yi Li, Zheng Zhou, Dong Liu, Yang Zhang, Guang-Can Guo, Wan-Su Bao, Zheng-Fu Han

针对差分相移量子密钥分发尚无无条件安全性证明的问题，利用冯·诺依曼熵的锐连续性等工具估计窃听者信息上界，并基于Devatak—Winter密钥率公式给出单脉冲攻击下的安全性下界。

量子密钥分发是在两个相距遥远的参与方之间共享密钥的技术，因其无条件安全性而备受关注。与其他量子密钥分发协议相比，差分相移量子密钥分发协议具有更高的效率和更简单的装置。遗憾的是，差分相移量子密钥分发的无条件安全性尚未得到证明。利用冯·诺依曼熵的锐连续性以及一些基本不等式，我们估计了窃听者Eve所获信息的上界。随后，我们借助Devatak—Winter的秘密密钥率公式，证明了差分相移量子密钥分发协议在单脉冲攻击下的安全性下界。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution is the art of sharing secret keys between two distant parties, and has attracted a lot of attention due to its unconditional security. Compared with other quantum key distribution protocols, the differential phase shift quantum key distribution protocol has higher efficiency and simpler apparatus. Unfortunately, the unconditional security of differential phase shift quantum key distribution has not been proved. Utilizing the sharp continuity of the von Neuman entropy and some basic inequalities, we estimate the upper bound for the eavesdropper Eve's information. We then prove the lower bound for the security of the differential phase shift quantum key distribution protocol against a one-pulse attack with Devatak—Winter's secret key rate formula.

通过检验两个系统之间的经典关联违背，无需借助经典统计方法即可生成并认证真随机数。本工作提出一种无需纠缠的真随机数扩展协议，其中随机性仅由二维量子见证的违背来保证。此外，我们只假设协议所用系统的维度具有紧致的上界，整个协议可视为半设备无关的黑箱情形。与基于纠缠的设备无关随机数扩展协议相比，我们的协议在实现与检验上都要容易得多。

Abstract (English)
By testing the classical correlation violation between two systems, true random numbers can be generated and certified without applying classical statistical method. In this work, we propose a true random-number expansion protocol without entanglement, where the randomness can be guaranteed only by the two-dimensional quantum witness violation. Furthermore, we only assume that the dimensionality of the system used in the protocol has a tight bound, and the whole protocol can be regarded as a semi-device-independent black-box scenario. Compared with the device-independent random-number expansion protocol based on entanglement, our protocol is much easier to implement and test.

已有研究通过考虑单脉冲攻击，分析了相干单向（COW）量子密钥分发协议安全性的上界[Branciard C, Gisin N and Scarani V (BGS) New J.Phys. (2008) 10 013031]。然而，他们的安全性分析基于长距离情形，其传输距离的典型值大于50 km。本文利用冯·诺依曼熵的尖锐连续性以及一些基本不等式，仅考虑接收端将会使用的光子数分辨探测器，给出了改进型相干单向量子密钥分发协议在最一般的单脉冲攻击下的安全性下界。与BGS的安全性分析相比，我们的安全性分析可以满足任意距离的情形。

Abstract (English)
Upper bounds for the security of coherent-one-way (COW) quantum key distribution protocols have been analyzed by considering the one-pulse-attack [Branciard C, Gisin N and Scarani V (BGS) New J.Phys. (2008) 10 013031]. However, their security analysis was based on long distance case, and the typical value of the transmission distance is larger than 50km. Applying the sharp continuity for the von Neumann entropy and some basic inequalities, we provide lower bounds for the security of modified coherent-one-way quantum key distribution protocol against the most general one-pulse-attack by only considering photon number resolved detectors that will be used in the receiver's side. Comparing with BGS's security analysis, our security analysis can be satisfied with arbitrary distance case.

Abstract (English)
Security proof of practical quantum key distribution with finite resources has attracted a lot of attentions in recent years. We give a security analysis about finite resources QKD in this paper, our method is much simper comparing with previous security analysis in finite resources case,the simulation result shows that the security analysis is reasonable in practical QKD realizations with finite resources.

Abstract (English)
The number of transmitted signals in practical quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol is always finite. We discuss the security of decoy states QKD protocol with finite resources by considering the statistical fluctuation for the yield and error rate of the quantum state in different sources of pulses (signal sources and decoy sources). The number of exchanged quantum signals vs positive key generation rate is given with experiment results.

抵御相关泄漏源的安全量子密钥分发Secure quantum key distribution against correlated leakage source

★Sci. Adv.

针对脉冲间相关性这一被忽视的源缺陷，建立相关源下 QKD 安全分析框架，首次给出有限密钥分析，并设计仅需相关范围与真空分量下界的抗相关泄漏源协议，仿真显示其容错性显著优于现有方案。

量子密钥分发（QKD）基于量子力学提供信息论安全性，然而其实现受到光源缺陷的阻碍。其中，传输脉冲之间的相关性对 QKD 的理论安全性构成关键但研究不足的威胁。我们提出一个相关源下 QKD 安全性的通用框架，通过利用广义链式法则扩展并重组 QKD 轮次，实现了首个有限密钥分析。受旁信道安全 QKD 启发，我们设计了一种抵御相关泄漏源的协议，仅需相关范围以及所制备态真空分量的下界。我们的框架也适用于其他 QKD 协议，为解决相关性引发的漏洞提供了通用方法。仿真证明了我们协议的有效性，以及其与现有协议相比显著更优的缺陷容限。这项工作为封堵 QKD 中的安全漏洞、提升其实用性，并确保现实约束下远距离、高性能安全通信迈出了关键一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides information-theoretic security based on quantum mechanics, yet its implementation is hindered by source imperfections. Among these, correlations between transmitted pulses present a critical but underexplored threat to QKD’s theoretical security. We propose a general framework for QKD security under correlated sources, achieving the first finite-key analysis by extending and reorganizing QKD rounds using the generalized chain rule. Inspired by side-channel-secure QKD, we design a protocol secure against correlated leakage sources, requiring only the correlation range and lower bounds on the vacuum component of the prepared states. Our framework also applies to other QKD protocols, providing a general approach to address correlation-induced vulnerabilities. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of our protocol and its significantly superior tolerance to imperfections compared to existing protocols. This work provides a crucial step toward closing security loopholes in QKD, enhancing its practicality, and ensuring long-distance, high-performance secure communication under real-world constraints.

利用测量设备无关协议自身的内禀事件直接计算偏振漂移的补偿量，无需参考脉冲或经典激光等额外资源，也不必中断密钥生成，并建立了引入偏振维度后的响应率模型。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是迈向量子互联网的关键一步，它消除了所有探测器侧信道，使得在节点不可信的条件下仍能实现安全的量子密钥分发。然而，MDI QKD 面临偏振对准的重大挑战，因为偏振态的漂移会影响密钥生成效率，尤其是当量子态从远端位置发送时。传统的偏振对准方法要么需要额外资源（如经典激光器或参考脉冲），要么会中断 QKD 过程，从而降低系统效率。本文提出了一种 MDI QKD 中的高效偏振对准方法，它利用 MDI 的内禀事件直接计算如何补偿偏振漂移。所提方法不需要参考脉冲等额外资源，从而消除了带宽限制；同时它速度很快，能够在判据涨落很小的条件下直接计算出偏振校正方式。我们还在编码维度之外引入了偏振维度，并建立了带有附加偏振维度的 MDI QKD 响应率模型。总体而言，所提方法是 MDI QKD 中一种资源高效的偏振漂移校正方案，能够提升 QKD 网络的实用性与可扩展性。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a crucial step for the quantum Internet, as it removes all detector side channels and enables secure QKD with untrusted nodes. However, MDI QKD faces a significant challenge from polarization alignment, since drift of the state of polarization affects the efficiency of key generation, especially when the quantum states are sent from remote locations. Conventional methods for polarization alignment either require additional resources, such as classical lasers or reference pulses, or interrupt the QKD process, which reduces the efficiency of the system. In this paper, an efficient polarization-alignment method in MDI QKD is proposed that leverages intrinsic events from MDI to directly calculate how to compensate for polarization drift. The proposed method does not require additional resources such as reference pulses, thereby eliminating bandwidth limitations, and it is fast, as it can directly calculate how to correct polarization with a small criterion fluctuation. We also introduce the polarization dimension in addition to the encoding dimension and establish a response-rate model for MDI QKD with additional polarization dimensions. Overall, the proposed method is a resource-efficient solution for polarization drift correction in MDI QKD, which can enhance the practicality and scalability of QKD networks.

Jia-Xuan Li, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang, Ze-Hao Wang, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）利用量子力学产生真随机性，但实际实现中的器件缺陷可能破坏安全性。我们提出一种基于纯度约束下测量不确定性的半器件无关 QRNG，用于条件最小熵估计。该协议无需对二维光源和可数维测量进行详细建模，并且对测量设备上的量子攻击仍然安全。我们揭示了一种由自然满足的纯度条件产生的隐含不确定性关系，利用测试态定义随机性参数 C，并通过态与测量的酉旋转对称性将其与可提取随机性的解析界联系起来。利用广义熵积累定理，我们将单轮界推广到多轮，并获得对抗相干攻击的可组合安全性。在标准商用光纤系统上实现后，我们的高容错协议实现了指数级安全随机性扩张，并适用于集成光子平台。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) exploit quantum mechanics to produce true randomness, but practical implementations suffer from device imperfections that can compromise security. We propose a semi–device-independent QRNG based on measurement uncertainty under purity constraints for conditional min-entropy estimation. Our protocol requires no detailed modeling of the two-dimensional source and the countable-dimensional measurement and remains secure against quantum attacks on measurement devices. We uncover an implicit uncertainty relation arising from naturally satisfied purity conditions, define a randomness parameter C using test states, and connect it to an analytical bound on extractable randomness via unitary rotation symmetries of states and measurements. Using the generalized entropy accumulation theorem, we extend the single-round bound to multirounds and obtain composable security against coherent attacks. Implemented on a standard commercial fiber system, our high-tolerance protocol achieves exponential secure randomness expansion and is suitable for integrated-photonic platforms.

随机数的生成在许多科学应用中发挥着重要作用。与伪随机数生成器相比，量子器件能够依据量子力学定律生成真随机数。然而，信息论安全的随机数通常建立在完美的器件模型之上，而该模型可能与现实器件存在偏差。为弥合这一差距，我们提出并实验演示了一种量子随机数生成协议。在我们的协议中，不对源作任何假设；需要对可信的二维测量作出一些合理假设，但不要求对其进行详细表征。即使考虑最一般的量子攻击并使用一般源，我们仍以10^{-10}的通用可组合安全参数实现了超过1 Mbps的随机数生成速率。

Abstract (English)
Generating random numbers plays an important role in many scientific applications. Compared to pseudorandom number generators, a quantum device is capable of generating true random numbers by the laws of quantum mechanics. However, information-theoretical secure random numbers are regularly based on a perfect device model, which may deviate from a real-world device. To close this gap, we propose a quantum random number generation protocol and experimentally demonstrate it. In our protocol, we make no assumptions about the source. Some reasonable assumptions on the trusted two-dimensional measurement are needed, but we do not require a detailed characterization. Even if considering the most general quantum attack and using the general sources, we achieve a randomness generation rate of over 1 Mbps with a universal composable security parameter of 10^{-10}.

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）基于量子力学的基本不可预测性，有望实现安全的随机数生成。然而，理论模型与实际器件之间不可避免的差距可能导致安全性失效。最近，人们提出了源无关量子随机数发生器（SI-QRNG），以解决光源特性无法表征的问题。然而，在目前大多数SI-QRNG协议的分析中，针对不完美测量的安全性证明是分别针对不同因素给出的，并且对偏离理论模型的微小偏差极为敏感。在此，我们针对SI-QRNG中的不完美测量建立了统一模型，并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系给出了紧致的速率界。随后我们评估了器件不完美度较大时的性能，结果表明，在我们的模型中，随机数速率可以达到常用离散变量QRNG速率上限的相近数量级。此外，利用日常光照和具有较大不完美度的测量器件，我们在实验上以Mbps量级演示了该方案。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) promise secure randomness generation based on the foundational unpredictability of quantum mechanics. However, the unavoidable gaps between theoretical models and practical devices could lead to security invalidation. Recently, a source-independent quantum random number generator (SI-QRNG) has been proposed to solve the issue of uncharacteristic sources. However, in most current analyses of SI-QRNG protocols, the security proofs with imperfect measurements are individual for different factors and very sensitive to small deviations from theoretical models. Here, we establish a unified model for imperfect measurements in the SI-QRNG and provide a tight rate bound based on the uncertainty relation for smooth entropies. Then the performance with large device imperfections is evaluated and the randomness rate in our model can approach a similar order of magnitude of the rate upper bound in common discrete variable QRNGs. In addition, by utilizing the daily illumination and measurement devices with large imperfections, we experimentally demonstrate our scheme at the rate of the order of magnitude of Mbps.

Xing Lin, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

器件非完美条件下源无关量子随机数发生器的安全性分析与改进Security analysis and improvement of source independent quantum random number generators with imperfect devices

指出源无关量子随机数发生器中可信但非完美测量器件的安全漏洞，通过重算条件最小熵并加装监测器加以修补，并发现采样轮数很大时后脉冲的影响可超过有限尺寸效应。

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）作为一种真正的随机性来源，在数值模拟和密码学等许多应用中不可或缺。最近，一种源无关量子随机数发生器（SI-QRNG）已经实现，它可以在光源不可信的情况下产生安全的随机数。然而，SI-QRNG 中所使用的可信但非完美器件的测量漏洞尚未被充分探究，这会带来安全性问题，尤其是在高速系统中。在此，我们指出并评估了 SI-QRNG 中实际非完美测量器件的安全漏洞。我们还给出了相应的对策，通过重新计算条件最小熵并增加监测器来防止这些信息泄露。此外，在考虑有限尺寸效应的情况下，我们表明当采样轮数很大时，后脉冲的影响可能超过有限尺寸效应的影响。我们的协议简单而有效，提升了 SI-QRNG 在实际中的安全性以及与高速测量器件的兼容性，从而为构建超快且安全性可认证的商用 SI-QRNG 系统铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A quantum random number generator (QRNG) as a genuine source of randomness is essential in many applications, such as number simulation and cryptography. Recently, a source-independent quantum random number generator (SI-QRNG), which can generate secure random numbers with untrusted sources, has been realized. However, the measurement loopholes of the trusted but imperfect devices used in SI-QRNGs have not yet been fully explored, which will cause security problems, especially in high-speed systems. Here, we point out and evaluate the security loopholes of practical imperfect measurement devices in SI-QRNGs. We also provide corresponding countermeasures to prevent these information leakages by recalculating the conditional minimum entropy and adding a monitor. Furthermore, by taking into account the finite-size effect, we show that the influence of the afterpulse can exceed that of the finite-size effect with the large number of sampled rounds. Our protocol is simple and effective, and it promotes the security of SI-QRNG in practice as well as the compatibility with high-speed measurement devices, thus paving the way for constructing ultrafast and security-certified commercial SI-QRNG systems.

Xing Lin, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Rong Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

无需监测信号扰动的量子密钥分发中的后脉冲效应Afterpulse effects in quantum key distribution without monitoring signal disturbance

首次将后脉冲效应纳入轮转差分相移量子密钥分发的紧致有限码长分析，表明非马尔可夫后脉冲模型可优化系统性能，且 RRDPS 在短时通信下相对诱骗态 BB84 的优势在典型后脉冲取值下依然成立。

轮转差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议是唯一不需要监测信号扰动的协议。此外，已有研究证明 RRDPS 在抵抗有限码长效应和容忍高误码率方面具有优异性能。然而，现有理论与实验均未考虑后脉冲效应，而该效应在高速 QKD 系统中不可忽略。在此，我们提出一种考虑后脉冲效应的紧致有限码长分析。结果表明，非马尔可夫后脉冲 RRDPS 模型在考虑后脉冲效应的情况下优化了系统性能。在典型后脉冲取值下，RRDPS 相对于诱骗态 BB84 在短时通信中的优势依然成立。

Abstract (English)
The round-robin differential phase shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol is the only one that does not require monitoring of signal disturbance. Moreover, it has been proven that RRDPS has excellent performance of resistance to finite-key effects and high error rate tolerance. However, the existing theories and experiments do not take the afterpulse effects into account, which cannot be neglected in high-speed QKD systems. Here, we propose a tight finite-key analysis with afterpulse effects. The results show that the non-Markovian afterpulse RRDPS model optimizes the system performance considering afterpulse effects. The advantage of RRDPS over decoy-state BB84 under short-time communication still holds at typical values of afterpulse.

无需监测信号扰动的量子密钥分发紧致有限密钥分析Tight finite-key analysis for quantum key distribution without monitoring signal disturbance

基于熵不确定关系与 Azuma 不等式，为轮询差分相移协议给出可抵御最一般相干攻击的紧致有限密钥安全性证明，表明相位随机化光源下实验可及的脉冲数即可逼近渐近极限。

与传统通信不同，量子密钥分发（QKD）能够达到无条件安全，因而受到大量研究关注。在现有各类 QKD 协议中，轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议无需监测信号扰动即可运行，这显著简化了其流程并提高了对误码率的容忍度。尽管已有若干 RRDPS 的安全性证明，但针对实际相位随机化光源的紧致有限密钥分析仍然缺失。本文基于熵不确定关系，提出了一种改进的 RRDPS 安全性证明，可抵御最一般的相干攻击。此外，借助 Azuma 不等式，我们的证明能够很好地处理有限密钥效应。所提出的有限密钥分析保持了相位随机化光源的优势，并表明实验上可接受的脉冲数足以接近渐近极限。这些结果有助于实现无需监测信号扰动的实用化 QKD。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Unlike traditional communication, quantum key distribution (QKD) can reach unconditional security and thus attracts intensive studies. Among all existing QKD protocols, round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) protocol can be running without monitoring signal disturbance, which significantly simplifies its flow and improves its tolerance of error rate. Although several security proofs of RRDPS have been given, a tight finite-key analysis with a practical phase-randomized source is still missing. In this paper, we propose an improved security proof of RRDPS against the most general coherent attack based on the entropic uncertainty relation. What’s more, with the help of Azuma’s inequality, our proof can tackle finite-key effects primely. The proposed finite-key analysis keeps the advantages of phase randomization source and indicates experimentally acceptable numbers of pulses are sufficient to approach the asymptotical bound closely. The results shed light on practical QKD without monitoring signal disturbance.

Hang Liu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

本文给出两处勘误，以更正我们论文中的两处排版错误。

往返差分相移量子密钥分发协议的有限码长分析Finite-key analysis for round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution

用后选择技术把往返差分相移协议的安全性证明推广到有限码长情形，预言其有限码长密钥率可与渐近情形相比拟。

自往返差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议提出以来，它因具有无需监测信号扰动即可限定信息泄露量这一独特性质而备受关注。最近，Yin 等人发展了一种新理论，可紧致地估计其信息泄露量。然而，有限码长效应尚未被纳入考虑。本文填补这一空白，利用后选择技术把 RRDPS 协议的安全性证明推广到有限码长情形。由此可以预期，在有限码长情形下 RRDPS 的密钥率能够与渐近情形相比拟，这对实际应用具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
Since the round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol was proposed, it has attracted much attention due to its unique characteristic i.e., it can bind the amount of information leakage without monitoring signal disturbance. Recently, Yin et al . have developed a novel theory to estimate its information leakage tightly. However, the finite-sized key effects are not taken into account. Here, we fill this gap and extend the security proof of the RRDPS protocol to the finite-sized regime using post-selection technique. As a consequence, it’s predicted that the key rate of RRDPS in a finite-sized key scenario can be comparable to the asymptotic one, which is meaningful for the real-life applications.
