No. 01

面向可扩展量子网络的全无调制器量子密钥分发架构Fully modulator-free architecture for quantum key distribution in scalable quantum networks

提出并实验演示首个全无调制器、全自由度直接调制量子密钥分发架构，利用光注入锁定与相干干涉同时控制相位和强度，30 dB 信道损耗下安全码率 4.78 kbps，与常规调制器系统相当。

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络是迈向未来量子互联网的基础一步，已成为密集研究的焦点。类比经典光网络架构可以看到，高容量骨干网通常依赖复杂的外部调制，而成本敏感的接入层更偏好更简单、更紧凑、更经济的直接调制。作为量子网络的基石，当今 QKD 网络同样具有这种骨干—接入层级结构，然而其实现仍严重依赖外部调制器，使接入层中直接调制 QKD 的生态位明显空缺。在此，我们提出并实验演示了首个填补这一空缺的全无调制器、全自由度直接调制 QKD 架构。发射端将光注入锁定与相干光干涉相结合，无需外部调制器即可同时实现相位与强度控制，从而能够制备任意量子态，并保持与标准时间仓编码接收端的固有兼容性。我们的实验实现采用相对廉价的激光二极管和无源光学元件，在 30 dB 信道损耗下实现 4.78 kbps 的安全密钥率，与传统基于调制器的系统性能相当。通过填补 QKD 生态中长期存在的直接调制生态位，这项工作为接入层部署难题提供了实用解决方案，并为紧凑、可扩展的 QKD 实现开辟了一条可行新方向。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks represent a foundational step toward the future quantum internet and have become a focus of intensive research. By analogy with the architecture of classical optical networks, we can observe that the high-capacity backbone typically relies on complex external modulation, while the cost-sensitive access layer prefers simpler, more compact, and more economical direct modulation. As the cornerstone of quantum networks, today’s QKD networks share this backbone-access hierarchy, yet their implementations remain heavily reliant on external modulators, leaving a clear ecological niche unfilled for directly modulated QKD in the access layer. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate the first fully modulator-free, full-degree-of-freedom direct-modulation QKD architecture that fills this niche. The transmitter combines optical injection locking with coherent optical interference to achieve simultaneous phase and intensity control without external modulators, enabling arbitrary quantum-state preparation while preserving inherent compatibility with standard time-bin-encoding receivers. Built with relatively inexpensive laser diodes and passive optical components, our experimental implementation achieves a secure key rate of 4.78 kbps at 30 dB channel loss, matching the performance of conventional modulator-based systems. By filling the long-standing direct-modulation niche in the QKD ecosystem, this work delivers a practical solution to the access-layer deployment challenge and opens a viable new direction for compact, scalable QKD implementation.

Feng-Yu Lu, Xiao-Juan Huang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Zi-Tao Liu, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

面向下一代量子互联网的全异构制备-测量量子网络Fully heterogeneous prepare-and-measure quantum network for the next stage of quantum internet

★Nat. Commun.

提出全异构量子网络及软件定义网络结构，用户可用任意主流乃至部分系统接入；五节点异构实验演示量子密钥分发、数字签名、拜占庭协议与量子会议，首次实现多恶意节点量子拜占庭协议。

量子互联网有望提供经典互联网可证明无法实现的独特能力。然而，当前的量子网络往往为特定任务设计专用系统，这阻碍了未来量子互联网的开放性与多样性。为解决这些局限，本工作提出一种全异构量子网络，并配套若干技术。该方案允许用户使用任意主流系统甚至部分系统接入网络。该网络还可执行多种不同的量子任务，并为全局优化与低成本设计提供可能。我们实现了包含异构节点的五节点量子网络，通过量子密钥分发、量子数字签名、量子拜占庭协议和量子会议等任务展示了该方案的优越性。尤其值得注意的是，该实验首次在量子网络中演示了多恶意节点量子拜占庭协议。本工作提出了连接多样用户系统并支持多种量子任务的全异构量子网络，还提出一种软件定义的量子网络结构，以协调网络节点并优化网络性能。这为开放且通用的量子互联网铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
The quantum internet promises unparalleled capabilities that are provably impossible with the classical internet. However, current quantum networks are often designed with dedicated systems for specified tasks, which hinders the openness and diversity of future quantum internet. To address these limitations, this work proposes a fully heterogeneous quantum network accompanied with several techniques. Our proposal allows users to access the network using any mainstream systems or even partial systems. The network also enables the execution of multiple distinct quantum tasks and provides opportunities for global optimization and cost-efficient design. A five-node quantum network featuring heterogeneous nodes has been implemented, demonstrating the superiority of our proposal through tasks such as quantum key distribution, quantum digital signature, quantum Byzantine agreement, and quantum conference. Notably, the experiment represents the first demonstration of multi-malicious node quantum Byzantine agreement in a quantum network. This work proposed a fully heterogeneous quantum network that connects diverse user systems and enables multiple quantum tasks. A software-defined quantum network structure is also proposed for coordinating network nodes and optimizing network performance. It paves the way for an open and versatile quantum internet.

提出非对称光源下MDI-QKD的性能分析理论，可处理单模与多时间模情形；以弱相干脉冲和自发参量下转换光源为例建模，发现密钥率在整个研究距离内并不因光源非对称而下降。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）消除了窃听者对测量方的所有攻击，一直被认为是实现端到端量子网络最有前景的技术之一。在实际中，光源与信道的非对称性通常是不可避免的。为此，我们提出一种理论，用于分析网络中任意两个MDI用户使用处于不同单模或多时间模的非对称光源进行通信时的性能。作为一个具体应用，我们对使用弱相干脉冲光源和自发参量下转换光源的MDI QKD进行建模并获得其密钥率，且将其与对称（即完全相同）光源情形下的性能进行比较。结果表明，实际性能并不会因光源的非对称性而下降；相反，在我们所研究的整个距离范围内，它都保持在良好水平。该工作为分析和优化具有非对称光源的MDI-QKD网络提供了理论基础，从而为完全非对称MDI-QKD网络的实际部署铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD), which eliminates all the attacks from the eavesdropper to the measurement party, has been one of the most promising technologies for the implementation of end-to-end quantum networks. In practice, the asymmetry of both sources and channels is generally inevitable. Therefore, we propose a theory to analyze the performance when any two MDI users in networks communicate using asymmetric sources in distinct single or multiple temporal modes. As a specific application, we model to obtain the key rate of MDI QKD with a weak-coherent pulse source and a spontaneous parametric down-conversion source, and compare the performance to the cases with symmetric (i.e., identical) sources. The result demonstrates that the actual performance does not degrade due to the asymmetry of sources. On the contrary, it maintains at a good level over the entire distance we study. This work provides a theoretical basis for analyzing and optimizing MDI-QKD networks with asymmetric sources, thus paving the way for the practical deployment of completely asymmetric MDI-QKD networks.

Jia-Ju Deng, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

全被动时间箱编码量子密钥分发的实验演示Experimental Demonstration of Fully Passive Quantum Key Distribution

在实验中实现全被动时间箱编码量子密钥分发，彻底去除了用户设备中的主动调制与调制器侧信道，原型系统在有限密钥条件下仍可给出有竞争力的安全成码率。

量子密钥分发（QKD）的被动式方案旨在去除用户设备中的所有主动调制，是消除调制器侧信道的一种非常理想的应对措施。然而，由于理论与实际两方面的限制，迄今为止 QKD 系统中的主动调制尚未被完全去除。本文报道了一个全被动时间箱编码 QKD 系统，并成功实现了一条无调制器的 QKD 链路。根据最新的理论分析，我们的原型能够在有限密钥条件下提供具有竞争力的成码率。

Abstract (English)
The passive approach to quantum key distribution (QKD) consists of removing all active modulation from the users' devices, a highly desirable countermeasure to get rid of modulator side channels. Nevertheless, active modulation has not been completely removed in QKD systems so far, due to both theoretical and practical limitations. In this Letter, we present a fully passive time-bin encoding QKD system and report on the successful implementation of a modulator-free QKD link. According to the latest theoretical analysis, our prototype is capable of delivering competitive secret key rates in the finite key regime.

面向安全高性能量子密钥分发的强度层析方法Intensity Tomography Method for Secure and High-Performance Quantum Key Distribution

针对随机强度涨落与关联强度涨落造成的调制不精确问题，提出强度层析方法，用本地单光子探测器测量诱骗态以精确标定涨落并紧致界定光子数态的未知密度矩阵，实验与仿真验证其可提升协议性能与实际安全性。

诱骗态方法极大地弥补了量子密钥分发（QKD）领域中多光子脉冲带来的漏洞，近年来几乎被用于所有实际 QKD 系统。然而，实际诱骗态 QKD 的安全性与性能仍受随机强度涨落、关联强度涨落等调制不精确因素的限制。本工作提出一种强度层析方法，用以对抗这些涨落。该方法能够紧致地界定光子数态的未知密度矩阵，并通过用本地单光子探测器测量诱骗态来精确标定涨落。我们通过实验与仿真验证了该层析方法。结果表明，我们的方法能够有效缓解这些涨落带来的缺陷，从而提升协议性能和实际安全性。鉴于这些涨落在实际 QKD 中不可避免，我们的方法将为 QKD 的实际应用铺平道路。

Abstract (English)
Decoy-state method has greatly filled in loopholes from multi-photon pulses in the field of quantum key distribution (QKD) and it has been employed in almost all practical QKD systems in recent years. However, security and performance of the practical decoy-state QKDs are still limited by inaccurate modulations such as random intensity fluctuation and correlated intensity fluctuation. In this work, an intensity tomography method is proposed as a countermeasure against these fluctuations. It has an ability to tightly bound the unknown density matrices of photon-number state and accurately calibrate the fluctuations by measuring the decoy states with a local single-photon detector. We verified the tomography method by experiments and simulations. The results indicated that our method can efficiently mitigate the flaws from these fluctuations to improve the protocol performance and practical security. Noting that these fluctuations are inevitable in practical QKDs, our method would pave the avenue for QKD's practical applications.

Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Jia-Lin Chen, Xiang Kang, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

针对诱骗态调制不准确这一漏洞，提出可实用的攻击方法并给出详细理论分析，实验上攻破了 MDI-QKD 系统并获取全部最终密钥，以警示源端安全的重要性。

诱骗态测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）被认为是最有前景的协议之一，因为它在物理上免疫于所有致命的探测端攻击。然而，源端的漏洞仍然为窃听者敞开着侧信道。此前的工作已表明，若诱骗态调制不准确，系统便不再安全，但窃听者利用调制不准确性的一种实用方法仍然缺失。在本工作中，我们提出了一种实用的攻击方法，并给出了详细的理论分析。利用该方法，我们在实验中攻击了一个 MDI-QKD 系统，并成功获取了全部最终密钥。通过演示这一攻击实验，我们希望引起人们对源端安全性的关注，并为开发源端安全性更好的协议提供启发。

Abstract (English)
Decoy-state measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is regarded as one of the most promising protocols since it is physically immune to all fatal detection-side attacks. However, the loopholes in the source side still open side channels to eavesdroppers. Previous work has indicated that a system is insecure if its decoy-state modulation is inaccurate, but a practical method for Eve to exploit the inaccurate modulation is still absent. In this work, we propose a practical hacking method and provide a detailed theoretical analysis. Using our method, we experimentally hacked a MDI-QKD system and successfully obtained all final keys. By demonstrating the hacking experiment, we hope to bring attention to source-side security and provide inspiration for the development of protocols with better source-side security.

Feng-Yu Lu, Peng Ye, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Xiao-Juan Huang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

★Optica

提出一种对不均衡基失配更宽容的测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议，降低了对编码系统的先验要求，以抵抗棘手的调制误差与涨落，并完成实验验证，在保持安全性的同时获得高性能。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）是一种革命性的协议，因为它在物理上免疫探测端的所有攻击。然而，该协议对源端仍保留严格假设，要求四个 BB84 态必须被完美制备才能保证安全性。一些协议放宽了编码系统中的部分假设以保持实际安全性，但性能会显著下降。在本工作中，我们提出一种 MDIQKD 协议，它只需要较少关于编码系统的先验知识，即可对抗棘手的调制误差与涨落。我们还对该协议进行了实验演示。结果表明，它具有高性能以及面向实际应用的良好安全性。其鲁棒性与灵活性对于 QKD 网络等复杂场景也展现出良好价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) is a revolutionary protocol since it is physically immune to all attacks on the detection side. However, the protocol still keeps the strict assumptions on the source side that specify that the four BB84 states must be perfectly prepared to ensure security. Some protocols release part of the assumptions in the encoding system to keep the practical security, but the performance would be dramatically reduced. In this work, we present a MDIQKD protocol that requires less knowledge of the encoding system to combat the troublesome modulation errors and fluctuations. We have also experimentally demonstrated the protocol. The result indicates a high performance and good security for practical applications. Its robustness and flexibility also exhibit a good value for complex scenarios such as the QKD networks.

诱骗态方法大幅提升了量子密钥分发的性能，并完美解决了多光子脉冲带来的关键问题。近年来，诱骗态方法在实用性方面占据关键地位，几乎所有QKD系统都采用了诱骗态方法。然而，传统强度调制器的不完美性限制了诱骗态方法的性能并引入侧信道。本工作设计了一种特殊的强度调制器及其配套调制方法，并进行了实验验证，以实现安全、稳定、高性能的诱骗态QKD。实验结果表明，其稳定且可调的强度、便捷的两级调制、固有的高速特性以及紧凑结构非常契合未来发展趋势，将有助于诱骗态方法完美地应用于QKD系统。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The decoy-state method substantially improves the performance of quantum key distribution (QKD) and perfectly solves crucial issues caused by multiphoton pulses. In recent years, the decoy-state method has occupied a key position in practicality, and almost all the QKD systems have employed the decoy-state method. However, the imperfections of traditional intensity modulators limit the performance of the decoy-state method and bring side channels. In this work, a special intensity modulator and its accompanying modulation method are designed and experimentally verified for the secure, stable, and high-performance decoy-state QKDs. The experimental result indicates that its stable and adjustable intensities, convenient two-level modulation, inherently high speed, and compact structure is extremely fit for future trends and will help the decoy-state method to be perfectly applied to QKD systems.

针对参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发，指出原始诱骗态方法因忽略不同基之间的潜在关联而过于悲观地估计相关产额，联合处理各基参数后显著提升了统计涨落下的密钥率与可达距离。

参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发（RFI-MDI-QKD）是一种新颖的协议，它消除了探测器端一切可能的攻击，也消除了源端进行参考系校准的必要性。然而，由于需要积累更多参数（例如失配基事件的产额与误码率）来监测安全性，统计涨落可能使其性能明显下降。本工作发现，原始诱骗态方法由于忽略了不同基之间的潜在关联，对这些产额的估计过于悲观。通过联合处理不同基的参数，在考虑统计涨落的情况下（统计涨落分析是最终分析有限码长效应的第一步），RFI-MDI-QKD 在密钥率和可达距离方面均得到大幅改善。我们的结果为通向实用化的 RFI-MDI-QKD 开辟了道路。

Abstract (English)
Reference-frame-independent measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (RFI-MDI-QKD) is a novel protocol that eliminates all possible attacks on the detector side and the necessity of reference-frame alignment in source sides. However, its performance may degrade notably due to statistical fluctuations since more parameters, e.g., yields and error rates for mismatched-basis events, must be accumulated to monitor the security. In this work, we find that the original decoy states method estimates these yields overpessimistically since it ignores the potential relations between different bases. Through jointly processing parameters of different bases, the performance of RFI-MDI-QKD is greatly improved in terms of the secret key rate and achievable distance when statistical fluctuations are considered (the statistical fluctuation analysis is the first step to the final analysis of the finite key size effect). Our results pave an avenue towards practical RFI-MDI-QKD.

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议及其变体，如相位匹配 QKD、发送或不发送 QKD 以及无相位后选择 TF-QKD（NPP-TFQKD），在长距离应用中极具前景。然而，这些协议在理论与实际之间仍存在若干差距。具体而言，有限码长分析仍然缺失，且光强波动未被纳入考虑。为处理有限码长效应，我们首先给出有限码长区域中 NPP-TFQKD 抵抗集体攻击的密钥率，随后证明它能够抵抗相干攻击。为处理光强波动，我们给出四强度诱骗态 NPP-TFQKD 的解析公式以及一个实用的光强波动模型。最后，通过详细仿真，我们表明 NPP-TFQKD 仍能保持其高密钥率和长可达距离的优势。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Twin-field quantum key distribution(TF-QKD) protocol and its variants, such as phase-matching QKD, sending-or-not-sending QKD and no phase post-selection TF-QKD(NPP-TFQKD), are very promising for long-distance applications. However, there are still some gaps between theory and practice in these protocols. Concretely, a finite-key size analysis is still missing, and the intensity fluctuations are not taken into account. To address the finite-key size effect, we first give the key rate of NPP-TFQKD against collective attack in finite-key size region and then prove it can be against coherent attack. To deal with the intensity fluctuations, we present an analytical formula of 4-intensity decoy state NPP-TFQKD and a practical intensity fluctuation model. Finally, through detailed simulations, we show NPP-TFQKD can still keep its superiority of high key rate and long achievable distance.

Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

在能够突破速率-距离极限的各种双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议版本中，Cui等人提出的无相位后选择TF-QKD是一种简洁的方案，由于去除了全局相位的后选择，它可以提供高密钥率。然而，该变体的可达距离短于原始的相位匹配QKD。本文提出一种通过引入额外诱骗模式来提升其性能的方法。信息泄露的上界可以被更紧致地估计，因此密钥率和可达距离都得到显著提升。有趣的是，所提出的额外诱骗模式的操作与编码模式相同，因此不会给实验系统带来困难。此外，在有限诱骗态下这种提升依然可观，这在实践中具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
Among the various versions of the twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) protocol [M. Lucamarini, Z. Yuan, J. Dynes, and A. Shields, Nature (London) 557, 400 (2018)] that can overcome the rate-distance limit, the TF-QKD without phase postselection proposed by Cui et al. [Phys. Rev. Appl. 11, 034053 (2019)] is an elegant TF-QKD that can provide high key rates since the postselection of global phases has been removed. However, the achievable distance of this variant is shorter than that of the original phase-matching QKD [X. Ma, P. Zeng, and H. Zhou, Phys. Rev. X 8, 031043 (2018)]. In this paper, we propose a method for improving its performance by introducing an additional decoy mode. The upper bound of the information leakage can be more tightly estimated; hence, both the key rate and the achievable distance are significantly improved. Interestingly, the operation of the proposed additional decoy mode is the same as that of the code mode; hence, it does not introduce difficulties into the experimental system. In addition, the improvement is substantial with finite decoy states, which is meaningful in practice.

利用快速波前整形技术在模拟动态散射信道中提升量子密钥分发性能，使量子传输效率平均提高10 dB，并成功建立起安全的量子链路。

自由空间量子密钥分发（QKD）在全球量子网络中发挥着重要作用。然而，自由空间信道会受到大气湍流以及霾、雾、尘等散射效应的影响，这些效应会显著削弱QKD的性能，甚至阻断安全的量子链路。在此，我们证明：利用快速波前整形技术，可以显著提升QKD在动态散射信道上的性能。该系统使量子传输效率平均获得10 dB的提升，并建立起用于QKD的安全量子链路。我们的工作证明了在自由空间动态散射信道中实现QKD的可行性，并增强了复杂信道QKD系统的部署能力。

Abstract (English)
Free-space quantum key distribution (QKD) plays an important role in the global quantum network. However, free space channels suffer from the atmospheric turbulence and scattering effects of haze, fog, and dust, which significantly weaken the performance of QKD or even block the secure quantum link. Here, we prove the performance of QKD over a dynamic scattering channel can be enhanced significantly using a fast wavefront shaping technique. The system achieves on average 10-dB enhancement of quantum transmission efficiency and establishes a secure quantum link for QKD. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of QKD through free-space dynamic scattering channels and enhances the deployment capability of complex-channel QKD system.

云、霾和雾对光的散射会降低量子密钥分发（QKD）中通信信道的传输效率，削弱系统的实际安全性，从而制约自由空间QKD的部署。在此，我们采用波前整形技术来补偿高损耗散射量子信道中畸变的光信号，并完成了偏振编码的BB84 QKD实验。借助这一量子信道补偿技术，我们实现了约250倍的典型传输效率提升，并且在考虑有限码长效应的条件下仍能建立安全的通信链路，而在优化之前该链路无法共享安全密钥。该方法应用于QKD系统，表明QKD系统的适用范围有望从无损信道扩展到强散射信道，从而增强全球量子通信网络的部署能力。

Abstract (English)
Scattering of light by cloud, haze, and fog decreases the transmission efficiency of communication channels in quantum key distribution (QKD), reduces the system's practical security, and thus constrains the deployment of free-space QKD. Here, we employ wave-front shaping technology to compensate distorted optical signals in high-loss scattering quantum channels and fulfill a polarization-encoded BB84 QKD experiment. With this quantum-channel compensation technology, we achieve a typical enhancement of about 250 in transmission efficiency and build a secure communication link even considering finite key length effect, while the link is impossible to share secure keys before optimization. The method applied in the QKD system shows the potential to expand the application range of QKD systems from lossless channels to highly scattered ones and therefore enhances the deployment ability of a global quantum communication network.

No. 01

激光洛伦兹线宽与高斯线宽的同步测量Simultaneous measurement of the Lorentzian and Gaussian linewidths of laser

利用干涉可见度随延时变化的规律，发现其对数含线性项与二次项，分别源于白噪声与闪烁噪声，据此提出同时测量洛伦兹线宽与高斯线宽的方法，并降低了对延时光纤长度的依赖。

线宽是反映单频激光器相干性的关键参数。由白噪声贡献的线宽已得到广泛研究，而非白噪声（主要是闪烁噪声）的影响却难以评估。然而，闪烁噪声可造成远大于洛伦兹分量的线宽展宽。考虑到干涉可见度可以作为相位噪声大小的有效指标，本工作将闪烁噪声量化为高斯线宽，并分析干涉可见度与激光线宽之间的关系。我们发现可见度的对数与延时呈二次依赖关系：线性项源于白噪声，二次项则来自闪烁噪声。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种同时测量洛伦兹线宽与高斯线宽的方法。该方法不仅避免了闪烁噪声对洛伦兹线宽测量的干扰，还提供了一种便捷的方式来评估闪烁噪声的大小。此外，该方法有效降低了线宽测量实验对延时光纤长度的依赖，较短的光纤有助于减小环境扰动。更重要的是，高斯线宽的引入为激光线宽提供了更全面的表征。

Abstract (English)
Linewidth is a key parameter reflecting the coherence of single-frequency lasers. While the linewidth contributed by white noise has been widely studied, the effect of nonwhite noise, mainly flicker noise, is hard to evaluate. However, flicker noise can cause linewidth broadening much larger than the Lorentzian component. Considering that interference visibility can serve as an effective indicator of phase noise magnitude, in this work, we quantify flicker noise as Gaussian linewidth and analyze the relation between interference visibility and laser linewidth. We find that the logarithm of visibility depends quadratically on the delay: the linear term is due to white noise, and the quadratic term arises from flicker noise. Based on this finding, we propose a method to simultaneously measure Lorentzian and Gaussian linewidths. This approach not only avoids flicker noise interference in Lorentzian linewidth measurements but also provides a convenient way to assess the magnitude of flicker noise. In addition, this approach effectively reduces the dependence of the linewidth measurement experiment on the length of the delay fiber, with shorter fibers helping to minimize environmental disturbances. More importantly, the introduction of the Gaussian linewidth provides a more comprehensive characterization of the laser linewidth.

从理论上说明用频率噪声功率谱密度估计积分线宽的合理性，指出以往方法源于高斯近似并给出更一般的结果；提出 Voigt 近似法使估计误差低于 5%，并建立干涉可见度与线宽的关系。

激光线宽的测量在计量学、相干光通信、高分辨率传感和激光雷达中具有重要意义。首先，本研究从理论上解释了为何通过频率噪声功率谱密度（PSD）估计积分线宽是有效的。我们发现，以往通过频率噪声 PSD 估计积分线宽的方法源自高斯近似，并由此得到了更一般的结果。其次，依据该理论，我们提出 Voigt 近似方法以提升估计性能。仿真结果表明，Voigt 近似的估计误差低于 5%。最后，基于 Voigt 近似，我们发现了干涉可见度与激光线宽之间的关系，为测量线宽提供了一种可能的便捷途径。

Abstract (English)
The measurement of a laser linewidth is significant in metrology, coherent optical communications, high-resolution sensing, and LIDAR. Firstly, in this study, we theoretically explain why estimating an integrated linewidth via a frequency-noise power spectral density (PSD) is valid. We find that the previous methods estimating the integrated linewidth via the frequency-noise PSD result from Gaussian approximation and obtain a more general consequence. Secondly, according to the theory, we propose the Voigt approximation method to improve the estimation performance. The simulation results show the Voigt approximation estimation error is lower than 5%. Finally, based on the Voigt approximation, the relationship between the interference visibility and laser linewidth is found, providing a possible convenient approach to measuring the linewidth.

★Nat. Phys.

在信息论框架下提出并实验实现结合量子光学与相对论的安全位置验证协议，2 km 间距的两位验证者借助相位随机化弱相干态，以优于 75 m 的精度确认证明者位置。

一种确定实体位置的安全方法可以支撑基于位置的交易授权、高价值目标追踪等方案。然而在证明者不可信的情形下，经典方法无法提供安全的位置验证，这意味着证明者可以就其真实位置误导验证者。我们提出并在信息论框架内实验实现了一种将量子光学与相对论相结合的安全位置验证协议。利用相位随机化弱相干态，相距 2 km 的两位验证者以优于 75 m 的精度安全地验证了证明者的位置。这些结果使安全的位置基认证成为实际可能，为金融交易、灾害响应与可认证的安全通信等应用铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A secure approach to determining the position of an entity can enable schemes such as position-based authorization for transactions and tracking of high-value targets. However, classical methods are incapable of providing secure position verification in the untrusted-prover case, meaning that a prover can mislead verifiers about its actual position. Here we propose and experimentally realize a secure position verification protocol that combines quantum optics and relativity within an information-theoretic framework. Using phase-randomized weak coherent states, two verifiers separated by 2 km securely verify the prover’s position with an accuracy better than 75 m. These results establish secure position-based authentication as a practical possibility, paving the way for applications in financial transactions, disaster response and authenticated secure communications.

基于de Finetti约化的侧信道安全量子密钥分发有限密钥分析改进Improved finite-key analysis for side-channel-secure quantum key distribution with de Finetti reduction

提出把相位误差估计在集体攻击与相干攻击下的失败概率联系起来，从而在相干攻击的参数估计中沿用独立同分布假设；相比基于后选择方法的既有分析，仿真给出的密钥率性能更好。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的用户之间能够生成安全密钥。然而，由于实际器件无法以完美精度工作，在真实QKD实现中实现无条件安全仍然是一项挑战。侧信道安全（SCS）QKD为同时实现高实际安全性和高性能提供了良好的解决方案。它保留了测量设备无关的优点，而在源端只需给出各态真空投影概率的上界。然而，SCS QKD针对一般相干攻击的安全性证明具有挑战性。基于后选择方法的现有分析性能较差。为克服这一缺陷，我们不再直接用后选择方法计算密钥率，而是提出一种方法，将相位误差估计在集体攻击与相干攻击下的失败概率相互关联，从而能够在针对相干攻击的参数估计中使用独立同分布假设。我们的仿真表明，我们给出的性能优于先前的分析。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables the generation of secure keys between two distant users. However, since practical devices cannot operate with perfect accuracy, achieving unconditional security in real-world QKD implementations remains a challenge. Side-channel-secure (SCS) QKD gives a good solution to realize both high practical security and performance. It keeps the advantage of measurement-device-independent, and for the source part, it only requires to upper bound the vacuum projecting probability of the states. However, security proof for SCS QKD against general coherent attacks is challenging. The existing analysis based on postselection method gives a bad performance. To overcome this drawback, instead of directly calculating key rate with postselection method, we propose a method correlating the failure probabilities of phase-error estimation against collective and coherent attacks, enabling the usage of the independent and identically distributed assumption in parameter estimation against coherent attacks. Our simulation shows that we give a better performance than previous analysis.

基于相位后选择的发送或不发送量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending quantum key distribution with phase postselection

该工作在SNS协议中引入相位后选择，大幅提高了选择「发送」的概率；数值模拟显示，无论是否采用主动奇偶配对方法，传输距离都能提升，离散相位随机化下也有类似改善。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可以帮助两个相距遥远的通信方共享安全密钥。近年来，双场（TF）QKD因其长传输距离而受到广泛研究。TF QKD的一个流行变体是发送或不发送（SNS）QKD，实验上已被验证可实现千公里级光纤密钥分发。本文将相位后选择引入SNS协议。通过这一改动，选择「发送」的概率可以大幅提高。数值模拟表明，无论是否采用主动奇偶配对方法，传输距离都能得到提升。文中还分析了离散相位随机化的情形，同样可以看到距离上的类似改善。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) could help to share a secure key between two distant peers. In recent years, twin-field (TF) QKD has been widely investigated because of its long transmission distance. One of the popular variants of TF QKD is sending-or-not-sending (SNS) QKD, which has been experimentally verified to realize 1000-km level fiber key distribution. In this article, we introduce phase postselection into the SNS protocol. With this modification, the probability of selecting ``sending'' can be substantially improved. The numerical simulation shows that the transmission distance can be improved both with and without the actively odd-parity pairing method. The case of discrete phase randomization is also analyzed, a similar improvement on distance can be seen.

相位编码双场量子密钥分发安全性分析的改进Improved security analysis for phase-encoding twin-field quantum key distribution

借鉴发送或不发送协议分别计算正确轮与错误轮信息泄漏的思路，改进相位匹配双场量子密钥分发的安全性分析，在无需改动实验的前提下延长传输距离，并推广至四相位部分相位后选择协议。

双场（TF）量子密钥分发（QKD）因其长传输距离而得到广泛研究。相位编码TF-QKD能够同时实现高密钥率和长传输距离，因而备受关注。在本文中，我们受到发送或不发送TF-QKD的启发，该协议分别计算正确轮和错误轮的信息泄漏；同时我们注意到这类方法已被用于许多QKD协议，例如六态QKD。我们将类似的方法应用于相位匹配TF-QKD，并发现其性能有所提升。在新的分析下，无需对实验做任何改动即可提升传输距离。我们还将新的分析应用于四相位部分相位后选择协议，同样可以获得类似的提升。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field (TF) quantum key distribution (QKD) has been extensively researched because of its long transmission distance. The phase-encoding TF-QKD can realize both a high key rate and a long transmission distance, so it has attracted a lot of attention. In this article, we are inspired by the sending-or-not-sending TF-QKD, in which the information leakages of correct rounds and erroneous rounds are calculated separately. And, we notice that this kind of method has been used in many QKD protocols---for example, the six-state QKD. We apply a similar method to the phase-matching TF-QKD and find some improvement in it. With the new analysis, the transmission distance can be improved without any changes in experiments. We also apply the new analysis in the four-phase partial-phase-postselection protocol, and a similar improvement can be achieved.

提出一种用非光子数分辨探测器测量脉冲光源光子数分布的方法，通过数值模拟验证了方案可行性，并在泊松光源上完成实验检验，可用于评估未知光源与新型光源。

量子密钥分发（QKD）有望实现无条件安全通信，但许多实际系统问题仍待解决。发射端安全性是量子密钥分发安全性的重要组成部分，而测量光子数分布有助于提升这一安全性。该测量对于测量未知光源或测试新设计的光源同样有用。本文提出一种利用非光子数分辨探测器测量脉冲光子数分布的方法，并通过数值模拟对该方案进行检验，表现良好；同时还在泊松光源上开展了实验以检验该方法。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) has a prospect to realize unconditional secure communication. However, many real system problems should be solved. Transmitters security is an important part of QKD security. And measuring photon number distribution could help improve it. This measurement is also useful for measuring unknown sources or testing newly designed sources. In this article, a method to measure the photon number distribution of pulses using non-photon-number-resolving detectors is proposed. Numerical simulation is conducted to test this scheme and performs well. Experiment on Poisson source is also used to test this method.

QKD 系统中 LiNbO3 马赫-曾德尔强度调制器的任意偏置控制Arbitrary bias control of LiNbO3 based Mach-Zehnder intensity modulators for QKD system

建立 RC 电路模型解释铌酸锂马赫-曾德尔强度调制器的偏置漂移，并提出无需反馈的多步偏置稳定方案，可在任意工作点长时间消除漂移而不增加系统复杂度。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可帮助相距遥远的双方共享无条件安全的密钥，而借助诱骗态协议还能提升可实现的密钥率。要在实验中实现 QKD，双方需要利用基于 LiNbO3 的马赫-曾德尔（LNMZ）强度调制器精确地发送若干不同强度的光脉冲。然而，LNMZ 强度调制器的偏置漂移可能影响 QKD 系统的性能。本文提出一个简单的 RC 电路模型来说明 LNMZ 强度调制器中的偏置漂移，并基于该模型提出一种多步偏置稳定方案来控制偏置工作点。实验结果表明，该方案可在长时间范围内消除任意工作点处的偏置漂移。此外，该方案无需任何反馈机制，这意味着它不会带来系统复杂度的任何增加，因而更适合 QKD 系统。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) can help distant agents to share unconditional secret keys, and the achievable secret key rate can be enhanced with the help of decoy-state protocol. To implement QKD experimentally, the agents are supposed to accurately transmit a number of different intensity pulses with the LiNbO 3 based Mach-Zehnder (LNMZ) intensity modulator. However, the bias drift of LNMZ intensity modulator may affect the performance of a QKD system. In this letter, we reveal a simple RC circuit model to demonstrate the bias drift in the LNMZ intensity modulator. And based on the model, we propose a multi-step bias stable scheme to control the bias working point. Experimental result shows that our scheme can eliminate the bias drift of at arbitrary working point within a long time range. Besides, there is no need of any feedback mechanisms in the scheme. This means our scheme will not lead to any increasement in system complexity, making it more suitable for a QKD system.

Jun Teng, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

多光子态发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution with multiphoton states

证明发送或不发送双场协议中多光子干涉同样可贡献密钥生成，并将双光子发射事件纳入有效事件，提出改进方案使密钥率高于仅利用单光子干涉的原方案。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议因其克服速率—距离极限的能力而受到广泛研究。人们还提出了TF-QKD的一种变体，称为发送或不发送（SNS）TF-QKD。SNS-TF-QKD将经典密钥0和1编码在发送或不发送相位随机化相干态中，这有助于容忍由光学相位涨落引起的大失准误差。然而，原始SNS-TF-QKD方案仅利用单光子干涉来生成密钥，这似乎与其他TF-QKD协议颇为不同。本文证明，在SNS TF-QKD协议中，多光子干涉也可对密钥生成作出贡献。据此，提出了一种具有更高密钥率的改进SNS-TF-QKD方案，其中不仅单光子发射事件，双光子发射事件也被视为有效事件。

Abstract (English)
The twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) protocol has led to extensive investigation for its capacity of overcoming the rate-distance limit. One variant for TF-QKD named sending-or-not-sending (SNS) TF-QKD has also been proposed. The SNS-TF-QKD encodes the classical keys 0 and 1 in sending or not sending the phase-randomized coherent states, which helps it to tolerate large misalignment errors due to optical phase fluctuations. Nevertheless, the original SNS-TF-QKD scheme utilizes only single-photon interference in generating secret keys, which seems quite different from other TF-QKD protocols. In this paper, we prove that multiphoton interference in the SNS TF-QKD protocol can also contribute to key generation. Accordingly, an improved SNS-TF-QKD scheme with higher key rate is proposed, where events of not only single-photon but also two-photon emissions are considered as effective events.

基于被动诱骗态的双场量子密钥分发Twin-field quantum key distribution with passive-decoy state

提出将双场量子密钥分发与被动诱骗态方法相结合，以规避主动调制光衰减器带来的侧信道风险；仿真表明其密钥率与主动诱骗方案相当，且仅需少量光子探测器即可获得令人满意的密钥率。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体，例如相位匹配QKD、发送或不发送QKD以及无相位后选择TF-QKD，有望在长距离上实现高密钥率，从而无需中继器即可突破速率-距离极限。这些协议的安全性证明基于诱骗态方法，而在实际实验中，诱骗态方法通常通过主动调制可变光衰减器并结合随机数发生器来实现；然而，这类主动诱骗方案可能引入侧信道，从而打开安全漏洞。为增强TF-QKD的源端安全性，本文提出基于被动诱骗态的TF-QKD，即将TF-QKD与被动诱骗方法相结合。我们通过仿真将其密钥生成率与主动诱骗情形进行比较，结果表明该方案的表现与主动诱骗TF-QKD一样好，并且仅需少量光子探测器即可达到令人满意的密钥率。这表明我们的工作具有实际意义。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Twin-Field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variants, e.g. phase-maching QKD, sending-or-not-sending QKD, and no phase post-selection TFQKD promise high key rates at long distance to beat the rate distance limit without a repeater. The security proof of these protocols are based on decoy-state method, which is usually performed by actively modulating a variable optical attenuator together with a random number generator in practical experiments, however, active-decoy schemes like this may lead to side channel and could open a security loophole. To enhance the source security of TF-QKD, in this paper, we propose passive-decoy based TF-QKD, in which we combine TF-QKD with the passive-decoy method. And we present a simulation comparing the key generation rate with that in active-decoy, the result shows our scheme performs as good as active decoy TF-QKD, and our scheme could reach satisfactory secret key rates with just a few photon detectors. This shows our work is meaningful in practice.

实际器件缺陷对弱相干态 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉性能的影响Realistic Device Imperfections Affect the Performance of Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference With Weak Coherent States

分析分束比偏差、探测器效率失配、入射脉冲强度不一致等器件缺陷对 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉可见度的影响，并以计入雪崩历史的非马尔可夫模型刻画 InGaAs 雪崩光电二极管的后脉冲效应，发现后脉冲比其他缺陷影响更大。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是一种有前景且实用的远程密钥共享协议，其中测量端的 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）型干涉为抵御针对测量设备的恶意攻击提供了一种简单而经济的方式。由于 HOM 干涉在很大程度上决定了 MDI QKD 系统的性能，其在实际情形下的干涉行为值得研究。本工作分析了存在若干实际缺陷时的 HOM 可见度，例如分束比偏差、探测器的探测效率失配、两路入射脉冲强度不一致。特别地，我们采用非马尔可夫模型讨论了 InGaAs 雪崩光电二极管探测器的后脉冲效应，其中考虑了雪崩历史，为后脉冲分析提供了新的、更准确的视角。仿真结果表明，实际情形下的后脉冲效应对 HOM 性能的影响大于其他缺陷。这些结果体现了其在实际高速 MDI QKD 系统以及其他基于光纤的 HOM 应用中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a promising and practical protocol for remote secret sharing, where the Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) type interference in the measurement side provides a simple and economic way to resist malicious attacks on the measurement devices. Because the HOM interference greatly indicates the performance of MDI QKD system, its interferential behavior in practical situations deserve to be studied. In this work, we analyzed HOM visibility with several practical imperfections, such as the deviation of the beam splitting ratio, detection efficiency mismatch of detectors, inconsistent intensities of two incident pulses. In particular, we discussed the afterpulse effect of InGaAs avalanche photodiode detectors with a non-Markovian model, where we take the avalanche history into consideration and provide a new and more accurate perspective for afterpulse analysis. Simulation results indicate that the afterpulse effect in practical situation has a greater impact on the HOM performance than other imperfections. The results exhibit its value in realistic high-speed MDI QKD systems as well as other fiber-based HOM applications.

基于偏振扰乱单元实现参考系无关的测量设备无关量子密钥分发，使安全密钥率对偏振随机扰动与相位参考漂移不敏感，无需校准主参考系；原理验证实验结合改进的波动分析方法验证了其可行性与优势。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是消除所有探测器侧信道攻击的一种有前景的协议。然而，参考系，例如偏振参考和相位参考，其变化会对MDI系统的性能构成严峻威胁。在此，我们基于偏振扰乱单元，演示了一种参考系无关的MDI QKD方案，该方案对易变的信道条件具有内在稳定性；因此，最终安全密钥率将对偏振的随机扰动和相位参考的漂移不敏感。这样，我们的方案从根本上免除了对主要参考系的校准，从而实质上减少了潜在漏洞以及整个系统的资源消耗。此外，我们还展示了采用改进的波动分析方法的原理验证实验，以验证所提出方案的可行性和优势。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a promising protocol for removing all detector side channel attacks. However, the variation of reference frames, e.g., polarization and phase reference, would be an acute threat to the performance of MDI systems. Here, based on polarization scrambling units, we demonstrate a reference-frame-independent MDI QKD scheme that is inherently stable against volatile channel conditions; therefore, the final secure key rate will be insensitive to the random disturbances of polarization and the drifts of phase reference. Thus, calibrations of the primary reference frames are intrinsically removed in our scheme, which essentially reduces potential vulnerabilities as well as the resource consumption of the whole system. In addition, a proof-of-principle experiment with an improved fluctuation analysis method is demonstrated to verify the feasibility and advantages of the proposed scheme.

Chao Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于未表征编码的实验测量设备无关量子密钥分发Experimental measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with uncharacterized encoding

利用失配基统计完成首个编码源未经表征的测量设备无关量子密钥分发原理验证实验，编码态只需限定在二维希尔伯特空间，即使通信双方不清楚编码态细节也能抵御态制备缺陷，系统获得正的安全密钥率。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是利用不可信测量设备共享密钥的一种有效方式。然而，在这一前景广阔的协议中，对编码态表征的假设仍然是必要的，这可能在现实实现中导致不必要的复杂性和潜在漏洞。在此，我们利用失配基统计，首次给出了编码源未经表征的MDI QKD原理验证实验。在该演示中，编码态仅需被约束在二维希尔伯特空间内，即使两个相距遥远的参与方（Alice和Bob）完全不知道其编码态的详细信息，也能抵御态制备缺陷。我们系统所获得的正的最终安全密钥率表明了这种新协议的可行性，并证明了其在与未经表征设备进行安全通信应用中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is an efficient way to share secrets using untrusted measurement devices. However, the assumption on the characterizations of encoding states is still necessary in this promising protocol, which may lead to unnecessary complexity and potential loopholes in realistic implementations. Here, by using the mismatched-basis statistics, we present the first proof-of-principle experiment of MDI QKD with uncharacterized encoding sources. In this demonstration, the encoded states are only required to be constrained in a two-dimensional Hilbert space, and two distant parties (Alice and Bob) are resistant to state preparation flaws even if they have no idea about the detailed information of their encoding states. The positive final secure key rates of our system exhibit the feasibility of this novel protocol, and demonstrate its value for the application of secure communication with uncharacterized devices.

随机数产生系统中熵提取效率的分析研究Analysis of entropy extraction efficiencies in random number generation systems

系统梳理并比较了基于辐射或光子到达时间的几种随机性提取方案，分析其鲁棒性、后处理需求与提取效率，为构建高效、紧凑且稳健的物理随机数发生器提供依据。

随机数（RN）在众多领域都有应用：彩票游戏、赌博、计算机模拟，以及最重要的——密码学 [N. Gisin 等，Rev. Mod. Phys. 74 (2002) 145]。在密码学理论中，系统的理论安全性要求使用高质量的随机数。因此，发展能够以足够速度产生不可预测随机数的方法，是一个有吸引力的课题。早期，尽管缺乏理论支持，由算法方法产生的伪随机数表现良好，能够满足合理的统计要求。然而，在实际实现中，这些伪随机序列完全由数学公式和初始种子决定，无法引入额外的熵或信息。在这种情况下，所产生的“随机”比特根本不随机。与算法方法不同，物理随机数发生器（RNG）基于不可预测的物理随机现象，因而引起了大量研究兴趣。然而，从这些物理熵源中提取随机比特的方式，对系统的效率和性能有很大影响。该文回顾并讨论了几种基于辐射或光子到达时间的随机性提取方案，分析了这些方法的鲁棒性、后处理需求，特别是提取效率，以帮助构建高效、紧凑且稳健的物理 RNG 系统。

Abstract (English)
Random numbers (RNs) have applications in many areas: lottery games, gambling, computer simulation, and, most importantly, cryptography [N. Gisin et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 74 (2002) 145]. In cryptography theory, the theoretical security of the system calls for high quality RNs. Therefore, developing methods for producing unpredictable RNs with adequate speed is an attractive topic. Early on, despite the lack of theoretical support, pseudo RNs generated by algorithmic methods performed well and satisfied reasonable statistical requirements. However, as implemented, those pseudorandom sequences were completely determined by mathematical formulas and initial seeds, which cannot introduce extra entropy or information. In these cases, “random” bits are generated that are not at all random. Physical random number generators (RNGs), which, in contrast to algorithmic methods, are based on unpredictable physical random phenomena, have attracted considerable research interest. However, the way that we extract random bits from those physical entropy sources has a large influence on the efficiency and performance of the system. In this manuscript, we will review and discuss several randomness extraction schemes that are based on radiation or photon arrival times. We analyze the robustness, post-processing requirements and, in particular, the extraction efficiency of those methods to aid in the construction of efficient, compact and robust physical RNG systems.

无需相位参考的测量设备无关量子密钥分发实验Phase-Reference-Free Experiment of Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution

提出相位编码的参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发方案，两个远距离干涉仪之间无需相位对准，在 20 km 光纤、1 MHz 系统上获得 8.309 bps 的平均安全密钥率。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是朝着在远程合法用户（Alice 与 Bob）之间实现实用信息论安全密钥共享迈出的实质性一步。与其他标准的设备相关量子密钥分发协议（如 BB84）一样，MDI QKD 假定 Alice 与 Bob 之间已经共享了参考系。在实践中，往往需要复杂的对准流程，这会占用系统资源并可能显著降低安全密钥生成率。在此，我们提出了一种相位编码的参考系无关 MDI QKD 方案，它不需要两个相距遥远的合法方干涉仪之间的任何相位对准。作为演示，我们给出了使用法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的原理性验证实验。实验系统工作在 1 MHz，在 Alice 与 Bob 之间光纤长度为 20 km 时获得了 8.309 bps 的平均安全密钥率。该系统在正常情况下无需相位补偿即可维持正的密钥生成率。结果显示了我们的系统用于成熟 MDI QKD 器件的可行性及其在网络场景中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a substantial step toward practical information-theoretic security for key sharing between remote legitimate users (Alice and Bob). As with other standard device-dependent quantum key distribution protocols, such as BB84, MDI QKD assumes that the reference frames have been shared between Alice and Bob. In practice, a nontrivial alignment procedure is often necessary, which requires system resources and may significantly reduce the secure key generation rate. Here, we propose a phase-coding reference-frame-independent MDI QKD scheme that requires no phase alignment between the interferometers of two distant legitimate parties. As a demonstration, a proof-of-principle experiment using Faraday-Michelson interferometers is presented. The experimental system worked at 1 MHz, and an average secure key rate of 8.309 bps was obtained at a fiber length of 20 km between Alice and Bob. The system can maintain a positive key generation rate without phase compensation under normal conditions. The results exhibit the feasibility of our system for use in mature MDI QKD devices and its value for network scenarios.

Chao Wang, Xiao-Tian Song, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Chun-Mei Zhang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉构建大规模全连接量子网络，利用集成孤子微梳与光子编码芯片实现大规模并行频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉和MDI量子密钥分发，在200 km范围、不可信网络提供商条件下仍保证严格的信息论安全性。

全连接量子网络可使每个用户同时与其他所有用户相连，是一种高度通用且鲁棒的组网架构。然而，此类网络的可扩展性在实用化应用中仍是巨大挑战。本文基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉构建了一个大规模全连接量子网络，即使网络提供商不可信，用户与用户之间的安全性仍能得到保证。利用集成孤子微梳（SMC）和光子编码芯片，我们实现了精确且大规模并行的频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉以及测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发。所提出的架构可在不可信网络提供商的条件下，实现跨越200公里的、具有严格信息论安全性的全连接量子网络。该组网架构为构建覆盖城域与城际的大规模全连接MDI量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Fully connected quantum networks enable simultaneous connection of every user to every other user and are a highly versatile and robust networking architecture. However, the scalability of such networks remains a great challenge for practical applications. Here we construct a large-scale fully connected quantum network founded on two-photon Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference, where user-to-user security is guaranteed even with an untrusted network provider. Using integrated soliton microcomb (SMC) and photonic encoding chips, we realize precise, massively parallel frequency generation and locking, high-visibility HOM interference and measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution. The proposed architecture enables a fully connected quantum network over 200 kilometers with strict information-theoretic security via an untrusted network provider. The implemented networking architecture paves the way for large-scale fully connected MDI quantum networks across metropolitan and intercity regions.

面向可组合量子网络的混合高维量子密钥分发Hybrid High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution for a Composable Quantum Network

通过发展多自由度映射方法，提出并实现了量子比特误码率低至0.57%的高维量子密钥分发系统，可稳定获得高安全密钥率，并能互联不同自由度编码的终端。

高维量子密钥分发（HD-QKD）具有更强的抗噪能力和更高的安全密钥率。在本工作中，我们通过发展一种多自由度（DOF）映射方法，提出并实现了一套量子比特误码率低至0.57%的HD-QKD系统。该系统能够稳定实现高安全密钥率，并且具有可组合性，从而可以构建兼容多种自由度的HD量子网络。结果表明，所提方案能够桥接编码于不同自由度的HD终端与二维终端，并可支撑高性能量子网络的大规模部署。我们的工作显著提升了HD-QKD的性能，并以混合方式增强了大规模量子网络的实际应用能力。

Abstract (English)
High-dimensional quantum key distribution (HD-QKD) possesses a higher noise-tolerance ability and secure key rate. In the work presented here, by developing a mapping method for multiple degrees of freedom (DOFs), we propose and implement a HD-QKD system with a quantum bit error rate as low as 0.57%. Our HD-QKD system can stably achieve high secure key rates and is composable, allowing one to build HD quantum networks compatible with multiple DOFs. The results indicate that the proposed scheme could bridge HD and two-dimensional terminals encoded in different DOFs and could support large-scale deployment of quantum networks with high performance. Our work significantly enhances the performance of HD-QKD and strengthens the practical applications of large-scale quantum networks in a hybrid way.

No. 03

利用时间鬼成像感知量子密钥分发中的量子黑客攻击Perceiving Quantum Hacking for Quantum Key Distribution Using Temporal Ghost Imaging

提出用时间鬼成像获取量子信号、量子信道与QKD系统的时间指纹，从而感知量子黑客攻击，并实验验证了其有效性，从信号与系统视角为提升实际安全性提供通用途径。

量子密钥分发（QKD）能够利用量子力学在远程用户之间生成安全密钥比特。然而，理论模型与实际实现之间的差距为窃听者提供了截获密钥的机会。最隐蔽的攻击被称为量子黑客攻击，即利用QKD系统的边信道漏洞使测量结果没有明显偏差的攻击。刻画量子信号、量子信道和QKD系统的全时间尺度特性，可以为合法用户提供击败恶意攻击的额外能力。这里，我们提出一种利用时间鬼成像（TGI）方案、以时间指纹感知量子黑客攻击的方法，并实验验证了其有效性。该方案从信号与系统的独特视角，提供了一条提升QKD实际安全性的通用途径。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can generate secure key bits between remote users with quantum mechanics. However, the gap between the theoretical model and practical realizations gives eavesdroppers opportunities to intercept the secret key. The most insidious attacks, known as quantum hacking, are the ones with no significant discrepancy of the measurement results using side-channel loopholes of QKD systems. Depicting full-time-scale characteristics of the quantum signals, the quantum channel, and the QKD system can provide legitimate users extra capabilities to defeat malicious attacks. Here, we propose the method exploring a temporal ghost-imaging (TGI) scheme to perceive quantum hacking with temporal fingerprints and experimentally verify its validity. The scheme presents a common approach to promote QKD's practical security from a unique perspective of signals and systems.

该工作把微腔耗散克尔孤子用作GHz量子密钥分发系统的光源，并借助其相干梳线实现了并行量子密钥分发，验证了利用片上孤子数百个载波开展大规模并行高速成码的可行性。

量子密钥分发（QKD）能够在量子力学原理的保证下，在远程合法用户之间分发对称密钥比特。对于实际应用，人们越来越关注将光源、探测器和调制器集成在光子芯片上。该工作将克尔耗散孤子引入微谐振腔，作为GHz量子密钥分发系统的光源；原理性实验表明，利用孤子的相干梳线可以实现并行量子密钥分发。该工作还使用现成的波分复用模块和片上孤子光源验证了并行QKD的性能。由于片上孤子可以提供覆盖C波段和L波段的数百个载波，这些结果表明，通过大规模并行QKD实现超高安全密钥率是可行的，尤其是在与蓬勃发展的光子集成电路技术相结合时。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) can distribute symmetric key bits between remote legitimate users with the guarantee of quantum mechanics principles. For practical applications, there is increasing attention to integrating the source, detectors, and modulators on a photonic chip. Here, the Kerr dissipative soliton is introduced in a microresonator as the light source for GHz QKD systems, and the proof‐of‐principle experiment demonstrates the parallel QKD can be achieved using coherent comb lines from the soliton. The performance of parallel QKD is also verified by using the off‐the‐shelf wavelength division modules and the on‐chip soliton source. Since the on‐chip soliton can provide hundreds of carriers covering the C and L bands, the results exhibit the feasibility to achieve ultra‐high rate secure key bits through massively parallel QKD, especially when incorporated with the thriving photonic integrated circuit technology.

利用不同自由度间的态映射刻画高质量高维量子密钥分发Characterizing High-Quality High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution by State Mapping Between Different Degrees of Freedom

利用轨道角动量与自旋这两个自由度之间的非干涉态映射，同时解决高维量子密钥分发中高维态制备与传输的技术难题，为实用化高维量子密钥分发系统提供了可行路径。

在量子安全通信中，利用高维（HD）资源是提高安全密钥率的重要手段，尤其在量子密钥分发（QKD）中更是如此。然而，由于高维态制备、传输与测量方面的技术困难，高维量子密钥分发（HDQKD）一直远离实际应用。本研究通过实现光子不同自由度——轨道角动量与自旋——之间的态映射方法，解决了前两个问题。这种非干涉的态映射方法对实用 HDQKD 系统具有直接影响。

Abstract (English)
In quantum secure communication, using high-dimensional (HD) resources is an important approach to increasing the secure key rate, especially in quantum key distribution (QKD). However, high-dimensional quantum key distribution (HDQKD) has remained far from practical applications, due to the technical difficulties in HD state preparation, transmission, and measurement. This study solves the first two issues by realizing a state-mapping approach between different degrees of freedom of a photon: orbital angular momentum and spin. This noninterferometric state-mapping approach offers immediate impact on practical HDQKD systems.

基于道威棱镜的单路Sagnac干涉仪操控轨道角动量光子Single-path Sagnac interferometer with Dove prism for orbital-angular-momentum photon manipulation

分析道威棱镜的偏振依赖效应对单路Sagnac干涉仪的影响，并提出仅需增加两片半波片的改进结构，理论上分束保真度可达100%且与输入偏振及棱镜传输矩阵无关，实验保真度提高约5%~10%。

轨道角动量（OAM）的量子数可以无限大，因而成为高维量子信息处理中的重要资源。道威棱镜（DP）是操控OAM光束最常用的工具。然而，道威棱镜会改变光子态的偏振，从而降低干涉仪的分束保真度。本工作分析了在使用分束器（BS）和偏振分束器（PBS）的常规单路Sagnac干涉仪（SPSI）中，道威棱镜对OAM光操控的偏振依赖效应。结果表明，BS型SPSI对输入偏振和道威棱镜的具体参数更为敏感。我们还提出并实现了一种改进的BS型SPSI，其分束保真度原则上可达100%，并且不依赖于输入偏振和道威棱镜的传输矩阵。实验表明，改进型BS型SPSI的保真度比常规结构高约5%~10%。改进型BS型SPSI易于实现（只需额外两片半波片），并能在自由运行条件下保持数小时量级的稳定。这些优点使该结构适合用于量子密码等关键量子信息处理任务。

Abstract (English)
Orbital angular momentum (OAM) is an important resource in high-dimensional quantum information processing, as its quantum number can be infinite. Dove prism (DP) is a most common tool to manipulate OAM light. However, the Dove prism changes the polarization of the photon states and decreases the sorting fidelity of the interferometer. In this work, we analyze the polarization-dependent effect of the DP on OAM light manipulation in the normal single-path Sagnac interferometers (SPSIs) with beam splitter (BS) and polarizing beam splitter (PBS). The results demonstrate that the BS SPSI is more sensitive to the input polarization and the specific parameters of the DP. We have also proposed and realized a modified BS SPSI, of which the sorting fidelity can be 100% in principle and is independent on the input polarization and the transmission matrix of the DP. The experiments demonstrate that the fidelity of the modified BS SPSI is about 5%~10% higher than that of the normal one. The modified BS SPSI is easy to implement (only two more half-wave plates are required) and is stable for free running at the scale of several hours. These merits make the structure suitable for applications in critical quantum information processing tasks, such as quantum cryptography.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Ya-Ping Li, Guo-Wei Zhang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

不破坏光子态的可扩展轨道角动量分选Scalable orbital-angular-momentum sorting without destroying photon states

提出由对称多端口分束器与道威棱镜级联构成的可扩展轨道角动量分选器，可同时分辨不同 OAM 态并保持轨道与自旋角动量，大幅减少高维分选所需的分束器数量。

携带轨道角动量（OAM）的单光子已引起研究人员的广泛关注。理论上单个光子可以携带无限多的 OAM 值。因此，OAM 光子态已被广泛用于量子信息和基础量子力学研究。尽管已有许多对不同 OAM 值量子态进行分选的方法，但高维 OAM 的无损高效分选仍是一项基本挑战。在此，我们提出一种可扩展的 OAM 分选器，能够同时分类不同的 OAM 态，同时保持轨道角动量和自旋角动量。该分选器的基本单元由对称多端口分束器（BS）和具有级联结构的道威棱镜组成，原则上可以灵活有效地组合，以分选任意高维 OAM 光子。这里提出的可扩展结构大大减少了分选高维 OAM 态所需的分束器数量。鉴于其无损和可扩展的特性，该分选器不仅可作为高维量子信息处理的基本器件，也可用于传统光学。

Abstract (English)
Single photons with orbital angular momentum (OAM) have attracted substantial attention from researchers. A single photon can carry infinite OAM values theoretically. Thus, OAM photon states have been widely used in quantum information and fundamental quantum mechanics. Although there have been many methods for sorting quantum states with different OAM values, the nondestructive and efficient sorter of high-dimensional OAM remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we propose a scalable OAM sorter which can categorize different OAM states simultaneously, meanwhile, preserving both OAM and spin angular momentum. Fundamental elements of the sorter are composed of symmetric multiport beam splitters (BSs) and Dove prisms with cascading structure, which in principle can be flexibly and effectively combined to sort arbitrarily high-dimensional OAM photons. The scalable structures proposed here greatly reduce the number of BSs required for sorting high-dimensional OAM states. In view of the nondestructive and extensible features, the sorters can be used as fundamental devices not only for high-dimensional quantum information processing, but also for traditional optics.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.94.033847

No. 08

单光子雪崩探测器后脉冲效应的非马尔可夫特性Non-Markovian Property of Afterpulsing Effect in Single-Photon Avalanche Detector

实测商用InGaAs/InP单光子雪崩二极管，证明后脉冲并非只由前一次点火雪崩决定，而具有雪崩历史记忆效应，后脉冲概率随点火雪崩脉冲数增加而上升，为高计数率器件工艺与后脉冲评估提供依据。

单光子雪崩光电二极管（SPAD）已被广泛用于量子光学研究。后脉冲效应是SPAD的固有特性，在大多数实验中都会影响系统性能，需要谨慎处理。长期以来，人们一直假定后脉冲由前一次点火雪崩所决定。我们研究了一只商用InGaAs/InP SPAD（雪崩光电二极管型号：Princeton Lightwave PGA-300）的后脉冲效应，证明其后脉冲具有非马尔可夫性，即在雪崩历史中存在记忆效应。理论分析与实验结果表明，这种记忆效应的体现就是后脉冲概率：它随点火雪崩脉冲数目的增加而增大。这一结论使后脉冲效应的原理更加清晰，对高计数率SPAD的制造工艺与后脉冲评估具有指导意义，也可以作为量子通信、量子随机数产生等应用中处理后脉冲信号的基本前提。

Abstract (English)
The single-photon avalanche photodiode (SPAD) has been widely used in research on quantum optics. The afterpulsing effect, which is an intrinsic character of SPAD, affects the system performance in most experiments and needs to be carefully handled. For a long time, afterpulsing has been presumed to be determined by the pre-ignition avalanche. We studied the afterpulsing effect of a commercial InGaAs/InP SPAD (The avalanche photodiode model is: Princeton Lightwave PGA-300) and demonstrated that its afterpulsing is non-Markovian, with a memory effect in the avalanching history. Theoretical analysis and experimental results clearly indicate that the embodiment of this memory effect is the afterpulsing probability, which increases as the number of ignition-avalanche pulses increase. This conclusion makes the principle of the afterpulsing effect clearer and is instructive to the manufacturing processes and afterpulsing evaluation of high-count-rate SPADs. It can also be regarded as a fundamental premise to handle the afterpulsing signals in many applications, such as quantum communication and quantum random number generation.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Ya-Ping Li, De-Yong He, Chao Wang, Yun-Guang Han, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Zheng-Fu Han

基于雪崩光电二极管的鲁棒量子随机数发生器Robust Quantum Random Number Generator Based on Avalanche Photodiodes

利用雪崩光电二极管的雪崩脉冲配合简单的时间仓编码高效提取器，在室温下实现真量子随机数产生，对脉冲强度与温度等慢变噪声具有鲁棒性，双管方案速率达 0.69 Mb/s。

我们提出并演示了一种在室温下实现高效真量子随机数发生器（RNG）的方案。该方案采用简单的时间仓编码方法构成有效提取器，把雪崩光电二极管（APD）的雪崩脉冲转换为高质量随机数，且对脉冲强度涨落、温度波动等慢变噪声具有鲁棒性。该方案可兼容光源，但光源并非必需，因此系统的鲁棒性得到有效增强。该原理性系统的随机比特产生速率为：双 APD 情形 0.69 Mb/s，单 APD 情形 0.34 Mb/s。结果表明，基于该方案的高速随机数发生器芯片有望借助可集成的 APD 阵列实现。

Abstract (English)
We propose and demonstrate a scheme to realize a high-efficiency truly quantum random number generator (RNG) at room temperature. Using an effective extractor with simple time bin encoding method, the avalanche pulses of avalanche photodiode (APD) are converted into high-quality random numbers that are robust to slow varying noise such as fluctuations of pulse intensity and temperature. A light source is compatible but not necessary in this scheme. Therefor the robustness of the system is effective enhanced. The random bits generation rate of this proof-of-principle system is 0.69 Mb/s with double APDs and 0.34 Mb/s with single APD. The results indicate that a high-speed RNG chip based on the scheme is potentially available with an integrable APD array.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Chao Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Fu-Sheng Lv, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

广义高维量子密钥分发的紧致有限密钥分析Tight finite-key analysis for generalized high-dimensional quantum key distribution

引入“密钥分类”思想并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系发展相关技术，给出了适用于广义高维量子密钥分发协议的紧致有限密钥分析，使有限资源条件下的高维协议在实验上成为可行。

由于能够容忍较高的误码率并在每次试验中产生更多密钥比特，高维量子密钥分发引起了广泛兴趣。尽管高维量子密钥分发已取得很大进展，理论与实验之间仍存在一些差距。其中之一是密钥的安全性严重依赖于发射信号的数量。迄今为止，现有的安全性证明仅适用于发射信号数量为无穷大或不切实际地大的情形。在此，我们通过引入“密钥分类”的思想，并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系发展相关技术，提出了一种适用于广义高维量子密钥分发协议的紧致有限密钥分析。得益于我们的理论，具有有限资源的高维量子密钥分发协议在实验上变得可行。

Abstract (English)
Due to the capability of tolerating high error rate and generating more key bits per trial, high-dimensional quantum key distribution attracts wide interest.Despite great progresses in high-dimensional quantum key distribution, there are still some gaps between theory and experiment.One of these is that the security of the secret key heavily depends on the number of the emitted signals.So far, the existing security proofs are only suitable in the case with an infinite or unpractically large number of emitted signals.Here, by introducing the idea of "key classification" and developing relevant techniques based on the uncertainty relation for smooth entropies, we propose a tight finite-key analysis suitable for generalized high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocols.Benefitting from our theory, high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocols with finite resources become experimentally feasible.

Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hang Liu, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Research

10.1103/PhysRevResearch.3.023019

No. 02

基于离散化全局相位的双场量子密钥分发优化协议Optimized protocol for twin-field quantum key distribution

★Commun. Phys.

将编码模式中全局相位的数目离散化，由此统一了前两类双场量子密钥分发协议，并揭示增加离散相位数目可延长可达距离，但短距离密钥率会因相位后选择而下降。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体协议极具吸引力，因为它们具有克服点对点 QKD 协议密钥率-损耗极限的优势。对于 TF-QKD 的各种变体而言，确保安全性的关键在于在编码模式与测试模式之间随机切换。在所有 TF-QKD 协议中，它们的编码模式差别很大，例如调制连续相位、仅调制两个相反相位，以及发送或不发送信号脉冲。在这里我们表明，通过对编码模式中全局相位的数目进行离散化，我们可以对前两类 TF-QKD 协议给出统一的视角，并证明增加离散相位的数目可以延长可达距离；而作为权衡，由于相位后选择，短距离下的密钥率会降低。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variant protocols are highly attractive due to the advantage of overcoming the rate-loss limit for secret key rates of point-to-point QKD protocols. For variations of TF-QKD, the key point to ensure security is switching randomly between a code mode and a test mode. Among all TF-QKD protocols, their code modes are very different, e.g. modulating continuous phases, modulating only two opposite phases, and sending or not sending signal pulses. Here we show that, by discretizing the number of global phases in the code mode, we can give a unified view on the first two types of TF-QKD protocols, and demonstrate that increasing the number of discrete phases extends the achievable distance, and as a trade-off, lowers the secret key rate at short distances due to the phase post-selection.

Communications Physics

10.1038/s42005-020-00415-0

单光子轮询差分正交相移量子密钥分发的安全性证明Security proof for single-photon round-robin differential-quadrature-phase-shift quantum key distribution

给出单光子RRDQPS协议的安全性证明，表明采用单光子源时可容忍误码率优于原始RRDPS协议，并建立统一理论把BB84协议涵盖为特例。

将差分正交相移（DQPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议与近期提出的轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议相结合，人们提出了轮询差分正交相移（RRDQPS）协议。然而，RRDQPS QKD协议的安全性证明仍然缺失，它相对于原始RRDPS协议的优势也尚不清楚。这里我们给出了单光子RRDQPS协议的安全性证明，借此清楚地表明：若采用单光子源，RRDQPS协议在可容忍误码率方面将优于原始RRDPS协议。更有趣的是，我们的证明给出了一个统一理论，涵盖著名的Bennett-Brassard 1984（BB84）协议与RRDQPS协议。由此确认，BB84协议确实是RRDQPS协议的一个特例。

Abstract (English)
Combining the differential-quadrature-phase-shift (DQPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol and the recently proposed round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS), the round-robin-differential-quadrature-phase-shift (RRDQPS) protocol has been proposed. However, a security proof of the RRDQPS QKD protocol is still missing and its advantage over the original RRDPS protocol is also unknown. Here, we give the security proof of single-photon RRDQPS protocol, by which we clearly show that, if a single photon source is applied, RRDQPS protocol will overwhelm the original RRDPS protocol in terms of tolerable error rate. More interestingly, our proof gives a unified theory covering the well-known Bennett-Brassard 1984 (BB84) protocol and RRDQPS protocol. Thus, it is confirmed that BB84 protocol is indeed a special case of the RRDQPS protocol.

Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Chao-han Cui, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

带信号扰动监测的轮询差分相移量子密钥分发Round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution with monitoring signal disturbance

模拟研究了同时用诱骗态与误码率统计监测信号扰动时的RRDPS协议，发现在典型实验参数下采用无穷诱骗态时其信道长度可超过BB84协议，而仅需两个诱骗态和一个信号态即可逼近该性能。

近年来，轮询差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）因其独特性质而备受关注，即无需获知比特误码率即可界定信息泄露。尽管RRDPS QKD已取得突破，但在监测信号扰动（例如同时使用诱骗态和误码率统计）时其表现如何仍是一个问题。这里，我们通过模拟研究了监测信号扰动情况下的RRDPS协议。令人兴奋的是，当采用无穷诱骗态方法时，在典型实验参数下RRDPS协议在信道长度方面可以优于常用的Bennett和Brassard 1984（BB84）协议。在有限诱骗态情形下，我们发现仅需两个诱骗态和一个信号态就足以获得非常接近无穷诱骗态情形的性能。我们的模拟证明，RRDPS在实际情况下是一种具有竞争力的协议。

Abstract (English)
In recent years, round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) has attracted great attention for its unique characteristics, i.e., the information leakage can be bounded without learning bit error rate. Though the RRDPS QKD has made a breakthrough, it is still a question of how RRDPS will perform with monitoring signal disturbance, e.g., decoy-state and error rate statistics are both used. Here, we present simulations to study RRDPS protocol while monitoring signal disturbance. To our excitement, when using the infinite decoy-states method, RRDPS protocol can outperform the commonly used Bennett and Brassard 1984 (BB84) protocol in terms of channel length under typical experimental parameters. In the case of finite decoy states, we find that only two decoy-states and one signal state are sufficient to obtain performance very close to the infinite decoy-states case. Our simulations prove that RRDPS is a competitive protocol in real-life situations.

Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

离散相位随机化量子密钥分发的有限码长分析Finite-Key Analysis for Quantum Key Distribution with Discrete-Phase Randomization

针对实验难以实现连续相位随机化的问题，基于共轭测量与量子态区分首次给出离散相位随机化双场量子密钥分发的有限码长安全性证明，指出取8个离散相位即可获得满意性能，但有限尺寸效应更显著。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个远程用户能够共享信息论安全的密钥。许多QKD协议假设编码态的相位可以在0到2π范围内连续随机化，然而这在实验中可能难以成立。最近提出的双场（TF）QKD尤其如此，它因能显著提高密钥率、甚至突破某些理论上的速率-损耗极限而备受关注。作为直观的解决方案，可以采用离散相位随机化替代连续随机化。然而，针对采用离散相位随机化的QKD协议，有限码长区域的安全性证明仍然缺失。这里，我们发展了一种基于共轭测量与量子态区分的技术，用于分析这种情况下的安全性。结果表明，TF-QKD采用合理数目的离散随机相位，例如来自{0,π/4,π/2,…,7π/4}的8个相位，即可获得令人满意的性能。另一方面，我们发现有限尺寸效应比以往更加显著，这意味着此时应发射更多脉冲。更重要的是，作为TF-QKD在有限码长区域采用离散相位随机化的首个证明，我们的方法同样适用于其他QKD协议。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) allows two remote parties to share information-theoretic secret keys. Many QKD protocols assume the phase of encoding state can be continuous randomized from 0 to 2π, which, however, may be questionable in the experiment. This is particularly the case in the recently proposed twin-field (TF) QKD, which has received a lot of attention since it can increase the key rate significantly and even beat some theoretical rate-loss limits. As an intuitive solution, one may introduce discrete-phase randomization instead of continuous randomization. However, a security proof for a QKD protocol with discrete-phase randomization in the finite-key region is still missing. Here, we develop a technique based on conjugate measurement and quantum state distinguishment to analyze the security in this case. Our results show that TF-QKD with a reasonable number of discrete random phases, e.g., 8 phases from {0,π/4,π/2,…,7π/4}, can achieve satisfactory performance. On the other hand, we find the finite-size effects become more notable than before, which implies that more pulses should be emit in this case. More importantly, as a the first proof for TF-QKD with discrete-phase randomization in the finite-key region, our method is also applicable in other QKD protocols.

Rui-Qiang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Xiao-Hang Jin, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

结合优势蒸馏的相位匹配量子密钥分发Phase-matching quantum key distribution with advantage distillation

在相位匹配量子密钥分发的量子通信环节之后加入优势蒸馏步骤，通过把原始密钥切分为仅含数比特的小块来筛选高度相关的比特对，从而容忍较大的系统失配误差，并显著提升安全密钥率与传输距离。

相位匹配量子密钥分发（PM-QKD）为在没有量子中继器的条件下超越基本的速率—距离极限提供了一种有前景的方案。本文将额外的优势蒸馏（AD）步骤插入量子通信之后，以提升 PM-QKD 的性能。仿真结果表明，通过把原始密钥切分为仅含几个比特的块，从而识别出高度相关的比特对，AD 方法能够容忍较高的系统失配误差，并显著提高安全密钥率和传输距离，这在当前的 PM-QKD 系统中非常有前景。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Phase-matching quantum key distribution (PM-QKD) provides a promising solution to surpass the fundamental rate–distance bound without quantum repeaters. In this paper, we insert an additional advantage distillation (AD) step after quantum communication to improve the performance of PM-QKD. Simulation results show that, by splitting the raw key into blocks of only a few bits so as to identify highly correlated bit pairs, the AD method can tolerate high system misalignment errors and improve the secret key rate and transmission distance significantly, which is very promising in current PM-QKD systems.

Rui-Qiang Wang, Chun-Mei Zhang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于广义算符支配条件的双场量子密钥分发有限密钥分析Finite-key analysis for twin-field quantum key distribution based on generalized operator dominance condition

针对现有基于算符支配条件的双场QKD有限密钥分析只适用于三诱骗态、无法靠增加诱骗态提升密钥率的局限，设计了新的算符支配条件，使密钥率随诱骗态数目增加而提高并逼近渐近界。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可以帮助两个相距遥远的通信方共享密钥比特，其安全性由物理定律保证。在实际中，QKD协议的密钥率总是随信道距离的增加而降低，这严重限制了QKD的应用。近来，双场（TF）QKD被提出并得到深入研究，因为它能够突破速率-距离极限，并大幅提高QKD可达到的距离。值得注意的是，K. Maeda等人基于算符支配条件提出了一种简单的TF-QKD有限密钥分析。尽管他们证明其方法足以突破速率-距离极限，但其算符支配条件并不具有一般性，即只能应用于三诱骗态情形，这意味着其密钥率无法通过引入更多诱骗态而提高，即使在制备无穷多诱骗态和光脉冲的情况下也无法达到渐近界。为弥补这一空白，我们通过设计新的算符支配条件，提出了改进的TF-QKD有限密钥分析。我们表明，增加诱骗态数目可以进一步提高密钥率并逼近渐近界。我们的理论可直接用于TF-QKD实验以获得更高的密钥率。我们的结果可直接用于实验以获得更高的密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can help two distant peers to share secret key bits, whose security is guaranteed by the law of physics. In practice, the secret key rate of a QKD protocol is always lowered with the increasing of channel distance, which severely limits the applications of QKD. Recently, twin-field (TF) QKD has been proposed and intensively studied, since it can beat the rate-distance limit and greatly increase the achievable distance of QKD. Remarkalebly, K. Maeda et. al. proposed a simple finite-key analysis for TF-QKD based on operator dominance condition. Although they showed that their method is sufficient to beat the rate-distance limit, their operator dominance condition is not general, i.e. it can be only applied in three decoy states scenarios, which implies that its key rate cannot be increased by introducing more decoy states, and also cannot reach the asymptotic bound even in case of preparing infinite decoy states and optical pulses. Here, to bridge this gap, we propose an improved finite-key analysis of TF-QKD through devising new operator dominance condition. We show that by adding the number of decoy states, the secret key rate can be furtherly improved and approach the asymptotic bound. Our theory can be directly used in TF-QKD experiment to obtain higher secret key rate. Our results can be directly used in experiments to obtain higher key rates.

Rui-Qiang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Feng-Yu Lu, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

双场量子密钥分发中的信号处理Signal Processing in Twin-field Quantum Key Distribution

梳理双场量子密钥分发走向实用时的两项信号处理难题，即双场的远程产生与快速相位漂移的完美补偿，并结合包括 833.8 km 光纤实验在内的近期工作，归纳了典型的应对方法与策略。

双场量子密钥分发能够突破线性界限，并有望在更长距离上提供更高的密钥率。但在实现双场协议时，信号处理面临两个主要挑战：一是双场的远程产生，二是快速相位漂移的完美补偿。这里，我们通过分析近期实验，特别是最新的 833.8 km 光纤双场实验，介绍了应对这些挑战的典型方法与策略。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field quantum key distribution can break through the linear bound, and promises higher key rate over longer distance. But there are two main challenges of signal processing when the twin-field protocol is implemented. One is remote generation of twin fields, the other is perfect compensation of the fast phase drift. Here, we introduce the typical methods and strategies to deal with these challenges by analysis of recent experiments, especially the latest twin-field experiment over 833.8 km fiber.

830公里光纤上的双场量子密钥分发Twin-field quantum key distribution over 830-km fibre

★Nat. Photon.

实验实现可容忍超过140 dB信道损耗的双场量子密钥分发系统，安全距离达833.8 km，创下光纤QKD的新纪录，在相近距离上的安全密钥率较此前纪录高出两个数量级以上。

量子密钥分发（QKD）为远程对等方之间基于物理协议共享信息论安全的密钥提供了一种很有前景的解决方案。根据量子物理规律，携带信号的光子不能通过经典光学技术进行放大或中继，否则就无法维持量子安全性。因此，信道的传输损耗限制了其可达距离，这一直是构建大规模量子安全网络的一大障碍。在此，我们展示了一套能够容忍超过140 dB信道损耗的实验QKD系统，实现了833.8 km的安全距离，创造了光纤QKD的新纪录。此外，优化的四相位双场协议和高质量的装置使该系统在相近距离上的安全密钥率比此前纪录高出两个数量级以上。我们的结果标志着朝着在1000 km尺度上构建可靠、高效的地面量子安全网络迈出了突破性的一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides a promising solution for sharing information-theoretic secure keys between remote peers with physics-based protocols. According to the law of quantum physics, the photons carrying signals cannot be amplified or relayed via classical optical techniques to maintain quantum security. As a result, the transmission loss of the channel limits its achievable distance, and this has been a huge barrier towards building large-scale quantum-secure networks. Here we present an experimental QKD system that could tolerate a channel loss beyond 140 dB and obtain a secure distance of 833.8 km, setting a new record for fibre-based QKD. Furthermore, the optimized four-phase twin-field protocol and high-quality set-up make its secure key rate more than two orders of magnitude greater than previous records over similar distances. Our results mark a breakthrough towards building reliable and efficient terrestrial quantum-secure networks over a scale of 1,000 km.

Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Rui-Qiang Wang, Peng Ye, Yao Zhou, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Yong-Gang Zhu, Pavel V. Morozov, Alexander V. Divochiy, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

在原理验证型量子密钥分发系统中突破基础速率—距离极限Beating the Fundamental Rate-Distance Limit in a Proof-of-Principle Quantum Key Distribution System

★Phys. Rev. X

实现了双场量子密钥分发协议的原型系统之一，采用不假设相位后选择的改进方案，在 300 km 光纤上控制双场相位演化，获得高可见度单光子干涉，从而突破无中继协议的线性界并实现稳定高速率成钥。

借助量子密钥分发（QKD），两个相距遥远的通信方能够共享具有信息论安全性的密钥比特。在有损信道中提高密钥率对 QKD 的应用至关重要。然而，已有证明表明存在一个基础的速率—距离极限，称为线性界，它限制了所有现有无中继协议与实现的性能。令人惊讶的是，最近提出的一种称为双场（TF）QKD 的协议无需量子中继即可突破线性界。在此，我们展示了 TF-QKD 协议的首批实现之一，并证明其在 300 km 的信道距离上具有突破线性界的优势。在我们的实验中，采用了一种不假设相位后选择的改进 TF-QKD 协议，因此预期可获得高于原始协议的密钥率。在控制穿越数百公里光纤的双场相位演化之后，所实现的系统获得了高可见度的单光子干涉，并支持稳定、高速率的测量设备无关 QKD。我们的实验演示与结果证实了 TF-QKD 协议的可行性及其在长距离密钥分发服务中的突出优越性。

Abstract (English)
With the help of quantum key distribution (QKD), two distant peers are able to share informationtheoretical secure key bits.Increasing the key rate is ultimately significant for the applications of QKD in the lossy channel.However, it has been proven that there is a fundamental rate-distance limit, called the linear bound, which restricts the performance of all existing repeaterless protocols and realizations.Surprisingly, a recently proposed protocol, called twin-field (TF) QKD, can beat the linear bound with no need for quantum repeaters.Here, we present one of the first implementations of the TF-QKD protocol and demonstrate its advantage of beating the linear bound at a channel distance of 300 km.In our experiment, a modified TF-QKD protocol that does not assume phase postselection is considered, and thus a higher key rate than the original one is expected.After controlling the phase evolution of the twin fields traveling through hundreds of kilometers of optical fibers, the implemented system achieves high-visibility singlephoton interference and allows stable and high-rate measurement-device-independent QKD.Our experimental demonstration and results confirm the feasibility of the TF-QKD protocol and its prominent superiority in long-distance key distribution services.

可抗信道扰动的实用化吉赫兹量子密钥分发系统Practical gigahertz quantum key distribution robust against channel disturbance

提出高速法拉第–萨格纳克–迈克尔逊量子密钥分发系统，可自动补偿信道偏振扰动；在 50 km 光纤、30 Hz 偏振加扰下，24 小时干涉条纹可见度达 99.35%，七天安全密钥率稳定在 306 kbit/s 且无需主动偏振对准。

量子密钥分发（QKD）为安全通信提供了颇具吸引力的解决方案。然而，当 QKD 系统从实验室走向现场时，信道扰动严重限制了其应用。这里提出一种高速法拉第–萨格纳克–迈克尔逊 QKD 系统，可自动补偿信道偏振扰动，从而在很大程度上避免环境突变带来的间歇性限制。在具有 30 Hz 偏振加扰的 50 km 光纤信道上，该相位编码 QKD 系统的实用性得到了表征：24 小时内干涉条纹可见度达 99.35%，并在无需主动偏振对准的情况下，七天里保持 306 kbit/s 的稳定安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides an attractive solution for secure communication. However, channel disturbance severely limits its application when a QKD system is transferred from the laboratory to the field. Here a high-speed Faraday-Sagnac-Michelson QKD system is proposed that can automatically compensate for the channel polarization disturbance, which largely avoids the intermittency limitations of environment mutation. Over a 50 km fiber channel with 30 Hz polarization scrambling, the practicality of this phase-coding QKD system was characterized with an interference fringe visibility of 99.35% over 24 h and a stable secure key rate of 306 k bits/s over seven days without active polarization alignment.

与基于量子比特（qubit）的协议相比，基于qudit的量子密钥分发协议通常允许两个合作方在更高的信道噪声下共享无条件安全密钥。然而一般而言，在基于qudit的协议中制备和测量所需的量子态非常困难。一个例外是近期提出的高容错qudit协议，即Chau15（Chau 2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324）。值得注意的是，该协议中的态制备与测量可以相对容易地完成，因为所需态是相位编码的，几乎类似于量子比特的对角基态。这里我们报道Chau15协议的首次原理性演示。我们实验的一个亮点是其后处理基于实用的单向方式，而Chau（2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324）中的原始提案依赖于复杂的双向后处理，这在实验上是一大挑战。此外，通过操控时间仓（time-bin）qudit并用可变延迟干涉仪进行测量，我们的实现可扩展至高维qudit，并证实了Chau15协议的实验可行性。

Abstract (English)
In comparison to qubit-based protocols, qudit-based quantum key distribution ones generally allow two cooperative parties to share unconditionally secure keys under a higher channel noise. However, it is very hard to prepare and measure the required quantum states in qudit-based protocols in general. One exception is the recently proposed highly error tolerant qudit-based protocol known as the Chau15 (Chau 2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324). Remarkably, the state preparation and measurement in this protocol can be done relatively easily since the required states are phase encoded almost like the diagonal basis states of a qubit. Here we report the first proof-of-principle demonstration of the Chau15 protocol. One highlight of our experiment is that its post-processing is based on practical one-way manner, while the original proposal in Chau (2015 Phys. Rev. A 92 062324) relies on complicated two-way post-processing, which is a great challenge in experiment. In addition, by manipulating time-bin qudit and measurement with a variable delay interferometer, our realization is extensible to qudit with high-dimensionality and confirms the experimental feasibility of the Chau15 protocol.

首次主动实现轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议：Alice发送每包65个脉冲的脉冲串，Bob用主动控制可变延迟干涉仪随机切换延迟，在90 km距离上成功分发密钥，验证了该协议在高误码情形下的可行性。

在现有量子密钥分发协议中，两个合法用户Alice与Bob必须监测信号扰动，以限定潜在的信息泄露上界。然而，在轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议中，信号扰动的监测是不必要的。在此，我们首次给出了RRDPS协议的主动实现。实验中，Alice制备脉冲串包，每个包由65个脉冲组成，且每个包的全局相位被随机化。Bob使用一种新颖的主动控制可变延迟干涉仪，实现不同延迟的随机切换。得益于每个包中脉冲数目众多以及干涉仪的高稳定性和低插入损耗，该系统可在90 km的距离上分发密钥。我们的实验演示与结果证实了RRDPS协议的可行性，尤其是在高误码情形下。

Abstract (English)
In existing quantum key distribution protocols, two legitimate peers, Alice and Bob, must monitor the signal disturbance to place a bound on the potential information leakage. However, in the round-robin differential phase shift (RRDPS) protocol, monitoring of the signal disturbance is unnecessary. Here, we present the first active implementation of the RRDPS protocol. In our experiment, Alice prepares packets of pulses, where each packet is a train with 65 pulses and the global phase of each packet is randomized. Bob uses a novel actively controlled variable-delay interferometer to realize the random switching of different delays. Benefiting from the large pulse number of each packet, and the high stability and low insertion loss of the interferometer, the system can distribute a secret key over a distance of 90 km. Our experimental demonstration and results confirm the feasibility of the RRDPS protocol, particularly in high-error situations.

Abstract (English)
A wide area quantum key distribution (QKD) network deployed on communication infrastructures provided by China Mobile Ltd. is demonstrated. Three cities and two metropolitan area QKD networks were linked up to form the Hefei-Chaohu-Wuhu wide area QKD network with over 150 kilometers coverage area, in which Hefei metropolitan area QKD network was a typical full-mesh core network to offer all-to-all interconnections, and Wuhu metropolitan area QKD network was a representative quantum access network with point-to-multipoint configuration. The whole wide area QKD network ran for more than 5000 hours, from 21 December 2011 to 19 July 2012, and part of the network stopped until last December. To adapt to the complex and volatile field environment, the Faraday-Michelson QKD system with several stability measures was adopted when we designed QKD devices. Through standardized design of QKD devices, resolution of symmetry problem of QKD devices, and seamless switching in dynamic QKD network, we realized the effective integration between point-to-point QKD techniques and networking schemes.

量子密钥分发网络：从城域网到广域网The QKD network: From metropolitan to wide area

介绍了量子密钥分发从城域网走向广域网的网络架构与关键技术，并梳理了BB84协议提出以来传输距离由32厘米提升至260公里、成码速率由200赫兹提升至10吉赫兹的发展历程。

在现代社会，安全通信与信息保护日益重要。量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个远程合法用户能够共享无条件安全的密钥。与此前的方案不同，这些密钥的安全性基于量子物理学原理，并且可以被证明。结合一次性密码本加密，QKD可为安全通信和信息保护提供有效途径[1, 2]。自Bennett和Brassard提出著名的BB84协议[3]以来，QKD或量子密码学已成为最具活力的研究领域之一。经过约二十年的发展，实验QKD取得了显著进步，例如传输距离从32 cm[4]提高到260 km[5]，速率从200 Hz[4]提高到10 GHz[6]。

Abstract (English)
Secure communication and information protection become more and more important in the modern society. Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables two remote legitimate users to share unconditionally secure keys. Different from the former ones, the security of these keys is based on the principles of quantum physics and could be proved. Combined with one-time pad encryption, QKD can provide us an effective way for secure communication and information protection[1, 2]. Since Bennett and Brassard proposed the famous BB84 protocol[3], QKD or quantum cryptography has become one of the most dynamic research fields. After about twenty years of development, experimental QKD has achieved significant improvements, such as the transmission distance increased from 32 cm[4]to 260 km[5], the speed increased from 200 Hz[4]to 10 GHz[6].

我们报道了在损耗超过50 dB、长度超过250 km的标准通信光纤上进行的量子密钥分发（QKD）演示。我们选用了差分相移QKD协议，并以2 GHz的系统时钟速率实现。通过对1 bit延迟法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的细致优化以及超导单光子探测器（SSPD）的使用，我们在光纤长度不超过205 km时实现了低于2%的量子比特误码率，在损耗为52.9 dB的260 km光纤上则为3.45%。我们还提高了SSPD的量子效率，以在50 km长度上获得高密钥率。

Abstract (English)
We report a demonstration of quantum key distribution (QKD) over a standard telecom fiber exceeding 50 dB in loss and 250 km in length. The differential phase shift QKD protocol was chosen and implemented with a 2 GHz system clock rate. By careful optimization of the 1 bit delayed Faraday-Michelson interferometer and the use of the superconducting single photon detector (SSPD), we achieved a quantum bit error rate below 2% when the fiber length was no more than 205 km, and of 3.45% for a 260 km fiber with 52.9 dB loss. We also improved the quantum efficiency of SSPD to obtain a high key rate for 50 km length.

Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Jun-Fu Guo, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

利用波长相关分束器与多波长光源攻击实际量子密钥分发系统Attacking a practical quantum-key-distribution system with wavelength-dependent beam-splitter and multiwavelength sources

针对熔融双锥分束器的波长相关特性这一安全漏洞，提出可适用于所有被动状态调制 QKD 系统的攻击方案，并在偏振编码系统上仅以误码率从 1.3% 升至 1.4% 的代价窃取全部密钥。

众所周知，量子密钥分发（QKD）的无条件安全性可由量子力学保证。然而，实际 QKD 系统存在一些不完美之处，窃听者可以利用这些不完美来攻击密钥。以当前的实验技术，采用熔融双锥工艺制作的实际分束器具有波长相关特性。基于这一致命的安全漏洞，我们提出一种波长相关攻击方案，它可应用于所有采用被动状态调制的实际 QKD 系统。此外，我们对一个实际的偏振编码 QKD 系统进行了实验攻击，仅以将量子比特错误率从 1.3% 提高到 1.4% 为代价，就获取了全部密钥信息。

Abstract (English)
It is well known that the unconditional security of quantum-key distribution (QKD) can be guaranteed by quantum mechanics. However, practical QKD systems have some imperfections, which can be controlled by the eavesdropper to attack the secret key. With current experimental technology, a realistic beam splitter, made by fused biconical technology, has a wavelength-dependent property. Based on this fatal security loophole, we propose a wavelength-dependent attacking protocol, which can be applied to all practical QKD systems with passive state modulation. Moreover, we experimentally attack a practical polarization encoding QKD system to obtain all the secret key information at the cost of only increasing the quantum bit error rate from $1.3$ to $1.4%$.
