提出基于无源光器件的省波长QKD网络拓扑，并在商用电信光纤上以20 MHz频率完成现场试验：两个波长支持五个节点，任意两节点可同时直接共享密钥，还表征了组网引入的插入损耗与串扰对点对点系统的影响。

我们提出一种基于无源光器件的节省波长的量子密钥分发（QKD）网络拓扑，并报道了该网络在商用电信光纤上以20 MHz频率进行的现场试验。在该网络中，两个波长支持五个节点，任意两个节点均可同时直接共享安全密钥。我们还表征了引入该QKD网络之后，插入损耗与串扰效应对点对点QKD系统的影响。

Abstract (English)
We propose a wavelength-saving topology of a quantum key distribution (QKD) network based on passive optical elements, and we report on the field test of this network on commercial telecom optical fiber at the frequency of 20 MHz. In this network, five nodes are supported with two wavelengths, and every two nodes can share secure keys directly at the same time. We also characterized the insertion loss and cross talk effects on the point-to-point QKD system after introducing this QKD network.

Abstract (English)
The secure key rates of decoy-state quantum key distribution (QKD) using the heralded single-photon source (HSPS) are recalculated in the case of intensity fluctuations. By numerical simulations, we show that the HSPS is a good source for decoy-state QKD experiments not only because it has larger upper bound of transmission distance than the usual weak-coherent source (WCS) but also because it is more robust against intensity fluctuations than the WCS.

全被动测量设备无关量子密钥分发Fully passive measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

提出全被动测量设备无关量子密钥分发方案，用线性光学同时实现被动编码与被动诱骗态调制，可同时抵御光源调制器边信道与测量设备攻击，并给出被动编码策略、诱骗态分析方法及渐近密钥率仿真。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）能够抵御针对探测设备的所有攻击，但源端仍存在一些安全性问题。一种可能的解决方案是采用被动协议，以消除源端主动调制器引入的边信道。最近，有人提出了一种全被动QKD协议，可以利用线性光学同时实现被动编码和被动诱骗态调制。在本工作中，我们提出了一种全被动MDIQKD方案，能够使系统同时免受源调制器的边信道和测量设备攻击，从而显著提高QKD系统的实现安全性。我们给出了具体的被动编码策略和诱骗态分析方法，随后给出了渐近情形下安全密钥率的仿真结果。我们的工作为提高QKD系统的实现安全性提供了一条可行途径，并为利用实际器件实现被动QKD方案提供了参考。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) can resist all attacks on the detection devices, but there are still some security issues related to the source side. One possible solution is to use the passive protocol to eliminate the side channels introduced by active modulators at the source. Recently, a fully passive QKD protocol was proposed that could simultaneously achieve passive encoding and passive decoy-state modulation using linear optics. In this work, we propose a fully passive MDIQKD scheme that can protect the system from both side channels of source modulators and attacks on the measurement devices, which can significantly improve the implementation security of the QKD systems. We provide a specific passive encoding strategy and a method for decoy-state analysis, followed by simulation results for the secure key rate in the asymptotic scenario. Our work offers a feasible way to improve the implementation security of QKD systems and serves as a reference for achieving passive QKD schemes using realistic devices.

Xiang Wang, Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Jia-Qi Geng, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

该工作为模式配对量子密钥分发给出可抵御一般攻击的严格安全性证明与有限码长分析，并提出六态协议；结果显示原协议在典型脉冲数下即可突破无中继速率-透射率界限，六态方案在长距离下显著提升成码率。

模式配对量子密钥分发（MP-QKD）是一种有潜力的协议，它不仅能够免疫所有可能的探测器侧信道攻击，而且无需全局相位锁定即可突破无中继速率-透射率界限。在本项工作中，我们分析了 MP-QKD 协议的有限码长效应，并给出了可抵御一般攻击的严格安全性证明。此外，我们提出了一种六态 MP-QKD 协议并分析了它的有限码长效应。结果表明，原始协议在实际中典型的有限脉冲数下即可突破无中继速率-透射率界限；而我们的六态协议在长距离情形下能够显著提高安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Mode-pairing quantum key distribution (MP-QKD) is a potential protocol that is not only immune to all possible detector side channel attacks, but also breaks the repeaterless rate-transmittance bound without needing global phase locking. Here we analyze the finite-key effect for the MP-QKD protocol with rigorous security proof against general attacks. Moreover, we propose a six-state MP-QKD protocol and analyze its finite-key effect. The results show that the original protocol can break the repeaterless rate-transmittance bound with a typical finite number of pulses in practice. And our six-state protocol can improve the secret key rate significantly in long distance cases.

测量设备无关量子密钥分发中的后脉冲效应Afterpulse effect in measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

针对高速量子密钥分发中单光子雪崩光电二极管固有的后脉冲效应，建立了将后脉冲纳入考虑的测量设备无关量子密钥分发模型并据此重新优化系统参数，所得安全密钥率明显高于忽略后脉冲的原有模型。

毫无疑问，测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）是一种能够免疫所有可能的探测器侧信道攻击的关键协议。在准备阶段，通常采用仿真模型得到一组优化参数，并利用这组参数在实际系统中获得更高的安全密钥率。随着高速量子密钥分发的实现，作为单光子雪崩光电二极管固有特性的后脉冲效应已不再可以忽略，这将使实际结果与现有解析模型之间产生很大偏差。本文建立了一个兼容后脉冲效应的 MDI-QKD 模型，用以获得优化参数。结果表明，使用这一兼容后脉冲效应的模型，可以得到比此前忽略后脉冲的模型高得多的密钥率。由于系统工作频率不断提高，将后脉冲效应纳入考虑具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
There is no doubt that measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is a crucial protocol that is immune to all possible detector side channel attacks. In the preparation phase, a simulation model is usually employed to get a set of optimized parameters, which is utilized for getting a higher secure key rate in reality. With the implementation of high-speed QKD, the afterpulse effect which is an intrinsic characteristic of the single-photon avalanche photodiode is no longer ignorable, this will lead to a great deviation compared with the existing analytical model. Here we develop an afterpulse-compatible MDI-QKD model to get the optimized parameters. Our results indicate that by using our afterpulse-compatible model, we can get a much higher key rate than the prior afterpulse-omitted model. It is significant to take the afterpulse effect into consideration because of the improvement of the system working frequency.

No. 01

利用时间鬼成像感知量子密钥分发中的量子黑客攻击Perceiving Quantum Hacking for Quantum Key Distribution Using Temporal Ghost Imaging

提出用时间鬼成像获取量子信号、量子信道与QKD系统的时间指纹，从而感知量子黑客攻击，并实验验证了其有效性，从信号与系统视角为提升实际安全性提供通用途径。

量子密钥分发（QKD）能够利用量子力学在远程用户之间生成安全密钥比特。然而，理论模型与实际实现之间的差距为窃听者提供了截获密钥的机会。最隐蔽的攻击被称为量子黑客攻击，即利用QKD系统的边信道漏洞使测量结果没有明显偏差的攻击。刻画量子信号、量子信道和QKD系统的全时间尺度特性，可以为合法用户提供击败恶意攻击的额外能力。这里，我们提出一种利用时间鬼成像（TGI）方案、以时间指纹感知量子黑客攻击的方法，并实验验证了其有效性。该方案从信号与系统的独特视角，提供了一条提升QKD实际安全性的通用途径。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can generate secure key bits between remote users with quantum mechanics. However, the gap between the theoretical model and practical realizations gives eavesdroppers opportunities to intercept the secret key. The most insidious attacks, known as quantum hacking, are the ones with no significant discrepancy of the measurement results using side-channel loopholes of QKD systems. Depicting full-time-scale characteristics of the quantum signals, the quantum channel, and the QKD system can provide legitimate users extra capabilities to defeat malicious attacks. Here, we propose the method exploring a temporal ghost-imaging (TGI) scheme to perceive quantum hacking with temporal fingerprints and experimentally verify its validity. The scheme presents a common approach to promote QKD's practical security from a unique perspective of signals and systems.

No. 02

时间域鬼成像方法及其在量子器件评估中的应用Temporal ghost imaging for quantum device evaluation

把鬼成像思想推广到时间域，通过测量两路信号的关联函数，原理性实验评估了门控模式单光子雪崩探测器的时间探测效率，为量子器件时间特性的实时监测与量子通信安全性评估提供了新工具。

鬼成像（GI）通过测量两路光束的关联函数来重建物体的图像，而这两路光束中的任何一路单独都不携带物体的结构信息。这一强大技术使得即使在存在噪声的情况下也能获得物体的高质量图像。在此，我们把GI方法引入时间域中的量子器件评估。我们完成了一个原理性实验，用于评估门控模式单光子雪崩探测器（SPAD）的时间探测效率。实验结果表明，采用时间鬼成像（TGI）方法可以实现对SPAD时间特性的高质量评估。我们的工作表明，TGI方法是实时监测量子器件时间特性的一种有效工具，并将为量子通信的安全性评估带来新的视角。

Abstract (English)
Ghost imaging (GI) can reconstruct the image of an object by measuring the correlation function of two beams, none of which carries the structure information of the object independently. This powerful technology makes it possible to obtain high-quality imaging of the object even in the presence of noise. Here, we introduce the GI method into quantum device evaluation in the time domain. We realized a proof-of-principle experiment to evaluate the temporal detection efficiency of a gated-mode single-photon avalanche detector (SPAD). The experimental results show that high-quality evaluation of temporal characteristics of the SPAD can be realized by the method of temporal GI (TGI). Our work indicates that the TGI method is an effective tool to monitor the temporal characteristics of quantum devices in real time and will bring a new perspective to the security evaluation of quantum communication.

相位翻转错误抑制量子密钥分发的原理性验证实验Proof of principle implementation of phase-flip error rejection quantum key distribution

借助自发参量下转换产生的双光子态实验验证了量子相位翻转错误抑制码，通过奇偶校验与后选择实现相位翻转抑制，在信道噪声概率低于 25% 时解码后的量子误码率较标准单光子偏振编码 BB84 方案明显降低。

提高信道噪声容限是设计和实现量子密钥分发（QKD）协议的一项重要任务。Wang 提出了量子相位翻转错误抑制（QPFER）码［Phys. Rev. Lett. 92, 077902 (2004)，DOI: 10.1103/PhysRevLett.92.077902］，以提高 QKD 实现所能容忍的相位翻转噪声。然而，迄今仍缺少证明其优势的实验。在此，我们借助自发参量下转换产生的双光子量子态，对 QPFER 码进行了实验验证。协议中引入奇偶校验与后选择方法以实现相位翻转抑制。与单光子偏振编码 BB84 方案的标准实现相比，当信道噪声概率低于 25% 时，解码后的量子误码率明显降低。实验结果还表明，在噪声水平处于合适区间时，QPFER 协议能够降低误码率、获得更高的密钥率，并在含噪信道中保持鲁棒性。

Abstract (English)
Improving the tolerance of channel noise is an important task for devising and implementing quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols. Quantum phase-flip error rejection (QPFER) code [Phys. Rev. Lett.92, 077902 (2004)PRLTAO0031-900710.1103/PhysRevLett.92.077902] has been introduced by Wang to increase the tolerable phase-flip noise of QKD implementations. However, an experiment that demonstrates its advantages is still missing. Here, we experimentally verify the QPFER code with the assistance of two photon quantum states generated by spontaneous parametric downconversion. The methods of parity check and postselection are introduced to the protocol for achieving the phase-flipping rejection. Comparing with the standard realization of the single photon polarization encoding BB84 scheme, the quantum error rate after decoding is obviously reduced when the probability of channel noise is less than 25%. The experiment results also show that QPFER protocol can reduce error rate, obtain a higher key rate, and be robust in the noisy channel when the noise level is in a proper region.

非对称量子-经典集成测量设备无关量子密钥分发的更高密钥率Higher key rate in asymmetric quantum-classical integrated measurement-device-independent quantum-key-distribution systems

建立了集成测量设备无关量子密钥分发中非对称效应的机理模型，并分析非对称结构的噪声抑制效应，发现非对称系统的密钥率反而最多提升260%，颠覆了对称系统更优的传统认知。

将测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）与经典网络集成，可兼顾安全性与经济性。遗憾的是，MDI QKD 的性能本就受到网络非对称性的抑制，还会因集成噪声的加入而进一步恶化。因此，人们一直认为对称系统更有利于获得更高的密钥率。然而，我们揭示了一个反直觉的事实：在集成系统中，非对称 MDI QKD 具有更好的性能。我们建立了集成 MDI 系统中非对称效应的机理模型，并分析了非对称结构的噪声抑制效应，观察到密钥率出人意料地提升至多 260%，所得结论与原系统截然相反。所发现的现象及所提出的分析模型为噪声抑制和性能提升提供了一种方法，使其能够很好地适配实际的非对称网络。

Abstract (English)
Integrating measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) with classical networks guarantees security and economy. Unfortunately, the performance of MDI QKD, suppressed though it is by network asymmetry, is further degraded by the addition of integration noise. As a consequence, symmetric systems are always believed to be better for a higher key rate. However, we reveal a counterintuitive fact that asymmetric MDI QKD has better performance in integrated systems. Modeling the mechanism of the asymmetric effect in integrated MDI systems and analyzing the noise-suppression effect of asymmetric structures, we observe an unanticipated increase of the key rate up to 260%, giving a conclusion diametrically opposite that for the original system. The phenomenon found and the proposed analytical model provide a method for noise suppression and performance improvement, permitting high adaptability for realistic asymmetric networks.

No. 01

针对量子密钥分发的诱导光折变攻击Induced-Photorefraction Attack against Quantum Key Distribution

该工作指出铌酸锂器件的光折变效应可被窃听者利用，从而构成量子密钥分发系统的潜在攻击漏洞，并阐明其物理机制与实现技术，提醒器件厂商与用户采取相应对策，为 QKD 安全性分析开辟了新途径。

铌酸锂（LN）器件已被广泛用于量子密钥分发（QKD）系统中，但 LN 器件中的光折变效应可被窃听者利用，成为一种潜在的攻击漏洞。本工作指出了 LN 器件的一个脆弱之处，制造商与用户必须对此有所认识，以便采取适当对策。此外，本工作所提出的物理机制与技术为 QKD 系统的安全性分析开辟了一条重要途径。

Abstract (English)
Lithium niobate (LN) devices have been widely adopted in systems for quantum key distribution (QKD), but the photorefractive effect in LN devices can be exploited as a potential loophole for malicious attacks by eavesdroppers. This work points out a vulnerability of LN devices of which manufacturers and users must become aware, so that appropriate countermeasures may be implemented. Moreover, the physical mechanism and techniques introduced in this work open an important avenue to the security analysis of QKD systems.

Peng Ye, Wei Chen, Guo-Wei Zhang, Feng-Yu Lu, Fang-Xiang Wang, Guan-Zhong Huang, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

用于芯片化量子密钥分发的透射率不变相位调制器Transmittance-invariant phase modulator for chip-based quantum key distribution

提出并实现片上透射率不变相位调制器，消除相位相关损耗造成的相位、强度与偏振之间的关联，可容忍较大工艺偏差且适用于多材料平台，并能提高标准PDK下电光相位调制器的调制深度。

在芯片化量子密钥分发（QKD）系统中，不理想的电光相位调制器（EOPM）导致非理想量子态制备，会降低安全密钥率并引入潜在安全性漏洞。我们提出并实现了一种片上透射率不变相位调制器（TIPM）来解决该问题。仿真与实验结果表明，TIPM能够消除相位相关损耗所造成的量子态相位、强度与偏振之间的关联。该设计可容忍显著的制备偏差，且对多材料平台具有普适性。此外，TIPM提高了标准工艺设计套件（PDK）中EOPM可达到的调制深度。TIPM的提出可提升芯片化QKD系统的实际安全性与性能。

Abstract (English)
In chip-based quantum key distribution (QKD) systems, the non-ideal quantum state preparation due to the imperfect electro-optic phase modulators (EOPM) decreases the secret key rate and introduces potential vulnerabilities. We propose and implement an on-chip transmittance-invariant phase modulator (TIPM) to solve this problem. Simulated and experimental results show that TIPM can eliminate the correlation between phase, intensity, and polarization of quantum states caused by phase-dependent loss. The design can tolerate a significant fabrication mismatch and is universal to multi-material platforms. Furthermore, TIPM increases the modulation depth achievable by EOPMs in standard process design kit (PDK). The proposal of TIPM can improve the practical security and performance of the chip-based QKD systems.

Peng Ye, Wei Chen, Ze-Hao Wang, Guo-Wei Zhang, Yu-Yang Ding, Guan-Zhong Huang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Wen Liu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

轮询差分相移量子密钥分发的改进安全性界限Improved security bound for the round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution

★Nat. Commun.

通过考察编码态的相位随机化与窃听者攻击之间的关联，给出了更紧的信息泄露界，特别适用于短脉冲串实现且无需监测信号扰动，并在140 km光纤上完成验证实验，突破了原理论的悲观预言。

轮询差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议因其独特的安全特性而受到深入研究；例如，无需获知密钥比特的误码率即可界定信息泄露。然而，其实用性和性能仍不尽如人意。这里，通过考察编码态的相位随机化及其与窃听者攻击的联系，我们得到了一个改进的信息泄露界。有趣的是，我们的理论对短脉冲串的实现尤为有用，并且仍然可以在不监测信号扰动的情况下运行。因此，RRDPS的实用性和性能得到提升。此外，我们完成了长达140 km光纤的原理性验证实验，这是迄今RRDPS所能达到的最长距离，而原有理论预言在我们的实验中无法生成任何安全密钥。我们的结果将有助于推动实用化RRDPS更接近实际应用。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol has attracted intensive study due to its distinct security characteristics; e.g., information leakage is bounded without learning the error rate of key bits. Nevertheless, its practicality and performance are still not satisfactory. Here, by observing the phase randomization of the encoding states and its connection with eavesdropper’s attack, we develop an improved bound on information leakage. Interestingly, our theory is especially useful for implementations with short trains of pulses, and running without monitoring signal disturbance is still available. As a result, the practicality and performance of RRDPS are improved. Furthermore, we realize a proof-of-principle experiment with up to 140 km of fiber, which has been the longest achievable distance of RRDPS until now, whereas the original theory predicted that no secret key could be generated in our experiment. Our results will help in bringing practical RRDPS closer to practical implementations.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Yun-Guang Han, Rong Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Nature Communications

10.1038/s41467-017-02211-x

No. 03

失配基统计使未表征量子比特源可用于量子密钥分发Mismatched-basis statistics enable quantum key distribution with uncharacterized qubit sources

提出一种后处理方法，利用双方选用不同基时的测量统计，证明纳入这些统计后，未表征的量子比特源也能用于测量设备无关量子密钥分发与 BB84 协议，而此前这被认为不可能。

在量子密钥分发的后处理中，来自失配基测量（即双方使用不同基）的原始密钥比特通常被丢弃。这里我们提出一种利用失配基情形下测量统计的后处理方法，并证明：纳入这些统计后，未表征的量子比特源可以被用于测量设备无关的量子密钥分发协议以及 Bennett-Brassard 1984 协议，而这在其他情况下是不可能的。

Abstract (English)
In the postprocessing of quantum key distribution, the raw key bits from the mismatched-basis measurements, where two parties use different bases, are normally discarded. Here, we propose a postprocessing method that exploits measurement statistics from mismatched-basis cases and prove that incorporating these statistics enables uncharacterized qubit sources to be used in the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution protocol and the Bennett-Brassard 1984 protocol, which is otherwise impossible.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Chi-Hang Fred Fung, Xiongfeng Ma, Chun-Mei Zhang, Hong-Wei Li, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 04

噪声与损耗信道下改进型乒乓协议的安全性Security of modified Ping-Pong protocol in noisy and lossy channel

针对 2002 年提出的基于纠缠的双向量子密钥协议给出一处简单且实验可行的修改，并证明在噪声与损耗信道下该改进协议可抵御集体攻击，仿真结果表明方案具有实用性。

“乒乓”（PP）协议是一种基于纠缠的双向量子密钥协议。在该协议中，Bob 制备一对最大纠缠量子比特，并把其中一个量子比特发送给 Alice；随后 Alice 对该量子比特进行一些必要的操作，再将其发回 Bob。尽管该协议早在 2002 年就已提出，但其在噪声与损耗信道中的安全性一直未被证明。在本报告中，我们对原始 PP 协议加入一处简单且实验上可行的修改，并在考虑噪声与损耗信道的情形下，证明这一改进型 PP 协议抵御集体攻击的安全性。仿真结果表明我们的协议是实用的。

Abstract (English)
The "Ping-Pong" (PP) protocol is a two-way quantum key protocol based on entanglement. In this protocol, Bob prepares one maximally entangled pair of qubits, and sends one qubit to Alice. Then, Alice performs some necessary operations on this qubit and sends it back to Bob. Although this protocol was proposed in 2002, its security in the noisy and lossy channel has not been proven. In this report, we add a simple and experimentally feasible modification to the original PP protocol, and prove the security of this modified PP protocol against collective attacks when the noisy and lossy channel is taken into account. Simulation results show that our protocol is practical.

Yun-Guang Han, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Scientific Reports

10.1038/srep04936

No. 05

免疫探测器侧信道攻击的无参考系无关量子密钥分发Reference-free-independent quantum key distribution immune to detector side channel attacks

提出一种新的无参考系无关（RFI）QKD协议，移除了全部探测器侧信道，且无需主动对准参考系即可容忍其未知慢漂移，数值模拟表明该协议有望实现较长的安全距离。

通常，共享参考系对实用化量子密钥分发（QKD）系统不可或缺。因此，由于环境引入的参考系未知且缓慢变化，大多数QKD系统需要主动对准参考系。颇为有趣的是，无参考系无关（RFI）QKD无需对准参考系即可生成密钥比特。然而，RFI QKD仍可能易受探测器侧信道攻击。在此，我们提出一种新的RFI QKD协议，其中所有探测器侧信道均被移除。此外，我们的协议仍能在不主动对准的情况下容忍参考系的未知慢变。数值模拟表明，该协议有望实现较长的安全距离。

Abstract (English)
Usually, a shared reference frame is indispensable for practical quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. As a result, most QKD systems need active alignment of reference frame due to the unknown and slowly variances of reference frame introduced by environment. Quite interestingly, reference-free-independent (RFI) QKD can generate secret-key bits without alignment of reference frame. However, RFI QKD may be still vulnerable to detector side channel attacks. Here, we propose a new RFI QKD protocol, in which all detector side channels are removed. Furthermore, our protocol can still tolerate unknown and slow variance of reference frame without active alignment. And a numerical simulation shows that long security distance is probable in this protocol.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Hong-Wei Li, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Quantum Information Processing

10.1007/s11128-013-0726-2

No. 06

基于未表征量子比特源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with uncharacterized qubit sources

该工作放宽了对编码系统的刻画要求：只要使用量子比特源，即便编码系统完全未表征也能保证安全性，并给出无需知晓编码态的安全证明与实用性模拟结果。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）被提出以抵御任何可能的探测攻击。原始方案的安全性依赖于如下假设：合法用户能够完全刻画包括源在内的编码系统。在此我们提出一种MDIQKD协议，只要使用量子比特源，就允许编码系统未被表征。我们给出了该MDIQKD协议的安全性证明，它不需要关于编码态的任何知识。模拟结果表明该方案具有实用性。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) is proposed to be secure against any possible detection attacks. The security of the original proposal relies on the assumption that the legitimate users can fully characterize the encoding systems including sources. Here, we propose a MDIQKD protocol where we allow uncharacterized encoding systems as long as qubit sources are used. A security proof of the MDIQKD protocol is presented that does not need the knowledge of the encoding states. Simulation results show that the scheme is practical.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Chi-Hang Fred Fung, Xiongfeng Ma, Chun-Mei Zhang, Hong-Wei Li, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.88.062322

No. 07

基于弱相干态的反事实量子密码学Counterfactual quantum cryptography based on weak coherent states

在反事实量子密码方案中，信息载体无需在量子信道中传播即可共享密钥；该工作针对常用弱相干激光源，在一般集体攻击下证明了方案安全性，并给出密钥率下界与实际性能分析。

在“反事实量子密码学”方案[T.-G. Noh, Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 230501 (2009)]中，即使信息载体不在量子信道中传输，两个合法远端用户仍可共享密钥比特。Yin等人[Z.-Q. Yin, H. W. Li, W. Chen, Z. F. Han, and G. C. Guo, Phys. Rev. A 82, 042335 (2010)]已证明采用理想单光子源的该协议的安全性。本文证明基于常用弱相干激光源的反事实量子密码方案在一般集体攻击下的安全性。此证明的基本假设是：单光子探测器的效率和暗计数率对任意$n$光子Fock态均保持一致。随后，通过对编码弱相干态的相位进行随机化，Eve的辅助量子态将转化为经典混合态。最后，给出了秘密密钥比特率的下界以及实际实现下的性能分析。

Abstract (English)
In the ``counterfactual quantum cryptography'' scheme [T.-G. Noh, Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 230501 (2009)], two legitimate distant peers may share secret-key bits even when the information carriers do not travel in the quantum channel. The security of this protocol with an ideal single-photon source has been proved by Yin et al. [Z.-Q. Yin, H. W. Li, W. Chen, Z. F. Han, and G. C. Guo, Phys. Rev. A 82, 042335 (2010)]. In this paper, we prove the security of the counterfactual-quantum-cryptography scheme based on a commonly used weak-coherent-laser source by considering a general collective attack. The basic assumption of this proof is that the efficiency and dark-counting rate of a single-photon detector are consistent for any $n$-photon Fock states. Then through randomizing the phases of the encoding weak coherent states, Eve's ancilla will be transformed into a classical mixture. Finally, the lower bound of the secret-key-bit rate and a performance analysis for the practical implementation are both given.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Yao Yao, Chun-Mei Zhang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

基于实用自发参量下转换源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution with Practical Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion Sources

把实际自发参量下转换源的光谱纠缠态分解为施密特本征态，定量计入各本征态对安全密钥率的贡献，修正了以往的高估，并据此精确优化泵浦与滤波条件。

测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）封堵了探测端的全部漏洞，极大提升了QKD的实际安全性。自发参量下转换（SPDC）源在MDI QKD中发挥着重要作用：借助预告（heralding）策略，它可以实现被动诱骗态等独特功能，从而减少源端的边信道信息泄漏。然而，实际SPDC源产生的光子对往往存在光谱纠缠，这会降低Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉可见度，进而抬高QKD误码率。遗憾的是，此前的研究尚未定量考虑这一效应，导致安全密钥率被高估，其结果无法适用于实际光源。本文填补了这一空白：将光谱纠缠态分解为施密特本征态，进而求出它们对安全密钥率的贡献。此外，该工作还允许对泵浦与滤波条件进行精确优化，以最大化最终密钥率。需要指出的是，我们的模型具有普适性，可推广到其他涉及HOM干涉的量子信息过程，如量子隐形传态、纠缠交换和量子计算。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD) closes all the loopholes in the detection side, which greatly improves the practical security of QKD. Spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) sources play a significant role in MDI QKD by using the heralding strategies to achieve unique features, such as the passive-decoy method, which reduces side-channel information leakage from the source. However, photon pairs from realistic SPDC sources are often spectrally entangled. This lowers the Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference visibility, and thus increases the QKD error rate. Unfortunately, research efforts so far have not considered this effect quantitatively. This leads to an overestimation in the secure key rate; therefore their results cannot be applied to practical sources. In this article, we close this gap by decomposing the spectral entangled state into Schmidt eigenstates, then find their contributions to the secure key rate. In addition, our work allows an accurate optimization of pumping and filtering conditions to maximize the final key rate. We note that our model is general and can be applied to other quantum information processes involving HOM interference, such as quantum teleportation, entanglement swapping, and quantum computation.

Xiao-Hai Zhan, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.20.034069

No. 02

基于连续波泵浦自发参量下转换预报单光子源的量子密钥分发Quantum Key Distribution with a Continuous-Wave-Pumped Spontaneous-Parametric-Down-Conversion Heralded Single-Photon Source

该工作建立了计入探测器时间抖动与死时间等实际缺陷的连续波泵浦预报单光子源 QKD 模型，表明其传输距离比当前最快的脉冲泵浦系统长约 31%，且运行更稳定、光谱特性更优。

量子密钥分发（QKD）协议利用单光子进行密钥交换。基于自发参量下转换（SPDC）的预报单光子源（HSPS）是产生高保真单光子的一种实用而有效的方式，尤其在长距离下能带来额外的性能提升。HSPS QKD 通常使用脉冲激光作为泵浦，但与连续波泵浦相比，其在运行稳定性和实用性方面存在不足。另一方面，目前仍缺乏描述连续波泵浦 HSPS 性能的精确模型。将脉冲泵浦 HSPS QKD 的成码率模型直接套用于连续波情形既不准确也不安全，而且会忽略单光子探测器的时间抖动与死时间。本文详细研究了连续波情形，并计入了实验仪器的实际非理想因素。我们的模型表明，连续波泵浦方案可达到比目前最快的脉冲泵浦 HSPS QKD 系统长得多的传输距离（长 31%），并具有运行稳定性更高、光谱特性更好等优点。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols utilize single photons for key exchanging. Heralded single-photon sources (HSPSs) with spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) is a practical and effective way of producing single photons of high fidelity, bringing extra performance especially at long distances. A pulsed laser is usually used as the pump for HSPS QKD, but it has disadvantages in operational stability and practicality compared to a cw one. On the other hand, a precise model describing the performance of HSPS with a cw pump is still missing. It is inaccurate and unsafe to apply the key rate model of the pulse-pumped HSPS QKD directly to the cw one, and it also overlooks the timing jitter and dead time of the single-photon detectors. In this paper, we study the cw case in detail, including practical imperfections of the experimental instruments. Our model shows that a cw-pumped setup can reach a much longer transmission distance (31 % longer) than the fastest pulsed HSPS QKD system at present, together with other advantages such as higher operational stability and better spectral characteristics.

Xiao-Hai Zhan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.19.034027

张春梅Chun-Mei Zhang1 篇

No. 01

基于Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt不等式的诱骗态测量设备无关量子密钥分发Decoy-state measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution based on the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt inequality

在仅要求量子态制备于二维希尔伯特空间、器件相互独立的假设下，分析含一个信号态与s−1个诱骗态的CHSH-MDI-QKD协议，并计入五强度情形的有限码长效应，仿真显示方案具有实用性。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议的提出旨在消除探测器侧信道攻击，但其安全性依赖于编码系统被完美刻画这一假设。相比之下，基于Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt不等式（CHSH）的MDI-QKD协议（CHSH-MDI-QKD）弱化了这一假设，它只要求量子态在二维希尔伯特空间中制备、且各器件相互独立。在实验实现中，由于缺乏理想的单光子源，QKD系统通常采用弱相干态，而弱相干态可能被制备于高维空间。本文研究采用 s（3≤s≤5）个强度的诱骗态CHSH-MDI-QKD协议，其中包括一个信号态和 s−1 个诱骗态；同时我们还考虑了五强度情形下诱骗态CHSH-MDI-QKD协议的有限码长效应。仿真结果表明该方案非常实用。

Abstract (English)
The measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol is proposed to remove the detector side channel attacks, while its security relies on the assumption that the encoding systems are perfectly characterized. In contrast, the MDI-QKD protocol based on the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt inequality (CHSH-MDI-QKD) weakens this assumption, which only requires the quantum state to be prepared in the two-dimensional Hilbert space and the devices are independent. In experimental realizations, the weak coherent state, which is always used in QKD systems due to the lack of an ideal single-photon source, may be prepared in the high-dimensional space. In this paper, we investigate the decoy-state CHSH-MDI-QKD protocol with $s(3\ensuremath{\le}s\ensuremath{\le}5)$ intensities, including one signal state and $s\ensuremath{-}1$ decoy states, and we also consider the finite-size effect on the decoy-state CHSH-MDI-QKD protocol with five intensities. Simulation results show that this scheme is very practical.

在城域规模上构建高维纠缠量子网络，采用偏振—时间戳混合编码与主动相位补偿，使传输距离比以往网络级高维实现提升三个数量级，并可与经典信号共纤共存。

量子通信网络对于安全信息传输和分布式量子技术至关重要。高维纠缠是此类网络的一种有前景的资源，因为它能够提升信息容量并提供更大的潜力。然而，其实际优势尚未得到充分探索，现有演示在现实条件下也未表现出相对于二维网络的明显优势。在此，我们演示了一个具备主动子空间划分功能的城域规模高维纠缠网络，在密钥率、灵活性和抗噪性方面展现出潜在的实际优势。我们采用偏振—时间戳混合编码，在单模光纤信道上分发高维纠缠。其传输距离比以往网络级高维实现提升了三个数量级，同时主动相位补偿支持长期稳定运行。我们的网络还可与经典信号共存，其可重构的子空间划分提供了实用量子网络所需的适应性。这些结果展示了一条通往大规模、高性能量子通信网络的实用路径。

Abstract (English)
Quantum communication networks are essential for secure information transfer and distributed quantum technologies. High-dimensional entanglement is a promising resource for such networks because it can increase the information capacity and offer greater potential. However, its practical advantages have not been fully explored, and existing demonstrations have not shown clear benefits over two-dimensional networks under realistic conditions. Here, we demonstrate a metropolitan-scale high-dimensional entangled network with active subspace division, showing potential practical benefits in key rate, flexibility, and noise resilience. Using hybrid polarization-time-bin encoding, we distribute high-dimensional entanglement over single-mode fiber channels. The transmission distance exceeds previous network-level high-dimensional implementations by three orders of magnitude, while active phase compensation supports long-term stable operation. Our network can also coexist with classical signals, and its reconfigurable subspace division provides the adaptability needed for practical quantum networks. These results show a practical route toward large-scale, high-performance quantum communication networks.

时间仓纠缠因其在长距离信道上的优异鲁棒性，是量子信息科学中的关键资源。实现高的量子干涉可见度对于基础研究和实际应用都不可或缺。迄今为止，能够准确描述基于时间仓纠缠的双光子干涉的模型仍有待建立。本工作分析了这类干涉的内在机制，并建立了一个可在实验上优化量子干涉可见度的有效模型。我们利用该模型分析了导致干涉可见度下降的各项因素，提出了应对这些问题的策略，并通过实验证明了模型的有效性。该模型可作为基于时间仓纠缠的系统的工具，用于辅助系统设计、预期结果评估以及实验装置优化。

Abstract (English)
Time-bin entanglement is a critical resource in quantum information science owing to its exceptional robustness over long-distance channels. Achieving high quantum interference visibility is indispensable for fundamental research and practical applications. To date, a model that can accurately describe time-bin entanglement-based two-photon interference remains to be established. In this work, we analyze the underlying mechanisms for this type of interference and develop an effective model for experimentally optimizing the quantum interference visibility. We use this model to analyze the factors contributing to the decline in interference visibility and offer strategies to address these issues, and we also demonstrate its effectiveness through experiments. Our model can serve as a tool for time-bin entanglement-based systems, aiding in system design, the evaluation of expected outcomes, and the optimization of experimental setups.

50 km 含噪光纤信道上的超纠缠量子通信Hyperentanglement quantum communication over a 50  km noisy fiber channel

利用偏振与时间片超纠缠实现高维编码，在 50 km 含噪光纤信道上完成高维纠缠量子密钥分发，安全密钥率与噪声容限均显著优于量子比特方案。

高维纠缠不仅能为量子通信提供更高的安全等级，还有望提升系统的信息容量与抗噪声能力。然而，由于不同高维自由度各自受到多种限制，这些优势能否在实际实现中带来改善仍缺乏充分证明。我们提出一种在长距离含噪光纤信道上充分利用这些优势的方案。我们利用偏振与时间片超纠缠实现高维编码，并观测到安全密钥率与噪声容限的显著提升，超越了量子比特系统的能力。此外，该演示实现了最远 50 km 的分发距离，据我们所知，这是迄今基于高维纠缠的量子密钥分发所达到的最长距离。该工作验证了高维纠缠在长距离含噪信道量子通信中的潜力，为构建鲁棒且资源高效的量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
High-dimensional entanglement not only offers a high security level for quantum communication but also promises improved information capacity and noise resistance of the system. However, due to various constraints on different high-dimensional degrees of freedom, whether these advantages can bring improvement to the actual implementation is still not well proven. Here we present a scheme to fully utilize these advantages over long-distance noisy fiber channels. We exploit polarization and time-bin hyperentanglement to achieve high-dimensional coding, and observe significant enhancements in secure key rates and noise tolerance that surpass the capabilities of qubit systems. Moreover, the demonstration achieves a distribution up to 50 km, which is the longest distance for high-dimensional entanglement-based quantum key distribution up to date, to our knowledge. Our demonstration validates the potential of high-dimensional entanglement for quantum communications over long-distance noisy channels, paving the way for a resilient and resource-efficient quantum network.

基于纠缠光子源的量子密钥分发的实用通用模型Realistic and general model for quantum key distribution with entangled-photon sources

指出现有模型将脉冲泵浦纠缠源的光子数分布视为热分布、忽略光谱模式会高估安全密钥率，通过分析光子数分布与联合光谱分布的关系重写光子对量子态，给出适用于脉冲乃至连续波泵浦系统的通用密钥率模型。

基于纠缠的量子密钥分发（EB-QKD）相较制备-测量类协议具有若干优势，例如无需诱骗态和主动调制器。目前，基于自发参量下转换过程的纠缠源已被广泛用于EB-QKD实验。已有模型大多把脉冲泵浦纠缠源的光子数分布视为热分布，但这样做忽略了光谱模式的任何影响，会导致安全密钥率被高估。本文分析了光子数分布与联合光谱分布之间的关联，并重写了光子对的量子态。随后我们将结果应用于EB-QKD，给出了一个通用模型，它不仅能用于任何脉冲泵浦系统，甚至可用于连续波泵浦系统来计算安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Entanglement-based quantum key distribution (EB-QKD) has several advantages over prepare-and-measure protocols, such as eliminating the need for decoy states and active modulators. At present, entanglement sources based on the spontaneous parametric down-conversion process have been widely used in EB-QKD experiments. Most of the existing models regard the photon-number distribution of pulse-pumped entanglement sources as thermal. However, doing so ignores any effects of spectral modes, which will lead to the overestimation of the secure key rate. In this paper, we analyze the correlation between the photon-number distribution and the joint spectral distribution and rewrite the quantum state of the photon pairs. Then we apply the results to EB-QKD and present a general model which can be used to calculate the secure key rate not only for any pulse-pumped systems but even for cw-pumped systems.

带相位后选择的量子密钥分发相位误码率分析Phase-error-rate analysis for quantum key distribution with phase postselection

针对相位后选择的非零区间所引入的固有误差，精确分析相位误码率上限，并将其用于SNS-TFQKD与MP-QKD，模拟表明长距离密钥率明显提升且无需改动实验。

量子密钥分发（QKD）利用量子力学原理建立信息论安全的通信信道，是一种开创性的方法。在QKD的安全性证明中，相位误码率是信息泄漏的关键指标，直接影响通信双方Alice与Bob所共享密钥比特的安全性。在估计相位误码率上界时，相位随机化及随后的后选择机制在许多QKD协议中起着关键作用。然而，相位后选择的非零区间会引入固有误差，导致相位误码率被高估。本文对带相位后选择的QKD协议进行精确的相位误码率分析，消除了与非零区间相关的误码率，有助于准确界定窃听者可能获取的信息量。我们进一步将该分析应用于发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发（SNS-TFQKD）和模式配对量子密钥分发（MP-QKD）。仿真结果证实，精确的相位误码分析能够显著改善密钥率性能，尤其是在实际的长距离情形下。需要指出的是，我们的方法无需改动现有实验硬件或协议步骤，可直接应用于当前的SNS-TF-QKD和MP-QKD，以实现更高的密钥率生成。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) stands as a pioneering method for establishing information-theoretically secure communication channels by utilizing the principles of quantum mechanics. In the security proof of QKD, the phase error rate serves as a critical indicator of information leakage and directly influences the security of the shared key bits between communicating parties, Alice and Bob. In estimating the upper bound of the phase error rate, phase randomization and subsequent postselection mechanisms serve pivotal roles across numerous QKD protocols. However, the nonzero interval of phase postselection will introduce intrinsic errors, leading to an overestimation of phase error rate. Here we make a precise phase-error-rate analysis for QKD protocols with phase postselection, which eliminates error rate associated with nonzero interval and helps us to accurately bound the amount of information an eavesdropper may obtain. We further apply our analysis in sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution (SNS-TFQKD) and mode-pairing quantum key distribution (MP-QKD). The simulation results confirm that our precise phase error analysis can noticeably improve the key rate performance especially over long distances in practice. Note that our method does not require alterations to the existing experimental hardware or protocol steps. It can be readily applied within current SNS-TF-QKD and MP-QKD for higher key rate generation.

带优势提取的发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution with advantage distillation

发送或不发送（SNS）协议是双场量子密钥分发（TFQKD）中一种非常有前景的变体，因为它在长距离区间具有优势，并且对较大的光学失准具有鲁棒性。主动奇宇称配对（AOPP）方法能够显著提升原始SNS TFQKD的密钥率性能，从而形成AOPP SNS TFQKD协议。本文引入优势提取（AD）方法，以进一步提升AOPP SNS TFQKD的通信距离。我们还针对AD过程中比特块大小为2的情形，在有限码长条件下证明了带AD的AOPP SNS TFQKD对抗相干攻击的可组合安全性。我们针对AOPP SNS TFQKD协议的AD方法有望在不改变SNS TFQKD实验系统的前提下提升实际中的密钥率性能。

Abstract (English)
A sending-or-not-sending (SNS) protocol is a very promising variant in twin-field quantum key distribution (TFQKD) for its advantages at the regime of long distance and the robustness against large optical misalignment. The actively odd-parity pairing (AOPP) method can significantly enhance the key-rate performance of the original SNS TFQKD, which forms the AOPP SNS TFQKD protocol. In this paper, we introduce the advantage distillation (AD) method to further improve the communication distance for AOPP SNS TFQKD. We also prove the composable security against coherent attacks for the AOPP SNS TFQKD with AD in the finite-key regime for bit blocks with a size of 2 in the AD process. Our AD method for AOPP SNS TFQKD protocol is expected to improve the key-rate performance in practice without changing the SNS TFQKD experimental system.

基于三个互不偏基的双场量子密钥分发Twin-field quantum key distribution with three mutually unbiased bases

推导二维希尔伯特空间中X、Y、Z三个互不偏基下的误码率，据此提升双场量子密钥分发的长距离密钥率与最大可达距离；无需改动物理实现，仅需对实验数据做后处理。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体无需量子中继即可突破速率—透射率的根本极限，为城际用户之间共享信息论安全的密钥提供了颇具前景的解决方案。本文提出，通过推导二维希尔伯特空间中三个互不偏基，即$\sigma_{X}$、$\sigma_{Y}$和$\sigma_{Z}$下的误码率，来提升TF-QKD在长距离下的密钥率以及最大可达距离。此外，在获知这些误码率后，可以引入含噪预处理以进一步提升其性能。我们还观察到，在加入含噪预处理时，较高的比特误码率并不必然意味着较低的密钥率。我们的方法不改变现有的物理实现或实验操作，只需对实验数据进行简单的后处理，因而可直接用于提升现有QKD系统的密钥率性能。仿真结果表明，对于相位编码TF-QKD协议，该方法在长距离密钥率和最大可达距离方面均有显著提升。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variants provide a promising solution for sharing information-theoretic secure keys between intercity peers since they are able to overcome the fundamental rate-transmittance bound without quantum repeaters. In this paper, we propose to improve the key rate at long distances and the maximum achievable distance for TF-QKD by deriving the error rates under three mutually unbiased bases, i.e., ${\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{X}, {\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{Y}$, and ${\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{Z}$ in two-dimensional Hilbert space. Moreover, learning these error rates, one can add noisy preprocessing to further improve its performance. We also observe that higher bit error rates do not necessarily imply lower key rates when noisy preprocessing is added. Our method does not change the existing physical implementation or experimental operation, but only requires simple postprocessing of the experimental data, which can be directly used to improve the key rate performance of the existing QKD system. The simulation results demonstrate its notable enhancements in terms of key rate at long distances and the maximum achievable distance for the phase-encoded TF-QKD protocol.

基于部分相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution with Partial Phase Postselection

提出部分相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发方案：编码模式免除全局相位随机化与后选择，以保持高成码率优势；诱骗模式则引入相位后选择来改善性能，并借助算符支配条件证明了有限码长下相干攻击时的普适安全性。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的用户能够共享信息论安全的密钥。近年来，一种被称为双场（TF）QKD的革命性突破被提出，用以克服成码率受线性限制的问题，并大幅提升了可达距离。相位随机化及随后的后选择在其安全性证明中发挥作用。此后，无相位后选择的TF QKD被提出，并成为流行的变体，因为去掉相位后选择可以获得更高的成码率；但与原始方案相比，其可达距离有所下降。本文提出一种部分相位后选择的TF QKD协议。即，其编码模式仍不依赖全局相位随机化和后选择，以保证高成码率的优势得以保留；另一方面，在诱骗模式中引入相位后选择以改善性能。应用算符支配条件，我们证明了所提协议的普适安全性：在有限码长情形下，它能在相干攻击下保持安全。数值模拟证实了该协议在成码率和可达距离方面的潜在优势。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) allows two remote parties to share information-theoretically secure keys. In recent years, a revolutionary breakthrough called twin-field (TF) QKD has been developed to overcome the linear key-rate constraint and greatly increases the achievable distance. Phase randomization and subsequent postselection play roles in its security proof. Later, no-phase-postselection TF QKD was proposed and became a popular variant, since the removal of phase postselection leads to a higher key rate. However, the achievable distance is decreased compared to the original one. Here, we propose a TF QKD protocol with partial phase postselection. Namely, its code mode is still free from global phase randomization and postselection to make sure the advantage of the high key rate remain. On the other hand, phase postselection is introduced in the decoy mode to improve the performance. Applying an operator dominance condition, we prove universal security of the proposed protocol in the finite-key case under coherent attacks, and numerical simulations confirm its potential advantages in terms of key rate and achievable distance.

利用三个互无偏基的维度见证提取更多随机性Extracting more randomness using dimension witnesses with three mutually unbiased bases

把制备-测量型量子随机数协议推广到用二维希尔伯特空间全部互无偏基约束最小熵，使不同光损耗与环境扰动下的成码率更高，并用偏振互无偏基完成原理性验证。

随机数在从密码任务到数值模拟的各类应用中都有价值。真正的随机性通常被认为只能来自用量子力学描述的量子系统。维度见证使我们能够区分经典与量子情形，并从实验数据评估系统维度。因此，基于维度见证的量子随机数发生器（QRNG）引起了大量研究。这里我们把 Brunner 等人 [Phys. Rev. Lett. 112, 140407 (2014).] 提出的制备-测量型 QRNG 协议推广为一个更一般、更优的协议。在我们的协议中，二维希尔伯特空间的全部互无偏基均可用于约束最小熵，从而在不同的光路损耗和不同的环境扰动下获得更高的随机数产生速率。我们还给出了该协议的原理性实验实现，与先前的方案相比，通过增加光子偏振互无偏基使随机数速率得到提升。我们的方法也可能适用于更高维的量子系统。

Abstract (English)
Random numbers are valuable for applications ranging from cryptographic tasks to numerical simulations. Genuine randomness is generally considered possible only with a quantum system described by quantum mechanics. The dimension witness allows us to distinguish between classical and quantum scenarios, and assess the system dimensions from experimental data. Accordingly, a quantum random number generator (QRNG) based on dimension witnesses has attracted intensive study. Here we extend the prepare-and-measure QRNG protocol proposed by Brunner et al. [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 112 , 140407 ( 2014 ). PRLTAO 0031-9007 10.1103/PhysRevLett.112.140407 ] to a more general and better one. In our protocol, all the mutually unbiased bases of two-dimensional Hilbert space can be used to bound the min-entropy, which leads to a higher random number generation rate in different optical path losses and different environmental disturbances. We also demonstrate a proof-of-principle realization of our protocol, in which the random number rate increases by more photon polarization mutually unbiased bases compared with the previous one. Our method may also be applicable in higher-dimensional quantum systems.

Abstract (English)
In this erratum the formulas (6) and (8) of Opt. Lett.44, 139 (2019) OPLEDP0146-959210.1364/OL.44.000139 have been updated.

Xue-Bi An, Hao Zhang, Chun-Mei Zhang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Qin Wang, De-Yong He, Peng-Lei Hao, Shu-Feng Liu, Xing-Yu Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.44.001133

No. 02

基于吉赫兹BB84量子密钥分发系统的实用化量子数字签名Practical quantum digital signature with a gigahertz BB84 quantum key distribution system

设计了对信道扰动本征稳定的非对称法拉第–Sagnac–Michelson干涉仪结构，使BB84系统重复频率达吉赫兹量级；在25 dB信道损耗、10⁻¹⁰安全等级下实现0.044 bit/s的签名速率。

量子数字签名（QDS）能够以信息论安全保证消息的完整性与不可否认性，近来受到更多关注。自Andersson等人提出[Phys. Rev. A 93, 032325 (2016)]以来，已有若干种不同的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统实现了使用非安全信道的量子数字签名协议。在此我们报道一套基于BB84 QKD系统的QDS实验。我们的系统设计了非对称法拉第–Sagnac–Michelson干涉仪结构，该结构对信道扰动具有本征稳定性。这一创新结构支撑系统高速工作，实际重复频率达到吉赫兹量级。在由25 km已铺设光纤并附加光学衰减构成的25 dB信道损耗下，于10⁻¹⁰安全等级下获得了0.044 bit/s的签名速率。因此，我们的QDS装置稳定且高效。本文为进一步推动QDS的实际应用迈出了一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum digital signature (QDS) can guarantee message integrity and non-repudiation with information-theoretical security, and it has attracted more attention recently. Since proposed by Andersson et al. [Phys. Rev. A93, 032325 (2016)PLRAAN1050-294710.1103/PhysRevA.93.032325], a quantum digital signature protocol using an insecure channel has been realized with several different quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. Here we report an experimental QDS based on a BB84 QKD system. An asymmetric Faraday–Sagnac–Michelson interferometer structure has been designed in our system, which is intrinsically stable against channel disturbance. The innovatory structure supports the system to work at high speed and, in practice, the repetition rate is in gigahertz. A 0.044 bit/s signature rate has been attained with a 25 dB channel loss composed of a 25 km installed fiber with additional optical attenuation in a 10−10 security level. Thus, our QDS device is stable and highly efficient. This Letter provides a further step for the practical application of QDS.

Xue-Bi An, Hao Zhang, Chun-Mei Zhang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Qin Wang, De-Yong He, Peng-Lei Hao, Shu-Feng Liu, Xing-Yu Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.44.000139

No. 03

基于维度见证违反与弱测量的实验三方量子随机数发生器Experimental three-party quantum random number generator based on dimension witness violation and weak measurement

基于弱测量技术提出并实验实现三名观测者共享的量子随机数发生器，首次观测到基于行列式值的双经典维度见证违反，并借助预告式单光子源同时满足独立性与维度假设，达到半设备无关级别。

随机数产生是现代科学中的一项重要任务。人们已提出并实现了多种量子随机数产生协议。然而，这些协议都基于两方。基于弱测量技术，我们提出并实现了三名观测者之间的量子随机数发生器。实验中首次观测到基于行列式值的双经典维度见证的违反。借助预告式单光子源，我们的实验装置满足了独立性假设与维度假设，这意味着我们的装置是半设备无关（semi-DI）的。本文为在多用户之间产生设备无关型随机数提供了新的思路，并在网络环境下的量子密码与量子随机数方面具有潜在应用前景。

Abstract (English)
Random number generation is an important task in modern science. A variety of quantum random number generation protocols have been proposed and realized. These protocols, however, are all based on two parties. Based on the weak measurement technique, we propose and realize a quantum random number generator among three observers. The violation of a double classical dimension witness based on the determinant value is first observed in experiment. With the heralding single-photon source, our experimental setup attains the independent assumption and the dimension assumption, which means our setup is semi-device-independent (DI). This Letter sheds new light on generating DI-type random number among multi-user and it has potential application prospect on the quantum cryptography and quantum random number in network environment.

Xue-Bi An, Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Meng-Jun Hu, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.43.003437

No. 04

基于独立装置与维度见证的量子随机数发生器原理性实现Proof-of-principle implementation of a quantum random number generator with independent devices and a dimension witness

利用预报式单光子源完成 Han16 协议的原理性实验，在独立装置条件下使量子随机数产生率较此前协议几乎翻倍，并验证该协议可容忍损耗与噪声。

随机数是现代科学中的一个核心问题，而如何估计给定装置所产生数据的真实随机性则是一个中心问题。Lunghi 等人提出了一种基于独立装置制备-测量场景的自检验量子随机数发生器。在此文基础上，Han 等人提出了一种更高效的估计真实随机性的方法（简称 Han16 协议）。这里我们报道利用 HSPS 对 Han16 协议进行的原理性实现。实验结果表明，与先前的协议相比，Han16 协议几乎使量子随机数的产生率提高了一倍。此外，实验结果还表明 Han16 协议是实用的，且实验装置能够容忍损耗与噪声。

Abstract (English)
The random number is a paramount issue in modern science. How to estimate the genuine randomness of the data generated by a given device is a central problem. Lunghi et al. proposed a self-testing quantum random number generator from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices. Based on this Letter, Han et al. proposed a more efficient method (Han16 protocol for short) to estimate the genuine randomness. Here we report a proof-of-principle realization of the Han16 protocol with a HSPS. The experimental results demonstrate that the Han16 protocol almost doubles the generation rate of the quantum random number with regard to the previous protocol. In addition, the results of the experiment show that the Han16 protocol is practical, and the experimental device can tolerate loss and noise.

Xue-Bi An, Yun-Guang Han, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Huang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.42.004139

Hua Chen3 篇

No. 01

基于纠缠光子的确定性量子密钥分发实验验证Experimental demonstration on the deterministic quantum key distribution based on entangled photons

利用电信波段纠缠光子源与改进的 Ping-Pong 协议，在 9 dB 光损耗信道中首次实现安全的确定性量子密钥分发，展示了纠缠光源用于实际光纤量子通信的可行前景。

作为一种重要资源，纠缠光源已被用于发展量子信息技术，例如量子密钥分发（QKD）。由于现有协议的安全性可能在有损信道中受到损害，迄今很少有实验实现基于纠缠的确定性 QKD 协议。在这项工作中，我们报道了一个遵循改进的“乒乓”（PP）协议的容损确定性 QKD 实验。实验结果首次证明，基于电信波段纠缠光子源，可以在光损耗为 9 dB 的信道中完成一次安全的确定性 QKD 会话。这展示了将纠缠光源用于现实光纤量子通信的可想见前景。

Abstract (English)
Abstract As an important resource, entanglement light source has been used in developing quantum information technologies, such as quantum key distribution(QKD). There are few experiments implementing entanglement-based deterministic QKD protocols since the security of existing protocols may be compromised in lossy channels. In this work, we report on a loss-tolerant deterministic QKD experiment which follows a modified “Ping-Pong”(PP) protocol. The experiment results demonstrate for the first time that a secure deterministic QKD session can be fulfilled in a channel with an optical loss of 9 dB, based on a telecom-band entangled photon source. This exhibits a conceivable prospect of ultilizing entanglement light source in real-life fiber-based quantum communications.

Hua Chen, Zhi-Yuan Zhou, Alaa Jabbar Jumaah Zangana, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Juan Wu, Yun-Guang Han, Shuang Wang, Hong-Wei Li, De-Yong He, Shelan Khasro Tawfeeq, Bao-Sen Shi, Guang-Can Guo, Wei Chen, Zheng-Fu Han
Scientific Reports

10.1038/srep20962

No. 02

两个独立弱相干脉冲间的Hong–Ou–Mandel干涉Hong–Ou–Mandel interference with two independent weak coherent states

用光量子理论分析两个独立弱相干脉冲间的HOM干涉，确认50%的可见度上限源自脉冲中的双单光子态，并借助同一皮秒激光分束与相位扫描在实验中逼近该极限。

近年来，由于测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）的推动，两个独立弱相干脉冲（WCP）之间的Hong–Ou–Mandel（HOM）干涉受到了广泛关注。此前基于经典波动理论的文献表明，这类HOM型干涉的可见度不超过50%。本工作采用量子光学方法分析这类干涉，相比波动理论揭示了更多细节。分析确认了50%的最大可见度，并得出结论：在不考虑噪声的情况下，50%的最大可见度来源于弱相干脉冲中的双单光子态。实验中，利用由同一皮秒激光源分束得到的弱相干脉冲并结合相位扫描，成功逼近了50%的可见度。由于这类HOM干涉对慢相位涨落不敏感，已实现的与所提出的实验方案均可为高分辨率光学测距提供稳定的途径。

Abstract (English)
Recently, the Hong–Ou–Mandel (HOM) interference between two independent weak coherent pulses (WCPs) has been paid much attention due to the measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD). Using classical wave theory, articles reported before show that the visibility of this kind of HOM-type interference is ≤ 50%. In this work, we analyze this kind of interference using quantum optics, which reveals more details compared to the wave theory. Analyses confirm the maximum visibility of 50%. And we conclude that the maximum visibility of 50% comes from the two single-photon states in WCPs, without considering the noise. In the experiment, we successfully approach the visibility of 50% by using WCPs splitting from the single pico-second laser source and phase scanning. Since this kind of HOM interference is immune to slow phase fluctuations, both the realized and proposed experiment designs can provide stable ways of high-resolution optical distance detection.

Hua Chen, Xue-Bi An, Juan Wu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Fu Han
Chinese Physics B

10.1088/1674-1056/25/2/020305

No. 03

偏振控制中固定轴线性延迟器有限延迟量限制的新方案New scheme for finite-retardation limitations of linear retarders with fixed axes in polarization control

针对固定轴线性延迟器延迟量有限这一约束，提出几何与数学上简明的约束方案并与最大值搜索算法结合，四路级联光纤挤压器实验中平均偏振误差角仅 0.09 rad，且未触及延迟极限。

固定轴线性延迟器的有限延迟量范围限制了其在偏振控制中的应用。本工作针对这一有限延迟量限制提出了一种简单高效的约束方案，并从几何和数学上给出了其理论基础。新的偏振控制算法将该约束方案与一种广泛使用的最大值搜索算法相结合。仿真和实验均证实了所提方案与控制算法的有效性和实用性。实验中，控制系统采用四个级联的线性延迟器，其快轴交替取向为 0° 和 45°。每个延迟器（光纤挤压器）具有 4π 的有限延迟量范围。在 15 分钟的测试中，系统以 26 rad/s 的平均速度稳定偏振波动，平均（最大）偏振误差角为 0.09（0.28）rad。此外，未出现触及延迟量极限的情况。

Abstract (English)
Finite retardation ranges of linear retarders with fixed axes limit their applications in polarization control. In this work, we present a simple and efficient constraint scheme for this finite-retardation limitation. Its theoretical basis is given geometrically and mathematically. The new polarization control algorithm combines the constraint scheme and a widely-used maximum-search algorithm. Both simulations and experiments confirm the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed scheme and control algorithm. In experiments, the control system uses four cascaded linear retarders with fast axes alternately oriented at 0° and 45°. Each retarder (fiber squeezer) has a finite retardation range of 4π. For a 15-min test, the mean (maximum) polarization error angle is 0.09 (0.28) rad while stabilizing a polarization fluctuation at an average speed of 26 rad/s. Furthermore, no events of hitting retardation limits occur.

Hua Chen, Mo Li, Wen-Ye Liang, Dong Wang, De-Yong He, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Communications

10.1016/j.optcom.2015.09.067

No. 01

无需相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution without Phase Postselection

该工作提出一种完全不需要后选择的截断型双场量子密钥分发协议，并给出通用安全性证明，表明即使只使用有限诱骗态，其密钥率也可优于其他方案，从而使中距离QKD系统具备更高实用价值。

在量子密码学中，双场（TF）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议可以通过有损信道提升理论密钥率，但其大多数安全性证明需要相位后选择，这使实际系统变得复杂，并严重限制了安全密钥率。本研究提出了一种无需任何后选择的截断TF-QKD协议，给出了通用的安全性证明，并表明即使只采用有限诱骗态，该方案在密钥率方面也可能优于其他协议。该协议表明中距离QKD系统可以达到高得多的密钥率，将使QKD系统在未来的网络安全中更具适用性。

Abstract (English)
In quantum cryptography, the twin-field (TF) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol could extend theoretical key rates through a lossy channel, but most of its security proofs require phase postselection, which complicates practical systems and severely limits secure key rates. This study presents a truncated TF-QKD protocol without any postselection, gives a general security proof, and shows that this scheme may beat other protocols in terms of key rate, even when only finite decoy states are employed. By showing that a medium-range QKD system can reach much higher key rates, this protocol will make QKD systems more applicable in tomorrow's cybersecurity.

Chaohan Cui, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.11.034053

No. 01

已铺设光纤中的偏振变化及其对量子密钥分发系统的影响Polarization variations in installed fibers and their influence on quantum key distribution systems

利用实测光纤偏振漂移数据建立定量评估方法，提出偏振漂移时间与所需跟踪速度两个特征参数，并针对不同长度的埋地与架空光纤给出偏振基对准模块的要求与建议。

已铺设光纤中的偏振变化复杂且易变，会严重影响对偏振敏感的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统的性能。基于所记录的各类已铺设光纤偏振变化数据，我们建立了一种解析方法，用于定量评估偏振变化对偏振敏感 QKD 系统的影响。以偏振变化引起的量子比特误码率上升作为关键判据，我们提出偏振漂移时间和所需跟踪速度两个参数来刻画偏振变化。针对不同长度的埋地与架空光纤，我们定量评估了偏振变化的影响，并就部署于不同类型光纤中的 QKD 系统的偏振基对准模块提出了要求与建议。

Abstract (English)
Polarization variations in the installed fibers are complex and volatile, and would severely affect the performances of polarization-sensitive quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. Based on the recorded data about polarization variations of different installed fibers, we establish an analytical methodology to quantitatively evaluate the influence of polarization variations on polarization-sensitive QKD systems. Using the increased quantum bit error rate induced by polarization variations as a key criteria, we propose two parameters - polarization drift time and required tracking speed - to characterize polarization variations. For field buried and aerial fibers with different length, we quantitatively evaluate the influence of polarization variations, and also provide requirements and suggestions for polarization basis alignment modules of QKD systems deployed in different kind of fibers.

Yu-Yang Ding, Hua Chen, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1364/OE.25.027923

No. 02

利用公开筛选密钥比特的量子密钥分发偏振基跟踪方案Polarization-basis tracking scheme for quantum key distribution using revealed sifted key bits

仅使用纠错过程中公开的筛选密钥比特，实现单光子级连续偏振基跟踪，无需参考光也不中断量子信号传输，50 km 光纤 BB84 系统连续运行 24 小时平均量子比特误码率 2.32%、标准差 0.87%。

发射端与接收端之间偏振基的校准是量子密钥分发中的一项重要任务。持续工作的偏振基跟踪方案（PBTS）将有效提升系统效率，并降低在传输与校准模式之间切换时的潜在安全风险。在此，我们提出了一种单光子水平的持续工作 PBTS，仅使用纠错过程中公开的筛选密钥比特，不引入额外的参考光，也不中断量子信号的传输。我们将该方案应用于 50 km 光纤信道中的偏振编码 BB84 QKD 系统，在 24 小时连续运行期间获得了 2.32% 的平均量子比特误码率（QBER）和 0.87% 的标准差。稳定且相对较低的 QBER 验证了该方案的有效性。

Abstract (English)
The calibration of the polarization basis between the transmitter and receiver is an important task in quantum key distribution. A continuously working polarization-basis tracking scheme (PBTS) will effectively promote the efficiency of the system and reduce the potential security risk when switching between the transmission and calibration modes. Here, we proposed a single-photon level continuously working PBTS using only sifted key bits revealed during an error correction procedure, without introducing additional reference light or interrupting the transmission of quantum signals. We applied the scheme to a polarization-encoding BB84 QKD system in a 50 km fiber channel, and obtained an average quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 2.32% and a standard derivation of 0.87% during 24 h of continuous operation. The stable and relatively low QBER validates the effectiveness of the scheme.

Yu-Yang Ding, Wei Chen, Hua Chen, Chao Wang, Ya-Ping li, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

基于薄膜铌酸锂微环谐振腔的全可调谐光滤波器Fully tunable optical filter based on a thin-film lithium niobate microring resonator

在薄膜铌酸锂芯片上实现2.5 mm×1.2 mm全可调滤波器，用三个电光移相器独立调节消光比、谐振波长与阻带宽度，消光比覆盖约0至31 dB，最大消光比下阻带宽度8.8~9.6 GHz，中心波长调谐效率1.95(8) pm/V。

本文在薄膜铌酸锂平台上演示了一种占位面积为2.5 mm × 1.2 mm的全可调谐光滤波器，其中消光比、谐振波长和阻带宽度可通过三个集成的电光移相器独立且同时调节。该器件实现的消光比调谐范围约为0 dB至31 dB。在最大消光比下，阻带宽度可在8.8 GHz至9.6 GHz之间变化。此外，阻带中心波长可线性移动，调谐效率为1.95(8) pm/V。这项工作为片上光子系统提供了一种紧凑、电光可重构且具备独立多参数控制能力的滤波器架构。

Abstract (English)
A fully tunable optical filter on a thin-film lithium niobate platform with a footprint of 2.5 mm × 1.2 mm is demonstrated, in which the extinction ratio, resonant wavelength, and stopband width can be independently and simultaneously adjusted via three integrated electro-optic phase shifters. The device achieves an extinction-ratio tuning range from approximately 0 dB to 31 dB. At maximum extinction ratio, the stopband width can be varied between 8.8 GHz and 9.6 GHz. Moreover, the stopband center wavelength can be shifted linearly with a tuning efficiency of 1.95(8) pm/V. This work provides a compact, electro-optically reconfigurable filter architecture with independent multi-parameter control for on-chip photonic systems.

Jia-Wen Fan, Jia-Lin Chen, Yu Guo, Ji-Zhe Zhang, Jia-Qi Wang, Yuan-Hao Yang, Xin-Biao Xu, Chang-Ling Zou, Guang-Can Guo, Wei Chen, Bi-Heng Liu

No. 01

独立器件下量子随机性认证的最优性Optimality of quantum randomness certification with independent devices

通过构建约化器件模型并证明其与原模型等价来估计最小熵，将问题化为混合整数规划高效求解，并在对称观测概率约束下给出解析形式的最优界，显著提升实际认证性能。

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）在密码系统中发挥着日益重要的作用。具体而言，在独立器件的制备—测量场景中实现的QRNG已引起深入研究，因为它本质上可容忍损耗，且其对器件的假设看起来相当自然。然而，先前工作中给出的最小熵估计并非最优，因此量子随机性认证在实际中的性能仍受到严重压制。这里我们提出一种估计最小熵的新方法：构建一个约化器件模型，并证明它与原模型等价。得益于这一约化，我们能够用混合整数规划有效地求解最小熵估计问题。此外，我们推导出当约束由对称的观测概率构成时一个解析形式的最优界。模拟结果表明，我们的工作在这一情形下给出最优解，并且相比先前工作带来了显著的性能提升。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) play an increasingly important role in cryptography systems. Specifically, QRNG performed in prepare-and-measure scenarios with independent devices has attracted intensive study, since it can be intrinsically loss tolerant and its assumptions on devices seem to be quite natural. However, the estimations of min-entropy given in previous works are not optimal. As a result, the performance of quantum randomness certification in practice is still severely depressed. Here, we present a novel method to estimate the min-entropy through developing a reduced device model and proving its equivalence to the original one. Benefitting from this reduction, we can solve the min-entropy estimation problem using mixed integer programming effectively. Furthermore, we derive an optimal bound of analytic form in the case that constraints are made up of symmetric observed probabilities. Simulation results show that our work gives an optimal solution in this case and brings a significant performance improvement compared to previous works.

独立器件场景下量子随机性认证的更紧致界Tighter bound of quantum randomness certification for independent-devices scenario

针对独立器件制备—测量场景中基于维度见证的随机性认证，引入拉格朗日乘子法更紧致地求解平均猜测概率优化问题，给出解析形式的最小熵下界，模拟显示随机数产生速率显著提高。

量子随机数产生因其随机性本质上来源于量子力学而非数学假设而备受关注。随机性认证，例如熵估计，成为量子随机数产生协议中的关键问题。我们研究一种基于维度见证的自检验协议，并假设器件相互独立。它解决了在器件未经表征的实际制备—测量场景中提取随机数的问题。然而，在现有工作中，作为维度见证函数的最小熵下界并不紧致。我们通过引入拉格朗日乘子法，对平均猜测概率上的优化问题进行细致分析，给出了更紧致的解析形式下界。仿真表明，实际中可实现显著更高的随机数产生速率。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum random number generation attracts considerable attention, since its randomness inherently originates in quantum mechanics, but not mathematical assumptions. Randomness certification, e.g. entropy estimation, becomes a key issue in the context of quantum random number generation protocol. We study a self-testing protocol based on dimension witness, with the assumption of independent devices. It addresses the random number extraction problem in a practical prepare-and-measure scenario with uncharacterized devices. However, the lower bound of min-entropy as a function of dimension witness is not tight in existing works. We present a tighter bound of analytic form, by introducing the Lagrangian multiplier method to closely analyze the optimization problem on average guessing probability. Through simulation, it turns out that a significantly higher random number generation rate can be achieved in practice.

C波段多芯光纤中量子密钥分发与25 dBm经典信道的集成Integration in the C-band between quantum key distribution and the classical channel of 25 dBm launch power over multicore fiber media

在7芯多芯光纤上实现量子与经典信道共存，借助空分复用将经典信道发射功率提升至25 dBm，较此前提高近19倍，且二者最小波长间隔仅1.6 nm，无需窄带滤波器。

量子—经典共存可基于波分复用（WDM）实现，但由于拉曼噪声，量子信号与经典信号之间的波长间隔以及经典信道的发射功率受到限制。如今，多芯光纤（MCF）可有效实现空分复用（SDM），从而降低拉曼噪声，进而放宽同波段共存的限制并获得高通信容量。本文在7芯MCF上实现了量子—经典共存。基于SDM，实现了25 dBm的最高发射功率，较此前工作提升了近19倍。此外，量子信道与经典信道均分配在C波段，二者之间的最小波长间隔仅为1.6 nm。该共存系统无需增加窄带滤波器。

Abstract (English)
The quantum–classical coexistence can be implemented based on wavelength division multiplexing (WDM), but due to Raman noise, the wavelength spacing between quantum and classical signals and launch power from classical channels are restricted. Space division multiplexing (SDM) can now be availably achieved by multicore fiber (MCF) to reduce Raman noise, thereby loosening the restriction for coexistence in the same band and obtaining a high communication capacity. In this paper, we realize the quantum–classical coexistence over a 7-core MCF. Based on the SDM, the highest launch power of 25 dBm is achieved which has been extended nearly 19 times in previous work. Moreover, both the quantum and classical channels are allocated in the C-band and the minimum wavelength spacing between them is only 1.6 nm. The coexistence system eliminates the need for adding a narrowband filter.

No. 02

基于超低损耗光纤的量子密钥分发与超高功率经典光通信融合Quantum key distribution integrating with ultra-high-power classical optical communications based on ultra-low-loss fiber

在 75 km 超低损耗光纤上结合有限密钥安全分析与经典信号噪声模型，实现经典信道 25 dBm 发射功率下的离散变量量子密钥分发，为共纤共存报道的最高功率。

考虑到光纤资源与实际应用的灵活性，在同一光纤介质中融合量子密钥分发（QKD）与经典光通信的需求大幅增长。为满足融合 QKD 的经典光网络大规模部署所需的超高功率，我们将有限密钥安全性分析方法与经典信号噪声模型相结合，在 75 km 的超低损耗（ULL）光纤上实现了经典信道发射功率高达 25 dBm 条件下的离散变量量子密钥分发（DV-QKD）。据我们所知，这是 DV-QKD 与经典通信共存时经典信号所达到的最高功率。结果表明，我们的 QKD 系统用于超高功率经典通信是可行的，并且具备耐受性。

Abstract (English)
The demand for the integration of quantum key distribution (QKD) and classical optical communication in the same optical fiber medium greatly increases as fiber resources and the flexibility of practical applications are taken into consideration. To satisfy the needs of the mass deployment of ultra-high power required for classical optical networks integrating QKD, we implement the discrete variable quantum key distribution (DV-QKD) under up to 25 dBm launch power from classical channels over 75 km on an ultra-low-loss (ULL) fiber by combining a finite-key security analysis method with the noise model of classical signals. To the best of our knowledge, this is the highest power launched by classical signals on the coexistence of DV-QKD and classical communication. The results exhibit the feasibility and tolerance of our QKD system for use in ultra-high-power classical communications.

高发射功率下基于标准单模光纤的量子密钥分发与光传送网共存Coexistence of quantum key distribution and optical transport network based on standard single-mode fiber at high launch power

在50 km标准G.652光纤上以15 dBm发射功率实现量子密钥分发与80 Gbps经典数据共存，20 km处安全密钥率达11 Kbps，并验证了对160 Gbps经典光功率高达18 dBm的容忍度。

考虑到城域光网络中的高成本和实际应用，单纤中量子密钥分发与光通信的复用需求日益增长。这里，我们在50 km广泛使用的标准（国际电信联盟电信标准化部门G.652建议）电信光纤上，以15 dBm发射功率实现了量子密钥分发与80 Gbps经典数据光传送网的集成，在20 km处获得11 Kbps的安全密钥率。通过容忍单模光纤上高达18 dBm的160 Gbps经典数据光功率，我们的结果表明量子密钥分发在未来大容量传输系统（如城域网和数据中心）中应用的潜力与容忍度。该量子密钥分发系统采用基于法拉第–米歇尔森干涉仪的相位编码方案，稳定、实用且对信道偏振扰动不敏感。我们还讨论了复用环境下量子密钥分发性能的基本极限。

Abstract (English)
There is an increasing demand for multiplexing of quantum key distribution with optical communications in single fiber in consideration of high costs and practical applications in the metropolitan optical network. Here, we realize the integration of quantum key distribution and an optical transport network of 80 Gbps classical data at 15 dBm launch power over 50 km of the widely used standard (G.652 Recommendation of the International Telecom Union Telecom Standardization Sector) telecom fiber. A secure key rate of 11 Kbps over 20 km is obtained. By tolerating a high classical optical power up to 18 dBm of 160 Gbps classical data on single-mode fiber, our result shows the potential and tolerance of quantum key distribution being used in future large capacity transmission systems, such as metropolitan area networks and data centers. The quantum key distribution system is stable, practical, and insensitive to the polarization disturbance of channels by using a phase coding system based on a Faraday–Michelson interferometer. We also discuss the fundamental limit for quantum key distribution performance in the multiplexing environment.

Jia-Qi Geng, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang, Qi-Fa Zhang, Ying-Ying Hu, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

独立装置制备-测量场景下获取更多量子随机性More randomness from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices

在独立装置的制备-测量场景中，改用全部观测概率直接计算最小熵而非仅依赖见证值；数值模拟表明典型不可信 BB84 装置下最小熵更高，可产出更多真实量子随机数。

如何从不可信装置中产生真实的量子随机性是量子信息处理中的一个重要问题。受此前关于自检验量子随机数发生器的工作［T. Lunghi 等，Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 150501 (2015)］启发，我们提出了一种在独立装置的制备-测量场景中产生量子随机性的方法。在已有协议中，量子随机性仅依赖于一个见证值（例如 Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt 值），该值由观测到的概率计算得到。与之不同，在我们的方法中，所有观测到的概率都被直接用于计算最小熵。通过数值模拟，我们发现当使用典型的不可信 Bennett-Brassard 1984（BB84）装置时，所提方案的最小熵高于此前的工作。因此，得益于这一方法，有可能获得比以往更多的真实量子随机数。

Abstract (English)
How to generate genuine quantum randomness from untrusted devices is an important problem in quantum information processing. Inspired by previous work on a self-testing quantum random number generator [T. Lunghi et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 150501 (2015)], we present a method to generate quantum randomness from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices. In existing protocols, the quantum randomness depends only on a witness value (e.g., Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt value), which is calculated with the observed probabilities. Differently, here all the observed probabilities are directly used to calculate the min-entropy in our method. Through numerical simulation, we find that the min-entropy of our proposed scheme is higher than that in the previous work when a typical untrusted Bennett-Brassard 1984 (BB84) setup is used. Consequently, thanks to the proposed method, more genuine quantum random numbers may be obtained than before.

No. 02

噪声与损耗信道下改进型乒乓协议的安全性Security of modified Ping-Pong protocol in noisy and lossy channel

针对 2002 年提出的基于纠缠的双向量子密钥协议给出一处简单且实验可行的修改，并证明在噪声与损耗信道下该改进协议可抵御集体攻击，仿真结果表明方案具有实用性。

“乒乓”（PP）协议是一种基于纠缠的双向量子密钥协议。在该协议中，Bob 制备一对最大纠缠量子比特，并把其中一个量子比特发送给 Alice；随后 Alice 对该量子比特进行一些必要的操作，再将其发回 Bob。尽管该协议早在 2002 年就已提出，但其在噪声与损耗信道中的安全性一直未被证明。在本报告中，我们对原始 PP 协议加入一处简单且实验上可行的修改，并在考虑噪声与损耗信道的情形下，证明这一改进型 PP 协议抵御集体攻击的安全性。仿真结果表明我们的协议是实用的。

Abstract (English)
The "Ping-Pong" (PP) protocol is a two-way quantum key protocol based on entanglement. In this protocol, Bob prepares one maximally entangled pair of qubits, and sends one qubit to Alice. Then, Alice performs some necessary operations on this qubit and sends it back to Bob. Although this protocol was proposed in 2002, its security in the noisy and lossy channel has not been proven. In this report, we add a simple and experimentally feasible modification to the original PP protocol, and prove the security of this modified PP protocol against collective attacks when the noisy and lossy channel is taken into account. Simulation results show that our protocol is practical.

基于线性光耦合器的紧凑型量子随机数产生Compact quantum random number generation using a linear optocoupler

利用发光二极管与光电探测器构成的集成线性光耦结构，直接测量输出光强噪声来产生随机比特，经 SHA-256 后处理后速率达 43 Mbps，序列通过 NIST 随机性检验。

迄今为止，已有多种量子随机数方案得到演示。然而，成本、体积以及最终的随机比特产生速率通常限制了它们作为现成产品被广泛应用。为克服这些限制，我们提出并演示了一种基于线性光耦合器的紧凑、简单且低成本的量子随机数产生方案。其集成结构主要由一个发光二极管和一个光电探测器构成。随机比特通过直接测量输出光的强度噪声来产生，该噪声源于发光二极管中 p 区空穴与 n 区电子之间的随机复合。此外，我们的系统对工作环境的涨落具有鲁棒性，并可扩展为并行结构，这对量子随机数产生的实用化与商业化应用具有重要意义。经 SHA-256 算法后处理后，获得 43 Mbps 的随机数产生速率。最终随机比特序列的自相关系数很低，其标准差为 3.16 × 10 − 4，并通过了 NIST 统计测试套件测试。

Abstract (English)
To date, various quantum random number schemes have been demonstrated. However, the cost, size, and final random bit generation rate usually limits their wide application on-shelf. To overcome these limitations, we propose and demonstrate a compact, simple, and low-cost quantum random number generation based on a linear optocoupler. Its integrated structure consists mainly of a light emitting diode and a photodetector. Random bits are generated by directly measuring the intensity noise of the output light, which originates from the random recombination between holes of the p region and electrons of the n region in a light emitting diode. Moreover, our system is robust against fluctuation of the operating environment, and can be extended to a parallel structure, which will be of great significance for the practical and commercial application of quantum random number generation. After post-processing by the SHA-256 algorithm, a random number generation rate of 43 Mbps is obtained. Finally, the final random bit sequences have low autocorrelation coefficients with a standard deviation of 3.16 × 10 − 4 and pass the NIST-Statistical Test Suite test.

基于标准单模光纤自发拉曼散射的量子随机数产生Quantum random number generation based on spontaneous Raman scattering in standard single-mode fiber

利用标准单模光纤中的后向自发拉曼散射，同时提取光子波长叠加与到达时间的随机性；每个有效探测得到5比特原始数据，含2.87比特最小熵，经后处理后通过NIST检验。

我们研究了基于标准单模光纤中后向自发拉曼散射的量子随机数产生方案，其中同时利用了光子波长叠加与到达时间的随机性。实验采用四个工作在门控盖革模式下的雪崩光电二极管，探测来自四个不同波长通道的后向拉曼散射光子，并在探测器之后放置时间数字转换器以记录其到达时间。来自不同通道的光子的波长信息与到达时间间隔信息均被用于产生随机比特。由于这两种熵源彼此独立，本系统的随机数资源得到了充分利用。每次有效探测可获得5比特原始数据，其中包含2.87比特最小熵。为获得随机比特的最佳产生速率，选用了合适的泵浦功率与光纤长度。采用SHA-256哈希算法进行后处理以消除原始数据的偏置，最终得到的随机比特序列通过了NIST统计检验。

Abstract (English)
We investigate quantum random number generation based on backward spontaneous Raman scattering in standard single-mode fiber, where the randomness of photon wavelength superposition and arrival time is simultaneously utilized. The experiment uses four avalanche photodiodes working in gated Geiger mode to detect backward Raman scattering photons from four different wavelength channels and a time-to-digital converter placed behind the detectors to record their arrival time. Both information of the wavelength and arrival time interval of photons from different channels are applied to generate random bits. Due to the independence of these two entropy sources, the random number resource of the present system is fully utilized. Five-bit raw data can be obtained for every effective click, which contains 2.87-bit min-entropy. To obtain the optimal generation rate of random bits, appropriate pump power and fiber length are adopted. The post-processing method by the SHA-256 hashing algorithm is used to remove the bias of the raw data, after which the final random bit sequences pass the NIST statistical test.

Ying-Ying Hu, Xing Lin, Shuang Wang, Jia-Qi Geng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 01

针对采用零差探测的量子密钥分发的量子黑客攻击Quantum hacking on quantum key distribution using homodyne detection

利用光纤分束器耦合比随波长变化这一器件不完美，提出针对零差探测连续变量量子密钥分发的波长攻击，可使实时散粒噪声估计产生偏差，并给出改进的防御方案。

商用量子密钥分发系统中的不完美器件会留下安全漏洞，窃听者可能加以利用。这类不完美的一个例子是光纤分束器的耦合比依赖于波长。利用这一漏洞，窃听者可以通过注入与通常使用波长不同的光，来改变接收端光纤分束器的透射率。在此，我们针对采用零差探测的实际连续变量量子密钥分发系统提出一种波长攻击。通过注入不同波长的光脉冲，该攻击使窃听者即使在进行实时散粒噪声估计时也能使其产生偏差。基于实验数据，我们讨论了该攻击的可行性，并通过改进此前提出的对策给出了一种防御方案。

Abstract (English)
Imperfect devices in commercial quantum key distribution systems open security loopholes that an eavesdropper may exploit. An example of one such imperfection is the wavelength-dependent coupling ratio of the fiber beam splitter. Utilizing this loophole, the eavesdropper can vary the transmittances of the fiber beam splitter at the receiver's side by inserting lights with wavelengths different from what is normally used. Here, we propose a wavelength attack on a practical continuous-variable quantum key distribution system using homodyne detection. By inserting light pulses at different wavelengths, this attack allows the eavesdropper to bias the shot-noise estimation even if it is done in real time. Based on experimental data, we discuss the feasibility of this attack and suggest a prevention scheme by improving the previously proposed countermeasures.

Jing-Zheng Huang, Sébastien Kunz-Jacques, Paul Jouguet, Christian Weedbrook, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1103/PhysRevA.89.032304

No. 02

利用波长攻击对连续变量量子密钥分发系统实施量子黑客攻击Quantum hacking of a continuous-variable quantum-key-distribution system using a wavelength attack

提出一种波长攻击，通过切换输入光波长控制Bob分束器的强度透过率，可攻破采用外差探测的连续变量量子密钥分发系统，即使监测了本地振荡光强度，最终密钥仍不安全。

连续变量量子密钥分发的安全性证明基于以下假设：窃听者既不能作用于本地振荡光，也不能控制Bob的分束器。由于此类协议在实现中可能存在不完美之处，这些假设在实际中可能并不成立。本文考虑本地振荡光在公共信道中传输的情形，提出一种波长攻击，使窃听者能够通过切换输入光的波长来控制Bob分束器的强度透过率。具体而言，我们针对采用外差探测协议、并使用直接协商或逆向协商的连续变量量子密钥分发系统。我们证明该攻击是可行的，并使得合法双方共享的所有最终密钥都不再安全，即使他们已监测了本地振荡光的强度。为在商用系统上防范该攻击，应在执行监测探测之前随机加入一个简单的波长滤波器。

Abstract (English)
The security proofs of continuous-variable quantum key distribution are based on the assumptions that the eavesdropper can neither act on the local oscillator nor control Bob's beam splitter. These assumptions may be invalid in practice due to potential imperfections in the implementations of such protocols. In this paper, we consider the problem of transmitting the local oscillator in a public channel and propose a wavelength attack which allows the eavesdropper to control the intensity transmission of Bob's beam splitter by switching the wavelength of the input light. Specifically we target continuous-variable quantum key distribution systems that use the heterodyne detection protocol using either direct or reverse reconciliation. Our attack is proved to be feasible and renders all of the final keys shared between the legitimate parties insecure, even if they have monitored the intensity of the local oscillator. To prevent our attack on commercial systems, a simple wavelength filter should be randomly added before performing monitoring detection.

Jing-Zheng Huang, Christian Weedbrook, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Hong-Wei Li, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.87.062329

利用波长相关分束器与多波长光源攻击实际量子密钥分发系统Attacking a practical quantum-key-distribution system with wavelength-dependent beam-splitter and multiwavelength sources

针对熔融双锥分束器的波长相关特性这一安全漏洞，提出可适用于所有被动状态调制 QKD 系统的攻击方案，并在偏振编码系统上仅以误码率从 1.3% 升至 1.4% 的代价窃取全部密钥。

众所周知，量子密钥分发（QKD）的无条件安全性可由量子力学保证。然而，实际 QKD 系统存在一些不完美之处，窃听者可以利用这些不完美来攻击密钥。以当前的实验技术，采用熔融双锥工艺制作的实际分束器具有波长相关特性。基于这一致命的安全漏洞，我们提出一种波长相关攻击方案，它可应用于所有采用被动状态调制的实际 QKD 系统。此外，我们对一个实际的偏振编码 QKD 系统进行了实验攻击，仅以将量子比特错误率从 1.3% 提高到 1.4% 为代价，就获取了全部密钥信息。

Abstract (English)
It is well known that the unconditional security of quantum-key distribution (QKD) can be guaranteed by quantum mechanics. However, practical QKD systems have some imperfections, which can be controlled by the eavesdropper to attack the secret key. With current experimental technology, a realistic beam splitter, made by fused biconical technology, has a wavelength-dependent property. Based on this fatal security loophole, we propose a wavelength-dependent attacking protocol, which can be applied to all practical QKD systems with passive state modulation. Moreover, we experimentally attack a practical polarization encoding QKD system to obtain all the secret key information at the cost of only increasing the quantum bit error rate from $1.3$ to $1.4%$.

基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉构建大规模全连接量子网络，利用集成孤子微梳与光子编码芯片实现大规模并行频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉和MDI量子密钥分发，在200 km范围、不可信网络提供商条件下仍保证严格的信息论安全性。

全连接量子网络可使每个用户同时与其他所有用户相连，是一种高度通用且鲁棒的组网架构。然而，此类网络的可扩展性在实用化应用中仍是巨大挑战。本文基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉构建了一个大规模全连接量子网络，即使网络提供商不可信，用户与用户之间的安全性仍能得到保证。利用集成孤子微梳（SMC）和光子编码芯片，我们实现了精确且大规模并行的频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉以及测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发。所提出的架构可在不可信网络提供商的条件下，实现跨越200公里的、具有严格信息论安全性的全连接量子网络。该组网架构为构建覆盖城域与城际的大规模全连接MDI量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Fully connected quantum networks enable simultaneous connection of every user to every other user and are a highly versatile and robust networking architecture. However, the scalability of such networks remains a great challenge for practical applications. Here we construct a large-scale fully connected quantum network founded on two-photon Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference, where user-to-user security is guaranteed even with an untrusted network provider. Using integrated soliton microcomb (SMC) and photonic encoding chips, we realize precise, massively parallel frequency generation and locking, high-visibility HOM interference and measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution. The proposed architecture enables a fully connected quantum network over 200 kilometers with strict information-theoretic security via an untrusted network provider. The implemented networking architecture paves the way for large-scale fully connected MDI quantum networks across metropolitan and intercity regions.

Ni–CeO2电极上氢氧化反应路径的密度泛函理论与实验联合研究Hydrogen Oxidation Pathway Over Ni–Ceria Electrode: Combined Study of DFT and Experiment

用强关联修正的密度泛函理论结合电导弛豫与程序升温脱附实验，揭示Ni10-CeO2(111)上氢氧化以伴随氢溢流的界面路径为主，界面反应贡献达98%，浸渍Ni形成界面使800°C活性提升72%。

Ni–二氧化铈金属陶瓷因其催化活性以及二氧化铈基材料因铈的可变价态而具有的混合电导，是中温固体氧化物燃料电池的潜在阳极。然而，Ni–二氧化铈体系中的阳极反应机理仍需进一步揭示。本工作采用强关联修正的密度泛函理论，深入研究了在Ni10-CeO2(111)模型体系上氢氧化反应的反应路径。计算表明，电子倾向于从Ni10团簇转移到铈表面，形成表面氧空位。考虑不同吸附位点后提出了六条路径，发现伴随氢溢流进行的界面路径是主导过程，其吸附能高达−1.859 eV，能垒为0.885 eV。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结果通过电导弛豫和程序升温脱附等实验测量得到验证。界面反应对总氢氧化反应的贡献高达98%，而通过将Ni浸渍到多孔二氧化铈中形成Ni–二氧化铈界面，使800°C下的电化学活性提高了72%。

Abstract (English)
Ni–ceria cermets are potential anodes for intermediate-temperature solid oxide fuel cells, thanks to the catalytic activity and mixed conductivities of ceria-based materials associated with the variable valence states of cerium. However, the anodic reaction mechanism in the Ni–ceria systems needs to be further revealed. Via density functional theory with strong correlated correction method, this work gains insight into reaction pathways of hydrogen oxidation on a model system of Ni 10 -CeO 2 (111). The calculation shows that electrons tend to be transferred from Ni 10 cluster to cerium surface, creating surface oxygen vacancies. Six pathways are proposed considering different adsorption sites, and the interface pathway proceeding with hydrogen spillover is found to be the prevailing process, which includes a high adsorption energy of −1.859 eV and an energy barrier of 0.885 eV. The density functional theory (DFT) calculation results are verified through experimental measurements including electrical conductivity relaxation and temperature programmed desorption. The contribution of interface reaction to the total hydrogen oxidation reaction reaches up to 98%, and the formation of Ni–ceria interface by infiltrating Ni to porous ceria improves the electrochemical activity by 72% at 800°C.
