离散相位随机化BB84协议的有限密钥分析Finite key analysis for discrete phase randomized BB84 protocol

针对离散相位随机化BB84协议缺乏有限脉冲数安全性分析的问题，给出两种条件下的安全性分析与参数优化，确认相位数超过30时可按连续相位随机化估算密钥率，相位较少时给出数值方法，性能略降但仍可接受。

量子密钥分发（QKD）是一种依赖量子力学内禀随机性来保证信息论安全性的安全通信方法。BB84是最早也是应用最广泛的QKD协议，其安全性证明至关重要。离散相位随机化BB84协议是诱骗态BB84协议的一种变体，已被证明在高速度QKD系统的发展中具有前景。然而，它仍然缺乏针对有限脉冲数的分析。本文对离散相位BB84协议进行了全面的安全性分析，在不同条件下使用两种不同的方法。分析包括仿真与优化，以确定最佳参数设置。研究确认，对于典型场景，如果离散相位的数量超过30，就可以假定运行的是连续相位随机化过程来计算密钥率。另一方面，对于相对较少的离散取值，我们发展了一种数值方法来计算密钥率。我们确认，在有限脉冲数下其性能有所下降，但仍然可以接受。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a secure communication method that relies on the inherent randomness of quantum mechanics to ensure information-theoretic security. The first and most widely used QKD protocol is BB84, and the proof of BB84's security is vital. The Discrete Phase Randomized BB84 protocol is a variant of the decoy BB84 protocol. It has been proven to be promising in the development of high-speed QKD systems. However, it still lacks an analysis with a finite number of pulses. This paper presents a comprehensive security analysis of the discrete phase BB84 protocol, using two different methods under different conditions. The analysis involves simulations and optimizations to determine the optimal parameter settings. It is confirmed that for typical scenarios, if the number of discrete phases exceeds 30, one can calculate the key rate by assuming that a continuous phase randomization process was in operation. On the other hand, for a relatively smaller number of discrete values, we have developed a numerical method to calculate the key rate. We have confirmed that its performance is reduced but still acceptable with a finite number of pulses.

Xiao-Hang Jin, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a secure communication method that relies on the inherent randomness of quantum mechanics to ensure information-theoretic security. The first and most widely used QKD protocol is BB84, and the proof of BB84's security is vital. The Discrete Phase Randomized BB84 protocol is a variant of the decoy BB84 protocol. It has been proven to be promising in the development of high-speed QKD systems. However, it still lacks an analysis with a finite number of pulses. This paper presents a comprehensive security analysis of the discrete phase BB84 protocol, using two different methods under different conditions. The analysis involves simulations and optimizations to determine the optimal parameter settings. It is confirmed that for typical scenarios, if the number of discrete phases exceeds 30, one can calculate the key rate by assuming that a continuous phase randomization process was in operation. On the other hand, for a relatively smaller number of discrete values, we have developed a numerical method to calculate the key rate. We have confirmed that its performance is reduced but still acceptable with a finite number of pulses.

电磁干扰对智能电网中实用量子密钥分发系统的影响Effect of electromagnetic disturbance on the practical QKD system in the smart grid

研究了变电站电磁干扰对智能电网中法拉第—迈克尔逊相位编码QKD系统的影响，推导出干扰引起的条纹可见度变化与附加量子误码率，最坏情况下平均值仅增加约0.17%，并给出了抑制该干扰的途径。

为提高智能电网的安全性，量子密钥分发（QKD）是一个极佳的选择。电力架空光缆上的快速波动以及变电站中的电磁干扰，是QKD实施面临的两大主要挑战。由于对信道的双折射不敏感，稳定的相位编码法拉第—迈克尔逊QKD系统在智能电网中非常实用。然而，必须考虑变电站中的电磁干扰对这一实用QKD系统的影响。这种干扰可能改变法拉第镜的旋转角，从而引入额外的量子比特误码率（QBER）。我们推导了该系统在电磁干扰下的新条纹可见度以及附加QBER。在最坏情况下，干扰导致的平均附加QBER仅增加约0.17%，相对于正常QBER值而言较小。我们还找到了降低电磁干扰对QKD系统影响的方法。

Abstract (English)
To improve the security of the smart grid, quantum key distribution (QKD) is an excellent choice. The rapid fluctuations on the power aerial optical cable and electromagnetic disturbance in substations are two main challenges for implementation of QKD. Due to insensitivity to birefringence of the channel, the stable phase-coding Faraday—Michelson QKD system is very practical in the smart grid. However, the electromagnetic disturbance in substations on this practical QKD system should be considered. The disturbance might change the rotation angle of the Faraday mirror, and would introduce an additional quantum bit error rate (QBER). We derive the new fringe visibility of the system and the additional QBER from the electromagnetic disturbance. In the worst case, the average additional QBER only increases about 0.17% due to the disturbance, which is relatively small to normal QBER values. We also find the way to degrade the electromagnetic disturbance on the QKD system.

从量子信息论出发给出测量设备无关量子密钥分发的安全性证明，界定了窃听者对筛选后密钥比特所掌握信息的上界，并据此得到最终的安全密钥比特率。

尽管一些理想量子密钥分发协议已被证明是安全的，但已有若干演示表明，实际量子密钥分发实现会因现实中的不完美性而遭到攻击。在这些攻击中，探测器侧信道攻击可能是最严重的。最近，一种测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议［Phys. Rev. Lett. 108 (2012) 130503］被提出，该方案消除了所有探测器侧信道攻击。这里给出一个基于量子信息论的新安全性证明。窃听者对筛选后密钥比特所掌握的信息被给出上界。进而利用该上界，可以得到最终的安全密钥比特率。

Abstract (English)
Although some ideal quantum key distribution protocols have been proved to be secure, there have been some demonstrations that practical quantum key distribution implementations were hacked due to some real-life imperfections. Among these attacks, detector side channel attacks may be the most serious. Recently, a measurement device independent quantum key distribution protocol [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 108 (2012) 130503 ] was proposed and all detector side channel attacks are removed in this scheme. Here a new security proof based on quantum information theory is given. The eavesdropper's information of the sifted key bits is bounded. Then with this bound, the final secure key bit rate can be obtained.

提出以改进相干态光源取代弱相干态来实现带诱骗态的测量设备无关量子密钥分发，模拟显示安全密钥率与传输距离均明显提升，原因在于多光子事件概率更低而单光子概率更高。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议是为消除探测器侧信道攻击而提出的。由于相干态光源存在多光子事件，MDI-QKD 协议的实际实现必须采用诱骗态来抵御光子数分离攻击。近来已有基于弱相干态（WCS）的 MDI-QKD 诱骗态研究。在本快报中，我们提出用改进相干态（MCS）光源来执行 MDI-QKD 协议。我们模拟了基于 MCS 光源的诱骗态 MDI-QKD 的性能，模拟表明，采用 MCS 光源可显著提升安全密钥率与传输距离。这一提升背后的物理原因是：MCS 的多光子事件概率低于 WCS，同时其单光子概率更高。

Abstract (English)
The measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol has been proposed for the purpose of removing the detector side channel attacks. Due to the multiphoton events of coherent states sources, real-life implementations of MDI-QKD protocol must employ decoy states to beat the photon-number-splitting attack. Decoy states for MDI-QKD based on the weak coherent states (WCSs) have been studied recently. In this Letter, we propose to perform MDI-QKD protocol with modified coherent states (MCS) sources. We simulate the performance of MDI-QKD with the decoy states based on MCS sources. And our simulation indicates that both the secure-key rate and transmission distance can be improved evidently with MCS sources. The physics behind this improvement is that the probability of multiphoton events of the MCS is lower than that of WCSs while at the same time the probability of single-photon is higher.

基于Sagnac干涉仪的参考系无关诱骗态BB84量子密钥分发实验实现Experimental realization of a reference-frame-independent decoy BB84 quantum key distribution based on Sagnac interferometer

利用光子偏振与轨道角动量联合编码，结合自补偿光纤Sagnac干涉仪实现高速偏振调制、q-plate无源操控旋转不变态，实验完成了可容忍参考系漂移的诱骗态BB84量子密钥分发。

量子密钥分发（QKD）利用量子物理特性，可在相距遥远的用户之间生成安全密钥比特。然而在大多数场景下，QKD系统都需要一个共享参考系。参考系无关（RFI）方案能够容忍合法远端用户之间参考系的漂移，这对于卫星、飞机等相对运动终端的运行具有重要意义。我们设计并通过实验演示了一套RFI-BB84-QKD系统，该系统利用光子的偏振态与轨道角动量态进行联合编码。我们采用自补偿光纤Sagnac干涉仪实现高速偏振调制，并用q-plate无源操控旋转不变的光子态，从而使该系统可以借助现成的商用器件实现高速运行。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can generate secure key bits between remote users employing the features of quantum physics. However, a shared reference frame is necessary for QKD systems in most scenarios. A reference-frame-independent (RFI) scheme can tolerate the reference frame drifting between legitimate remote users, which is significant in the operation of relative moving terminals such as satellites and aircraft. We design and experimentally demonstrate an RFI-BB84-QKD system by joint encoding with the polarization and orbital angular momentum states of the photons. We use self-compensating fiber Sagnac interferometers to perform high-speed polarization modulation, and q-plates to passively manipulate the rotation-invariant photon states, which makes the system feasible for high-speed operation using off-the-shelf components.

提出一种可直接搭建在现有BB84系统上的单光子贝尔态测量量子密钥分发方案，揭示其与传统相位编码协议之间的隐藏物理联系，并实验验证了可行性。

最近，人们提出了一些基于单光子贝尔态测量（SBSM）的测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）替代方案。尽管这些替代方案的安全性并不严格等同于MDI QKD，但它们具备传统类BB84协议成码率高的优势，同时避免了MDI QKD所要求的两光子干涉技术复杂性。然而，与常用的BB84系统相比，这些已提出方案的装置相当复杂。在此我们提出一种基于SBSM的QKD的简单实现，它直接建立在已有的BB84 QKD实现之上。我们的方案揭示了基于SBSM的QKD与传统相位编码QKD协议之间的隐藏联系。这一发现阐明了这两类不同QKD协议背后的物理。此外，我们实验演示了该协议的可行性。

Abstract (English)
Recently some alternatives to the measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD) based on the single-photon Bell-state measurement (SBSM) were proposed. Although these alternatives are not precisely as secure as the MDI QKD, they possess the advantage of a high key rate of the traditional BB84-like protocol and avoid the technical complexity of two-photon interference required in the MDI QKD. However, the setups of these proposed schemes are rather complicated compared to commonly used BB84 systems. Here we propose a simple implementation of SBSM-based QKD that is directly built on the existing realization of the BB84 QKD. Our proposal exhibits the hidden connection between the SBSM-based QKD and traditional phase-encoding QKD protocols. This finding discloses the physics behind these two different types of QKD protocols. In addition, we experimentally demonstrate the feasibility of our protocol.

相位编码参考系无关量子密钥分发的原理性验证实验Proof-of-principle experiment of reference-frame-independent quantum key distribution with phase coding

在80 km光纤上完成相位编码参考系无关QKD原理性实验，计入有限码长后仍可达50 km；并提出适用于弱相干源的诱骗态方法以抵抗光子数分离攻击。

我们展示了在80 km光纤链路上进行的相位编码参考系无关量子密钥分发（RFI-QKD）原理性实验。在考虑有限码长界之后，仍可实现50 km的传输距离。在此情形下，各基矢态的相位之间由一种缓慢时变的变换相联系。此外，我们针对采用弱相干源的RFI-QKD系统提出并实现了一种新的诱骗态方法，用以抵御光子数分离攻击。借助参考系无关协议以及带有法拉第旋转镜的迈克耳孙干涉仪，我们的系统对干涉仪的慢相位变化和信道的偏振扰动均免疫，使整个流程具有很强的鲁棒性。

Abstract (English)
We have demonstrated a proof-of-principle experiment of reference-frame-independent phase coding quantum key distribution (RFI-QKD) over an 80-km optical fiber. After considering the finite-key bound, we still achieve a distance of 50 km. In this scenario, the phases of the basis states are related by a slowly time-varying transformation. Furthermore, we developed and realized a new decoy state method for RFI-QKD systems with weak coherent sources to counteract the photon-number-splitting attack. With the help of a reference-frame-independent protocol and a Michelson interferometer with Faraday rotator mirrors, our system is rendered immune to the slow phase changes of the interferometer and the polarization disturbances of the channel, making the procedure very robust.

诱骗态协议是为克服原始的光子数分离攻击而提出的。当采用更优策略时，攻击者可以使信号态脉冲与诱骗态脉冲的总增益之比变化很小，甚至可使信号态脉冲的总增益与没有攻击者时相同。本文首先给出一个包含原始攻击的部分光子数分离攻击模型，进而发现诱骗态协议在部分光子数分离攻击下仍然有效。

Abstract (English)
The decoy state protocol was proposed to overcome the primitive photon number splitting attack. When using a better strategy, the attacker can ensure that the ratio of the overall gain of the signal state pulse against the decoy state pulse changes very little, even to keep the overall gain of the signal state pulses equal to that obtained without attacker. In this paper we first give a model of the partial photon number splitting attack which contains the original one, and then find that the decoy state protocol still works effectively under the partial photon number splitting attack.

Abstract (English)
The estimation of key rate is an important aspect of the quantum key distribution process, especially in the use of dead time. In this paper, we demonstrate a numerical simulation to estimate the average detection probability and the key rate. Using our method, the estimated average detection probability is better than the previous result. Besides, we can easily find the best dead time, especially when considering the impact of after pulse.

基于FPGA的数字相位编码量子密钥分发系统FPGA based digital phase-coding quantum key distribution system

提出一种新的数字调制方法并搭建紧凑型相位编码QKD样机，在50 km光纤上连续运行87小时，平均量子误码率3.22%、成码率8.91 kbps，方案可扩展至Gbit/s级高速系统。

量子密钥分发（QKD）是一项有望实现信息论安全的技术。相位编码是研制光纤信道实用化QKD系统的重要途径。为提高相位编码的调制速率，本文提出一种新的数字调制方法，并利用实验室现有器件搭建了紧凑、稳健的QKD系统样机，以验证该方法的有效性。系统部署于实验室环境的50 km光纤上，在无人干预的情况下连续运行87 h。系统量子误码率（QBER）保持稳定，平均值为3.22%，安全成码率为8.91 kbps。尽管受法拉第-迈克耳孙干涉仪（FMI）结构限制，演示系统中光子的调制速率仅为200 MHz，但所提方法与基于现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）的电子学方案，对于调制速率达Gbit/s量级的高速QKD系统具有很大潜力。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a technology with the potential capability to achieve information-theoretic security. Phasecoding is an important approach to develop practical QKD systems in fiber channel. In order to improve the phase-coding modulation rate, we proposed a new digital-modulation method in this paper and constructed a compact and robust prototype of QKD system using currently available components in our lab to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method. The system was deployed in laboratory environment over a 50 km fiber and continuously operated during 87 h without manual interaction. The quantum bit error rate (QBER) of the system was stable with an average value of 3.22% and the secure key generation rate is 8.91 kbps. Although the modulation rate of the photon in the demo system was only 200 MHz, which was limited by the Faraday-Michelson interferometer (FMI) structure, the proposed method and the field programmable gate array (FPGA) based electronics scheme have a great potential for high speed QKD systems with Giga-bits/second modulation rate.

提出一种针对门控雪崩光电二极管的雪崩过渡区攻击，窃听引入的量子比特误码率不足 0.5%，攻击前后光电流与后脉冲概率几乎不变，几乎不留痕迹。

作为迈向实用化与安全量子密钥分发的必要步骤，识别并修补可能的攻击是重要且有价值的。本研究讨论一种针对门控模式雪崩光电二极管（APD）探测器的雪崩过渡区（ATR）攻击，此类探测器广泛用于量子密钥分发系统。与其他攻击不同，这种攻击几乎不留痕迹；窃听者引入的量子比特误码率低于 0.5%，攻击前后的光电流与后脉冲概率几乎相同。这些发现凸显了实际量子密钥分发系统中探测信号的重要性，对提升实用化量子密钥分发的安全性至关重要。

Abstract (English)
As necessary steps toward practical and secure quantum key distribution (QKD), identifying and patching possible attacks are important and valuable. This study discusses an avalanche-transition-region (ATR) attack on a gated-mode avalanche photodiode (APD) detector, widely used in QKD systems. Unlike other attacks, this one leaves almost no trace; the eavesdropper introduces less than 0.5% quantum bit-error rate, and the photocurrent and afterpulse probability before and after hacking are nearly identical. These findings highlight the importance of detection signals in real-life QKD systems, and are crucial to enhancing the security of practical QKD.

在固态量子存储器中存储量子点发射的多个单光子脉冲Storage of multiple single-photon pulses emitted from a quantum dot in a solid-state quantum memory

★Nat. Commun.

在保偏固态量子存储器中存储量子点确定性发射的单光子，并演示了 1、20 和 100 个窄单光子脉冲的多时间模式存储，每个脉冲至多含一个光子，为全固态量子中继器奠定基础。

量子中继器是不可避免的光学传输损耗下，在远距离分发纠缠的关键部件。受 Duan–Lukin–Cirac–Zoller 协议启发，人们提出了许多基于量子存储器的改进型量子中继器协议，这些协议通常关注纠缠分发速率。在这些协议中，消除多光子（或多光子对）以及使用多模量子存储器已被证明能够大幅提高纠缠分发速率。在此，我们演示了将量子点确定性发射的单光子存储于保偏固态量子存储器中；此外，还演示了具有 1、20 和 100 个窄单光子脉冲的多时间模式存储。多光子被消除，每个脉冲中最多只包含一个光子。而且，两个子系统的固态特性使该构型更加稳定、更易于扩展。我们的工作将有助于构建基于全固态器件的高效量子中继器。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum repeaters are critical components for distributing entanglement over long distances in presence of unavoidable optical losses during transmission. Stimulated by the Duan–Lukin–Cirac–Zoller protocol, many improved quantum repeater protocols based on quantum memories have been proposed, which commonly focus on the entanglement-distribution rate. Among these protocols, the elimination of multiple photons (or multiple photon-pairs) and the use of multimode quantum memory are demonstrated to have the ability to greatly improve the entanglement-distribution rate. Here, we demonstrate the storage of deterministic single photons emitted from a quantum dot in a polarization-maintaining solid-state quantum memory; in addition, multi-temporal-mode memory with 1, 20 and 100 narrow single-photon pulses is also demonstrated. Multi-photons are eliminated, and only one photon at most is contained in each pulse. Moreover, the solid-state properties of both sub-systems make this configuration more stable and easier to be scalable. Our work will be helpful in the construction of efficient quantum repeaters based on all-solid-state devices.

面向实际部署的分层城域量子密码网络外场实验Field experiment on a robust hierarchical metropolitan quantum cryptography network

基于市区商用电信光纤，用法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪装置搭建含七个用户的城域分层量子密码网络，集成量子路由器、光开关与可信中继，并在政府部门之间实现即时视频、声音、文本消息与机密文件的安全传输。

本文报道了一个架设在市区商用电信光纤上的分层城域量子密码网络。该七用户网络包含一个四节点骨干网（其中一个节点充当子网网关）、一个两用户子网以及一条单光纤接入链路，它们均由法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪装置实现。这里集成了量子路由器、光开关和可信中继等技术，以保证量子密码网络的可行性与可扩展性。网络中有五个节点位于政府部门，量子密钥分发网络所生成的密钥被用于加密这些部门之间传输的即时视频、声音、文本消息和机密文件。包括分层量子密码通信网络链路及相应应用软件在内的整体实现，标志着朝着具有高安全水平的实用用户导向网络迈出了一大步。

Abstract (English)
A hierarchical metropolitan quantum cryptography network upon the inner-city commercial telecom fiber cables is reported in this paper. The seven-user network contains a four-node backbone net with one node acting as the subnet gateway, a two-user subnet and a single-fiber access link, which is realized by the Faraday-Michelson interferometer set-ups. The techniques of the quantum router, optical switch and trusted relay are assembled here to guarantee the feasibility and expandability of the quantum cryptography network. Five nodes of the network are located in the government departments and the secure keys generated by the quantum key distribution network are utilized to encrypt the instant video, sound, text messages and confidential files transmitting between these bureaus. The whole implementation including the hierarchical quantum cryptographic communication network links and the corresponding application software shows a big step toward the practical user-oriented network with a high security level.

综述飞机与无人机平台量子密钥分发的最新进展，梳理自由空间信道传输与移动平台链路等关键技术，并展望机载量子通信在天地一体化网络中承担灵活中继的作用。

自由空间量子密钥分发（QKD）已取得令人瞩目的成就，它是扩展量子通信传输距离的一种可行途径。借助卫星、飞机、无人机（UAV）等移动平台经由自由空间信道传输量子比特的可行性已得到验证。鉴于星基 QKD 的工作时间与资源消耗有限，且卫星节点与地面网络之间存在最后一公里难题，机载 QKD 有望为大规模一体化网络提供灵活的链路与中继。本文综述了基于飞机或无人机的 QKD 近期的重要进展，重点介绍其关键技术，并展望机载量子通信的未来。

Abstract (English)
Remarkable achievements have been witnessed in free-space quantum key distribution (QKD), which acts as an available approach to extend the transmission range of quantum communications.The feasibility of transmitting qubits through the free-space channel with the aid of moving platforms like satellites, aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has been verified.In view of the limited working time and resource consumption of the satellite-based QKD and the last-mile challenges of connecting satellite nodes with terrestrial networks, the airborne QKD is expected to provide flexible and relay links for the large-scale integrated network.This paper reviews the recent significant progress of QKD based on aircraft or UAVs, highlights their critical techniques, and prospects the future of airborne quantum communications.

No. 01

Pt-CeO2基催化剂上CO2的活化与还原CO<sub>2</sub> Activation and Reduction on Pt-CeO<sub>2</sub>-Based Catalysts

结合密度泛函理论与电导弛豫方法研究三种Pt修饰或未修饰的CeO2基催化剂上的CO2还原，发现Pt团簇促进界面电子转移、拉近d带中心并降低解离能垒，还原速率排序与实验测量一致。

CO2转化在可持续碳循环中起着关键作用。本工作通过密度泛函理论（DFT）和电导弛豫（ECR）两种方法，研究了三种Pt修饰/未修饰的CeO2基催化剂（部分还原的CeO2(111)、Pt修饰的部分还原CeO2(111)，以及Pt修饰的部分还原Sm0.2Ce0.8O1.9(111)（SDC）表面）上的CO2还原。DFT结果表明，CeO2基表面上的Pt团簇能够有效增强CO2的吸附能并降低CO2解离的能垒，有利于CO2的转化。这应归因于电子从CeO2基表面转移到Pt团簇，使Pt的d带中心更靠近费米能级，从而增强了CO2与Pt d电子之间的相互作用。深入研究表明，在没有Pt团簇的情况下，CO2分子需要先形成CO3^2–，然后再解离为CO，这与Pt团簇上CO2的直接活化不同。重要的是，CO2反应的微观动力学分析表明，CO2还原速率遵循Pt修饰的SDC表面 > Pt修饰的CeO2表面 > CeO2表面的顺序。这一结果与ECR测量结果一致。

Abstract (English)
CO 2 conversion plays a critical role in sustainable carbon cycling. In this work, reduction of CO 2 over three Pt-decorated/undecorated CeO 2 -based catalysts (partially reduced CeO 2 (111), Pt decorated partially reduced CeO 2 (111), and Pt decorated partially reduced Sm 0.2 Ce 0.8 O 1.9 (111) (SDC) surfaces) is investigated via both density functional theory (DFT) and electrical conductivity relaxation (ECR) methods. DFT results indicate that a Pt cluster over a CeO 2 -based surface could effectively enhance CO 2 adsorption energies and depress the energy barriers for CO 2 dissociation, beneficial to the CO 2 conversion. This should be ascribed to the electron transferring from the CeO 2 -based surface to the Pt cluster, which makes the Pt d-band center closer to the Fermi level and thus enhances the interaction between CO 2 and Pt d-electrons. Intensive investigation indicates that without the Pt cluster, the CO 2 molecule needs to form CO 3 2– first and then dissociates into CO, different from the direct activation of CO 2 on the Pt cluster. Importantly, the microkinetic analyses of CO 2 reactions suggest that the CO 2 reduction rates follow the sequence of Pt-decorated SDC surface > Pt-decorated CeO 2 surface > CeO 2 surface. This result is consistent with ECR measurements.

在信息论框架下提出并实验实现结合量子光学与相对论的安全位置验证协议，2 km 间距的两位验证者借助相位随机化弱相干态，以优于 75 m 的精度确认证明者位置。

一种确定实体位置的安全方法可以支撑基于位置的交易授权、高价值目标追踪等方案。然而在证明者不可信的情形下，经典方法无法提供安全的位置验证，这意味着证明者可以就其真实位置误导验证者。我们提出并在信息论框架内实验实现了一种将量子光学与相对论相结合的安全位置验证协议。利用相位随机化弱相干态，相距 2 km 的两位验证者以优于 75 m 的精度安全地验证了证明者的位置。这些结果使安全的位置基认证成为实际可能，为金融交易、灾害响应与可认证的安全通信等应用铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A secure approach to determining the position of an entity can enable schemes such as position-based authorization for transactions and tracking of high-value targets. However, classical methods are incapable of providing secure position verification in the untrusted-prover case, meaning that a prover can mislead verifiers about its actual position. Here we propose and experimentally realize a secure position verification protocol that combines quantum optics and relativity within an information-theoretic framework. Using phase-randomized weak coherent states, two verifiers separated by 2 km securely verify the prover’s position with an accuracy better than 75 m. These results establish secure position-based authentication as a practical possibility, paving the way for applications in financial transactions, disaster response and authenticated secure communications.

微梳驱动的大规模全连接量子网络Microcomb-driven large-scale fully connected quantum network

★Nat. Commun.

基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉构建大规模全连接量子网络，利用集成孤子微梳与光子编码芯片实现大规模并行频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉和MDI量子密钥分发，在200 km范围、不可信网络提供商条件下仍保证严格的信息论安全性。

全连接量子网络可使每个用户同时与其他所有用户相连，是一种高度通用且鲁棒的组网架构。然而，此类网络的可扩展性在实用化应用中仍是巨大挑战。本文基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉构建了一个大规模全连接量子网络，即使网络提供商不可信，用户与用户之间的安全性仍能得到保证。利用集成孤子微梳（SMC）和光子编码芯片，我们实现了精确且大规模并行的频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉以及测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发。所提出的架构可在不可信网络提供商的条件下，实现跨越200公里的、具有严格信息论安全性的全连接量子网络。该组网架构为构建覆盖城域与城际的大规模全连接MDI量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Fully connected quantum networks enable simultaneous connection of every user to every other user and are a highly versatile and robust networking architecture. However, the scalability of such networks remains a great challenge for practical applications. Here we construct a large-scale fully connected quantum network founded on two-photon Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference, where user-to-user security is guaranteed even with an untrusted network provider. Using integrated soliton microcomb (SMC) and photonic encoding chips, we realize precise, massively parallel frequency generation and locking, high-visibility HOM interference and measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution. The proposed architecture enables a fully connected quantum network over 200 kilometers with strict information-theoretic security via an untrusted network provider. The implemented networking architecture paves the way for large-scale fully connected MDI quantum networks across metropolitan and intercity regions.

No. 02

基于平面光波回路芯片的偏振不敏感量子密钥分发Polarization-insensitive quantum key distribution using planar lightwave circuit chips

研制出基于平面光波回路的偏振不敏感时间比特解码芯片，从机理上补偿量子信号的偏振扰动，并在1.25 GHz时钟频率、50 km光纤下获得1.34 Mbps的平均安全密钥率。

量子密钥分发（QKD）系统的自稳定对于准确评估窃听者所获取的信息至关重要。我们研制并验证了一种用于QKD的偏振不敏感时间比特解码芯片，它基于平面光波回路（PLC）的混合非对称法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪（AFMI）。与现有基于芯片的QKD工作相比，该方案能够从本质上补偿量子信号所受的偏振扰动，因而可在任意温度下工作。我们在时钟频率为1.25 GHz的时间比特QKD系统中对芯片进行了实验验证，并借助优化的分析模型，在50 km光纤信道上获得1.34 Mbps的平均安全密钥率（SKR）。量子比特误码率和SKR在随机偏振扰动下均保持稳定变化，这表明基于PLC的AFMI可用于发展自稳定的QKD系统。

Abstract (English)
Self-stabilizing the quantum key distribution (QKD) system is essential to evaluate eavesdroppers’ information accurately. We develop and verify a polarization-insensitive time-bin decoder chip for QKD with the hybrid asymmetric Faraday-Michelson interferometer (AFMI) based on the planar lightwave circuit (PLC). Compared with existing chip-based QKD works, the scheme can intrinsically compensate for the polarization perturbation to quantum signals and thus work at arbitrary temperatures. We experimentally verify the chips in a time-bin QKD system at the clocking rate of 1.25 GHz and obtain an average secure key rate (SKR) of 1.34 Mbps over a 50 km fiber channel with an optimized analysis model. The steady variations of the quantum bit error and SKR with random polarization disturbance demonstrate that PLC-based AFMIs are available for developing self-stable QKD systems.

Guo-Wei Zhang, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Li Zhang, Fang-Xiang Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wen Liu, Jun-Ming An, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Science China Information Sciences

No. 03

基于混合集成平面光波电路的偏振无关干涉仪Polarization-insensitive interferometer based on a hybrid integrated planar light-wave circuit

将石英平面光波电路芯片与法拉第旋转镜结合实现偏振无关干涉仪，两片带温控的非对称干涉仪串联评估单光子干涉，12小时平均可见度高于99%，起伏小于0.5%。

干涉仪是经典光学系统和量子光学系统中的基本元件。提取光子相位时所需的严格稳定性容易受到偏振变化以及环境扰动所引起相移的影响。在此，我们将石英平面光波电路芯片与法拉第旋转镜相结合，实现了偏振无关的干涉仪。两个带有温度控制器的非对称干涉仪串联连接，用以评估单光子干涉。即使存在主动的随机偏振扰动，12小时内的平均干涉可见度仍高于99%，且起伏小于0.5%。实验结果证实，该混合芯片可满足量子密钥分发和纠缠测量等高要求应用的需要。

Abstract (English)
Interferometers are essential elements in classical and quantum optical systems. The strictly required stability when extracting the phase of photons is vulnerable to polarization variation and phase shift induced by environment disturbance. Here, we implement polarization-insensitive interferometers by combining silica planar light-wave circuit chips and Faraday rotator mirrors. Two asymmetric interferometers with temperature controllers are connected in series to evaluate the single-photon interference. Average interference visibility over 12 h is above 99%, and the variations are less than 0.5%, even with active random polarization disturbance. The experiment results verify that the hybrid chip is available for high-demand applications like quantum key distribution and entanglement measurement.

No. 01

相位编码量子密钥分发系统相位漂移的实时补偿Real-time compensation of phase drift for phase-encoded quantum key distribution systems

针对相位调制存在非线性时主动相位跟踪难以适用的问题，提出四相位扫描法，由四条干涉条纹与编码矩阵自动算出相位调制器的驱动电压，可实时补偿环境变化与系统非线性引起的相位漂移。

相位漂移是相位编码量子密钥分发（QKD）系统固有的问题。现有的主动相位跟踪与补偿方案无法满足相位调制存在非线性的系统的要求。本文提出一种四相位扫描方法，该方法建立在对相位漂移所致量子比特误码率（QBER）的定量分析以及相位补偿的性能要求之上。通过获取四条干涉条纹并调整系统的编码矩阵，该方法可自动计算出相位调制器的精确驱动电压。实现方案与实验测试表明，所提方法能够补偿由环境变化和系统非线性引起的相位漂移，并适用于大规模QKD网络。

Abstract (English)
Phase drift is an inherent problem in phase-encoded quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. The current active phase tracking and compensation solutions cannot satisfy the requirements of a system with nonlinearity in phase modulation. This paper presents a four-phase scanning method, which is based on the quantitative analysis of the quantum bit error rate (QBER) from phase drift and the performance requirements of phase compensation. By obtaining the four interference fringes and adjusting the coding matrix of the system, this method automatically calculates the accurate driving voltages for the phase modulator. The implementation and experimental tests show that the proposed method can compensate phase drift caused by environmental changes and the system’s nonlinearity, and is applicable to large-scale QKD networks.

提出改进模型来模拟采用弱相干光源的被动诱骗态量子密钥分发，该模型在实际系统中性能更优，并完成了信道损耗超过 22.0 dB 的实验演示。

被动诱骗态量子密钥分发（PDS-QKD）在高速场景中具有优势。基于 Curty 的理论[Opt. Lett. 34, 3238 (2009)]，我们提出一个改进模型，用于模拟采用弱相干光源的 PDS-QKD。该改进模型能在实际 PDS-QKD 系统中提供更好的性能。此外，我们报道了信道损耗超过 22.0 dB 的 PDS-QKD 实验演示。

Abstract (English)
Passive decoy state quantum key distribution (PDS-QKD) has advantages in high-speed scenarios. We propose a modified model to simulate the PDS-QKD with a weak coherent light source based on Curty's theory [ Opt. Lett. 34 3238 (2009) ]. The modified model can provide better performance in a practical PDS-QKD system. Moreover, we report an experimental demonstration of the PDS-QKD of over 22.0-dB channel loss.

网络环境下密钥的量子秘密共享方案Quantum Secret Sharing of Key in Networks

分析了两类无需纠缠的实用量子秘密共享协议，并指出二者的组合可构成量子秘密共享网络的基本单元，具有实际应用潜力。

量子秘密共享是量子密码学中的一个重要问题。我们分析了两类无需纠缠的实用量子秘密共享协议，而它们的组合可以作为量子秘密共享网络中的一个基本单元，在实际应用中具有潜力。

Abstract (English)
Quantum secret sharing is a important problem in the quantum cryptography. We analyzed two kinds of practical quantum secret sharing protocols without entanglement. And their combination could be a basic unit in the quantum secret sharing network, which is potential in practical applications.

用于被动诱骗态量子密钥分发的实用非泊松光源Practical non-Poissonian light source for passive decoy state quantum key distribution

利用法拉第镜构建出本征稳定的非泊松光源，并以 Hanbury Brown-Twiss 实验测得稳定的 g(2)(0)，结果与 Curty 等人的理论预言吻合，为被动诱骗态量子密钥分发提供了关键器件。

被动诱骗态量子密钥分发（QKD）在高速应用中具有巨大潜力。本工作利用法拉第镜实现了一种本征稳定的非泊松光源，它有望成为实现被动诱骗态 QKD 的关键元件。通过 Hanbury Brown-Twiss 实验获得了稳定的 g(2)(0)，所得结果与依据 Curty 等人理论 [Opt. Lett. 34, 3238 (2009)] 给出的理论值符合良好。

Abstract (English)
Passive decoy state quantum key distribution (QKD) has enormous potential in high-speed applications. In this Letter, an intrinsic-stable non-Poissonian light source was implemented with Faraday mirrors and could be a crucial element in realizing passive decoy state QKD. The stable g((2))(0) was obtained through a Hanbury Brown-Twiss experiment, and the results fit well with the theoretical value according to Curty et al.'s theory [Opt. Lett.34, 3238 (2009)].

No. 01

测量设备无关的量子抛币协议及其抗探测器侧信道攻击方案Measurement-device-independent quantum coin tossing

针对不诚实 Alice 可借探测器致盲攻击使量子抛币完全失密的问题，提出测量设备无关量子抛币方案，在相干攻击下偏置与原容损协议相同，并可兼容弱相干态光源。

量子抛币（QCT）是量子密码学中的一个重要基本原语，一直受到持续关注。然而在实际的 QCT 中，Bob 的探测器可能遭受不诚实的 Alice 发起的探测器侧信道攻击，这有可能使协议完全不安全。在此，我们基于近期的一项实验报道了一种简单的探测器致盲攻击策略。为消除所有探测器侧信道，我们提出了测量设备无关 QCT（MDI-QCT）的解决方案。该方法类似于测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）的思想。MDI-QCT 在使用单光子源时是容损的，并且在相干攻击下具有与原容损 QCT 相同的偏置。此外，在某些特殊情形下，它还具有使安全距离加倍的潜在优势。最后，MDI-QCT 也可以经修改以适配弱相干态光源。因此，基于实用 MDI-QKD 的快速发展，我们的方案可以容易地实现。

Abstract (English)
Quantum coin tossing (QCT) is an important primitive of quantum cryptography and has received continuous interest. However, in practical QCT, Bob's detectors can be subjected to detector-side channel attacks launched by dishonest Alice, which will possibly make the protocol completely insecure. Here, we report a simple strategy of a detector-blinding attack based on a recent experiment. To remove all the detector side channels, we present a solution of measurement-device-independent QCT (MDI-QCT). This method is similar to the idea of MDI quantum key distribution (QKD). MDI-QCT is loss tolerant with single-photon sources and has the same bias as the original loss-tolerant QCT under a coherent attack. Moreover, it provides the potential advantage of doubling the secure distance for some special cases. Finally, MDI-QCT can also be modified to fit the weak coherent-state sources. Thus, based on the rapid development of practical MDI-QKD, our proposal can be implemented easily.

Liangyuan Zhao, Zhenqiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Hua Chen, Guangcan Guo, Zhengfu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.92.062327

Minghao Zheng1 篇

No. 01

固体氧化物燃料电池铜-氧化铈阳极三相界面的 H2 与 CO 氧化过程H 2 and CO oxidation process at the three-phase boundary of Cu-ceria cermet anode for solid oxide fuel cell

利用电导弛豫与交流阻抗方法解析 SDC-Cu-气相三相边界处 H2 和 CO 的氧化动力学，发现少量 Cu 覆盖即可主导反应并给出各自决速步，CO 氧化速率约为 H2 的五倍。

Cu-二氧化铈金属陶瓷作为以碳氢燃料运行的固体氧化物燃料电池（SOFC）阳极材料已被广泛研究。然而，阳极反应过程仍不清楚，尤其是二氧化铈-Cu-气相三相边界（3PB）处的反应过程。本工作研究了钐掺杂二氧化铈（SDC）-Cu-气相 3PB 处 H2 和 CO 氧化的反应动力学，这两种物质是碳氢化合物经外部重整和内部重整得到的产物。电化学电导弛豫测量表明，Cu 是一种协同催化剂，能够显著提高反应速率。当 5.4% 的 SDC 表面被 Cu 颗粒覆盖时，3PB 处的反应贡献了 H2/CO 氧化的 81.3/66.8%。结合交流阻抗分析，提出了 3PB 处反应的基元步骤。水蒸气结合到氧空位、一氧化碳转化为碳酸盐分别是 H2 和 CO 氧化的决速步。Cu-SDC 对 CO 氧化的催化活性远高于对 H2 的活性，反应速率约为后者的五倍。此外，Cu-SDC 电极对 CO 的电化学氧化表现出更低的界面极化电阻和更低的活化能。因此，当 Cu-二氧化铈阳极使用合成气（碳氢化合物的重整产物）时，CO 比 H2 更容易被氧化。

Abstract (English)
Cu-ceria cermets have been widely investigated as the anode materials for solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) that operated with hydrocarbon fuels. However, the anode reaction processes are not clear yet, especially those at the ceria-Cu-gas three phase boundary (3 PB). This work investigates samaria-doped ceria (SDC)-Cu-gas 3 PB reaction kinetics for the oxidation of H2 and CO, the products from hydrocarbons via external and internal reforming. Electrochemical conductivity relaxation measurement demonstrates that Cu is a synergistic catalyst that can significantly increase the reaction rate. The reaction at 3 PB contributes 81.3/66.8% of H2/CO oxidation when 5.4% SDC surface is covered with Cu particles. Combining with AC impedance analysis, elementary steps are proposed for the reaction at 3 PB. Water vapor combining to oxygen vacancy and carbon monoxide transforming to carbonate are the rate-determining steps for the oxidation of H2 and CO, respectively. Cu-SDC has shown much higher catalytic activity, i.e. about fivefold reaction rate, for the oxidation of CO than H2. In addition, Cu-SDC electrodes exhibit lower interfacial polarization resistance and lower activation energy for the electrochemical oxidation of CO than H2. Consequently, CO is easier to be oxidized than H2 when the Cu-ceria anode is fueled with syngas, the reforming product from hydrocarbons.

Minghao Zheng, Shuang Wang, Mei Li, Changrong Xia
Journal of Power Sources

10.1016/j.jpowsour.2017.01.127

No. 01

测量设备无关量子密钥分发中的光源时间不完美性Source temporal imperfections in measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

针对测量设备无关量子密钥分发中时间抖动、脉冲形状不完美与脉冲间干涉三类光源时间缺陷，建立按时间单元离散计算的定量刻画方案，并对四强度协议系统仿真优化参数，提升了密钥率。

在高速量子密钥分发系统中，重复频率是限制系统效率的关键因素。在基于双光子干涉的测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议的实现中，固有的时间不完美性会显著影响系统的重复频率。我们针对时间抖动、脉冲形状不完美和脉冲间干涉这三种时间不完美性建立了一套系统性的方案。通过将时间离散为时间单元并计算每个单元内的干涉，我们定量刻画了时间失配对双光子干涉的影响。利用该方案，我们仿真了一个基于四强度协议的具体实验系统，并通过参数优化获得了更高的密钥率。该方法由此为在高性能系统的实验实现中提升效率提供了一条具体路径。

Abstract (English)
In high-speed quantum key distribution systems, the repetition rate is a critical factor limiting system efficiency. In the implementation of the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution protocol based on two-photon interference, inherent temporal imperfections can significantly impact the system's repetition rate. We establish a systematic scheme for three temporal imperfections: time jitter, pulse shape imperfection, and interpulse interference. By discretizing time into time units and calculating the interference within each, we quantitatively characterize how temporal misalignment affects two-photon interference. Using this scheme, we simulate a specific experimental system based on the four-intensity protocol, and through parameter optimization, achieve a higher key rate. The approach thus offers a concrete pathway for enhancing the efficiency in the experimental realization of high-performance systems.

Zhi-Jian Hu, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Wei-Xin Xie, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Fang-Xiang Wang, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 02

强噪声环境下的高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发High-Rate Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution under Intense Noise

★Phys. Rev. Lett.

报道重复频率达2.5 GHz的高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发系统，结合优势蒸馏方法，在425 kHz噪声计数（比隔离环境高4个数量级）下仍能生成安全密钥，30 dB信道衰减时密钥率达到kbps量级，且无需庞大探测装置。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）是通向实用化量子通信的一条有前景的途径，但目前的高性能演示实验往往代价高昂且只能在隔离环境中实现。本文提出一套高速MDI-QKD系统，其重复频率达到前所未有的2.5 GHz，并通过引入优势蒸馏方法验证了其强大的抗噪声能力。该系统在425 kHz噪声计数下仍能高效生成安全密钥，这一噪声水平比隔离系统高4个数量级。在30 dB信道衰减下，无需庞大且资源密集的探测装置即可获得kbps量级的安全密钥率。本工作为QKD的部署确立了一套完整的实用化方案，并解决了长期以来难以实现的难题——构建兼具高安全性、高密钥率、环境鲁棒性和物理紧凑性的实用量子安全网络。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is a promising path toward practical quantum communication, but current high-performance demonstrations come at prohibitive overhead and isolated environments. Here, we present a high-speed MDI-QKD system operating at an unprecedented repetition frequency of 2.5 GHz and verify its strong noise tolerance by incorporating the advantage distillation method. The secure key is efficiently generated under 425 kHz noise counts, which is 4 orders of magnitude higher than isolated systems. A secure key rate with a kbps level is achieved under 30 dB channel attenuation without bulky, resource-intensive detection devices. Our Letter establishes a complete practical solution for QKD deployment and resolves the persistent difficulty of realizing practical quantum secure networks with advanced security, a high key rate, environmental robustness, and physical compactness.

Hong-Wei Li, Wei-Xin Xie, Chun-Mei Zhang, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yu-Long Wang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Letters

10.1103/1b8r-r248

No. 03

基于后处理时域滤波的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution based on postprocessing time-domain filtering

提出无需额外硬件的时域后处理滤波方案，抑制宣布式单光子源中光子对频谱关联对 HOM 干涉可见度的损害，通过优化滤波器宽度同时提升密钥率与最大传输距离，并可推广至量子隐形传态等协议。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）消除了所有探测器端的漏洞。与弱相干脉冲相比，宣布式单光子源（HSPS）能够标示光子的存在，从而延长 MDI-QKD 的可达距离，并使被动诱骗态实现和量子存储辅助构型等先进协议成为可能。然而在实际中，HSPS 中光子对之间的频谱关联会降低 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉的可见度。尽管窄带滤波可以抑制这一效应，但它依赖专用硬件且缺乏灵活性。在此，我们提出一种基于时域后处理滤波技术的 MDI-QKD 方案，该方案不需要额外硬件，显著提高了密钥率和最大传输距离。通过优化滤波器宽度，该方法可以灵活适应光源或信道的变化。此外，它还可以方便地推广到其他依赖 HOM 干涉的协议，包括量子隐形传态和纠缠交换。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) eliminates all detector-side vulnerabilities. Compared to weak coherent pulses, heralded single-photon sources (HSPSs) signal the presence of photons, thereby extending the achievable distance of MDI-QKD and enabling advanced protocols such as passive decoy-state implementations and quantum-memory-assisted configurations. In practice, however, spectral correlations between photon pairs in HSPS degrade Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference visibility. Although narrowband filtering can suppress this effect, it relies on dedicated hardware and lacks flexibility. Here, we propose an MDI-QKD scheme based on a time-domain postprocessing filtering technique that requires no additional hardware, significantly improving both the key rate and the maximum transmission distance. By optimizing the filter width, this method flexibly adapts to variations in the source or channel. Furthermore, it can be readily extended to other protocols relying on HOM interference, including quantum teleportation and entanglement swapping.

Hao-Yu Chen, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/gvvj-17xy

No. 04

通过定制致盲脉冲攻击高速量子密钥分发系统Hacking high-speed quantum-key-distribution systems by tailoring the blinding pulse

通过定制致盲脉冲并调整其与门信号的时间偏移，改进了针对高速正弦门控单光子探测器的致盲攻击，短距离下引入的附加误码率低于0.5%，并提出三种实用防御对策。

目前，量子密钥分发（QKD）系统正朝着高速实现的方向发展，以满足大规模数据加密的需求。高性能的高速门控单光子探测器（SPD）是实现此类系统的关键。然而，这些探测器的实际安全性仍然是一个关键问题。最近有报道称，一种针对高速正弦门控 SPD 的攻击通过欺骗宽度鉴别机制使探测器致盲。受这项工作启发，我们通过定制致盲脉冲并改变致盲脉冲与门信号之间的时间偏移，进一步优化了攻击策略，从而实现了更有效的攻击。实验与仿真结果表明，在短距离通信场景下，我们提出的攻击策略所引入的附加量子比特误码率（QBER）低于 0.5%。值得注意的是，我们提出并评估了三种实用对策来防御此类攻击，包括辅助的传统鉴别监测、雪崩电流监测以及探测事件的时间分布分析。这些防御策略增强了高速 SPD 的鲁棒性，并有助于开发更安全、更可靠的 QKD 系统。

Abstract (English)
Currently, quantum-key-distribution (QKD) systems are evolving toward high-speed implementations to meet the demands of large-scale data encryption. High-performance, high-speed gated single-photon detectors (SPDs) are essential for enabling such systems. However, the practical security of these detectors remains a critical concern. Recently, an attack targeting high-speed sine-gated SPDs was reported, in which the detector was blinded by deceiving the width discrimination mechanism. Inspired by this work, we further optimize the attack strategy by customizing the blinding pulse and modifying the temporal offset between the blinding pulse and the gate signal, thereby achieving a more effective attack. Experimental and simulation results show that in short-distance communication scenarios, the additional quantum bit error rate (QBER) introduced by our proposed attack strategy is less than 0.5%. Of note, we propose and evaluate three practical countermeasures to defend against such attacks, which include auxiliary conventional discrimination monitoring, avalanche current monitoring, and temporal distribution analysis of detection events. These defense strategies enhance the robustness of high-speed SPDs and contribute to the development of more secure and reliable QKD systems.

Xiang Kang, Jia-Lin Chen, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1103/nqz3-z1zb

No. 05

基于非对称光源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with asymmetric sources

提出非对称光源下MDI-QKD的性能分析理论，可处理单模与多时间模情形；以弱相干脉冲和自发参量下转换光源为例建模，发现密钥率在整个研究距离内并不因光源非对称而下降。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）消除了窃听者对测量方的所有攻击，一直被认为是实现端到端量子网络最有前景的技术之一。在实际中，光源与信道的非对称性通常是不可避免的。为此，我们提出一种理论，用于分析网络中任意两个MDI用户使用处于不同单模或多时间模的非对称光源进行通信时的性能。作为一个具体应用，我们对使用弱相干脉冲光源和自发参量下转换光源的MDI QKD进行建模并获得其密钥率，且将其与对称（即完全相同）光源情形下的性能进行比较。结果表明，实际性能并不会因光源的非对称性而下降；相反，在我们所研究的整个距离范围内，它都保持在良好水平。该工作为分析和优化具有非对称光源的MDI-QKD网络提供了理论基础，从而为完全非对称MDI-QKD网络的实际部署铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD), which eliminates all the attacks from the eavesdropper to the measurement party, has been one of the most promising technologies for the implementation of end-to-end quantum networks. In practice, the asymmetry of both sources and channels is generally inevitable. Therefore, we propose a theory to analyze the performance when any two MDI users in networks communicate using asymmetric sources in distinct single or multiple temporal modes. As a specific application, we model to obtain the key rate of MDI QKD with a weak-coherent pulse source and a spontaneous parametric down-conversion source, and compare the performance to the cases with symmetric (i.e., identical) sources. The result demonstrates that the actual performance does not degrade due to the asymmetry of sources. On the contrary, it maintains at a good level over the entire distance we study. This work provides a theoretical basis for analyzing and optimizing MDI-QKD networks with asymmetric sources, thus paving the way for the practical deployment of completely asymmetric MDI-QKD networks.

Jia-Ju Deng, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/zw9s-ywd6

No. 06

时间编码量子密钥分发系统的真实探测器模型Realistic detector model for a time-bin-encoding quantum key distribution system

建立了时间编码量子密钥分发系统中探测器的真实响应模型，可准确预测增益、刻画早晚时间格之间的相关性，并据此获得更高的安全密钥率。

鉴于单光子雪崩探测器日益广泛的应用，后脉冲的存在使死时间不可避免。死时间是影响量子密钥分发（QKD）计数率与安全密钥率（SKR）的关键因素。这一问题在时间编码系统中尤为突出，而此前的模型无法准确估计增益。值得注意的是，它引入了早时间格与晚时间格之间的相关性，从而产生强相关比特并带来安全风险。在此，我们提出了一个能够精确刻画时间编码系统中探测器响应的真实模型。该模型不仅提高了增益预测的准确性，与蒙特卡罗模拟结果吻合良好，还为数据处理提供了理论支撑，有助于缓解安全风险。最后，借助我们的模型，我们可以获得远高于先前模型的安全密钥率，并通过调节探测器参数进一步提升实际QKD系统的性能。我们的模拟结果表明，该模型对于QKD系统在实践中的应用与部署至关重要。

Abstract (English)
In light of the growing widely utilized single-photon avalanche detectors, dead time is inevitable due to the presence of afterpulse. Dead time is a critical factor that influences the count rate and the secret key rate (SKR) of quantum key distribution (QKD). It is particularly significant in time-bin-encoding systems, while prior models fail to accurately estimate the gains. Of note, it introduces correlations between early bins and late bins, hence bits with strong correlation and security risks. Here, we put forward a realistic model that precisely characterizes the response of detectors for time-bin-encoding systems. Our model not only improves the accuracy of gain predictions, showing an excellent match with the Monte Carlo simulation results, but also provides theoretical support for data processing, helping to mitigate security risks. Finally, leveraging our model, we can get a much higher SKR than prior models and further enhance the performance of practical QKD systems by adjusting the detector parameters. Our simulation results demonstrate that our model is essential for the application and deployment of QKD systems in practice.

Xiao-Juan Huang, Ze-Hao Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Jiaqi Geng, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Yu Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.23.054071

No. 07

飞秒脉冲注入硅光调制器对量子密钥分发安全性的影响Effect of femtosecond-pulse-injection silicon photonic modulators on the security of quantum key distribution

首次揭示硅光强度调制器中的双光子吸收会给窃听者留下可乘之机：实验上通过外部注入飞秒脉冲改变诱骗态强度，使合法方按安全证明预估的密钥率被高估，为集成QKD系统的设计与标准化提供安全性考量。

集成光子学在量子通信器件中发挥着关键作用，具有出色的鲁棒性、可扩展性和性能。硅光子学技术的日益成熟为量子密钥分发（QKD）的小型化和低成本实现提供了巨大潜力。虽然铌酸锂调制器在QKD系统中的实际安全性已被广泛研究，但硅光调制器采用了新的调制机制，因而有必要深入研究其对QKD系统安全性的影响。我们首次揭示，硅光强度调制器中的双光子吸收效应会引入漏洞，使窃听者（Eve）能够对QKD系统实施恶意攻击。通过实验演示，我们表明，借助外部注入飞秒脉冲，Eve可以操控合法用户发送的诱骗态的强度。基于实验结果，我们发现，在存在该攻击的情况下，合法用户会持续高估安全证明所预测的密钥率。我们的工作是对集成QKD系统设计与标准化的一个新安全性层面的初步探索。

Abstract (English)
Integrated photonics plays a pivotal role in quantum communication devices, offering exceptional robustness, scalability, and performance. The growing maturity of silicon photonics technology offers significant potential for miniaturization and cost-effective implementation of quantum key distribution (QKD). While the practical security of lithium niobate modulators in QKD systems has been extensively examined, the adoption of a new modulation mechanism by silicon photonic modulators necessitates a thorough investigation into their impact on the security of QKD systems. For the first time, we reveal that the two-photon absorption effect in silicon photonic intensity modulators will introduce vulnerabilities, enabling an eavesdropper (Eve) to execute malicious attacks on QKD systems. Through experimental demonstration, we show that by externally injecting femtosecond pulses, Eve can manipulate the intensities of decoy states sent by legitimate users. Based on the experimental results, we find that in the presence of the attack, legitimate users consistently overestimate the secret key rate predicted by the security proof. Our work represents an initial exploration into a new security aspect for the design and standardization of integrated QKD systems.

Xiang Kang, Peng Ye, Shuang Wang, Guo-Wei Zhang, Ze-Hao Wang, Jia-Lin Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.23.024014

No. 08

时间仓纠缠可见度优化的理论模型Model for optimizing the visibility of time-bin entanglement

建立可准确描述时间仓纠缠双光子干涉的有效模型，用以定位干涉可见度下降的原因并给出优化实验的策略，并经实验验证。

时间仓纠缠因其在长距离信道上的优异鲁棒性，是量子信息科学中的关键资源。实现高的量子干涉可见度对于基础研究和实际应用都不可或缺。迄今为止，能够准确描述基于时间仓纠缠的双光子干涉的模型仍有待建立。本工作分析了这类干涉的内在机制，并建立了一个可在实验上优化量子干涉可见度的有效模型。我们利用该模型分析了导致干涉可见度下降的各项因素，提出了应对这些问题的策略，并通过实验证明了模型的有效性。该模型可作为基于时间仓纠缠的系统的工具，用于辅助系统设计、预期结果评估以及实验装置优化。

Abstract (English)
Time-bin entanglement is a critical resource in quantum information science owing to its exceptional robustness over long-distance channels. Achieving high quantum interference visibility is indispensable for fundamental research and practical applications. To date, a model that can accurately describe time-bin entanglement-based two-photon interference remains to be established. In this work, we analyze the underlying mechanisms for this type of interference and develop an effective model for experimentally optimizing the quantum interference visibility. We use this model to analyze the factors contributing to the decline in interference visibility and offer strategies to address these issues, and we also demonstrate its effectiveness through experiments. Our model can serve as a tool for time-bin entanglement-based systems, aiding in system design, the evaluation of expected outcomes, and the optimization of experimental setups.

Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.110.042414

No. 09

基于相位后选择的发送或不发送量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending quantum key distribution with phase postselection

该工作在SNS协议中引入相位后选择，大幅提高了选择「发送」的概率；数值模拟显示，无论是否采用主动奇偶配对方法，传输距离都能提升，离散相位随机化下也有类似改善。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可以帮助两个相距遥远的通信方共享安全密钥。近年来，双场（TF）QKD因其长传输距离而受到广泛研究。TF QKD的一个流行变体是发送或不发送（SNS）QKD，实验上已被验证可实现千公里级光纤密钥分发。本文将相位后选择引入SNS协议。通过这一改动，选择「发送」的概率可以大幅提高。数值模拟表明，无论是否采用主动奇偶配对方法，传输距离都能得到提升。文中还分析了离散相位随机化的情形，同样可以看到距离上的类似改善。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) could help to share a secure key between two distant peers. In recent years, twin-field (TF) QKD has been widely investigated because of its long transmission distance. One of the popular variants of TF QKD is sending-or-not-sending (SNS) QKD, which has been experimentally verified to realize 1000-km level fiber key distribution. In this article, we introduce phase postselection into the SNS protocol. With this modification, the probability of selecting ``sending'' can be substantially improved. The numerical simulation shows that the transmission distance can be improved both with and without the actively odd-parity pairing method. The case of discrete phase randomization is also analyzed, a similar improvement on distance can be seen.

Yang-Guang Shan, Yao Zhou, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.22.024056

No. 10

相位编码双场量子密钥分发安全性分析的改进Improved security analysis for phase-encoding twin-field quantum key distribution

借鉴发送或不发送协议分别计算正确轮与错误轮信息泄漏的思路，改进相位匹配双场量子密钥分发的安全性分析，在无需改动实验的前提下延长传输距离，并推广至四相位部分相位后选择协议。

双场（TF）量子密钥分发（QKD）因其长传输距离而得到广泛研究。相位编码TF-QKD能够同时实现高密钥率和长传输距离，因而备受关注。在本文中，我们受到发送或不发送TF-QKD的启发，该协议分别计算正确轮和错误轮的信息泄漏；同时我们注意到这类方法已被用于许多QKD协议，例如六态QKD。我们将类似的方法应用于相位匹配TF-QKD，并发现其性能有所提升。在新的分析下，无需对实验做任何改动即可提升传输距离。我们还将新的分析应用于四相位部分相位后选择协议，同样可以获得类似的提升。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field (TF) quantum key distribution (QKD) has been extensively researched because of its long transmission distance. The phase-encoding TF-QKD can realize both a high key rate and a long transmission distance, so it has attracted a lot of attention. In this article, we are inspired by the sending-or-not-sending TF-QKD, in which the information leakages of correct rounds and erroneous rounds are calculated separately. And, we notice that this kind of method has been used in many QKD protocols---for example, the six-state QKD. We apply a similar method to the phase-matching TF-QKD and find some improvement in it. With the new analysis, the transmission distance can be improved without any changes in experiments. We also apply the new analysis in the four-phase partial-phase-postselection protocol, and a similar improvement can be achieved.

Yang-Guang Shan, Yao Zhou, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.110.012450

No. 11

全被动测量设备无关量子密钥分发Fully passive measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

提出全被动测量设备无关量子密钥分发方案，用线性光学同时实现被动编码与被动诱骗态调制，可同时抵御光源调制器边信道与测量设备攻击，并给出被动编码策略、诱骗态分析方法及渐近密钥率仿真。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）能够抵御针对探测设备的所有攻击，但源端仍存在一些安全性问题。一种可能的解决方案是采用被动协议，以消除源端主动调制器引入的边信道。最近，有人提出了一种全被动QKD协议，可以利用线性光学同时实现被动编码和被动诱骗态调制。在本工作中，我们提出了一种全被动MDIQKD方案，能够使系统同时免受源调制器的边信道和测量设备攻击，从而显著提高QKD系统的实现安全性。我们给出了具体的被动编码策略和诱骗态分析方法，随后给出了渐近情形下安全密钥率的仿真结果。我们的工作为提高QKD系统的实现安全性提供了一条可行途径，并为利用实际器件实现被动QKD方案提供了参考。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) can resist all attacks on the detection devices, but there are still some security issues related to the source side. One possible solution is to use the passive protocol to eliminate the side channels introduced by active modulators at the source. Recently, a fully passive QKD protocol was proposed that could simultaneously achieve passive encoding and passive decoy-state modulation using linear optics. In this work, we propose a fully passive MDIQKD scheme that can protect the system from both side channels of source modulators and attacks on the measurement devices, which can significantly improve the implementation security of the QKD systems. We provide a specific passive encoding strategy and a method for decoy-state analysis, followed by simulation results for the secure key rate in the asymptotic scenario. Our work offers a feasible way to improve the implementation security of QKD systems and serves as a reference for achieving passive QKD schemes using realistic devices.

带相位后选择的量子密钥分发相位误码率分析Phase-error-rate analysis for quantum key distribution with phase postselection

量子密钥分发（QKD）利用量子力学原理建立信息论安全的通信信道，是一种开创性的方法。在QKD的安全性证明中，相位误码率是信息泄漏的关键指标，直接影响通信双方Alice与Bob所共享密钥比特的安全性。在估计相位误码率上界时，相位随机化及随后的后选择机制在许多QKD协议中起着关键作用。然而，相位后选择的非零区间会引入固有误差，导致相位误码率被高估。本文对带相位后选择的QKD协议进行精确的相位误码率分析，消除了与非零区间相关的误码率，有助于准确界定窃听者可能获取的信息量。我们进一步将该分析应用于发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发（SNS-TFQKD）和模式配对量子密钥分发（MP-QKD）。仿真结果证实，精确的相位误码分析能够显著改善密钥率性能，尤其是在实际的长距离情形下。需要指出的是，我们的方法无需改动现有实验硬件或协议步骤，可直接应用于当前的SNS-TF-QKD和MP-QKD，以实现更高的密钥率生成。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) stands as a pioneering method for establishing information-theoretically secure communication channels by utilizing the principles of quantum mechanics. In the security proof of QKD, the phase error rate serves as a critical indicator of information leakage and directly influences the security of the shared key bits between communicating parties, Alice and Bob. In estimating the upper bound of the phase error rate, phase randomization and subsequent postselection mechanisms serve pivotal roles across numerous QKD protocols. However, the nonzero interval of phase postselection will introduce intrinsic errors, leading to an overestimation of phase error rate. Here we make a precise phase-error-rate analysis for QKD protocols with phase postselection, which eliminates error rate associated with nonzero interval and helps us to accurately bound the amount of information an eavesdropper may obtain. We further apply our analysis in sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution (SNS-TFQKD) and mode-pairing quantum key distribution (MP-QKD). The simulation results confirm that our precise phase error analysis can noticeably improve the key rate performance especially over long distances in practice. Note that our method does not require alterations to the existing experimental hardware or protocol steps. It can be readily applied within current SNS-TF-QKD and MP-QKD for higher key rate generation.

发送或不发送（SNS）协议是双场量子密钥分发（TFQKD）中一种非常有前景的变体，因为它在长距离区间具有优势，并且对较大的光学失准具有鲁棒性。主动奇宇称配对（AOPP）方法能够显著提升原始SNS TFQKD的密钥率性能，从而形成AOPP SNS TFQKD协议。本文引入优势提取（AD）方法，以进一步提升AOPP SNS TFQKD的通信距离。我们还针对AD过程中比特块大小为2的情形，在有限码长条件下证明了带AD的AOPP SNS TFQKD对抗相干攻击的可组合安全性。我们针对AOPP SNS TFQKD协议的AD方法有望在不改变SNS TFQKD实验系统的前提下提升实际中的密钥率性能。

Abstract (English)
A sending-or-not-sending (SNS) protocol is a very promising variant in twin-field quantum key distribution (TFQKD) for its advantages at the regime of long distance and the robustness against large optical misalignment. The actively odd-parity pairing (AOPP) method can significantly enhance the key-rate performance of the original SNS TFQKD, which forms the AOPP SNS TFQKD protocol. In this paper, we introduce the advantage distillation (AD) method to further improve the communication distance for AOPP SNS TFQKD. We also prove the composable security against coherent attacks for the AOPP SNS TFQKD with AD in the finite-key regime for bit blocks with a size of 2 in the AD process. Our AD method for AOPP SNS TFQKD protocol is expected to improve the key-rate performance in practice without changing the SNS TFQKD experimental system.

基于内禀事件的测量设备无关量子密钥分发中的偏振对准Polarization alignment in measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with intrinsic events

利用测量设备无关协议自身的内禀事件直接计算偏振漂移的补偿量，无需参考脉冲或经典激光等额外资源，也不必中断密钥生成，并建立了引入偏振维度后的响应率模型。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是迈向量子互联网的关键一步，它消除了所有探测器侧信道，使得在节点不可信的条件下仍能实现安全的量子密钥分发。然而，MDI QKD 面临偏振对准的重大挑战，因为偏振态的漂移会影响密钥生成效率，尤其是当量子态从远端位置发送时。传统的偏振对准方法要么需要额外资源（如经典激光器或参考脉冲），要么会中断 QKD 过程，从而降低系统效率。本文提出了一种 MDI QKD 中的高效偏振对准方法，它利用 MDI 的内禀事件直接计算如何补偿偏振漂移。所提方法不需要参考脉冲等额外资源，从而消除了带宽限制；同时它速度很快，能够在判据涨落很小的条件下直接计算出偏振校正方式。我们还在编码维度之外引入了偏振维度，并建立了带有附加偏振维度的 MDI QKD 响应率模型。总体而言，所提方法是 MDI QKD 中一种资源高效的偏振漂移校正方案，能够提升 QKD 网络的实用性与可扩展性。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a crucial step for the quantum Internet, as it removes all detector side channels and enables secure QKD with untrusted nodes. However, MDI QKD faces a significant challenge from polarization alignment, since drift of the state of polarization affects the efficiency of key generation, especially when the quantum states are sent from remote locations. Conventional methods for polarization alignment either require additional resources, such as classical lasers or reference pulses, or interrupt the QKD process, which reduces the efficiency of the system. In this paper, an efficient polarization-alignment method in MDI QKD is proposed that leverages intrinsic events from MDI to directly calculate how to compensate for polarization drift. The proposed method does not require additional resources such as reference pulses, thereby eliminating bandwidth limitations, and it is fast, as it can directly calculate how to correct polarization with a small criterion fluctuation. We also introduce the polarization dimension in addition to the encoding dimension and establish a response-rate model for MDI QKD with additional polarization dimensions. Overall, the proposed method is a resource-efficient solution for polarization drift correction in MDI QKD, which can enhance the practicality and scalability of QKD networks.

非对称量子-经典集成测量设备无关量子密钥分发的更高密钥率Higher key rate in asymmetric quantum-classical integrated measurement-device-independent quantum-key-distribution systems

建立了集成测量设备无关量子密钥分发中非对称效应的机理模型，并分析非对称结构的噪声抑制效应，发现非对称系统的密钥率反而最多提升260%，颠覆了对称系统更优的传统认知。

将测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）与经典网络集成，可兼顾安全性与经济性。遗憾的是，MDI QKD 的性能本就受到网络非对称性的抑制，还会因集成噪声的加入而进一步恶化。因此，人们一直认为对称系统更有利于获得更高的密钥率。然而，我们揭示了一个反直觉的事实：在集成系统中，非对称 MDI QKD 具有更好的性能。我们建立了集成 MDI 系统中非对称效应的机理模型，并分析了非对称结构的噪声抑制效应，观察到密钥率出人意料地提升至多 260%，所得结论与原系统截然相反。所发现的现象及所提出的分析模型为噪声抑制和性能提升提供了一种方法，使其能够很好地适配实际的非对称网络。

Abstract (English)
Integrating measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) with classical networks guarantees security and economy. Unfortunately, the performance of MDI QKD, suppressed though it is by network asymmetry, is further degraded by the addition of integration noise. As a consequence, symmetric systems are always believed to be better for a higher key rate. However, we reveal a counterintuitive fact that asymmetric MDI QKD has better performance in integrated systems. Modeling the mechanism of the asymmetric effect in integrated MDI systems and analyzing the noise-suppression effect of asymmetric structures, we observe an unanticipated increase of the key rate up to 260%, giving a conclusion diametrically opposite that for the original system. The phenomenon found and the proposed analytical model provide a method for noise suppression and performance improvement, permitting high adaptability for realistic asymmetric networks.

基于实用自发参量下转换源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution with Practical Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion Sources

把实际自发参量下转换源的光谱纠缠态分解为施密特本征态，定量计入各本征态对安全密钥率的贡献，修正了以往的高估，并据此精确优化泵浦与滤波条件。

测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）封堵了探测端的全部漏洞，极大提升了QKD的实际安全性。自发参量下转换（SPDC）源在MDI QKD中发挥着重要作用：借助预告（heralding）策略，它可以实现被动诱骗态等独特功能，从而减少源端的边信道信息泄漏。然而，实际SPDC源产生的光子对往往存在光谱纠缠，这会降低Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉可见度，进而抬高QKD误码率。遗憾的是，此前的研究尚未定量考虑这一效应，导致安全密钥率被高估，其结果无法适用于实际光源。本文填补了这一空白：将光谱纠缠态分解为施密特本征态，进而求出它们对安全密钥率的贡献。此外，该工作还允许对泵浦与滤波条件进行精确优化，以最大化最终密钥率。需要指出的是，我们的模型具有普适性，可推广到其他涉及HOM干涉的量子信息过程，如量子隐形传态、纠缠交换和量子计算。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD) closes all the loopholes in the detection side, which greatly improves the practical security of QKD. Spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) sources play a significant role in MDI QKD by using the heralding strategies to achieve unique features, such as the passive-decoy method, which reduces side-channel information leakage from the source. However, photon pairs from realistic SPDC sources are often spectrally entangled. This lowers the Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference visibility, and thus increases the QKD error rate. Unfortunately, research efforts so far have not considered this effect quantitatively. This leads to an overestimation in the secure key rate; therefore their results cannot be applied to practical sources. In this article, we close this gap by decomposing the spectral entangled state into Schmidt eigenstates, then find their contributions to the secure key rate. In addition, our work allows an accurate optimization of pumping and filtering conditions to maximize the final key rate. We note that our model is general and can be applied to other quantum information processes involving HOM interference, such as quantum teleportation, entanglement swapping, and quantum computation.

全被动时间箱编码量子密钥分发的实验演示Experimental Demonstration of Fully Passive Quantum Key Distribution

在实验中实现全被动时间箱编码量子密钥分发，彻底去除了用户设备中的主动调制与调制器侧信道，原型系统在有限密钥条件下仍可给出有竞争力的安全成码率。

量子密钥分发（QKD）的被动式方案旨在去除用户设备中的所有主动调制，是消除调制器侧信道的一种非常理想的应对措施。然而，由于理论与实际两方面的限制，迄今为止 QKD 系统中的主动调制尚未被完全去除。本文报道了一个全被动时间箱编码 QKD 系统，并成功实现了一条无调制器的 QKD 链路。根据最新的理论分析，我们的原型能够在有限密钥条件下提供具有竞争力的成码率。

Abstract (English)
The passive approach to quantum key distribution (QKD) consists of removing all active modulation from the users' devices, a highly desirable countermeasure to get rid of modulator side channels. Nevertheless, active modulation has not been completely removed in QKD systems so far, due to both theoretical and practical limitations. In this Letter, we present a fully passive time-bin encoding QKD system and report on the successful implementation of a modulator-free QKD link. According to the latest theoretical analysis, our prototype is capable of delivering competitive secret key rates in the finite key regime.

通过发展多自由度映射方法，提出并实现了量子比特误码率低至0.57%的高维量子密钥分发系统，可稳定获得高安全密钥率，并能互联不同自由度编码的终端。

高维量子密钥分发（HD-QKD）具有更强的抗噪能力和更高的安全密钥率。在本工作中，我们通过发展一种多自由度（DOF）映射方法，提出并实现了一套量子比特误码率低至0.57%的HD-QKD系统。该系统能够稳定实现高安全密钥率，并且具有可组合性，从而可以构建兼容多种自由度的HD量子网络。结果表明，所提方案能够桥接编码于不同自由度的HD终端与二维终端，并可支撑高性能量子网络的大规模部署。我们的工作显著提升了HD-QKD的性能，并以混合方式增强了大规模量子网络的实际应用能力。

Abstract (English)
High-dimensional quantum key distribution (HD-QKD) possesses a higher noise-tolerance ability and secure key rate. In the work presented here, by developing a mapping method for multiple degrees of freedom (DOFs), we propose and implement a HD-QKD system with a quantum bit error rate as low as 0.57%. Our HD-QKD system can stably achieve high secure key rates and is composable, allowing one to build HD quantum networks compatible with multiple DOFs. The results indicate that the proposed scheme could bridge HD and two-dimensional terminals encoded in different DOFs and could support large-scale deployment of quantum networks with high performance. Our work significantly enhances the performance of HD-QKD and strengthens the practical applications of large-scale quantum networks in a hybrid way.

铌酸锂（LN）器件已被广泛用于量子密钥分发（QKD）系统中，但 LN 器件中的光折变效应可被窃听者利用，成为一种潜在的攻击漏洞。本工作指出了 LN 器件的一个脆弱之处，制造商与用户必须对此有所认识，以便采取适当对策。此外，本工作所提出的物理机制与技术为 QKD 系统的安全性分析开辟了一条重要途径。

Abstract (English)
Lithium niobate (LN) devices have been widely adopted in systems for quantum key distribution (QKD), but the photorefractive effect in LN devices can be exploited as a potential loophole for malicious attacks by eavesdroppers. This work points out a vulnerability of LN devices of which manufacturers and users must become aware, so that appropriate countermeasures may be implemented. Moreover, the physical mechanism and techniques introduced in this work open an important avenue to the security analysis of QKD systems.

基于三个互不偏基的双场量子密钥分发Twin-field quantum key distribution with three mutually unbiased bases

推导二维希尔伯特空间中X、Y、Z三个互不偏基下的误码率，据此提升双场量子密钥分发的长距离密钥率与最大可达距离；无需改动物理实现，仅需对实验数据做后处理。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体无需量子中继即可突破速率—透射率的根本极限，为城际用户之间共享信息论安全的密钥提供了颇具前景的解决方案。本文提出，通过推导二维希尔伯特空间中三个互不偏基，即$\sigma_{X}$、$\sigma_{Y}$和$\sigma_{Z}$下的误码率，来提升TF-QKD在长距离下的密钥率以及最大可达距离。此外，在获知这些误码率后，可以引入含噪预处理以进一步提升其性能。我们还观察到，在加入含噪预处理时，较高的比特误码率并不必然意味着较低的密钥率。我们的方法不改变现有的物理实现或实验操作，只需对实验数据进行简单的后处理，因而可直接用于提升现有QKD系统的密钥率性能。仿真结果表明，对于相位编码TF-QKD协议，该方法在长距离密钥率和最大可达距离方面均有显著提升。

Abstract (English)
Twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variants provide a promising solution for sharing information-theoretic secure keys between intercity peers since they are able to overcome the fundamental rate-transmittance bound without quantum repeaters. In this paper, we propose to improve the key rate at long distances and the maximum achievable distance for TF-QKD by deriving the error rates under three mutually unbiased bases, i.e., ${\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{X}, {\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{Y}$, and ${\ensuremath{\sigma}}_{Z}$ in two-dimensional Hilbert space. Moreover, learning these error rates, one can add noisy preprocessing to further improve its performance. We also observe that higher bit error rates do not necessarily imply lower key rates when noisy preprocessing is added. Our method does not change the existing physical implementation or experimental operation, but only requires simple postprocessing of the experimental data, which can be directly used to improve the key rate performance of the existing QKD system. The simulation results demonstrate its notable enhancements in terms of key rate at long distances and the maximum achievable distance for the phase-encoded TF-QKD protocol.
