该工作建立了计入探测器时间抖动与死时间等实际缺陷的连续波泵浦预报单光子源 QKD 模型，表明其传输距离比当前最快的脉冲泵浦系统长约 31%，且运行更稳定、光谱特性更优。

量子密钥分发（QKD）协议利用单光子进行密钥交换。基于自发参量下转换（SPDC）的预报单光子源（HSPS）是产生高保真单光子的一种实用而有效的方式，尤其在长距离下能带来额外的性能提升。HSPS QKD 通常使用脉冲激光作为泵浦，但与连续波泵浦相比，其在运行稳定性和实用性方面存在不足。另一方面，目前仍缺乏描述连续波泵浦 HSPS 性能的精确模型。将脉冲泵浦 HSPS QKD 的成码率模型直接套用于连续波情形既不准确也不安全，而且会忽略单光子探测器的时间抖动与死时间。本文详细研究了连续波情形，并计入了实验仪器的实际非理想因素。我们的模型表明，连续波泵浦方案可达到比目前最快的脉冲泵浦 HSPS QKD 系统长得多的传输距离（长 31%），并具有运行稳定性更高、光谱特性更好等优点。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols utilize single photons for key exchanging. Heralded single-photon sources (HSPSs) with spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) is a practical and effective way of producing single photons of high fidelity, bringing extra performance especially at long distances. A pulsed laser is usually used as the pump for HSPS QKD, but it has disadvantages in operational stability and practicality compared to a cw one. On the other hand, a precise model describing the performance of HSPS with a cw pump is still missing. It is inaccurate and unsafe to apply the key rate model of the pulse-pumped HSPS QKD directly to the cw one, and it also overlooks the timing jitter and dead time of the single-photon detectors. In this paper, we study the cw case in detail, including practical imperfections of the experimental instruments. Our model shows that a cw-pumped setup can reach a much longer transmission distance (31 % longer) than the fastest pulsed HSPS QKD system at present, together with other advantages such as higher operational stability and better spectral characteristics.

Xiao-Hai Zhan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.19.034027

No. 22

高性能量子密钥分发系统中的探测响应依赖模型Dependency model for high-performance quantum-key-distribution systems

针对单光子雪崩二极管死时间与后脉冲导致增益估计有偏的问题，建立探测器响应依赖模型，可更准确地优化参数并指导死时间选取，仿真表明其对系统实用部署具有重要作用。

精确估计探测响应对于高性能且安全的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统至关重要。单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）被广泛用于估计单光子产额。然而，在SPAD存在死时间和后脉冲的情况下，以往模型对增益的估计存在偏差，这将导致优化参数拟合不佳，并大幅降低系统性能。这里，我们建立了一个依赖性模型，可提供更精确的优化，从而实现更高性能的QKD系统。此外，为进一步提升系统性能，我们的模型可指导用户选择合适的死时间。仿真结果表明，该模型在QKD系统的实际应用与部署中发挥着重要作用。

Abstract (English)
A precise estimation of the detection response is essential for a high-performance and secure quantum-key-distribution (QKD) system. Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are widely applied to estimate the single-photon yields. However, in the presence of the dead time and afterpulse of the SPADs, the estimations of gains in previous models are biased, which will lead to ill-fitting optimized parameters and greatly degrade the system performance. Here, we develop a dependency model for providing more accurate optimization to achieve higher-performance QKD systems. Moreover, to further improve the system performance, our model guides users to choose proper dead time. Our simulation results indicate that our model plays an important role in the practical application and deployment of QKD systems.

Xiao-Juan Huang, Feng-Yu Lu, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Ze-Hao Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.106.062607

No. 23

基于纠缠光子源的量子密钥分发的实用通用模型Realistic and general model for quantum key distribution with entangled-photon sources

指出现有模型将脉冲泵浦纠缠源的光子数分布视为热分布、忽略光谱模式会高估安全密钥率，通过分析光子数分布与联合光谱分布的关系重写光子对量子态，给出适用于脉冲乃至连续波泵浦系统的通用密钥率模型。

基于纠缠的量子密钥分发（EB-QKD）相较制备-测量类协议具有若干优势，例如无需诱骗态和主动调制器。目前，基于自发参量下转换过程的纠缠源已被广泛用于EB-QKD实验。已有模型大多把脉冲泵浦纠缠源的光子数分布视为热分布，但这样做忽略了光谱模式的任何影响，会导致安全密钥率被高估。本文分析了光子数分布与联合光谱分布之间的关联，并重写了光子对的量子态。随后我们将结果应用于EB-QKD，给出了一个通用模型，它不仅能用于任何脉冲泵浦系统，甚至可用于连续波泵浦系统来计算安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Entanglement-based quantum key distribution (EB-QKD) has several advantages over prepare-and-measure protocols, such as eliminating the need for decoy states and active modulators. At present, entanglement sources based on the spontaneous parametric down-conversion process have been widely used in EB-QKD experiments. Most of the existing models regard the photon-number distribution of pulse-pumped entanglement sources as thermal. However, doing so ignores any effects of spectral modes, which will lead to the overestimation of the secure key rate. In this paper, we analyze the correlation between the photon-number distribution and the joint spectral distribution and rewrite the quantum state of the photon pairs. Then we apply the results to EB-QKD and present a general model which can be used to calculate the secure key rate not only for any pulse-pumped systems but even for cw-pumped systems.

Zhen-Qiu Zhong, Shuang Wang, Xiao-Hai Zhan, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.106.052606

No. 24

基于部分相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution with Partial Phase Postselection

提出部分相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发方案：编码模式免除全局相位随机化与后选择，以保持高成码率优势；诱骗模式则引入相位后选择来改善性能，并借助算符支配条件证明了有限码长下相干攻击时的普适安全性。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的用户能够共享信息论安全的密钥。近年来，一种被称为双场（TF）QKD的革命性突破被提出，用以克服成码率受线性限制的问题，并大幅提升了可达距离。相位随机化及随后的后选择在其安全性证明中发挥作用。此后，无相位后选择的TF QKD被提出，并成为流行的变体，因为去掉相位后选择可以获得更高的成码率；但与原始方案相比，其可达距离有所下降。本文提出一种部分相位后选择的TF QKD协议。即，其编码模式仍不依赖全局相位随机化和后选择，以保证高成码率的优势得以保留；另一方面，在诱骗模式中引入相位后选择以改善性能。应用算符支配条件，我们证明了所提协议的普适安全性：在有限码长情形下，它能在相干攻击下保持安全。数值模拟证实了该协议在成码率和可达距离方面的潜在优势。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) allows two remote parties to share information-theoretically secure keys. In recent years, a revolutionary breakthrough called twin-field (TF) QKD has been developed to overcome the linear key-rate constraint and greatly increases the achievable distance. Phase randomization and subsequent postselection play roles in its security proof. Later, no-phase-postselection TF QKD was proposed and became a popular variant, since the removal of phase postselection leads to a higher key rate. However, the achievable distance is decreased compared to the original one. Here, we propose a TF QKD protocol with partial phase postselection. Namely, its code mode is still free from global phase randomization and postselection to make sure the advantage of the high key rate remain. On the other hand, phase postselection is introduced in the decoy mode to improve the performance. Applying an operator dominance condition, we prove universal security of the proposed protocol in the finite-key case under coherent attacks, and numerical simulations confirm its potential advantages in terms of key rate and achievable distance.

Yao Zhou, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rui-Qiang Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.18.054026

No. 25

基于不可信源与未表征测量的可认证量子随机数Certified Randomness from Untrusted Sources and Uncharacterized Measurements

★Phys. Rev. Lett.

提出无需假设源的量子随机数生成协议，仅对可信二维测量作合理假设而无需详细表征，在通用量子攻击下实现超过1 Mbps的生成速率，可组合安全参数达10^{-10}。

随机数的生成在许多科学应用中发挥着重要作用。与伪随机数生成器相比，量子器件能够依据量子力学定律生成真随机数。然而，信息论安全的随机数通常建立在完美的器件模型之上，而该模型可能与现实器件存在偏差。为弥合这一差距，我们提出并实验演示了一种量子随机数生成协议。在我们的协议中，不对源作任何假设；需要对可信的二维测量作出一些合理假设，但不要求对其进行详细表征。即使考虑最一般的量子攻击并使用一般源，我们仍以10^{-10}的通用可组合安全参数实现了超过1 Mbps的随机数生成速率。

Abstract (English)
Generating random numbers plays an important role in many scientific applications. Compared to pseudorandom number generators, a quantum device is capable of generating true random numbers by the laws of quantum mechanics. However, information-theoretical secure random numbers are regularly based on a perfect device model, which may deviate from a real-world device. To close this gap, we propose a quantum random number generation protocol and experimentally demonstrate it. In our protocol, we make no assumptions about the source. Some reasonable assumptions on the trusted two-dimensional measurement are needed, but we do not require a detailed characterization. Even if considering the most general quantum attack and using the general sources, we achieve a randomness generation rate of over 1 Mbps with a universal composable security parameter of 10^{-10}.

Xing Lin, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Letters

10.1103/PhysRevLett.129.050506

No. 26

散射信道中的量子密钥分发：波前整形补偿Quantum Key Distribution Over a Channel with Scattering

用波前整形技术补偿高损耗散射量子信道中畸变的光信号，完成偏振编码BB84协议实验，传输效率典型提升约250倍，考虑有限码长效应后仍可建立安全密钥链路。

云、霾和雾对光的散射会降低量子密钥分发（QKD）中通信信道的传输效率，削弱系统的实际安全性，从而制约自由空间QKD的部署。在此，我们采用波前整形技术来补偿高损耗散射量子信道中畸变的光信号，并完成了偏振编码的BB84 QKD实验。借助这一量子信道补偿技术，我们实现了约250倍的典型传输效率提升，并且在考虑有限码长效应的条件下仍能建立安全的通信链路，而在优化之前该链路无法共享安全密钥。该方法应用于QKD系统，表明QKD系统的适用范围有望从无损信道扩展到强散射信道，从而增强全球量子通信网络的部署能力。

Abstract (English)
Scattering of light by cloud, haze, and fog decreases the transmission efficiency of communication channels in quantum key distribution (QKD), reduces the system's practical security, and thus constrains the deployment of free-space QKD. Here, we employ wave-front shaping technology to compensate distorted optical signals in high-loss scattering quantum channels and fulfill a polarization-encoded BB84 QKD experiment. With this quantum-channel compensation technology, we achieve a typical enhancement of about 250 in transmission efficiency and build a secure communication link even considering finite key length effect, while the link is impossible to share secure keys before optimization. The method applied in the QKD system shows the potential to expand the application range of QKD systems from lossless channels to highly scattered ones and therefore enhances the deployment ability of a global quantum communication network.

Qi-Hang Lu, Fang-Xiang Wang, Kun Huang, Xin Wu, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Wei Chen, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.17.034045

No. 27

多光子态发送或不发送双场量子密钥分发Sending-or-not-sending twin-field quantum key distribution with multiphoton states

证明发送或不发送双场协议中多光子干涉同样可贡献密钥生成，并将双光子发射事件纳入有效事件，提出改进方案使密钥率高于仅利用单光子干涉的原方案。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议因其克服速率—距离极限的能力而受到广泛研究。人们还提出了TF-QKD的一种变体，称为发送或不发送（SNS）TF-QKD。SNS-TF-QKD将经典密钥0和1编码在发送或不发送相位随机化相干态中，这有助于容忍由光学相位涨落引起的大失准误差。然而，原始SNS-TF-QKD方案仅利用单光子干涉来生成密钥，这似乎与其他TF-QKD协议颇为不同。本文证明，在SNS TF-QKD协议中，多光子干涉也可对密钥生成作出贡献。据此，提出了一种具有更高密钥率的改进SNS-TF-QKD方案，其中不仅单光子发射事件，双光子发射事件也被视为有效事件。

Abstract (English)
The twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) protocol has led to extensive investigation for its capacity of overcoming the rate-distance limit. One variant for TF-QKD named sending-or-not-sending (SNS) TF-QKD has also been proposed. The SNS-TF-QKD encodes the classical keys 0 and 1 in sending or not sending the phase-randomized coherent states, which helps it to tolerate large misalignment errors due to optical phase fluctuations. Nevertheless, the original SNS-TF-QKD scheme utilizes only single-photon interference in generating secret keys, which seems quite different from other TF-QKD protocols. In this paper, we prove that multiphoton interference in the SNS TF-QKD protocol can also contribute to key generation. Accordingly, an improved SNS-TF-QKD scheme with higher key rate is proposed, where events of not only single-photon but also two-photon emissions are considered as effective events.

Jun Teng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Feng-Yu Lu, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.104.062441

No. 28

利用非光子数分辨探测器表征量子密钥分发脉冲光源的光子数分布Characterizing photon-number distribution of pulsed sources using non–photon-number-resolving detectors for quantum key distribution

提出一种用非光子数分辨探测器测量脉冲光源光子数分布的方法，通过数值模拟验证了方案可行性，并在泊松光源上完成实验检验，可用于评估未知光源与新型光源。

量子密钥分发（QKD）有望实现无条件安全通信，但许多实际系统问题仍待解决。发射端安全性是量子密钥分发安全性的重要组成部分，而测量光子数分布有助于提升这一安全性。该测量对于测量未知光源或测试新设计的光源同样有用。本文提出一种利用非光子数分辨探测器测量脉冲光子数分布的方法，并通过数值模拟对该方案进行检验，表现良好；同时还在泊松光源上开展了实验以检验该方法。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) has a prospect to realize unconditional secure communication. However, many real system problems should be solved. Transmitters security is an important part of QKD security. And measuring photon number distribution could help improve it. This measurement is also useful for measuring unknown sources or testing newly designed sources. In this article, a method to measure the photon number distribution of pulses using non-photon-number-resolving detectors is proposed. Numerical simulation is conducted to test this scheme and performs well. Experiment on Poisson source is also used to test this method.

Yang-Guang Shan, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.104.032406

No. 29

广义高维量子密钥分发的紧致有限密钥分析Tight finite-key analysis for generalized high-dimensional quantum key distribution

引入“密钥分类”思想并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系发展相关技术，给出了适用于广义高维量子密钥分发协议的紧致有限密钥分析，使有限资源条件下的高维协议在实验上成为可行。

由于能够容忍较高的误码率并在每次试验中产生更多密钥比特，高维量子密钥分发引起了广泛兴趣。尽管高维量子密钥分发已取得很大进展，理论与实验之间仍存在一些差距。其中之一是密钥的安全性严重依赖于发射信号的数量。迄今为止，现有的安全性证明仅适用于发射信号数量为无穷大或不切实际地大的情形。在此，我们通过引入“密钥分类”的思想，并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系发展相关技术，提出了一种适用于广义高维量子密钥分发协议的紧致有限密钥分析。得益于我们的理论，具有有限资源的高维量子密钥分发协议在实验上变得可行。

Abstract (English)
Due to the capability of tolerating high error rate and generating more key bits per trial, high-dimensional quantum key distribution attracts wide interest.Despite great progresses in high-dimensional quantum key distribution, there are still some gaps between theory and experiment.One of these is that the security of the secret key heavily depends on the number of the emitted signals.So far, the existing security proofs are only suitable in the case with an infinite or unpractically large number of emitted signals.Here, by introducing the idea of "key classification" and developing relevant techniques based on the uncertainty relation for smooth entropies, we propose a tight finite-key analysis suitable for generalized high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocols.Benefitting from our theory, high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocols with finite resources become experimentally feasible.

Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hang Liu, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Research

10.1103/PhysRevResearch.3.023019

No. 30

利用时间鬼成像感知量子密钥分发中的量子黑客攻击Perceiving Quantum Hacking for Quantum Key Distribution Using Temporal Ghost Imaging

提出用时间鬼成像获取量子信号、量子信道与QKD系统的时间指纹，从而感知量子黑客攻击，并实验验证了其有效性，从信号与系统视角为提升实际安全性提供通用途径。

量子密钥分发（QKD）能够利用量子力学在远程用户之间生成安全密钥比特。然而，理论模型与实际实现之间的差距为窃听者提供了截获密钥的机会。最隐蔽的攻击被称为量子黑客攻击，即利用QKD系统的边信道漏洞使测量结果没有明显偏差的攻击。刻画量子信号、量子信道和QKD系统的全时间尺度特性，可以为合法用户提供击败恶意攻击的额外能力。这里，我们提出一种利用时间鬼成像（TGI）方案、以时间指纹感知量子黑客攻击的方法，并实验验证了其有效性。该方案从信号与系统的独特视角，提供了一条提升QKD实际安全性的通用途径。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can generate secure key bits between remote users with quantum mechanics. However, the gap between the theoretical model and practical realizations gives eavesdroppers opportunities to intercept the secret key. The most insidious attacks, known as quantum hacking, are the ones with no significant discrepancy of the measurement results using side-channel loopholes of QKD systems. Depicting full-time-scale characteristics of the quantum signals, the quantum channel, and the QKD system can provide legitimate users extra capabilities to defeat malicious attacks. Here, we propose the method exploring a temporal ghost-imaging (TGI) scheme to perceive quantum hacking with temporal fingerprints and experimentally verify its validity. The scheme presents a common approach to promote QKD's practical security from a unique perspective of signals and systems.

Fang-Xiang Wang, Juan Wu, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen−Qiang Yin, Chang−Ling Zou, Guang−Can Guo, Zheng−Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

10.1103/PhysRevApplied.15.034051

No. 31

面向动态量子密钥分发网络的单光子雪崩光电二极管优化Optimizing Single-Photon Avalanche Photodiodes for Dynamic Quantum Key Distribution Networks

把单光子雪崩二极管的探测效率、暗计数概率与后脉冲率纳入参数优化，通过调节电压与温度提升动态量子密钥分发网络的安全密钥率及其对信道变化与不对称性的适应能力。

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络可以在众多远程用户之间提供无条件安全的通信。在实际 QKD 网络中，随着节点的动态接入与退出，各用户链路的品质以及不同用户之间的链路长度（例如传输损耗）各不相同并且不断变化。针对各种信道环境进行定制化优化能够带来网络性能收益。在本文中，我们将单光子雪崩光电二极管（SPAD）的探测效率、暗计数概率和后脉冲率纳入参数优化，通过控制其电压和温度来优化动态 QKD 网络中的安全密钥率。结果表明，我们的方法提高了网络对信道变化与不对称性的适应能力，并且有利于在复杂信道环境中建立 QKD 网络。该方法适用于任意基于 SPAD 的 QKD 系统与网络架构。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks can provide unconditional secure communications among many remote users. In real QKD networks, with the dynamic access and quit of nodes, qualities of various user links and the link lengths among different users, such as transmission loss, are different and changing. Customized optimization that aims at various channel environments offers a network performance benefit. In this paper, we propose including the detection efficiency, dark-count probability, and afterpulse rate of the single-photon avalanche photodiode (SPAD) into the parameter optimization by controlling its voltage and temperature to optimize the secure key rates in dynamic QKD networks. The result shows that our method improves the network adaptability to the variation and asymmetry of channel and profits the establishment of QKD networks in a complex channel environment. This method is suitable for arbitrary SPAD-based QKD system and network architecture.

Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Jun Teng, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review Applied

参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发的高效诱骗态Efficient decoy states for the reference-frame-independent measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution

针对参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发，指出原始诱骗态方法因忽略不同基之间的潜在关联而过于悲观地估计相关产额，联合处理各基参数后显著提升了统计涨落下的密钥率与可达距离。

参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发（RFI-MDI-QKD）是一种新颖的协议，它消除了探测器端一切可能的攻击，也消除了源端进行参考系校准的必要性。然而，由于需要积累更多参数（例如失配基事件的产额与误码率）来监测安全性，统计涨落可能使其性能明显下降。本工作发现，原始诱骗态方法由于忽略了不同基之间的潜在关联，对这些产额的估计过于悲观。通过联合处理不同基的参数，在考虑统计涨落的情况下（统计涨落分析是最终分析有限码长效应的第一步），RFI-MDI-QKD 在密钥率和可达距离方面均得到大幅改善。我们的结果为通向实用化的 RFI-MDI-QKD 开辟了道路。

Abstract (English)
Reference-frame-independent measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (RFI-MDI-QKD) is a novel protocol that eliminates all possible attacks on the detector side and the necessity of reference-frame alignment in source sides. However, its performance may degrade notably due to statistical fluctuations since more parameters, e.g., yields and error rates for mismatched-basis events, must be accumulated to monitor the security. In this work, we find that the original decoy states method estimates these yields overpessimistically since it ignores the potential relations between different bases. Through jointly processing parameters of different bases, the performance of RFI-MDI-QKD is greatly improved in terms of the secret key rate and achievable distance when statistical fluctuations are considered (the statistical fluctuation analysis is the first step to the final analysis of the finite key size effect). Our results pave an avenue towards practical RFI-MDI-QKD.

Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Rong Wang, Hang Liu, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

由于我们发现诱骗态方法已被多个研究组提出，应在本文第2段末尾补充以下参考文献[Phys. Rev. Lett. 94, 230503 (2005)]：“在多光子态存在的情况下，直到诱骗态方法被提出[8,9,29,30,46]之前，伊芙一直有机会实施光子数分离攻击。”

Abstract (English)
Since we found that the decoy-state method had been proposed by several research groups, the following reference [Phys. Rev. Lett. 94, 230503 (2005)] should be added at the end of the paragraph 2 in our paper: "The existence of multiphoton states gave Eve a chink to implement a photon-number-splitting attack until the decoy-state method was proposed [8,9,29,30,46]."

基于弱相干光源的量子密钥分发中对准误差的建模Modeling Alignment Error in Quantum Key Distribution Based on a Weak Coherent Source

针对对准误差理论模型仅描述单光子行为、与弱相干光源不相容的问题，引入可在实际系统中便捷测得的泄漏光比，构建了包含多光子脉冲传输并能精确刻画双击事件的模型，缩小了理论与实际系统的差距。

在光学量子密码中，对准误差是量子密钥分发（QKD）安全密钥生成中的重要因素，也是错误事件的根源之一。然而，理论建模通常只反映单光子的行为，与弱相干光源不相容。本研究通过定义在实际QKD系统中可以方便获得的泄漏光比，建立了一个更贴近实际的模型，将多光子脉冲的传输纳入失准误差分析。此外，双击事件可以被精确描述，从而缩小了模型与实际系统之间的差距。

Abstract (English)
In optical quantum cryptography, alignment error is important in secure key generation for quantum key distribution (QKD), being one of the roots of error events. However, theoretical modeling typically only reflects the behavior of a single photon, which is incompatible with a weak coherent source. This study develops a realistic model to include the propagation of multiphoton pulses in the misalignment-error analysis by defining the $l\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}e\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}k\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}g\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}e$ $l\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}i\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}g\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}h\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}t$ $r\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}a\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}t\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}i\phantom{\rule{0}{0ex}}o$, which can be obtained conveniently in practical QKD systems. In addition, double-click events can be depicted precisely, and thus the gap between the model and real systems is narrowed.

提升双场量子密钥分发性能的方法Improving the performance of twin-field quantum key distribution

针对Cui等人提出的、无需相位后选择的TF-QKD变体可达距离偏短的问题，该工作引入一个额外的诱骗模式，更紧致地估计信息泄露上界，从而显著提升密钥率与传输距离，且该模式的操作与编码模式相同，不增加实验难度。

在能够突破速率-距离极限的各种双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）协议版本中，Cui等人提出的无相位后选择TF-QKD是一种简洁的方案，由于去除了全局相位的后选择，它可以提供高密钥率。然而，该变体的可达距离短于原始的相位匹配QKD。本文提出一种通过引入额外诱骗模式来提升其性能的方法。信息泄露的上界可以被更紧致地估计，因此密钥率和可达距离都得到显著提升。有趣的是，所提出的额外诱骗模式的操作与编码模式相同，因此不会给实验系统带来困难。此外，在有限诱骗态下这种提升依然可观，这在实践中具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
Among the various versions of the twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) protocol [M. Lucamarini, Z. Yuan, J. Dynes, and A. Shields, Nature (London) 557, 400 (2018)] that can overcome the rate-distance limit, the TF-QKD without phase postselection proposed by Cui et al. [Phys. Rev. Appl. 11, 034053 (2019)] is an elegant TF-QKD that can provide high key rates since the postselection of global phases has been removed. However, the achievable distance of this variant is shorter than that of the original phase-matching QKD [X. Ma, P. Zeng, and H. Zhou, Phys. Rev. X 8, 031043 (2018)]. In this paper, we propose a method for improving its performance by introducing an additional decoy mode. The upper bound of the information leakage can be more tightly estimated; hence, both the key rate and the achievable distance are significantly improved. Interestingly, the operation of the proposed additional decoy mode is the same as that of the code mode; hence, it does not introduce difficulties into the experimental system. In addition, the improvement is substantial with finite decoy states, which is meaningful in practice.

在原理验证型量子密钥分发系统中突破基础速率—距离极限Beating the Fundamental Rate-Distance Limit in a Proof-of-Principle Quantum Key Distribution System

★Phys. Rev. X

实现了双场量子密钥分发协议的原型系统之一，采用不假设相位后选择的改进方案，在 300 km 光纤上控制双场相位演化，获得高可见度单光子干涉，从而突破无中继协议的线性界并实现稳定高速率成钥。

借助量子密钥分发（QKD），两个相距遥远的通信方能够共享具有信息论安全性的密钥比特。在有损信道中提高密钥率对 QKD 的应用至关重要。然而，已有证明表明存在一个基础的速率—距离极限，称为线性界，它限制了所有现有无中继协议与实现的性能。令人惊讶的是，最近提出的一种称为双场（TF）QKD 的协议无需量子中继即可突破线性界。在此，我们展示了 TF-QKD 协议的首批实现之一，并证明其在 300 km 的信道距离上具有突破线性界的优势。在我们的实验中，采用了一种不假设相位后选择的改进 TF-QKD 协议，因此预期可获得高于原始协议的密钥率。在控制穿越数百公里光纤的双场相位演化之后，所实现的系统获得了高可见度的单光子干涉，并支持稳定、高速率的测量设备无关 QKD。我们的实验演示与结果证实了 TF-QKD 协议的可行性及其在长距离密钥分发服务中的突出优越性。

Abstract (English)
With the help of quantum key distribution (QKD), two distant peers are able to share informationtheoretical secure key bits.Increasing the key rate is ultimately significant for the applications of QKD in the lossy channel.However, it has been proven that there is a fundamental rate-distance limit, called the linear bound, which restricts the performance of all existing repeaterless protocols and realizations.Surprisingly, a recently proposed protocol, called twin-field (TF) QKD, can beat the linear bound with no need for quantum repeaters.Here, we present one of the first implementations of the TF-QKD protocol and demonstrate its advantage of beating the linear bound at a channel distance of 300 km.In our experiment, a modified TF-QKD protocol that does not assume phase postselection is considered, and thus a higher key rate than the original one is expected.After controlling the phase evolution of the twin fields traveling through hundreds of kilometers of optical fibers, the implemented system achieves high-visibility singlephoton interference and allows stable and high-rate measurement-device-independent QKD.Our experimental demonstration and results confirm the feasibility of the TF-QKD protocol and its prominent superiority in long-distance key distribution services.

Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Feng-Yu Lu, Chao-Han Cui, Wei Chen, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physical Review X

10.1103/PhysRevX.9.021046

No. 37

无需相位后选择的双场量子密钥分发Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution without Phase Postselection

该工作提出一种完全不需要后选择的截断型双场量子密钥分发协议，并给出通用安全性证明，表明即使只使用有限诱骗态，其密钥率也可优于其他方案，从而使中距离QKD系统具备更高实用价值。

在量子密码学中，双场（TF）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议可以通过有损信道提升理论密钥率，但其大多数安全性证明需要相位后选择，这使实际系统变得复杂，并严重限制了安全密钥率。本研究提出了一种无需任何后选择的截断TF-QKD协议，给出了通用的安全性证明，并表明即使只采用有限诱骗态，该方案在密钥率方面也可能优于其他协议。该协议表明中距离QKD系统可以达到高得多的密钥率，将使QKD系统在未来的网络安全中更具适用性。

Abstract (English)
In quantum cryptography, the twin-field (TF) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol could extend theoretical key rates through a lossy channel, but most of its security proofs require phase postselection, which complicates practical systems and severely limits secure key rates. This study presents a truncated TF-QKD protocol without any postselection, gives a general security proof, and shows that this scheme may beat other protocols in terms of key rate, even when only finite decoy states are employed. By showing that a medium-range QKD system can reach much higher key rates, this protocol will make QKD systems more applicable in tomorrow's cybersecurity.

Chaohan Cui, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Rong Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

利用不同自由度间的态映射刻画高质量高维量子密钥分发Characterizing High-Quality High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution by State Mapping Between Different Degrees of Freedom

利用轨道角动量与自旋这两个自由度之间的非干涉态映射，同时解决高维量子密钥分发中高维态制备与传输的技术难题，为实用化高维量子密钥分发系统提供了可行路径。

在量子安全通信中，利用高维（HD）资源是提高安全密钥率的重要手段，尤其在量子密钥分发（QKD）中更是如此。然而，由于高维态制备、传输与测量方面的技术困难，高维量子密钥分发（HDQKD）一直远离实际应用。本研究通过实现光子不同自由度——轨道角动量与自旋——之间的态映射方法，解决了前两个问题。这种非干涉的态映射方法对实用 HDQKD 系统具有直接影响。

Abstract (English)
In quantum secure communication, using high-dimensional (HD) resources is an important approach to increasing the secure key rate, especially in quantum key distribution (QKD). However, high-dimensional quantum key distribution (HDQKD) has remained far from practical applications, due to the technical difficulties in HD state preparation, transmission, and measurement. This study solves the first two issues by realizing a state-mapping approach between different degrees of freedom of a photon: orbital angular momentum and spin. This noninterferometric state-mapping approach offers immediate impact on practical HDQKD systems.

利用单光子探测器雪崩过渡区攻击量子密钥分发系统Hacking the Quantum Key Distribution System by Exploiting the Avalanche-Transition Region of Single-Photon Detectors

提出一种针对门控雪崩光电二极管的雪崩过渡区攻击，窃听引入的量子比特误码率不足 0.5%，攻击前后光电流与后脉冲概率几乎不变，几乎不留痕迹。

作为迈向实用化与安全量子密钥分发的必要步骤，识别并修补可能的攻击是重要且有价值的。本研究讨论一种针对门控模式雪崩光电二极管（APD）探测器的雪崩过渡区（ATR）攻击，此类探测器广泛用于量子密钥分发系统。与其他攻击不同，这种攻击几乎不留痕迹；窃听者引入的量子比特误码率低于 0.5%，攻击前后的光电流与后脉冲概率几乎相同。这些发现凸显了实际量子密钥分发系统中探测信号的重要性，对提升实用化量子密钥分发的安全性至关重要。

Abstract (English)
As necessary steps toward practical and secure quantum key distribution (QKD), identifying and patching possible attacks are important and valuable. This study discusses an avalanche-transition-region (ATR) attack on a gated-mode avalanche photodiode (APD) detector, widely used in QKD systems. Unlike other attacks, this one leaves almost no trace; the eavesdropper introduces less than 0.5% quantum bit-error rate, and the photocurrent and afterpulse probability before and after hacking are nearly identical. These findings highlight the importance of detection signals in real-life QKD systems, and are crucial to enhancing the security of practical QKD.

单光子轮询差分正交相移量子密钥分发的安全性证明Security proof for single-photon round-robin differential-quadrature-phase-shift quantum key distribution

给出单光子RRDQPS协议的安全性证明，表明采用单光子源时可容忍误码率优于原始RRDPS协议，并建立统一理论把BB84协议涵盖为特例。

将差分正交相移（DQPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议与近期提出的轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议相结合，人们提出了轮询差分正交相移（RRDQPS）协议。然而，RRDQPS QKD协议的安全性证明仍然缺失，它相对于原始RRDPS协议的优势也尚不清楚。这里我们给出了单光子RRDQPS协议的安全性证明，借此清楚地表明：若采用单光子源，RRDQPS协议在可容忍误码率方面将优于原始RRDPS协议。更有趣的是，我们的证明给出了一个统一理论，涵盖著名的Bennett-Brassard 1984（BB84）协议与RRDQPS协议。由此确认，BB84协议确实是RRDQPS协议的一个特例。

Abstract (English)
Combining the differential-quadrature-phase-shift (DQPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol and the recently proposed round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS), the round-robin-differential-quadrature-phase-shift (RRDQPS) protocol has been proposed. However, a security proof of the RRDQPS QKD protocol is still missing and its advantage over the original RRDPS protocol is also unknown. Here, we give the security proof of single-photon RRDQPS protocol, by which we clearly show that, if a single photon source is applied, RRDQPS protocol will overwhelm the original RRDPS protocol in terms of tolerable error rate. More interestingly, our proof gives a unified theory covering the well-known Bennett-Brassard 1984 (BB84) protocol and RRDQPS protocol. Thus, it is confirmed that BB84 protocol is indeed a special case of the RRDQPS protocol.

Physical Review A

10.1103/PhysRevA.98.062331

面向量子密钥分发的后脉冲效应分析Afterpulse Analysis for Quantum Key Distribution

针对高速量子密钥分发中后脉冲引入额外误码、使系统严重偏离传统解析模型的问题，利用后脉冲的非马尔可夫性质建立了新的分析模型，显著提升了优化后的密钥率与实际系统对后脉冲的容忍度。

在光学量子密码中，后脉冲效应对量子密钥分发（QKD）的安全密钥生成十分重要，因为它会引入额外误码，并使系统严重偏离传统的解析模型，对高速系统尤为如此。本研究利用后脉冲的非马尔可夫性质，建立了一种不同的解析模型，使QKD系统能更好地与后脉冲相兼容。由此得到的优化密钥率大幅提高，因此在实际QKD系统中，用于安全通信的后脉冲容忍度可显著改善。

Abstract (English)
In optical quantum cryptography, the afterpulse effect is important for secure key generation in quantum key distribution (QKD), because it introduces additional error and leads to great deviation from the traditional analytical model, especially for high-speed systems. This study develops a different analytical model to make QKD systems more afterpulse-compatible, by exploiting the non-Markovian nature of the afterpulse. The optimized key rate obtained here is much higher, and thus the tolerance of the afterpulse effect can be significantly improved in practical QKD systems for secure communication.

不破坏光子态的可扩展轨道角动量分选Scalable orbital-angular-momentum sorting without destroying photon states

提出由对称多端口分束器与道威棱镜级联构成的可扩展轨道角动量分选器，可同时分辨不同 OAM 态并保持轨道与自旋角动量，大幅减少高维分选所需的分束器数量。

携带轨道角动量（OAM）的单光子已引起研究人员的广泛关注。理论上单个光子可以携带无限多的 OAM 值。因此，OAM 光子态已被广泛用于量子信息和基础量子力学研究。尽管已有许多对不同 OAM 值量子态进行分选的方法，但高维 OAM 的无损高效分选仍是一项基本挑战。在此，我们提出一种可扩展的 OAM 分选器，能够同时分类不同的 OAM 态，同时保持轨道角动量和自旋角动量。该分选器的基本单元由对称多端口分束器（BS）和具有级联结构的道威棱镜组成，原则上可以灵活有效地组合，以分选任意高维 OAM 光子。这里提出的可扩展结构大大减少了分选高维 OAM 态所需的分束器数量。鉴于其无损和可扩展的特性，该分选器不仅可作为高维量子信息处理的基本器件，也可用于传统光学。

Abstract (English)
Single photons with orbital angular momentum (OAM) have attracted substantial attention from researchers. A single photon can carry infinite OAM values theoretically. Thus, OAM photon states have been widely used in quantum information and fundamental quantum mechanics. Although there have been many methods for sorting quantum states with different OAM values, the nondestructive and efficient sorter of high-dimensional OAM remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we propose a scalable OAM sorter which can categorize different OAM states simultaneously, meanwhile, preserving both OAM and spin angular momentum. Fundamental elements of the sorter are composed of symmetric multiport beam splitters (BSs) and Dove prisms with cascading structure, which in principle can be flexibly and effectively combined to sort arbitrarily high-dimensional OAM photons. The scalable structures proposed here greatly reduce the number of BSs required for sorting high-dimensional OAM states. In view of the nondestructive and extensible features, the sorters can be used as fundamental devices not only for high-dimensional quantum information processing, but also for traditional optics.

独立装置制备-测量场景下获取更多量子随机性More randomness from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices

在独立装置的制备-测量场景中，改用全部观测概率直接计算最小熵而非仅依赖见证值；数值模拟表明典型不可信 BB84 装置下最小熵更高，可产出更多真实量子随机数。

如何从不可信装置中产生真实的量子随机性是量子信息处理中的一个重要问题。受此前关于自检验量子随机数发生器的工作［T. Lunghi 等，Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 150501 (2015)］启发，我们提出了一种在独立装置的制备-测量场景中产生量子随机性的方法。在已有协议中，量子随机性仅依赖于一个见证值（例如 Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt 值），该值由观测到的概率计算得到。与之不同，在我们的方法中，所有观测到的概率都被直接用于计算最小熵。通过数值模拟，我们发现当使用典型的不可信 Bennett-Brassard 1984（BB84）装置时，所提方案的最小熵高于此前的工作。因此，得益于这一方法，有可能获得比以往更多的真实量子随机数。

Abstract (English)
How to generate genuine quantum randomness from untrusted devices is an important problem in quantum information processing. Inspired by previous work on a self-testing quantum random number generator [T. Lunghi et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 150501 (2015)], we present a method to generate quantum randomness from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices. In existing protocols, the quantum randomness depends only on a witness value (e.g., Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt value), which is calculated with the observed probabilities. Differently, here all the observed probabilities are directly used to calculate the min-entropy in our method. Through numerical simulation, we find that the min-entropy of our proposed scheme is higher than that in the previous work when a typical untrusted Bennett-Brassard 1984 (BB84) setup is used. Consequently, thanks to the proposed method, more genuine quantum random numbers may be obtained than before.

测量设备无关的量子抛币协议及其抗探测器侧信道攻击方案Measurement-device-independent quantum coin tossing

针对不诚实 Alice 可借探测器致盲攻击使量子抛币完全失密的问题，提出测量设备无关量子抛币方案，在相干攻击下偏置与原容损协议相同，并可兼容弱相干态光源。

量子抛币（QCT）是量子密码学中的一个重要基本原语，一直受到持续关注。然而在实际的 QCT 中，Bob 的探测器可能遭受不诚实的 Alice 发起的探测器侧信道攻击，这有可能使协议完全不安全。在此，我们基于近期的一项实验报道了一种简单的探测器致盲攻击策略。为消除所有探测器侧信道，我们提出了测量设备无关 QCT（MDI-QCT）的解决方案。该方法类似于测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）的思想。MDI-QCT 在使用单光子源时是容损的，并且在相干攻击下具有与原容损 QCT 相同的偏置。此外，在某些特殊情形下，它还具有使安全距离加倍的潜在优势。最后，MDI-QCT 也可以经修改以适配弱相干态光源。因此，基于实用 MDI-QKD 的快速发展，我们的方案可以容易地实现。

Abstract (English)
Quantum coin tossing (QCT) is an important primitive of quantum cryptography and has received continuous interest. However, in practical QCT, Bob's detectors can be subjected to detector-side channel attacks launched by dishonest Alice, which will possibly make the protocol completely insecure. Here, we report a simple strategy of a detector-blinding attack based on a recent experiment. To remove all the detector side channels, we present a solution of measurement-device-independent QCT (MDI-QCT). This method is similar to the idea of MDI quantum key distribution (QKD). MDI-QCT is loss tolerant with single-photon sources and has the same bias as the original loss-tolerant QCT under a coherent attack. Moreover, it provides the potential advantage of doubling the secure distance for some special cases. Finally, MDI-QCT can also be modified to fit the weak coherent-state sources. Thus, based on the rapid development of practical MDI-QKD, our proposal can be implemented easily.

无需相位参考的测量设备无关量子密钥分发实验Phase-Reference-Free Experiment of Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution

★Phys. Rev. Lett.

提出相位编码的参考系无关测量设备无关量子密钥分发方案，两个远距离干涉仪之间无需相位对准，在 20 km 光纤、1 MHz 系统上获得 8.309 bps 的平均安全密钥率。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是朝着在远程合法用户（Alice 与 Bob）之间实现实用信息论安全密钥共享迈出的实质性一步。与其他标准的设备相关量子密钥分发协议（如 BB84）一样，MDI QKD 假定 Alice 与 Bob 之间已经共享了参考系。在实践中，往往需要复杂的对准流程，这会占用系统资源并可能显著降低安全密钥生成率。在此，我们提出了一种相位编码的参考系无关 MDI QKD 方案，它不需要两个相距遥远的合法方干涉仪之间的任何相位对准。作为演示，我们给出了使用法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的原理性验证实验。实验系统工作在 1 MHz，在 Alice 与 Bob 之间光纤长度为 20 km 时获得了 8.309 bps 的平均安全密钥率。该系统在正常情况下无需相位补偿即可维持正的密钥生成率。结果显示了我们的系统用于成熟 MDI QKD 器件的可行性及其在网络场景中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a substantial step toward practical information-theoretic security for key sharing between remote legitimate users (Alice and Bob). As with other standard device-dependent quantum key distribution protocols, such as BB84, MDI QKD assumes that the reference frames have been shared between Alice and Bob. In practice, a nontrivial alignment procedure is often necessary, which requires system resources and may significantly reduce the secure key generation rate. Here, we propose a phase-coding reference-frame-independent MDI QKD scheme that requires no phase alignment between the interferometers of two distant legitimate parties. As a demonstration, a proof-of-principle experiment using Faraday-Michelson interferometers is presented. The experimental system worked at 1 MHz, and an average secure key rate of 8.309 bps was obtained at a fiber length of 20 km between Alice and Bob. The system can maintain a positive key generation rate without phase compensation under normal conditions. The results exhibit the feasibility of our system for use in mature MDI QKD devices and its value for network scenarios.

基于单光子贝尔态测量的量子密钥分发简单实现Simple implementation of quantum key distribution based on single-photon Bell-state measurement

提出一种可直接搭建在现有BB84系统上的单光子贝尔态测量量子密钥分发方案，揭示其与传统相位编码协议之间的隐藏物理联系，并实验验证了可行性。

最近，人们提出了一些基于单光子贝尔态测量（SBSM）的测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发（QKD）替代方案。尽管这些替代方案的安全性并不严格等同于MDI QKD，但它们具备传统类BB84协议成码率高的优势，同时避免了MDI QKD所要求的两光子干涉技术复杂性。然而，与常用的BB84系统相比，这些已提出方案的装置相当复杂。在此我们提出一种基于SBSM的QKD的简单实现，它直接建立在已有的BB84 QKD实现之上。我们的方案揭示了基于SBSM的QKD与传统相位编码QKD协议之间的隐藏联系。这一发现阐明了这两类不同QKD协议背后的物理。此外，我们实验演示了该协议的可行性。

Abstract (English)
Recently some alternatives to the measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution (QKD) based on the single-photon Bell-state measurement (SBSM) were proposed. Although these alternatives are not precisely as secure as the MDI QKD, they possess the advantage of a high key rate of the traditional BB84-like protocol and avoid the technical complexity of two-photon interference required in the MDI QKD. However, the setups of these proposed schemes are rather complicated compared to commonly used BB84 systems. Here we propose a simple implementation of SBSM-based QKD that is directly built on the existing realization of the BB84 QKD. Our proposal exhibits the hidden connection between the SBSM-based QKD and traditional phase-encoding QKD protocols. This finding discloses the physics behind these two different types of QKD protocols. In addition, we experimentally demonstrate the feasibility of our protocol.

失配基统计使未表征量子比特源可用于量子密钥分发Mismatched-basis statistics enable quantum key distribution with uncharacterized qubit sources

提出一种后处理方法，利用双方选用不同基时的测量统计，证明纳入这些统计后，未表征的量子比特源也能用于测量设备无关量子密钥分发与 BB84 协议，而此前这被认为不可能。

在量子密钥分发的后处理中，来自失配基测量（即双方使用不同基）的原始密钥比特通常被丢弃。这里我们提出一种利用失配基情形下测量统计的后处理方法，并证明：纳入这些统计后，未表征的量子比特源可以被用于测量设备无关的量子密钥分发协议以及 Bennett-Brassard 1984 协议，而这在其他情况下是不可能的。

Abstract (English)
In the postprocessing of quantum key distribution, the raw key bits from the mismatched-basis measurements, where two parties use different bases, are normally discarded. Here, we propose a postprocessing method that exploits measurement statistics from mismatched-basis cases and prove that incorporating these statistics enables uncharacterized qubit sources to be used in the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution protocol and the Bennett-Brassard 1984 protocol, which is otherwise impossible.

基于Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt不等式的诱骗态测量设备无关量子密钥分发Decoy-state measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution based on the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt inequality

在仅要求量子态制备于二维希尔伯特空间、器件相互独立的假设下，分析含一个信号态与s−1个诱骗态的CHSH-MDI-QKD协议，并计入五强度情形的有限码长效应，仿真显示方案具有实用性。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议的提出旨在消除探测器侧信道攻击，但其安全性依赖于编码系统被完美刻画这一假设。相比之下，基于Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt不等式（CHSH）的MDI-QKD协议（CHSH-MDI-QKD）弱化了这一假设，它只要求量子态在二维希尔伯特空间中制备、且各器件相互独立。在实验实现中，由于缺乏理想的单光子源，QKD系统通常采用弱相干态，而弱相干态可能被制备于高维空间。本文研究采用 s（3≤s≤5）个强度的诱骗态CHSH-MDI-QKD协议，其中包括一个信号态和 s−1 个诱骗态；同时我们还考虑了五强度情形下诱骗态CHSH-MDI-QKD协议的有限码长效应。仿真结果表明该方案非常实用。

Abstract (English)
The measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol is proposed to remove the detector side channel attacks, while its security relies on the assumption that the encoding systems are perfectly characterized. In contrast, the MDI-QKD protocol based on the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt inequality (CHSH-MDI-QKD) weakens this assumption, which only requires the quantum state to be prepared in the two-dimensional Hilbert space and the devices are independent. In experimental realizations, the weak coherent state, which is always used in QKD systems due to the lack of an ideal single-photon source, may be prepared in the high-dimensional space. In this paper, we investigate the decoy-state CHSH-MDI-QKD protocol with $s(3\ensuremath{\le}s\ensuremath{\le}5)$ intensities, including one signal state and $s\ensuremath{-}1$ decoy states, and we also consider the finite-size effect on the decoy-state CHSH-MDI-QKD protocol with five intensities. Simulation results show that this scheme is very practical.

Chun-Mei Zhang, Mo Li, Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Dong Wang, Jing-Zheng Huang, Yun-Guang Han, Man-Li Xu, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Patcharapong Treeviriyanupab, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

利用光纤分束器耦合比随波长变化这一器件不完美，提出针对零差探测连续变量量子密钥分发的波长攻击，可使实时散粒噪声估计产生偏差，并给出改进的防御方案。

商用量子密钥分发系统中的不完美器件会留下安全漏洞，窃听者可能加以利用。这类不完美的一个例子是光纤分束器的耦合比依赖于波长。利用这一漏洞，窃听者可以通过注入与通常使用波长不同的光，来改变接收端光纤分束器的透射率。在此，我们针对采用零差探测的实际连续变量量子密钥分发系统提出一种波长攻击。通过注入不同波长的光脉冲，该攻击使窃听者即使在进行实时散粒噪声估计时也能使其产生偏差。基于实验数据，我们讨论了该攻击的可行性，并通过改进此前提出的对策给出了一种防御方案。

Abstract (English)
Imperfect devices in commercial quantum key distribution systems open security loopholes that an eavesdropper may exploit. An example of one such imperfection is the wavelength-dependent coupling ratio of the fiber beam splitter. Utilizing this loophole, the eavesdropper can vary the transmittances of the fiber beam splitter at the receiver's side by inserting lights with wavelengths different from what is normally used. Here, we propose a wavelength attack on a practical continuous-variable quantum key distribution system using homodyne detection. By inserting light pulses at different wavelengths, this attack allows the eavesdropper to bias the shot-noise estimation even if it is done in real time. Based on experimental data, we discuss the feasibility of this attack and suggest a prevention scheme by improving the previously proposed countermeasures.

提出仅用二维希尔伯特空间编码量子态、且态制备与测量设备相互独立的QKD协议，既弱化了原始MDI-QKD的态制备假设，又能克服限制FDI-QKD应用的探测漏洞问题，可用实际光学元件实现。

本文提出一种量子密钥分发（QKD）协议，它仅基于编码量子系统的二维希尔伯特空间，并要求态制备设备与测量设备相互独立。我们的协议受到完全设备无关量子密钥分发（FDI-QKD）协议和测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议的启发。我们的协议只要求态在二维希尔伯特空间中制备，这弱化了原始MDI-QKD协议中的态制备假设。更有趣的是，我们的协议能够克服FDI-QKD协议中的探测漏洞问题，而该问题极大地限制了FDI-QKD的应用。因此，我们的协议可以用实际的光学元件实现。

Abstract (English)
In this paper, we propose a quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol based on only a two-dimensional Hilbert space encoding a quantum system and independent devices between the equipment for state preparation and measurement. Our protocol is inspired by the fully device-independent quantum key distribution (FDI-QKD) protocol and the measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol. Our protocol only requires the state to be prepared in the two-dimensional Hilbert space, which weakens the state preparation assumption in the original MDI-QKD protocol. More interestingly, our protocol can overcome the detection loophole problem in the FDI-QKD protocol, which greatly limits the application of FDI-QKD. Hence our protocol can be implemented with practical optical components.

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）被提出以抵御任何可能的探测攻击。原始方案的安全性依赖于如下假设：合法用户能够完全刻画包括源在内的编码系统。在此我们提出一种MDIQKD协议，只要使用量子比特源，就允许编码系统未被表征。我们给出了该MDIQKD协议的安全性证明，它不需要关于编码态的任何知识。模拟结果表明该方案具有实用性。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) is proposed to be secure against any possible detection attacks. The security of the original proposal relies on the assumption that the legitimate users can fully characterize the encoding systems including sources. Here, we propose a MDIQKD protocol where we allow uncharacterized encoding systems as long as qubit sources are used. A security proof of the MDIQKD protocol is presented that does not need the knowledge of the encoding states. Simulation results show that the scheme is practical.

利用波长攻击对连续变量量子密钥分发系统实施量子黑客攻击Quantum hacking of a continuous-variable quantum-key-distribution system using a wavelength attack

提出一种波长攻击，通过切换输入光波长控制Bob分束器的强度透过率，可攻破采用外差探测的连续变量量子密钥分发系统，即使监测了本地振荡光强度，最终密钥仍不安全。

连续变量量子密钥分发的安全性证明基于以下假设：窃听者既不能作用于本地振荡光，也不能控制Bob的分束器。由于此类协议在实现中可能存在不完美之处，这些假设在实际中可能并不成立。本文考虑本地振荡光在公共信道中传输的情形，提出一种波长攻击，使窃听者能够通过切换输入光的波长来控制Bob分束器的强度透过率。具体而言，我们针对采用外差探测协议、并使用直接协商或逆向协商的连续变量量子密钥分发系统。我们证明该攻击是可行的，并使得合法双方共享的所有最终密钥都不再安全，即使他们已监测了本地振荡光的强度。为在商用系统上防范该攻击，应在执行监测探测之前随机加入一个简单的波长滤波器。

Abstract (English)
The security proofs of continuous-variable quantum key distribution are based on the assumptions that the eavesdropper can neither act on the local oscillator nor control Bob's beam splitter. These assumptions may be invalid in practice due to potential imperfections in the implementations of such protocols. In this paper, we consider the problem of transmitting the local oscillator in a public channel and propose a wavelength attack which allows the eavesdropper to control the intensity transmission of Bob's beam splitter by switching the wavelength of the input light. Specifically we target continuous-variable quantum key distribution systems that use the heterodyne detection protocol using either direct or reverse reconciliation. Our attack is proved to be feasible and renders all of the final keys shared between the legitimate parties insecure, even if they have monitored the intensity of the local oscillator. To prevent our attack on commercial systems, a simple wavelength filter should be randomly added before performing monitoring detection.

我们研究了半设备无关协议与全设备无关协议之间的关系。作为工具，我们利用了贝尔不等式与维度见证之间的对应关系。我们提出了一种把前者转换为后者、以及反向转换的方法。这一关系为两种场景都带来了有趣的结果。首先，我们在半设备无关与全设备无关两种情形下都找到了比特率更高的随机数生成协议。作为副产品，我们得到了若干类贝尔不等式和维度见证。随后，我们展示了贝尔不等式研究中使用的优化方法如何能够被用于维度见证。

Abstract (English)
We study the relation between semi- and fully-device-independent protocols. As a tool, we use the correspondence between Bell inequalities and dimension witnesses. We present a method for converting the former into the latter, and vice versa. This relation provides us with interesting results for both scenarios. First, we find random-number-generation protocols with higher bit rates for both the semi- and fully-device-independent cases. As a byproduct, we obtain classes of Bell inequalities and dimension witnesses. Then, we show how optimization methods used in studies on Bell inequalities can be adopted for dimension witnesses.

在反事实量子密码方案中，信息载体无需在量子信道中传播即可共享密钥；该工作针对常用弱相干激光源，在一般集体攻击下证明了方案安全性，并给出密钥率下界与实际性能分析。

在“反事实量子密码学”方案[T.-G. Noh, Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 230501 (2009)]中，即使信息载体不在量子信道中传输，两个合法远端用户仍可共享密钥比特。Yin等人[Z.-Q. Yin, H. W. Li, W. Chen, Z. F. Han, and G. C. Guo, Phys. Rev. A 82, 042335 (2010)]已证明采用理想单光子源的该协议的安全性。本文证明基于常用弱相干激光源的反事实量子密码方案在一般集体攻击下的安全性。此证明的基本假设是：单光子探测器的效率和暗计数率对任意$n$光子Fock态均保持一致。随后，通过对编码弱相干态的相位进行随机化，Eve的辅助量子态将转化为经典混合态。最后，给出了秘密密钥比特率的下界以及实际实现下的性能分析。

Abstract (English)
In the ``counterfactual quantum cryptography'' scheme [T.-G. Noh, Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 230501 (2009)], two legitimate distant peers may share secret-key bits even when the information carriers do not travel in the quantum channel. The security of this protocol with an ideal single-photon source has been proved by Yin et al. [Z.-Q. Yin, H. W. Li, W. Chen, Z. F. Han, and G. C. Guo, Phys. Rev. A 82, 042335 (2010)]. In this paper, we prove the security of the counterfactual-quantum-cryptography scheme based on a commonly used weak-coherent-laser source by considering a general collective attack. The basic assumption of this proof is that the efficiency and dark-counting rate of a single-photon detector are consistent for any $n$-photon Fock states. Then through randomizing the phases of the encoding weak coherent states, Eve's ancilla will be transformed into a classical mixture. Finally, the lower bound of the secret-key-bit rate and a performance analysis for the practical implementation are both given.

Zhen-Qiang Yin, Hong-Wei Li, Yao Yao, Chun-Mei Zhang, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

针对熔融双锥分束器的波长相关特性这一安全漏洞，提出可适用于所有被动状态调制 QKD 系统的攻击方案，并在偏振编码系统上仅以误码率从 1.3% 升至 1.4% 的代价窃取全部密钥。

众所周知，量子密钥分发（QKD）的无条件安全性可由量子力学保证。然而，实际 QKD 系统存在一些不完美之处，窃听者可以利用这些不完美来攻击密钥。以当前的实验技术，采用熔融双锥工艺制作的实际分束器具有波长相关特性。基于这一致命的安全漏洞，我们提出一种波长相关攻击方案，它可应用于所有采用被动状态调制的实际 QKD 系统。此外，我们对一个实际的偏振编码 QKD 系统进行了实验攻击，仅以将量子比特错误率从 1.3% 提高到 1.4% 为代价，就获取了全部密钥信息。

Abstract (English)
It is well known that the unconditional security of quantum-key distribution (QKD) can be guaranteed by quantum mechanics. However, practical QKD systems have some imperfections, which can be controlled by the eavesdropper to attack the secret key. With current experimental technology, a realistic beam splitter, made by fused biconical technology, has a wavelength-dependent property. Based on this fatal security loophole, we propose a wavelength-dependent attacking protocol, which can be applied to all practical QKD systems with passive state modulation. Moreover, we experimentally attack a practical polarization encoding QKD system to obtain all the secret key information at the cost of only increasing the quantum bit error rate from $1.3$ to $1.4%$.

Abstract (English)
By testing the classical correlation violation between two systems, true random numbers can be generated and certified without applying classical statistical method. In this work, we propose a true random-number expansion protocol without entanglement, where the randomness can be guaranteed only by the two-dimensional quantum witness violation. Furthermore, we only assume that the dimensionality of the system used in the protocol has a tight bound, and the whole protocol can be regarded as a semi-device-independent black-box scenario. Compared with the device-independent random-number expansion protocol based on entanglement, our protocol is much easier to implement and test.

No. 01

面向可扩展量子网络的全无调制器量子密钥分发架构Fully modulator-free architecture for quantum key distribution in scalable quantum networks

提出并实验演示首个全无调制器、全自由度直接调制量子密钥分发架构，利用光注入锁定与相干干涉同时控制相位和强度，30 dB 信道损耗下安全码率 4.78 kbps，与常规调制器系统相当。

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络是迈向未来量子互联网的基础一步，已成为密集研究的焦点。类比经典光网络架构可以看到，高容量骨干网通常依赖复杂的外部调制，而成本敏感的接入层更偏好更简单、更紧凑、更经济的直接调制。作为量子网络的基石，当今 QKD 网络同样具有这种骨干—接入层级结构，然而其实现仍严重依赖外部调制器，使接入层中直接调制 QKD 的生态位明显空缺。在此，我们提出并实验演示了首个填补这一空缺的全无调制器、全自由度直接调制 QKD 架构。发射端将光注入锁定与相干光干涉相结合，无需外部调制器即可同时实现相位与强度控制，从而能够制备任意量子态，并保持与标准时间仓编码接收端的固有兼容性。我们的实验实现采用相对廉价的激光二极管和无源光学元件，在 30 dB 信道损耗下实现 4.78 kbps 的安全密钥率，与传统基于调制器的系统性能相当。通过填补 QKD 生态中长期存在的直接调制生态位，这项工作为接入层部署难题提供了实用解决方案，并为紧凑、可扩展的 QKD 实现开辟了一条可行新方向。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks represent a foundational step toward the future quantum internet and have become a focus of intensive research. By analogy with the architecture of classical optical networks, we can observe that the high-capacity backbone typically relies on complex external modulation, while the cost-sensitive access layer prefers simpler, more compact, and more economical direct modulation. As the cornerstone of quantum networks, today’s QKD networks share this backbone-access hierarchy, yet their implementations remain heavily reliant on external modulators, leaving a clear ecological niche unfilled for directly modulated QKD in the access layer. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate the first fully modulator-free, full-degree-of-freedom direct-modulation QKD architecture that fills this niche. The transmitter combines optical injection locking with coherent optical interference to achieve simultaneous phase and intensity control without external modulators, enabling arbitrary quantum-state preparation while preserving inherent compatibility with standard time-bin-encoding receivers. Built with relatively inexpensive laser diodes and passive optical components, our experimental implementation achieves a secure key rate of 4.78 kbps at 30 dB channel loss, matching the performance of conventional modulator-based systems. By filling the long-standing direct-modulation niche in the QKD ecosystem, this work delivers a practical solution to the access-layer deployment challenge and opens a viable new direction for compact, scalable QKD implementation.

Feng-Yu Lu, Xiao-Juan Huang, Yu-Xuan Fan, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Zi-Tao Liu, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于弱相干态的相对论位置验证方案Relativistic position verification with coherent states

在信息论框架下提出并实验实现结合量子光学与相对论的安全位置验证协议，2 km 间距的两位验证者借助相位随机化弱相干态，以优于 75 m 的精度确认证明者位置。

一种确定实体位置的安全方法可以支撑基于位置的交易授权、高价值目标追踪等方案。然而在证明者不可信的情形下，经典方法无法提供安全的位置验证，这意味着证明者可以就其真实位置误导验证者。我们提出并在信息论框架内实验实现了一种将量子光学与相对论相结合的安全位置验证协议。利用相位随机化弱相干态，相距 2 km 的两位验证者以优于 75 m 的精度安全地验证了证明者的位置。这些结果使安全的位置基认证成为实际可能，为金融交易、灾害响应与可认证的安全通信等应用铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A secure approach to determining the position of an entity can enable schemes such as position-based authorization for transactions and tracking of high-value targets. However, classical methods are incapable of providing secure position verification in the untrusted-prover case, meaning that a prover can mislead verifiers about its actual position. Here we propose and experimentally realize a secure position verification protocol that combines quantum optics and relativity within an information-theoretic framework. Using phase-randomized weak coherent states, two verifiers separated by 2 km securely verify the prover’s position with an accuracy better than 75 m. These results establish secure position-based authentication as a practical possibility, paving the way for applications in financial transactions, disaster response and authenticated secure communications.

全连接量子网络可使每个用户同时与其他所有用户相连，是一种高度通用且鲁棒的组网架构。然而，此类网络的可扩展性在实用化应用中仍是巨大挑战。本文基于双光子Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉构建了一个大规模全连接量子网络，即使网络提供商不可信，用户与用户之间的安全性仍能得到保证。利用集成孤子微梳（SMC）和光子编码芯片，我们实现了精确且大规模并行的频率产生与锁定、高可见度HOM干涉以及测量设备无关（MDI）量子密钥分发。所提出的架构可在不可信网络提供商的条件下，实现跨越200公里的、具有严格信息论安全性的全连接量子网络。该组网架构为构建覆盖城域与城际的大规模全连接MDI量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Fully connected quantum networks enable simultaneous connection of every user to every other user and are a highly versatile and robust networking architecture. However, the scalability of such networks remains a great challenge for practical applications. Here we construct a large-scale fully connected quantum network founded on two-photon Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference, where user-to-user security is guaranteed even with an untrusted network provider. Using integrated soliton microcomb (SMC) and photonic encoding chips, we realize precise, massively parallel frequency generation and locking, high-visibility HOM interference and measurement-device-independent (MDI) quantum key distribution. The proposed architecture enables a fully connected quantum network over 200 kilometers with strict information-theoretic security via an untrusted network provider. The implemented networking architecture paves the way for large-scale fully connected MDI quantum networks across metropolitan and intercity regions.

量子互联网有望提供经典互联网可证明无法实现的独特能力。然而，当前的量子网络往往为特定任务设计专用系统，这阻碍了未来量子互联网的开放性与多样性。为解决这些局限，本工作提出一种全异构量子网络，并配套若干技术。该方案允许用户使用任意主流系统甚至部分系统接入网络。该网络还可执行多种不同的量子任务，并为全局优化与低成本设计提供可能。我们实现了包含异构节点的五节点量子网络，通过量子密钥分发、量子数字签名、量子拜占庭协议和量子会议等任务展示了该方案的优越性。尤其值得注意的是，该实验首次在量子网络中演示了多恶意节点量子拜占庭协议。本工作提出了连接多样用户系统并支持多种量子任务的全异构量子网络，还提出一种软件定义的量子网络结构，以协调网络节点并优化网络性能。这为开放且通用的量子互联网铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
The quantum internet promises unparalleled capabilities that are provably impossible with the classical internet. However, current quantum networks are often designed with dedicated systems for specified tasks, which hinders the openness and diversity of future quantum internet. To address these limitations, this work proposes a fully heterogeneous quantum network accompanied with several techniques. Our proposal allows users to access the network using any mainstream systems or even partial systems. The network also enables the execution of multiple distinct quantum tasks and provides opportunities for global optimization and cost-efficient design. A five-node quantum network featuring heterogeneous nodes has been implemented, demonstrating the superiority of our proposal through tasks such as quantum key distribution, quantum digital signature, quantum Byzantine agreement, and quantum conference. Notably, the experiment represents the first demonstration of multi-malicious node quantum Byzantine agreement in a quantum network. This work proposed a fully heterogeneous quantum network that connects diverse user systems and enables multiple quantum tasks. A software-defined quantum network structure is also proposed for coordinating network nodes and optimizing network performance. It paves the way for an open and versatile quantum internet.

Abstract (English)
Abstract Mode-pairing quantum key distribution (MP-QKD) is a potential protocol that is not only immune to all possible detector side channel attacks, but also breaks the repeaterless rate-transmittance bound without needing global phase locking. The results show that the original protocol can break the repeaterless rate-transmittance bound with a typical finite number of pulses in practice. And our six-state protocol can improve the secret key rate significantly in long distance cases.

实验实现可容忍超过140 dB信道损耗的双场量子密钥分发系统，安全距离达833.8 km，创下光纤QKD的新纪录，在相近距离上的安全密钥率较此前纪录高出两个数量级以上。

量子密钥分发（QKD）为远程对等方之间基于物理协议共享信息论安全的密钥提供了一种很有前景的解决方案。根据量子物理规律，携带信号的光子不能通过经典光学技术进行放大或中继，否则就无法维持量子安全性。因此，信道的传输损耗限制了其可达距离，这一直是构建大规模量子安全网络的一大障碍。在此，我们展示了一套能够容忍超过140 dB信道损耗的实验QKD系统，实现了833.8 km的安全距离，创造了光纤QKD的新纪录。此外，优化的四相位双场协议和高质量的装置使该系统在相近距离上的安全密钥率比此前纪录高出两个数量级以上。我们的结果标志着朝着在1000 km尺度上构建可靠、高效的地面量子安全网络迈出了突破性的一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides a promising solution for sharing information-theoretic secure keys between remote peers with physics-based protocols. According to the law of quantum physics, the photons carrying signals cannot be amplified or relayed via classical optical techniques to maintain quantum security. As a result, the transmission loss of the channel limits its achievable distance, and this has been a huge barrier towards building large-scale quantum-secure networks. Here we present an experimental QKD system that could tolerate a channel loss beyond 140 dB and obtain a secure distance of 833.8 km, setting a new record for fibre-based QKD. Furthermore, the optimized four-phase twin-field protocol and high-quality set-up make its secure key rate more than two orders of magnitude greater than previous records over similar distances. Our results mark a breakthrough towards building reliable and efficient terrestrial quantum-secure networks over a scale of 1,000 km.

无需监测信号扰动的量子密钥分发紧致有限密钥分析Tight finite-key analysis for quantum key distribution without monitoring signal disturbance

基于熵不确定关系与 Azuma 不等式，为轮询差分相移协议给出可抵御最一般相干攻击的紧致有限密钥安全性证明，表明相位随机化光源下实验可及的脉冲数即可逼近渐近极限。

与传统通信不同，量子密钥分发（QKD）能够达到无条件安全，因而受到大量研究关注。在现有各类 QKD 协议中，轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议无需监测信号扰动即可运行，这显著简化了其流程并提高了对误码率的容忍度。尽管已有若干 RRDPS 的安全性证明，但针对实际相位随机化光源的紧致有限密钥分析仍然缺失。本文基于熵不确定关系，提出了一种改进的 RRDPS 安全性证明，可抵御最一般的相干攻击。此外，借助 Azuma 不等式，我们的证明能够很好地处理有限密钥效应。所提出的有限密钥分析保持了相位随机化光源的优势，并表明实验上可接受的脉冲数足以接近渐近极限。这些结果有助于实现无需监测信号扰动的实用化 QKD。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Unlike traditional communication, quantum key distribution (QKD) can reach unconditional security and thus attracts intensive studies. Among all existing QKD protocols, round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) protocol can be running without monitoring signal disturbance, which significantly simplifies its flow and improves its tolerance of error rate. Although several security proofs of RRDPS have been given, a tight finite-key analysis with a practical phase-randomized source is still missing. In this paper, we propose an improved security proof of RRDPS against the most general coherent attack based on the entropic uncertainty relation. What’s more, with the help of Azuma’s inequality, our proof can tackle finite-key effects primely. The proposed finite-key analysis keeps the advantages of phase randomization source and indicates experimentally acceptable numbers of pulses are sufficient to approach the asymptotical bound closely. The results shed light on practical QKD without monitoring signal disturbance.

诱骗态方法大幅提升了量子密钥分发的性能，并完美解决了多光子脉冲带来的关键问题。近年来，诱骗态方法在实用性方面占据关键地位，几乎所有QKD系统都采用了诱骗态方法。然而，传统强度调制器的不完美性限制了诱骗态方法的性能并引入侧信道。本工作设计了一种特殊的强度调制器及其配套调制方法，并进行了实验验证，以实现安全、稳定、高性能的诱骗态QKD。实验结果表明，其稳定且可调的强度、便捷的两级调制、固有的高速特性以及紧凑结构非常契合未来发展趋势，将有助于诱骗态方法完美地应用于QKD系统。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The decoy-state method substantially improves the performance of quantum key distribution (QKD) and perfectly solves crucial issues caused by multiphoton pulses. In recent years, the decoy-state method has occupied a key position in practicality, and almost all the QKD systems have employed the decoy-state method. However, the imperfections of traditional intensity modulators limit the performance of the decoy-state method and bring side channels. In this work, a special intensity modulator and its accompanying modulation method are designed and experimentally verified for the secure, stable, and high-performance decoy-state QKDs. The experimental result indicates that its stable and adjustable intensities, convenient two-level modulation, inherently high speed, and compact structure is extremely fit for future trends and will help the decoy-state method to be perfectly applied to QKD systems.

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）作为一种真正的随机性来源，在数值模拟和密码学等许多应用中不可或缺。最近，一种源无关量子随机数发生器（SI-QRNG）已经实现，它可以在光源不可信的情况下产生安全的随机数。然而，SI-QRNG 中所使用的可信但非完美器件的测量漏洞尚未被充分探究，这会带来安全性问题，尤其是在高速系统中。在此，我们指出并评估了 SI-QRNG 中实际非完美测量器件的安全漏洞。我们还给出了相应的对策，通过重新计算条件最小熵并增加监测器来防止这些信息泄露。此外，在考虑有限尺寸效应的情况下，我们表明当采样轮数很大时，后脉冲的影响可能超过有限尺寸效应的影响。我们的协议简单而有效，提升了 SI-QRNG 在实际中的安全性以及与高速测量器件的兼容性，从而为构建超快且安全性可认证的商用 SI-QRNG 系统铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Abstract A quantum random number generator (QRNG) as a genuine source of randomness is essential in many applications, such as number simulation and cryptography. Recently, a source-independent quantum random number generator (SI-QRNG), which can generate secure random numbers with untrusted sources, has been realized. However, the measurement loopholes of the trusted but imperfect devices used in SI-QRNGs have not yet been fully explored, which will cause security problems, especially in high-speed systems. Here, we point out and evaluate the security loopholes of practical imperfect measurement devices in SI-QRNGs. We also provide corresponding countermeasures to prevent these information leakages by recalculating the conditional minimum entropy and adding a monitor. Furthermore, by taking into account the finite-size effect, we show that the influence of the afterpulse can exceed that of the finite-size effect with the large number of sampled rounds. Our protocol is simple and effective, and it promotes the security of SI-QRNG in practice as well as the compatibility with high-speed measurement devices, thus paving the way for constructing ultrafast and security-certified commercial SI-QRNG systems.

Xing Lin, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Rong Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

★Commun. Phys.

将编码模式中全局相位的数目离散化，由此统一了前两类双场量子密钥分发协议，并揭示增加离散相位数目可延长可达距离，但短距离密钥率会因相位后选择而下降。

双场量子密钥分发（TF-QKD）及其变体协议极具吸引力，因为它们具有克服点对点 QKD 协议密钥率-损耗极限的优势。对于 TF-QKD 的各种变体而言，确保安全性的关键在于在编码模式与测试模式之间随机切换。在所有 TF-QKD 协议中，它们的编码模式差别很大，例如调制连续相位、仅调制两个相反相位，以及发送或不发送信号脉冲。在这里我们表明，通过对编码模式中全局相位的数目进行离散化，我们可以对前两类 TF-QKD 协议给出统一的视角，并证明增加离散相位的数目可以延长可达距离；而作为权衡，由于相位后选择，短距离下的密钥率会降低。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) and its variant protocols are highly attractive due to the advantage of overcoming the rate-loss limit for secret key rates of point-to-point QKD protocols. For variations of TF-QKD, the key point to ensure security is switching randomly between a code mode and a test mode. Among all TF-QKD protocols, their code modes are very different, e.g. modulating continuous phases, modulating only two opposite phases, and sending or not sending signal pulses. Here we show that, by discretizing the number of global phases in the code mode, we can give a unified view on the first two types of TF-QKD protocols, and demonstrate that increasing the number of discrete phases extends the achievable distance, and as a trade-off, lowers the secret key rate at short distances due to the phase post-selection.

★Nat. Commun.

通过考察编码态的相位随机化与窃听者攻击之间的关联，给出了更紧的信息泄露界，特别适用于短脉冲串实现且无需监测信号扰动，并在140 km光纤上完成验证实验，突破了原理论的悲观预言。

轮询差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议因其独特的安全特性而受到深入研究；例如，无需获知密钥比特的误码率即可界定信息泄露。然而，其实用性和性能仍不尽如人意。这里，通过考察编码态的相位随机化及其与窃听者攻击的联系，我们得到了一个改进的信息泄露界。有趣的是，我们的理论对短脉冲串的实现尤为有用，并且仍然可以在不监测信号扰动的情况下运行。因此，RRDPS的实用性和性能得到提升。此外，我们完成了长达140 km光纤的原理性验证实验，这是迄今RRDPS所能达到的最长距离，而原有理论预言在我们的实验中无法生成任何安全密钥。我们的结果将有助于推动实用化RRDPS更接近实际应用。

Abstract (English)
Abstract The round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol has attracted intensive study due to its distinct security characteristics; e.g., information leakage is bounded without learning the error rate of key bits. Nevertheless, its practicality and performance are still not satisfactory. Here, by observing the phase randomization of the encoding states and its connection with eavesdropper’s attack, we develop an improved bound on information leakage. Interestingly, our theory is especially useful for implementations with short trains of pulses, and running without monitoring signal disturbance is still available. As a result, the practicality and performance of RRDPS are improved. Furthermore, we realize a proof-of-principle experiment with up to 140 km of fiber, which has been the longest achievable distance of RRDPS until now, whereas the original theory predicted that no secret key could be generated in our experiment. Our results will help in bringing practical RRDPS closer to practical implementations.

首次主动实现轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议：Alice发送每包65个脉冲的脉冲串，Bob用主动控制可变延迟干涉仪随机切换延迟，在90 km距离上成功分发密钥，验证了该协议在高误码情形下的可行性。

在现有量子密钥分发协议中，两个合法用户Alice与Bob必须监测信号扰动，以限定潜在的信息泄露上界。然而，在轮询差分相移（RRDPS）协议中，信号扰动的监测是不必要的。在此，我们首次给出了RRDPS协议的主动实现。实验中，Alice制备脉冲串包，每个包由65个脉冲组成，且每个包的全局相位被随机化。Bob使用一种新颖的主动控制可变延迟干涉仪，实现不同延迟的随机切换。得益于每个包中脉冲数目众多以及干涉仪的高稳定性和低插入损耗，该系统可在90 km的距离上分发密钥。我们的实验演示与结果证实了RRDPS协议的可行性，尤其是在高误码情形下。

Abstract (English)
In existing quantum key distribution protocols, two legitimate peers, Alice and Bob, must monitor the signal disturbance to place a bound on the potential information leakage. However, in the round-robin differential phase shift (RRDPS) protocol, monitoring of the signal disturbance is unnecessary. Here, we present the first active implementation of the RRDPS protocol. In our experiment, Alice prepares packets of pulses, where each packet is a train with 65 pulses and the global phase of each packet is randomized. Bob uses a novel actively controlled variable-delay interferometer to realize the random switching of different delays. Benefiting from the large pulse number of each packet, and the high stability and low insertion loss of the interferometer, the system can distribute a secret key over a distance of 90 km. Our experimental demonstration and results confirm the feasibility of the RRDPS protocol, particularly in high-error situations.

量子中继器是不可避免的光学传输损耗下，在远距离分发纠缠的关键部件。受 Duan–Lukin–Cirac–Zoller 协议启发，人们提出了许多基于量子存储器的改进型量子中继器协议，这些协议通常关注纠缠分发速率。在这些协议中，消除多光子（或多光子对）以及使用多模量子存储器已被证明能够大幅提高纠缠分发速率。在此，我们演示了将量子点确定性发射的单光子存储于保偏固态量子存储器中；此外，还演示了具有 1、20 和 100 个窄单光子脉冲的多时间模式存储。多光子被消除，每个脉冲中最多只包含一个光子。而且，两个子系统的固态特性使该构型更加稳定、更易于扩展。我们的工作将有助于构建基于全固态器件的高效量子中继器。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum repeaters are critical components for distributing entanglement over long distances in presence of unavoidable optical losses during transmission. Stimulated by the Duan–Lukin–Cirac–Zoller protocol, many improved quantum repeater protocols based on quantum memories have been proposed, which commonly focus on the entanglement-distribution rate. Among these protocols, the elimination of multiple photons (or multiple photon-pairs) and the use of multimode quantum memory are demonstrated to have the ability to greatly improve the entanglement-distribution rate. Here, we demonstrate the storage of deterministic single photons emitted from a quantum dot in a polarization-maintaining solid-state quantum memory; in addition, multi-temporal-mode memory with 1, 20 and 100 narrow single-photon pulses is also demonstrated. Multi-photons are eliminated, and only one photon at most is contained in each pulse. Moreover, the solid-state properties of both sub-systems make this configuration more stable and easier to be scalable. Our work will be helpful in the construction of efficient quantum repeaters based on all-solid-state devices.

在城域规模上构建高维纠缠量子网络，采用偏振—时间戳混合编码与主动相位补偿，使传输距离比以往网络级高维实现提升三个数量级，并可与经典信号共纤共存。

量子通信网络对于安全信息传输和分布式量子技术至关重要。高维纠缠是此类网络的一种有前景的资源，因为它能够提升信息容量并提供更大的潜力。然而，其实际优势尚未得到充分探索，现有演示在现实条件下也未表现出相对于二维网络的明显优势。在此，我们演示了一个具备主动子空间划分功能的城域规模高维纠缠网络，在密钥率、灵活性和抗噪性方面展现出潜在的实际优势。我们采用偏振—时间戳混合编码，在单模光纤信道上分发高维纠缠。其传输距离比以往网络级高维实现提升了三个数量级，同时主动相位补偿支持长期稳定运行。我们的网络还可与经典信号共存，其可重构的子空间划分提供了实用量子网络所需的适应性。这些结果展示了一条通往大规模、高性能量子通信网络的实用路径。

Abstract (English)
Quantum communication networks are essential for secure information transfer and distributed quantum technologies. High-dimensional entanglement is a promising resource for such networks because it can increase the information capacity and offer greater potential. However, its practical advantages have not been fully explored, and existing demonstrations have not shown clear benefits over two-dimensional networks under realistic conditions. Here, we demonstrate a metropolitan-scale high-dimensional entangled network with active subspace division, showing potential practical benefits in key rate, flexibility, and noise resilience. Using hybrid polarization-time-bin encoding, we distribute high-dimensional entanglement over single-mode fiber channels. The transmission distance exceeds previous network-level high-dimensional implementations by three orders of magnitude, while active phase compensation supports long-term stable operation. Our network can also coexist with classical signals, and its reconfigurable subspace division provides the adaptability needed for practical quantum networks. These results show a practical route toward large-scale, high-performance quantum communication networks.

在650 nm厚氮化硅平台上设计并制备偏振不敏感马赫-曾德尔干涉仪，采用粒子群优化的多模干涉器与分段变宽波导补偿材料双折射，主动偏振扰动下单光子干涉可见度仍约98.7%，偏振相关损耗低于0.3 dB、1 dB带宽达147 nm。

偏振不敏感光子器件对于抑制光子在传输过程中随机偏振演化带来的不利影响、实现鲁棒的光量子操控至关重要。本工作在设计并演示了氮化物平台上厚度为650 nm的偏振不敏感马赫-曾德尔干涉仪（MZI）。器件设计中采用了经粒子群优化的多模干涉器，其边缘形状经过剪裁并引入亚波长光栅结构，同时在干涉仪两臂中采用分段变宽波导设计，以补偿其固有的材料双折射。所制备MZI的实验结果表明，即使在主动偏振扰动下，单光子干涉可见度仍保持约98.7%，并且在147 nm的1 dB带宽范围内实现了小于0.3 dB的偏振相关损耗。这些特性使其成为量子密钥分发等集成量子光子系统的理想候选器件。

Abstract (English)
Polarization-insensitive photonic devices are essential for mitigating the adverse effects of random polarization evolution during photon transmission and implementing robust quantum manipulation of light. In this work, we design and demonstrate a polarization-insensitive Mach–Zehnder interferometer (MZI) on a nitride platform with the thickness of 650 nm. We design the device by adopting a particle-swarm-optimized multimode interferometer with tailored edge shapes and sub-wavelength grating structures, combined with a segmented width-varied waveguide design in the interferometer arms to compensate for their intrinsic material birefringences. The experimental results of the fabricated MZI maintain a single-photon interference visibility about 98.7% even under active polarization scrambling, while a polarization-dependent loss &lt; 0.3 dB over a 147 nm 1 dB bandwidth has been achieved. These properties make it a promising component for integrated quantum photonic systems such as quantum key distribution.

本文在薄膜铌酸锂平台上演示了一种占位面积为2.5 mm × 1.2 mm的全可调谐光滤波器，其中消光比、谐振波长和阻带宽度可通过三个集成的电光移相器独立且同时调节。该器件实现的消光比调谐范围约为0 dB至31 dB。在最大消光比下，阻带宽度可在8.8 GHz至9.6 GHz之间变化。此外，阻带中心波长可线性移动，调谐效率为1.95(8) pm/V。这项工作为片上光子系统提供了一种紧凑、电光可重构且具备独立多参数控制能力的滤波器架构。

Abstract (English)
A fully tunable optical filter on a thin-film lithium niobate platform with a footprint of 2.5 mm × 1.2 mm is demonstrated, in which the extinction ratio, resonant wavelength, and stopband width can be independently and simultaneously adjusted via three integrated electro-optic phase shifters. The device achieves an extinction-ratio tuning range from approximately 0 dB to 31 dB. At maximum extinction ratio, the stopband width can be varied between 8.8 GHz and 9.6 GHz. Moreover, the stopband center wavelength can be shifted linearly with a tuning efficiency of 1.95(8) pm/V. This work provides a compact, electro-optically reconfigurable filter architecture with independent multi-parameter control for on-chip photonic systems.

Abstract (English)
Thin-film lithium niobate on sapphire provides an excellent platform for simultaneously confining acoustic and optical modes without suspended structures, enabling efficient acousto-optic modulation through strong piezoelectric coupling. Here, we identify the challenges in realizing the forward Brillouin interaction at visible wavelengths and overcome the limitation by introducing a quasi-phase-matching scheme through periodic waveguide width modulation. We predict a 69.9% inter-modal optical conversion efficiency over 0.36 mm using only 5 mW acoustic power. Our study paves the way for high-performance visible-wavelength acousto-optic devices on integrated platforms.

从理论上说明用频率噪声功率谱密度估计积分线宽的合理性，指出以往方法源于高斯近似并给出更一般的结果；提出 Voigt 近似法使估计误差低于 5%，并建立干涉可见度与线宽的关系。

激光线宽的测量在计量学、相干光通信、高分辨率传感和激光雷达中具有重要意义。首先，本研究从理论上解释了为何通过频率噪声功率谱密度（PSD）估计积分线宽是有效的。我们发现，以往通过频率噪声 PSD 估计积分线宽的方法源自高斯近似，并由此得到了更一般的结果。其次，依据该理论，我们提出 Voigt 近似方法以提升估计性能。仿真结果表明，Voigt 近似的估计误差低于 5%。最后，基于 Voigt 近似，我们发现了干涉可见度与激光线宽之间的关系，为测量线宽提供了一种可能的便捷途径。

Abstract (English)
The measurement of a laser linewidth is significant in metrology, coherent optical communications, high-resolution sensing, and LIDAR. Firstly, in this study, we theoretically explain why estimating an integrated linewidth via a frequency-noise power spectral density (PSD) is valid. We find that the previous methods estimating the integrated linewidth via the frequency-noise PSD result from Gaussian approximation and obtain a more general consequence. Secondly, according to the theory, we propose the Voigt approximation method to improve the estimation performance. The simulation results show the Voigt approximation estimation error is lower than 5%. Finally, based on the Voigt approximation, the relationship between the interference visibility and laser linewidth is found, providing a possible convenient approach to measuring the linewidth.

高维纠缠不仅能为量子通信提供更高的安全等级，还有望提升系统的信息容量与抗噪声能力。然而，由于不同高维自由度各自受到多种限制，这些优势能否在实际实现中带来改善仍缺乏充分证明。我们提出一种在长距离含噪光纤信道上充分利用这些优势的方案。我们利用偏振与时间片超纠缠实现高维编码，并观测到安全密钥率与噪声容限的显著提升，超越了量子比特系统的能力。此外，该演示实现了最远 50 km 的分发距离，据我们所知，这是迄今基于高维纠缠的量子密钥分发所达到的最长距离。该工作验证了高维纠缠在长距离含噪信道量子通信中的潜力，为构建鲁棒且资源高效的量子网络铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
High-dimensional entanglement not only offers a high security level for quantum communication but also promises improved information capacity and noise resistance of the system. However, due to various constraints on different high-dimensional degrees of freedom, whether these advantages can bring improvement to the actual implementation is still not well proven. Here we present a scheme to fully utilize these advantages over long-distance noisy fiber channels. We exploit polarization and time-bin hyperentanglement to achieve high-dimensional coding, and observe significant enhancements in secure key rates and noise tolerance that surpass the capabilities of qubit systems. Moreover, the demonstration achieves a distribution up to 50 km, which is the longest distance for high-dimensional entanglement-based quantum key distribution up to date, to our knowledge. Our demonstration validates the potential of high-dimensional entanglement for quantum communications over long-distance noisy channels, paving the way for a resilient and resource-efficient quantum network.

诱骗态测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）被认为是最有前景的协议之一，因为它在物理上免疫于所有致命的探测端攻击。然而，源端的漏洞仍然为窃听者敞开着侧信道。此前的工作已表明，若诱骗态调制不准确，系统便不再安全，但窃听者利用调制不准确性的一种实用方法仍然缺失。在本工作中，我们提出了一种实用的攻击方法，并给出了详细的理论分析。利用该方法，我们在实验中攻击了一个 MDI-QKD 系统，并成功获取了全部最终密钥。通过演示这一攻击实验，我们希望引起人们对源端安全性的关注，并为开发源端安全性更好的协议提供启发。

Abstract (English)
Decoy-state measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is regarded as one of the most promising protocols since it is physically immune to all fatal detection-side attacks. However, the loopholes in the source side still open side channels to eavesdroppers. Previous work has indicated that a system is insecure if its decoy-state modulation is inaccurate, but a practical method for Eve to exploit the inaccurate modulation is still absent. In this work, we propose a practical hacking method and provide a detailed theoretical analysis. Using our method, we experimentally hacked a MDI-QKD system and successfully obtained all final keys. By demonstrating the hacking experiment, we hope to bring attention to source-side security and provide inspiration for the development of protocols with better source-side security.

轮转差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议是唯一不需要监测信号扰动的协议。此外，已有研究证明 RRDPS 在抵抗有限码长效应和容忍高误码率方面具有优异性能。然而，现有理论与实验均未考虑后脉冲效应，而该效应在高速 QKD 系统中不可忽略。在此，我们提出一种考虑后脉冲效应的紧致有限码长分析。结果表明，非马尔可夫后脉冲 RRDPS 模型在考虑后脉冲效应的情况下优化了系统性能。在典型后脉冲取值下，RRDPS 相对于诱骗态 BB84 在短时通信中的优势依然成立。

Abstract (English)
The round-robin differential phase shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol is the only one that does not require monitoring of signal disturbance. Moreover, it has been proven that RRDPS has excellent performance of resistance to finite-key effects and high error rate tolerance. However, the existing theories and experiments do not take the afterpulse effects into account, which cannot be neglected in high-speed QKD systems. Here, we propose a tight finite-key analysis with afterpulse effects. The results show that the non-Markovian afterpulse RRDPS model optimizes the system performance considering afterpulse effects. The advantage of RRDPS over decoy-state BB84 under short-time communication still holds at typical values of afterpulse.

提出并实现片上透射率不变相位调制器，消除相位相关损耗造成的相位、强度与偏振之间的关联，可容忍较大工艺偏差且适用于多材料平台，并能提高标准PDK下电光相位调制器的调制深度。

在芯片化量子密钥分发（QKD）系统中，不理想的电光相位调制器（EOPM）导致非理想量子态制备，会降低安全密钥率并引入潜在安全性漏洞。我们提出并实现了一种片上透射率不变相位调制器（TIPM）来解决该问题。仿真与实验结果表明，TIPM能够消除相位相关损耗所造成的量子态相位、强度与偏振之间的关联。该设计可容忍显著的制备偏差，且对多材料平台具有普适性。此外，TIPM提高了标准工艺设计套件（PDK）中EOPM可达到的调制深度。TIPM的提出可提升芯片化QKD系统的实际安全性与性能。

Abstract (English)
In chip-based quantum key distribution (QKD) systems, the non-ideal quantum state preparation due to the imperfect electro-optic phase modulators (EOPM) decreases the secret key rate and introduces potential vulnerabilities. We propose and implement an on-chip transmittance-invariant phase modulator (TIPM) to solve this problem. Simulated and experimental results show that TIPM can eliminate the correlation between phase, intensity, and polarization of quantum states caused by phase-dependent loss. The design can tolerate a significant fabrication mismatch and is universal to multi-material platforms. Furthermore, TIPM increases the modulation depth achievable by EOPMs in standard process design kit (PDK). The proposal of TIPM can improve the practical security and performance of the chip-based QKD systems.
