测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDIQKD）是一种革命性的协议，因为它在物理上免疫探测端的所有攻击。然而，该协议对源端仍保留严格假设，要求四个 BB84 态必须被完美制备才能保证安全性。一些协议放宽了编码系统中的部分假设以保持实际安全性，但性能会显著下降。在本工作中，我们提出一种 MDIQKD 协议，它只需要较少关于编码系统的先验知识，即可对抗棘手的调制误差与涨落。我们还对该协议进行了实验演示。结果表明，它具有高性能以及面向实际应用的良好安全性。其鲁棒性与灵活性对于 QKD 网络等复杂场景也展现出良好价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDIQKD) is a revolutionary protocol since it is physically immune to all attacks on the detection side. However, the protocol still keeps the strict assumptions on the source side that specify that the four BB84 states must be perfectly prepared to ensure security. Some protocols release part of the assumptions in the encoding system to keep the practical security, but the performance would be dramatically reduced. In this work, we present a MDIQKD protocol that requires less knowledge of the encoding system to combat the troublesome modulation errors and fluctuations. We have also experimentally demonstrated the protocol. The result indicates a high performance and good security for practical applications. Its robustness and flexibility also exhibit a good value for complex scenarios such as the QKD networks.

毫无疑问，测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）是一种能够免疫所有可能的探测器侧信道攻击的关键协议。在准备阶段，通常采用仿真模型得到一组优化参数，并利用这组参数在实际系统中获得更高的安全密钥率。随着高速量子密钥分发的实现，作为单光子雪崩光电二极管固有特性的后脉冲效应已不再可以忽略，这将使实际结果与现有解析模型之间产生很大偏差。本文建立了一个兼容后脉冲效应的 MDI-QKD 模型，用以获得优化参数。结果表明，使用这一兼容后脉冲效应的模型，可以得到比此前忽略后脉冲的模型高得多的密钥率。由于系统工作频率不断提高，将后脉冲效应纳入考虑具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
There is no doubt that measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is a crucial protocol that is immune to all possible detector side channel attacks. In the preparation phase, a simulation model is usually employed to get a set of optimized parameters, which is utilized for getting a higher secure key rate in reality. With the implementation of high-speed QKD, the afterpulse effect which is an intrinsic characteristic of the single-photon avalanche photodiode is no longer ignorable, this will lead to a great deviation compared with the existing analytical model. Here we develop an afterpulse-compatible MDI-QKD model to get the optimized parameters. Our results indicate that by using our afterpulse-compatible model, we can get a much higher key rate than the prior afterpulse-omitted model. It is significant to take the afterpulse effect into consideration because of the improvement of the system working frequency.

量子密钥分发（QKD）网络有望为大量用户提供信息论安全的通信。在 QKD 网络中，被称为测量设备无关（MDI）QKD 的检测安全协议通过支持不可信测量节点，能够自然地增强现实安全性。然而，环境对量子态的扰动会降低多用户通信的性能。我们提出一种 MDI-QKD 组网方案，它对环境扰动具有鲁棒性，并对多用户接入具有适应性：两个以上的用户无需校准参考系，也无需补偿信道的偏振扰动，即可同时生成密钥。为实现这一点，我们引入参考系无关协议以及免偏振补偿方法，设计了多用户测量单元，并将其与原有的双用户单元相结合。该方案在多用户场景中实验演示了网络鲁棒性与适应性的提升；对于 N 用户网络，扰动补偿所需的时间与器件成本可从 O(N) 降至 O(1)。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) networks are promising to serve large numbers of users with information-theoretic secure communication. In QKD networks, the detection-safe protocol, termed measurement-device-independent (MDI) QKD, can naturally enhance realistic security by supporting untrusted measurement nodes. However, the environmental disturbances to quantum states degrade the performance of multi-user communication. Here we propose an MDI-QKD networking scheme with robustness against environmental disturbance and adaptability to multi-user access, where more than two users can generate keys simultaneously regardless of aligning reference frames and compensating channel disturbance on polarization. To achieve this, we introduce the reference-frame-independent protocol as well as a polarization-compensation-free method, design a multi-user measurement unit, and combine it with original two-user units. The scheme is experimentally demonstrated for the improvement of network robustness and adaptability in multi-user scenarios, and the time and device costs of disturbance compensation can be saved from O ( N ) to O ( 1 ) for an N-user network.

对不完美测量不敏感的量子随机数发生器：利用不可信日常光照Imperfection-insensitivity quantum random number generator with untrusted daily illumination

为源无关量子随机数发生器中的不完美测量建立统一模型，基于光滑熵不确定性关系给出紧致速率界，并在日常光照与较大器件误差下实现Mbps量级实验演示。

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）基于量子力学的基本不可预测性，有望实现安全的随机数生成。然而，理论模型与实际器件之间不可避免的差距可能导致安全性失效。最近，人们提出了源无关量子随机数发生器（SI-QRNG），以解决光源特性无法表征的问题。然而，在目前大多数SI-QRNG协议的分析中，针对不完美测量的安全性证明是分别针对不同因素给出的，并且对偏离理论模型的微小偏差极为敏感。在此，我们针对SI-QRNG中的不完美测量建立了统一模型，并基于光滑熵的不确定性关系给出了紧致的速率界。随后我们评估了器件不完美度较大时的性能，结果表明，在我们的模型中，随机数速率可以达到常用离散变量QRNG速率上限的相近数量级。此外，利用日常光照和具有较大不完美度的测量器件，我们在实验上以Mbps量级演示了该方案。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) promise secure randomness generation based on the foundational unpredictability of quantum mechanics. However, the unavoidable gaps between theoretical models and practical devices could lead to security invalidation. Recently, a source-independent quantum random number generator (SI-QRNG) has been proposed to solve the issue of uncharacteristic sources. However, in most current analyses of SI-QRNG protocols, the security proofs with imperfect measurements are individual for different factors and very sensitive to small deviations from theoretical models. Here, we establish a unified model for imperfect measurements in the SI-QRNG and provide a tight rate bound based on the uncertainty relation for smooth entropies. Then the performance with large device imperfections is evaluated and the randomness rate in our model can approach a similar order of magnitude of the rate upper bound in common discrete variable QRNGs. In addition, by utilizing the daily illumination and measurement devices with large imperfections, we experimentally demonstrate our scheme at the rate of the order of magnitude of Mbps.

Xing Lin, Rong Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

C波段多芯光纤中量子密钥分发与25 dBm经典信道的集成Integration in the C-band between quantum key distribution and the classical channel of 25 dBm launch power over multicore fiber media

在7芯多芯光纤上实现量子与经典信道共存，借助空分复用将经典信道发射功率提升至25 dBm，较此前提高近19倍，且二者最小波长间隔仅1.6 nm，无需窄带滤波器。

量子—经典共存可基于波分复用（WDM）实现，但由于拉曼噪声，量子信号与经典信号之间的波长间隔以及经典信道的发射功率受到限制。如今，多芯光纤（MCF）可有效实现空分复用（SDM），从而降低拉曼噪声，进而放宽同波段共存的限制并获得高通信容量。本文在7芯MCF上实现了量子—经典共存。基于SDM，实现了25 dBm的最高发射功率，较此前工作提升了近19倍。此外，量子信道与经典信道均分配在C波段，二者之间的最小波长间隔仅为1.6 nm。该共存系统无需增加窄带滤波器。

Abstract (English)
The quantum–classical coexistence can be implemented based on wavelength division multiplexing (WDM), but due to Raman noise, the wavelength spacing between quantum and classical signals and launch power from classical channels are restricted. Space division multiplexing (SDM) can now be availably achieved by multicore fiber (MCF) to reduce Raman noise, thereby loosening the restriction for coexistence in the same band and obtaining a high communication capacity. In this paper, we realize the quantum–classical coexistence over a 7-core MCF. Based on the SDM, the highest launch power of 25 dBm is achieved which has been extended nearly 19 times in previous work. Moreover, both the quantum and classical channels are allocated in the C-band and the minimum wavelength spacing between them is only 1.6 nm. The coexistence system eliminates the need for adding a narrowband filter.

基于超低损耗光纤的量子密钥分发与超高功率经典光通信融合Quantum key distribution integrating with ultra-high-power classical optical communications based on ultra-low-loss fiber

在 75 km 超低损耗光纤上结合有限密钥安全分析与经典信号噪声模型，实现经典信道 25 dBm 发射功率下的离散变量量子密钥分发，为共纤共存报道的最高功率。

考虑到光纤资源与实际应用的灵活性，在同一光纤介质中融合量子密钥分发（QKD）与经典光通信的需求大幅增长。为满足融合 QKD 的经典光网络大规模部署所需的超高功率，我们将有限密钥安全性分析方法与经典信号噪声模型相结合，在 75 km 的超低损耗（ULL）光纤上实现了经典信道发射功率高达 25 dBm 条件下的离散变量量子密钥分发（DV-QKD）。据我们所知，这是 DV-QKD 与经典通信共存时经典信号所达到的最高功率。结果表明，我们的 QKD 系统用于超高功率经典通信是可行的，并且具备耐受性。

Abstract (English)
The demand for the integration of quantum key distribution (QKD) and classical optical communication in the same optical fiber medium greatly increases as fiber resources and the flexibility of practical applications are taken into consideration. To satisfy the needs of the mass deployment of ultra-high power required for classical optical networks integrating QKD, we implement the discrete variable quantum key distribution (DV-QKD) under up to 25 dBm launch power from classical channels over 75 km on an ultra-low-loss (ULL) fiber by combining a finite-key security analysis method with the noise model of classical signals. To the best of our knowledge, this is the highest power launched by classical signals on the coexistence of DV-QKD and classical communication. The results exhibit the feasibility and tolerance of our QKD system for use in ultra-high-power classical communications.

利用发光二极管与光电探测器构成的集成线性光耦结构，直接测量输出光强噪声来产生随机比特，经 SHA-256 后处理后速率达 43 Mbps，序列通过 NIST 随机性检验。

迄今为止，已有多种量子随机数方案得到演示。然而，成本、体积以及最终的随机比特产生速率通常限制了它们作为现成产品被广泛应用。为克服这些限制，我们提出并演示了一种基于线性光耦合器的紧凑、简单且低成本的量子随机数产生方案。其集成结构主要由一个发光二极管和一个光电探测器构成。随机比特通过直接测量输出光的强度噪声来产生，该噪声源于发光二极管中 p 区空穴与 n 区电子之间的随机复合。此外，我们的系统对工作环境的涨落具有鲁棒性，并可扩展为并行结构，这对量子随机数产生的实用化与商业化应用具有重要意义。经 SHA-256 算法后处理后，获得 43 Mbps 的随机数产生速率。最终随机比特序列的自相关系数很低，其标准差为 3.16 × 10 − 4，并通过了 NIST 统计测试套件测试。

Abstract (English)
To date, various quantum random number schemes have been demonstrated. However, the cost, size, and final random bit generation rate usually limits their wide application on-shelf. To overcome these limitations, we propose and demonstrate a compact, simple, and low-cost quantum random number generation based on a linear optocoupler. Its integrated structure consists mainly of a light emitting diode and a photodetector. Random bits are generated by directly measuring the intensity noise of the output light, which originates from the random recombination between holes of the p region and electrons of the n region in a light emitting diode. Moreover, our system is robust against fluctuation of the operating environment, and can be extended to a parallel structure, which will be of great significance for the practical and commercial application of quantum random number generation. After post-processing by the SHA-256 algorithm, a random number generation rate of 43 Mbps is obtained. Finally, the final random bit sequences have low autocorrelation coefficients with a standard deviation of 3.16 × 10 − 4 and pass the NIST-Statistical Test Suite test.

在50 km标准G.652光纤上以15 dBm发射功率实现量子密钥分发与80 Gbps经典数据共存，20 km处安全密钥率达11 Kbps，并验证了对160 Gbps经典光功率高达18 dBm的容忍度。

考虑到城域光网络中的高成本和实际应用，单纤中量子密钥分发与光通信的复用需求日益增长。这里，我们在50 km广泛使用的标准（国际电信联盟电信标准化部门G.652建议）电信光纤上，以15 dBm发射功率实现了量子密钥分发与80 Gbps经典数据光传送网的集成，在20 km处获得11 Kbps的安全密钥率。通过容忍单模光纤上高达18 dBm的160 Gbps经典数据光功率，我们的结果表明量子密钥分发在未来大容量传输系统（如城域网和数据中心）中应用的潜力与容忍度。该量子密钥分发系统采用基于法拉第–米歇尔森干涉仪的相位编码方案，稳定、实用且对信道偏振扰动不敏感。我们还讨论了复用环境下量子密钥分发性能的基本极限。

Abstract (English)
There is an increasing demand for multiplexing of quantum key distribution with optical communications in single fiber in consideration of high costs and practical applications in the metropolitan optical network. Here, we realize the integration of quantum key distribution and an optical transport network of 80 Gbps classical data at 15 dBm launch power over 50 km of the widely used standard (G.652 Recommendation of the International Telecom Union Telecom Standardization Sector) telecom fiber. A secure key rate of 11 Kbps over 20 km is obtained. By tolerating a high classical optical power up to 18 dBm of 160 Gbps classical data on single-mode fiber, our result shows the potential and tolerance of quantum key distribution being used in future large capacity transmission systems, such as metropolitan area networks and data centers. The quantum key distribution system is stable, practical, and insensitive to the polarization disturbance of channels by using a phase coding system based on a Faraday–Michelson interferometer. We also discuss the fundamental limit for quantum key distribution performance in the multiplexing environment.

Jia-Qi Geng, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Shuang Wang, Qi-Fa Zhang, Ying-Ying Hu, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

利用标准单模光纤中的后向自发拉曼散射，同时提取光子波长叠加与到达时间的随机性；每个有效探测得到5比特原始数据，含2.87比特最小熵，经后处理后通过NIST检验。

我们研究了基于标准单模光纤中后向自发拉曼散射的量子随机数产生方案，其中同时利用了光子波长叠加与到达时间的随机性。实验采用四个工作在门控盖革模式下的雪崩光电二极管，探测来自四个不同波长通道的后向拉曼散射光子，并在探测器之后放置时间数字转换器以记录其到达时间。来自不同通道的光子的波长信息与到达时间间隔信息均被用于产生随机比特。由于这两种熵源彼此独立，本系统的随机数资源得到了充分利用。每次有效探测可获得5比特原始数据，其中包含2.87比特最小熵。为获得随机比特的最佳产生速率，选用了合适的泵浦功率与光纤长度。采用SHA-256哈希算法进行后处理以消除原始数据的偏置，最终得到的随机比特序列通过了NIST统计检验。

Abstract (English)
We investigate quantum random number generation based on backward spontaneous Raman scattering in standard single-mode fiber, where the randomness of photon wavelength superposition and arrival time is simultaneously utilized. The experiment uses four avalanche photodiodes working in gated Geiger mode to detect backward Raman scattering photons from four different wavelength channels and a time-to-digital converter placed behind the detectors to record their arrival time. Both information of the wavelength and arrival time interval of photons from different channels are applied to generate random bits. Due to the independence of these two entropy sources, the random number resource of the present system is fully utilized. Five-bit raw data can be obtained for every effective click, which contains 2.87-bit min-entropy. To obtain the optimal generation rate of random bits, appropriate pump power and fiber length are adopted. The post-processing method by the SHA-256 hashing algorithm is used to remove the bias of the raw data, after which the final random bit sequences pass the NIST statistical test.

基于广义算符支配条件的双场量子密钥分发有限密钥分析Finite-key analysis for twin-field quantum key distribution based on generalized operator dominance condition

针对现有基于算符支配条件的双场QKD有限密钥分析只适用于三诱骗态、无法靠增加诱骗态提升密钥率的局限，设计了新的算符支配条件，使密钥率随诱骗态数目增加而提高并逼近渐近界。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可以帮助两个相距遥远的通信方共享密钥比特，其安全性由物理定律保证。在实际中，QKD协议的密钥率总是随信道距离的增加而降低，这严重限制了QKD的应用。近来，双场（TF）QKD被提出并得到深入研究，因为它能够突破速率-距离极限，并大幅提高QKD可达到的距离。值得注意的是，K. Maeda等人基于算符支配条件提出了一种简单的TF-QKD有限密钥分析。尽管他们证明其方法足以突破速率-距离极限，但其算符支配条件并不具有一般性，即只能应用于三诱骗态情形，这意味着其密钥率无法通过引入更多诱骗态而提高，即使在制备无穷多诱骗态和光脉冲的情况下也无法达到渐近界。为弥补这一空白，我们通过设计新的算符支配条件，提出了改进的TF-QKD有限密钥分析。我们表明，增加诱骗态数目可以进一步提高密钥率并逼近渐近界。我们的理论可直接用于TF-QKD实验以获得更高的密钥率。我们的结果可直接用于实验以获得更高的密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can help two distant peers to share secret key bits, whose security is guaranteed by the law of physics. In practice, the secret key rate of a QKD protocol is always lowered with the increasing of channel distance, which severely limits the applications of QKD. Recently, twin-field (TF) QKD has been proposed and intensively studied, since it can beat the rate-distance limit and greatly increase the achievable distance of QKD. Remarkalebly, K. Maeda et. al. proposed a simple finite-key analysis for TF-QKD based on operator dominance condition. Although they showed that their method is sufficient to beat the rate-distance limit, their operator dominance condition is not general, i.e. it can be only applied in three decoy states scenarios, which implies that its key rate cannot be increased by introducing more decoy states, and also cannot reach the asymptotic bound even in case of preparing infinite decoy states and optical pulses. Here, to bridge this gap, we propose an improved finite-key analysis of TF-QKD through devising new operator dominance condition. We show that by adding the number of decoy states, the secret key rate can be furtherly improved and approach the asymptotic bound. Our theory can be directly used in TF-QKD experiment to obtain higher secret key rate. Our results can be directly used in experiments to obtain higher key rates.

往返差分相移量子密钥分发协议的有限码长分析Finite-key analysis for round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution

用后选择技术把往返差分相移协议的安全性证明推广到有限码长情形，预言其有限码长密钥率可与渐近情形相比拟。

自往返差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）协议提出以来，它因具有无需监测信号扰动即可限定信息泄露量这一独特性质而备受关注。最近，Yin 等人发展了一种新理论，可紧致地估计其信息泄露量。然而，有限码长效应尚未被纳入考虑。本文填补这一空白，利用后选择技术把 RRDPS 协议的安全性证明推广到有限码长情形。由此可以预期，在有限码长情形下 RRDPS 的密钥率能够与渐近情形相比拟，这对实际应用具有重要意义。

Abstract (English)
Since the round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol was proposed, it has attracted much attention due to its unique characteristic i.e., it can bind the amount of information leakage without monitoring signal disturbance. Recently, Yin et al . have developed a novel theory to estimate its information leakage tightly. However, the finite-sized key effects are not taken into account. Here, we fill this gap and extend the security proof of the RRDPS protocol to the finite-sized regime using post-selection technique. As a consequence, it’s predicted that the key rate of RRDPS in a finite-sized key scenario can be comparable to the asymptotic one, which is meaningful for the real-life applications.

基于Sagnac干涉仪的参考系无关诱骗态BB84量子密钥分发实验实现Experimental realization of a reference-frame-independent decoy BB84 quantum key distribution based on Sagnac interferometer

利用光子偏振与轨道角动量联合编码，结合自补偿光纤Sagnac干涉仪实现高速偏振调制、q-plate无源操控旋转不变态，实验完成了可容忍参考系漂移的诱骗态BB84量子密钥分发。

量子密钥分发（QKD）利用量子物理特性，可在相距遥远的用户之间生成安全密钥比特。然而在大多数场景下，QKD系统都需要一个共享参考系。参考系无关（RFI）方案能够容忍合法远端用户之间参考系的漂移，这对于卫星、飞机等相对运动终端的运行具有重要意义。我们设计并通过实验演示了一套RFI-BB84-QKD系统，该系统利用光子的偏振态与轨道角动量态进行联合编码。我们采用自补偿光纤Sagnac干涉仪实现高速偏振调制，并用q-plate无源操控旋转不变的光子态，从而使该系统可以借助现成的商用器件实现高速运行。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) can generate secure key bits between remote users employing the features of quantum physics. However, a shared reference frame is necessary for QKD systems in most scenarios. A reference-frame-independent (RFI) scheme can tolerate the reference frame drifting between legitimate remote users, which is significant in the operation of relative moving terminals such as satellites and aircraft. We design and experimentally demonstrate an RFI-BB84-QKD system by joint encoding with the polarization and orbital angular momentum states of the photons. We use self-compensating fiber Sagnac interferometers to perform high-speed polarization modulation, and q-plates to passively manipulate the rotation-invariant photon states, which makes the system feasible for high-speed operation using off-the-shelf components.

时间域鬼成像方法及其在量子器件评估中的应用Temporal ghost imaging for quantum device evaluation

把鬼成像思想推广到时间域，通过测量两路信号的关联函数，原理性实验评估了门控模式单光子雪崩探测器的时间探测效率，为量子器件时间特性的实时监测与量子通信安全性评估提供了新工具。

鬼成像（GI）通过测量两路光束的关联函数来重建物体的图像，而这两路光束中的任何一路单独都不携带物体的结构信息。这一强大技术使得即使在存在噪声的情况下也能获得物体的高质量图像。在此，我们把GI方法引入时间域中的量子器件评估。我们完成了一个原理性实验，用于评估门控模式单光子雪崩探测器（SPAD）的时间探测效率。实验结果表明，采用时间鬼成像（TGI）方法可以实现对SPAD时间特性的高质量评估。我们的工作表明，TGI方法是实时监测量子器件时间特性的一种有效工具，并将为量子通信的安全性评估带来新的视角。

Abstract (English)
Ghost imaging (GI) can reconstruct the image of an object by measuring the correlation function of two beams, none of which carries the structure information of the object independently. This powerful technology makes it possible to obtain high-quality imaging of the object even in the presence of noise. Here, we introduce the GI method into quantum device evaluation in the time domain. We realized a proof-of-principle experiment to evaluate the temporal detection efficiency of a gated-mode single-photon avalanche detector (SPAD). The experimental results show that high-quality evaluation of temporal characteristics of the SPAD can be realized by the method of temporal GI (TGI). Our work indicates that the TGI method is an effective tool to monitor the temporal characteristics of quantum devices in real time and will bring a new perspective to the security evaluation of quantum communication.

Juan Wu, Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于吉赫兹BB84量子密钥分发系统的实用化量子数字签名Practical quantum digital signature with a gigahertz BB84 quantum key distribution system

设计了对信道扰动本征稳定的非对称法拉第–Sagnac–Michelson干涉仪结构，使BB84系统重复频率达吉赫兹量级；在25 dB信道损耗、10⁻¹⁰安全等级下实现0.044 bit/s的签名速率。

量子数字签名（QDS）能够以信息论安全保证消息的完整性与不可否认性，近来受到更多关注。自Andersson等人提出[Phys. Rev. A 93, 032325 (2016)]以来，已有若干种不同的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统实现了使用非安全信道的量子数字签名协议。在此我们报道一套基于BB84 QKD系统的QDS实验。我们的系统设计了非对称法拉第–Sagnac–Michelson干涉仪结构，该结构对信道扰动具有本征稳定性。这一创新结构支撑系统高速工作，实际重复频率达到吉赫兹量级。在由25 km已铺设光纤并附加光学衰减构成的25 dB信道损耗下，于10⁻¹⁰安全等级下获得了0.044 bit/s的签名速率。因此，我们的QDS装置稳定且高效。本文为进一步推动QDS的实际应用迈出了一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum digital signature (QDS) can guarantee message integrity and non-repudiation with information-theoretical security, and it has attracted more attention recently. Since proposed by Andersson et al. [Phys. Rev. A93, 032325 (2016)PLRAAN1050-294710.1103/PhysRevA.93.032325], a quantum digital signature protocol using an insecure channel has been realized with several different quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. Here we report an experimental QDS based on a BB84 QKD system. An asymmetric Faraday–Sagnac–Michelson interferometer structure has been designed in our system, which is intrinsically stable against channel disturbance. The innovatory structure supports the system to work at high speed and, in practice, the repetition rate is in gigahertz. A 0.044 bit/s signature rate has been attained with a 25 dB channel loss composed of a 25 km installed fiber with additional optical attenuation in a 10−10 security level. Thus, our QDS device is stable and highly efficient. This Letter provides a further step for the practical application of QDS.

相位翻转错误抑制量子密钥分发的原理性验证实验Proof of principle implementation of phase-flip error rejection quantum key distribution

借助自发参量下转换产生的双光子态实验验证了量子相位翻转错误抑制码，通过奇偶校验与后选择实现相位翻转抑制，在信道噪声概率低于 25% 时解码后的量子误码率较标准单光子偏振编码 BB84 方案明显降低。

提高信道噪声容限是设计和实现量子密钥分发（QKD）协议的一项重要任务。Wang 提出了量子相位翻转错误抑制（QPFER）码［Phys. Rev. Lett. 92, 077902 (2004)，DOI: 10.1103/PhysRevLett.92.077902］，以提高 QKD 实现所能容忍的相位翻转噪声。然而，迄今仍缺少证明其优势的实验。在此，我们借助自发参量下转换产生的双光子量子态，对 QPFER 码进行了实验验证。协议中引入奇偶校验与后选择方法以实现相位翻转抑制。与单光子偏振编码 BB84 方案的标准实现相比，当信道噪声概率低于 25% 时，解码后的量子误码率明显降低。实验结果还表明，在噪声水平处于合适区间时，QPFER 协议能够降低误码率、获得更高的密钥率，并在含噪信道中保持鲁棒性。

Abstract (English)
Improving the tolerance of channel noise is an important task for devising and implementing quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols. Quantum phase-flip error rejection (QPFER) code [Phys. Rev. Lett.92, 077902 (2004)PRLTAO0031-900710.1103/PhysRevLett.92.077902] has been introduced by Wang to increase the tolerable phase-flip noise of QKD implementations. However, an experiment that demonstrates its advantages is still missing. Here, we experimentally verify the QPFER code with the assistance of two photon quantum states generated by spontaneous parametric downconversion. The methods of parity check and postselection are introduced to the protocol for achieving the phase-flipping rejection. Comparing with the standard realization of the single photon polarization encoding BB84 scheme, the quantum error rate after decoding is obviously reduced when the probability of channel noise is less than 25%. The experiment results also show that QPFER protocol can reduce error rate, obtain a higher key rate, and be robust in the noisy channel when the noise level is in a proper region.

Juan Wu, Xue-Bi An, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Fang-Xiang Wang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 29

带信号扰动监测的轮询差分相移量子密钥分发Round-robin-differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution with monitoring signal disturbance

模拟研究了同时用诱骗态与误码率统计监测信号扰动时的RRDPS协议，发现在典型实验参数下采用无穷诱骗态时其信道长度可超过BB84协议，而仅需两个诱骗态和一个信号态即可逼近该性能。

近年来，轮询差分相移（RRDPS）量子密钥分发（QKD）因其独特性质而备受关注，即无需获知比特误码率即可界定信息泄露。尽管RRDPS QKD已取得突破，但在监测信号扰动（例如同时使用诱骗态和误码率统计）时其表现如何仍是一个问题。这里，我们通过模拟研究了监测信号扰动情况下的RRDPS协议。令人兴奋的是，当采用无穷诱骗态方法时，在典型实验参数下RRDPS协议在信道长度方面可以优于常用的Bennett和Brassard 1984（BB84）协议。在有限诱骗态情形下，我们发现仅需两个诱骗态和一个信号态就足以获得非常接近无穷诱骗态情形的性能。我们的模拟证明，RRDPS在实际情况下是一种具有竞争力的协议。

Abstract (English)
In recent years, round-robin-differential-phase-shift (RRDPS) quantum key distribution (QKD) has attracted great attention for its unique characteristics, i.e., the information leakage can be bounded without learning bit error rate. Though the RRDPS QKD has made a breakthrough, it is still a question of how RRDPS will perform with monitoring signal disturbance, e.g., decoy-state and error rate statistics are both used. Here, we present simulations to study RRDPS protocol while monitoring signal disturbance. To our excitement, when using the infinite decoy-states method, RRDPS protocol can outperform the commonly used Bennett and Brassard 1984 (BB84) protocol in terms of channel length under typical experimental parameters. In the case of finite decoy states, we find that only two decoy-states and one signal state are sufficient to obtain performance very close to the infinite decoy-states case. Our simulations prove that RRDPS is a competitive protocol in real-life situations.

Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

10.1364/OL.43.004228

No. 30

基于维度见证违反与弱测量的实验三方量子随机数发生器Experimental three-party quantum random number generator based on dimension witness violation and weak measurement

基于弱测量技术提出并实验实现三名观测者共享的量子随机数发生器，首次观测到基于行列式值的双经典维度见证违反，并借助预告式单光子源同时满足独立性与维度假设，达到半设备无关级别。

随机数产生是现代科学中的一项重要任务。人们已提出并实现了多种量子随机数产生协议。然而，这些协议都基于两方。基于弱测量技术，我们提出并实现了三名观测者之间的量子随机数发生器。实验中首次观测到基于行列式值的双经典维度见证的违反。借助预告式单光子源，我们的实验装置满足了独立性假设与维度假设，这意味着我们的装置是半设备无关（semi-DI）的。本文为在多用户之间产生设备无关型随机数提供了新的思路，并在网络环境下的量子密码与量子随机数方面具有潜在应用前景。

Abstract (English)
Random number generation is an important task in modern science. A variety of quantum random number generation protocols have been proposed and realized. These protocols, however, are all based on two parties. Based on the weak measurement technique, we propose and realize a quantum random number generator among three observers. The violation of a double classical dimension witness based on the determinant value is first observed in experiment. With the heralding single-photon source, our experimental setup attains the independent assumption and the dimension assumption, which means our setup is semi-device-independent (DI). This Letter sheds new light on generating DI-type random number among multi-user and it has potential application prospect on the quantum cryptography and quantum random number in network environment.

Xue-Bi An, Hong-Wei Li, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Meng-Jun Hu, Wei Huang, Bing-Jie Xu, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

No. 31

可抗信道扰动的实用化吉赫兹量子密钥分发系统Practical gigahertz quantum key distribution robust against channel disturbance

提出高速法拉第–萨格纳克–迈克尔逊量子密钥分发系统，可自动补偿信道偏振扰动；在 50 km 光纤、30 Hz 偏振加扰下，24 小时干涉条纹可见度达 99.35%，七天安全密钥率稳定在 306 kbit/s 且无需主动偏振对准。

量子密钥分发（QKD）为安全通信提供了颇具吸引力的解决方案。然而，当 QKD 系统从实验室走向现场时，信道扰动严重限制了其应用。这里提出一种高速法拉第–萨格纳克–迈克尔逊 QKD 系统，可自动补偿信道偏振扰动，从而在很大程度上避免环境突变带来的间歇性限制。在具有 30 Hz 偏振加扰的 50 km 光纤信道上，该相位编码 QKD 系统的实用性得到了表征：24 小时内干涉条纹可见度达 99.35%，并在无需主动偏振对准的情况下，七天里保持 306 kbit/s 的稳定安全密钥率。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides an attractive solution for secure communication. However, channel disturbance severely limits its application when a QKD system is transferred from the laboratory to the field. Here a high-speed Faraday-Sagnac-Michelson QKD system is proposed that can automatically compensate for the channel polarization disturbance, which largely avoids the intermittency limitations of environment mutation. Over a 50 km fiber channel with 30 Hz polarization scrambling, the practicality of this phase-coding QKD system was characterized with an interference fringe visibility of 99.35% over 24 h and a stable secure key rate of 306 k bits/s over seven days without active polarization alignment.

Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Cong Hui, Peng-Lei Hao, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Chao Wang, Li-Jun Zhang, Jie Kuang, Shu-Feng Liu, Zheng Zhou, Yong-Gang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Optics Letters

No. 32

已铺设光纤中的偏振变化及其对量子密钥分发系统的影响Polarization variations in installed fibers and their influence on quantum key distribution systems

利用实测光纤偏振漂移数据建立定量评估方法，提出偏振漂移时间与所需跟踪速度两个特征参数，并针对不同长度的埋地与架空光纤给出偏振基对准模块的要求与建议。

已铺设光纤中的偏振变化复杂且易变，会严重影响对偏振敏感的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统的性能。基于所记录的各类已铺设光纤偏振变化数据，我们建立了一种解析方法，用于定量评估偏振变化对偏振敏感 QKD 系统的影响。以偏振变化引起的量子比特误码率上升作为关键判据，我们提出偏振漂移时间和所需跟踪速度两个参数来刻画偏振变化。针对不同长度的埋地与架空光纤，我们定量评估了偏振变化的影响，并就部署于不同类型光纤中的 QKD 系统的偏振基对准模块提出了要求与建议。

Abstract (English)
Polarization variations in the installed fibers are complex and volatile, and would severely affect the performances of polarization-sensitive quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. Based on the recorded data about polarization variations of different installed fibers, we establish an analytical methodology to quantitatively evaluate the influence of polarization variations on polarization-sensitive QKD systems. Using the increased quantum bit error rate induced by polarization variations as a key criteria, we propose two parameters - polarization drift time and required tracking speed - to characterize polarization variations. For field buried and aerial fibers with different length, we quantitatively evaluate the influence of polarization variations, and also provide requirements and suggestions for polarization basis alignment modules of QKD systems deployed in different kind of fibers.

Yu-Yang Ding, Hua Chen, Shuang Wang, De-Yong He, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Zheng Zhou, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于道威棱镜的单路Sagnac干涉仪操控轨道角动量光子Single-path Sagnac interferometer with Dove prism for orbital-angular-momentum photon manipulation

分析道威棱镜的偏振依赖效应对单路Sagnac干涉仪的影响，并提出仅需增加两片半波片的改进结构，理论上分束保真度可达100%且与输入偏振及棱镜传输矩阵无关，实验保真度提高约5%~10%。

轨道角动量（OAM）的量子数可以无限大，因而成为高维量子信息处理中的重要资源。道威棱镜（DP）是操控OAM光束最常用的工具。然而，道威棱镜会改变光子态的偏振，从而降低干涉仪的分束保真度。本工作分析了在使用分束器（BS）和偏振分束器（PBS）的常规单路Sagnac干涉仪（SPSI）中，道威棱镜对OAM光操控的偏振依赖效应。结果表明，BS型SPSI对输入偏振和道威棱镜的具体参数更为敏感。我们还提出并实现了一种改进的BS型SPSI，其分束保真度原则上可达100%，并且不依赖于输入偏振和道威棱镜的传输矩阵。实验表明，改进型BS型SPSI的保真度比常规结构高约5%~10%。改进型BS型SPSI易于实现（只需额外两片半波片），并能在自由运行条件下保持数小时量级的稳定。这些优点使该结构适合用于量子密码等关键量子信息处理任务。

Abstract (English)
Orbital angular momentum (OAM) is an important resource in high-dimensional quantum information processing, as its quantum number can be infinite. Dove prism (DP) is a most common tool to manipulate OAM light. However, the Dove prism changes the polarization of the photon states and decreases the sorting fidelity of the interferometer. In this work, we analyze the polarization-dependent effect of the DP on OAM light manipulation in the normal single-path Sagnac interferometers (SPSIs) with beam splitter (BS) and polarizing beam splitter (PBS). The results demonstrate that the BS SPSI is more sensitive to the input polarization and the specific parameters of the DP. We have also proposed and realized a modified BS SPSI, of which the sorting fidelity can be 100% in principle and is independent on the input polarization and the transmission matrix of the DP. The experiments demonstrate that the fidelity of the modified BS SPSI is about 5%~10% higher than that of the normal one. The modified BS SPSI is easy to implement (only two more half-wave plates are required) and is stable for free running at the scale of several hours. These merits make the structure suitable for applications in critical quantum information processing tasks, such as quantum cryptography.

基于独立装置与维度见证的量子随机数发生器原理性实现Proof-of-principle implementation of a quantum random number generator with independent devices and a dimension witness

利用预报式单光子源完成 Han16 协议的原理性实验，在独立装置条件下使量子随机数产生率较此前协议几乎翻倍，并验证该协议可容忍损耗与噪声。

随机数是现代科学中的一个核心问题，而如何估计给定装置所产生数据的真实随机性则是一个中心问题。Lunghi 等人提出了一种基于独立装置制备-测量场景的自检验量子随机数发生器。在此文基础上，Han 等人提出了一种更高效的估计真实随机性的方法（简称 Han16 协议）。这里我们报道利用 HSPS 对 Han16 协议进行的原理性实现。实验结果表明，与先前的协议相比，Han16 协议几乎使量子随机数的产生率提高了一倍。此外，实验结果还表明 Han16 协议是实用的，且实验装置能够容忍损耗与噪声。

Abstract (English)
The random number is a paramount issue in modern science. How to estimate the genuine randomness of the data generated by a given device is a central problem. Lunghi et al. proposed a self-testing quantum random number generator from a prepare-and-measure scenario with independent devices. Based on this Letter, Han et al. proposed a more efficient method (Han16 protocol for short) to estimate the genuine randomness. Here we report a proof-of-principle realization of the Han16 protocol with a HSPS. The experimental results demonstrate that the Han16 protocol almost doubles the generation rate of the quantum random number with regard to the previous protocol. In addition, the results of the experiment show that the Han16 protocol is practical, and the experimental device can tolerate loss and noise.

Xue-Bi An, Yun-Guang Han, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Huang, Wei Chen, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1364/OL.42.004139

抗环境扰动的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution robust against environmental disturbances

基于偏振扰乱单元实现参考系无关的测量设备无关量子密钥分发，使安全密钥率对偏振随机扰动与相位参考漂移不敏感，无需校准主参考系；原理验证实验结合改进的波动分析方法验证了其可行性与优势。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是消除所有探测器侧信道攻击的一种有前景的协议。然而，参考系，例如偏振参考和相位参考，其变化会对MDI系统的性能构成严峻威胁。在此，我们基于偏振扰乱单元，演示了一种参考系无关的MDI QKD方案，该方案对易变的信道条件具有内在稳定性；因此，最终安全密钥率将对偏振的随机扰动和相位参考的漂移不敏感。这样，我们的方案从根本上免除了对主要参考系的校准，从而实质上减少了潜在漏洞以及整个系统的资源消耗。此外，我们还展示了采用改进的波动分析方法的原理验证实验，以验证所提出方案的可行性和优势。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is a promising protocol for removing all detector side channel attacks. However, the variation of reference frames, e.g., polarization and phase reference, would be an acute threat to the performance of MDI systems. Here, based on polarization scrambling units, we demonstrate a reference-frame-independent MDI QKD scheme that is inherently stable against volatile channel conditions; therefore, the final secure key rate will be insensitive to the random disturbances of polarization and the drifts of phase reference. Thus, calibrations of the primary reference frames are intrinsically removed in our scheme, which essentially reduces potential vulnerabilities as well as the resource consumption of the whole system. In addition, a proof-of-principle experiment with an improved fluctuation analysis method is demonstrated to verify the feasibility and advantages of the proposed scheme.

Chao Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

利用公开筛选密钥比特的量子密钥分发偏振基跟踪方案Polarization-basis tracking scheme for quantum key distribution using revealed sifted key bits

仅使用纠错过程中公开的筛选密钥比特，实现单光子级连续偏振基跟踪，无需参考光也不中断量子信号传输，50 km 光纤 BB84 系统连续运行 24 小时平均量子比特误码率 2.32%、标准差 0.87%。

发射端与接收端之间偏振基的校准是量子密钥分发中的一项重要任务。持续工作的偏振基跟踪方案（PBTS）将有效提升系统效率，并降低在传输与校准模式之间切换时的潜在安全风险。在此，我们提出了一种单光子水平的持续工作 PBTS，仅使用纠错过程中公开的筛选密钥比特，不引入额外的参考光，也不中断量子信号的传输。我们将该方案应用于 50 km 光纤信道中的偏振编码 BB84 QKD 系统，在 24 小时连续运行期间获得了 2.32% 的平均量子比特误码率（QBER）和 0.87% 的标准差。稳定且相对较低的 QBER 验证了该方案的有效性。

Abstract (English)
The calibration of the polarization basis between the transmitter and receiver is an important task in quantum key distribution. A continuously working polarization-basis tracking scheme (PBTS) will effectively promote the efficiency of the system and reduce the potential security risk when switching between the transmission and calibration modes. Here, we proposed a single-photon level continuously working PBTS using only sifted key bits revealed during an error correction procedure, without introducing additional reference light or interrupting the transmission of quantum signals. We applied the scheme to a polarization-encoding BB84 QKD system in a 50 km fiber channel, and obtained an average quantum bit error rate (QBER) of 2.32% and a standard derivation of 0.87% during 24 h of continuous operation. The stable and relatively low QBER validates the effectiveness of the scheme.

Yu-Yang Ding, Wei Chen, Hua Chen, Chao Wang, Ya-Ping li, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

基于未表征编码的实验测量设备无关量子密钥分发Experimental measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with uncharacterized encoding

利用失配基统计完成首个编码源未经表征的测量设备无关量子密钥分发原理验证实验，编码态只需限定在二维希尔伯特空间，即使通信双方不清楚编码态细节也能抵御态制备缺陷，系统获得正的安全密钥率。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）是利用不可信测量设备共享密钥的一种有效方式。然而，在这一前景广阔的协议中，对编码态表征的假设仍然是必要的，这可能在现实实现中导致不必要的复杂性和潜在漏洞。在此，我们利用失配基统计，首次给出了编码源未经表征的MDI QKD原理验证实验。在该演示中，编码态仅需被约束在二维希尔伯特空间内，即使两个相距遥远的参与方（Alice和Bob）完全不知道其编码态的详细信息，也能抵御态制备缺陷。我们系统所获得的正的最终安全密钥率表明了这种新协议的可行性，并证明了其在与未经表征设备进行安全通信应用中的价值。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) is an efficient way to share secrets using untrusted measurement devices. However, the assumption on the characterizations of encoding states is still necessary in this promising protocol, which may lead to unnecessary complexity and potential loopholes in realistic implementations. Here, by using the mismatched-basis statistics, we present the first proof-of-principle experiment of MDI QKD with uncharacterized encoding sources. In this demonstration, the encoded states are only required to be constrained in a two-dimensional Hilbert space, and two distant parties (Alice and Bob) are resistant to state preparation flaws even if they have no idea about the detailed information of their encoding states. The positive final secure key rates of our system exhibit the feasibility of this novel protocol, and demonstrate its value for the application of secure communication with uncharacterized devices.

Chao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Hong-Wei Li, Chun-Mei Zhang, Yu-Yang Ding, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

偏振控制中固定轴线性延迟器有限延迟量限制的新方案New scheme for finite-retardation limitations of linear retarders with fixed axes in polarization control

针对固定轴线性延迟器延迟量有限这一约束，提出几何与数学上简明的约束方案并与最大值搜索算法结合，四路级联光纤挤压器实验中平均偏振误差角仅 0.09 rad，且未触及延迟极限。

固定轴线性延迟器的有限延迟量范围限制了其在偏振控制中的应用。本工作针对这一有限延迟量限制提出了一种简单高效的约束方案，并从几何和数学上给出了其理论基础。新的偏振控制算法将该约束方案与一种广泛使用的最大值搜索算法相结合。仿真和实验均证实了所提方案与控制算法的有效性和实用性。实验中，控制系统采用四个级联的线性延迟器，其快轴交替取向为 0° 和 45°。每个延迟器（光纤挤压器）具有 4π 的有限延迟量范围。在 15 分钟的测试中，系统以 26 rad/s 的平均速度稳定偏振波动，平均（最大）偏振误差角为 0.09（0.28）rad。此外，未出现触及延迟量极限的情况。

Abstract (English)
Finite retardation ranges of linear retarders with fixed axes limit their applications in polarization control. In this work, we present a simple and efficient constraint scheme for this finite-retardation limitation. Its theoretical basis is given geometrically and mathematically. The new polarization control algorithm combines the constraint scheme and a widely-used maximum-search algorithm. Both simulations and experiments confirm the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed scheme and control algorithm. In experiments, the control system uses four cascaded linear retarders with fast axes alternately oriented at 0° and 45°. Each retarder (fiber squeezer) has a finite retardation range of 4π. For a 15-min test, the mean (maximum) polarization error angle is 0.09 (0.28) rad while stabilizing a polarization fluctuation at an average speed of 26 rad/s. Furthermore, no events of hitting retardation limits occur.

Hua Chen, Mo Li, Wen-Ye Liang, Dong Wang, De-Yong He, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

广域量子密钥分发网络的现场与长期演示Field and long-term demonstration of a wide area quantum key distribution network

在中国移动通信基础设施上建成覆盖合肥、巢湖、芜湖三地、面积逾150公里的广域量子密钥分发网络，连续运行5000余小时，验证了点对点QKD技术与组网方案的有效融合。

演示了一个部署在中国移动通信有限公司提供的通信基础设施上的广域量子密钥分发（QKD）网络。三个城市和两个城域QKD网络被连接起来，组成覆盖面积超过150公里的合肥—巢湖—芜湖广域QKD网络，其中合肥城域QKD网络是典型的全网状核心网络，可提供全互联；芜湖城域QKD网络则是具有点对多点配置的代表性量子接入网络。整个广域QKD网络从2011年12月21日至2012年7月19日运行了5000多小时，部分网络一直运行到去年12月。为适应复杂多变的现场环境，我们在设计QKD设备时采用了带有多项稳定措施的Faraday-Michelson QKD系统。通过QKD设备的标准化设计、QKD设备对称性问题的解决以及动态QKD网络中的无缝切换，我们实现了点对点QKD技术与组网方案的有效融合。

Abstract (English)
A wide area quantum key distribution (QKD) network deployed on communication infrastructures provided by China Mobile Ltd. is demonstrated. Three cities and two metropolitan area QKD networks were linked up to form the Hefei-Chaohu-Wuhu wide area QKD network with over 150 kilometers coverage area, in which Hefei metropolitan area QKD network was a typical full-mesh core network to offer all-to-all interconnections, and Wuhu metropolitan area QKD network was a representative quantum access network with point-to-multipoint configuration. The whole wide area QKD network ran for more than 5000 hours, from 21 December 2011 to 19 July 2012, and part of the network stopped until last December. To adapt to the complex and volatile field environment, the Faraday-Michelson QKD system with several stability measures was adopted when we designed QKD devices. Through standardized design of QKD devices, resolution of symmetry problem of QKD devices, and seamless switching in dynamic QKD network, we realized the effective integration between point-to-point QKD techniques and networking schemes.

采用改进相干态的测量设备无关量子密钥分发Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with modified coherent state

提出以改进相干态光源取代弱相干态来实现带诱骗态的测量设备无关量子密钥分发，模拟显示安全密钥率与传输距离均明显提升，原因在于多光子事件概率更低而单光子概率更高。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议是为消除探测器侧信道攻击而提出的。由于相干态光源存在多光子事件，MDI-QKD 协议的实际实现必须采用诱骗态来抵御光子数分离攻击。近来已有基于弱相干态（WCS）的 MDI-QKD 诱骗态研究。在本快报中，我们提出用改进相干态（MCS）光源来执行 MDI-QKD 协议。我们模拟了基于 MCS 光源的诱骗态 MDI-QKD 的性能，模拟表明，采用 MCS 光源可显著提升安全密钥率与传输距离。这一提升背后的物理原因是：MCS 的多光子事件概率低于 WCS，同时其单光子概率更高。

Abstract (English)
The measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol has been proposed for the purpose of removing the detector side channel attacks. Due to the multiphoton events of coherent states sources, real-life implementations of MDI-QKD protocol must employ decoy states to beat the photon-number-splitting attack. Decoy states for MDI-QKD based on the weak coherent states (WCSs) have been studied recently. In this Letter, we propose to perform MDI-QKD protocol with modified coherent states (MCS) sources. We simulate the performance of MDI-QKD with the decoy states based on MCS sources. And our simulation indicates that both the secure-key rate and transmission distance can be improved evidently with MCS sources. The physics behind this improvement is that the probability of multiphoton events of the MCS is lower than that of WCSs while at the same time the probability of single-photon is higher.

2 GHz时钟速率下260 km标准通信光纤上的量子密钥分发2 GHz clock quantum key distribution over 260 km of standard telecom fiber

采用2 GHz系统时钟的差分相移量子密钥分发协议，结合1 bit延迟法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的优化与超导单光子探测器，在损耗52.9 dB的260 km光纤上实现了3.45%的量子比特误码率，并提升了50 km处的密钥率。

我们报道了在损耗超过50 dB、长度超过250 km的标准通信光纤上进行的量子密钥分发（QKD）演示。我们选用了差分相移QKD协议，并以2 GHz的系统时钟速率实现。通过对1 bit延迟法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪的细致优化以及超导单光子探测器（SSPD）的使用，我们在光纤长度不超过205 km时实现了低于2%的量子比特误码率，在损耗为52.9 dB的260 km光纤上则为3.45%。我们还提高了SSPD的量子效率，以在50 km长度上获得高密钥率。

Abstract (English)
We report a demonstration of quantum key distribution (QKD) over a standard telecom fiber exceeding 50 dB in loss and 250 km in length. The differential phase shift QKD protocol was chosen and implemented with a 2 GHz system clock rate. By careful optimization of the 1 bit delayed Faraday-Michelson interferometer and the use of the superconducting single photon detector (SSPD), we achieved a quantum bit error rate below 2% when the fiber length was no more than 205 km, and of 3.45% for a 260 km fiber with 52.9 dB loss. We also improved the quantum efficiency of SSPD to obtain a high key rate for 50 km length.

针对BGS的安全性分析仅适用于50 km以上长距离情形的局限，利用冯·诺依曼熵的尖锐连续性等基本不等式，给出改进型相干单向协议在最一般单脉冲攻击下的安全下界，且只需接收端使用光子数分辨探测器，可适用于任意传输距离。

已有研究通过考虑单脉冲攻击，分析了相干单向（COW）量子密钥分发协议安全性的上界[Branciard C, Gisin N and Scarani V (BGS) New J.Phys. (2008) 10 013031]。然而，他们的安全性分析基于长距离情形，其传输距离的典型值大于50 km。本文利用冯·诺依曼熵的尖锐连续性以及一些基本不等式，仅考虑接收端将会使用的光子数分辨探测器，给出了改进型相干单向量子密钥分发协议在最一般的单脉冲攻击下的安全性下界。与BGS的安全性分析相比，我们的安全性分析可以满足任意距离的情形。

Abstract (English)
Upper bounds for the security of coherent-one-way (COW) quantum key distribution protocols have been analyzed by considering the one-pulse-attack [Branciard C, Gisin N and Scarani V (BGS) New J.Phys. (2008) 10 013031]. However, their security analysis was based on long distance case, and the typical value of the transmission distance is larger than 50km. Applying the sharp continuity for the von Neumann entropy and some basic inequalities, we provide lower bounds for the security of modified coherent-one-way quantum key distribution protocol against the most general one-pulse-attack by only considering photon number resolved detectors that will be used in the receiver's side. Comparing with BGS's security analysis, our security analysis can be satisfied with arbitrary distance case.

被动诱骗态量子密钥分发（QKD）在高速应用中具有巨大潜力。本工作利用法拉第镜实现了一种本征稳定的非泊松光源，它有望成为实现被动诱骗态 QKD 的关键元件。通过 Hanbury Brown-Twiss 实验获得了稳定的 g(2)(0)，所得结果与依据 Curty 等人理论 [Opt. Lett. 34, 3238 (2009)] 给出的理论值符合良好。

Abstract (English)
Passive decoy state quantum key distribution (QKD) has enormous potential in high-speed applications. In this Letter, an intrinsic-stable non-Poissonian light source was implemented with Faraday mirrors and could be a crucial element in realizing passive decoy state QKD. The stable g((2))(0) was obtained through a Hanbury Brown-Twiss experiment, and the results fit well with the theoretical value according to Curty et al.'s theory [Opt. Lett.34, 3238 (2009)].

Abstract (English)
We propose a wavelength-saving topology of a quantum key distribution (QKD) network based on passive optical elements, and we report on the field test of this network on commercial telecom optical fiber at the frequency of 20 MHz. In this network, five nodes are supported with two wavelengths, and every two nodes can share secure keys directly at the same time. We also characterized the insertion loss and cross talk effects on the point-to-point QKD system after introducing this QKD network.

We discuss the security of decoy states QKD protocol with finite resources by considering the statistical fluctuation for the yield and error rate of the quantum state in different sources of pulses (signal sources and decoy sources). 报道一套可部署的量子密钥分发系统，用双并联马赫–曾德尔编码器单步统一制备偏振态与诱骗态，配合 2.5 GHz 小型化单光子雪崩探测器，在 10 km 与 100 km 处分别实现 60.33 Mbps 与 3.08 Mbps 的安全成码率。

量子密钥分发（QKD）是实现信息论安全通信的一项有前景的技术。QKD 系统的实用性对大规模网络部署至关重要，既需要高密钥生成速率，也需要用于量子态制备与探测的小型化模块。在此我们报道了一套可部署的 QKD 系统，在 10 km 处实现 60.33 ± 0.03 Mbps、在 100 km 处实现 3.08 ± 0.20 Mbps 的安全密钥速率。该系统集成了一个双并联马赫–曾德尔编码器，在紧凑设计中通过单步调制实现对偏振态与诱骗态的高保真、统一制备。同时，我们研制了工作在 2.5 GHz 的小型化单光子雪崩探测器，在保持低噪声的同时实现了高计数率。这一高性能且紧凑的方案为需要高容量与高带宽的城市安全通信网络确立了一条可行的路线。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a promising technology for information-theoretic secure communications. The practicality of QKD systems is critical for large-scale network deployment, requiring both high key generation rate and miniaturized modules for quantum-state preparation and detection. Here, we report a deployable QKD system that achieves secure key rates of 60.33 ± 0.03 Mbps at 10 km and 3.08 ± 0.20 Mbps at 100 km. The system integrates a dual-parallel Mach–Zehnder encoder to achieve high-fidelity, unified preparation of polarization and decoy states via single-step modulation in a compact design. Meanwhile, we developed miniaturized single-photon avalanche detectors operating at 2.5 GHz, achieving high count rates while maintaining low noise. This high-performance and compact solution establishes a feasible roadmap for urban secure communication networks that require high capacity and bandwidth.

Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Wei-Xin Xie, De-Yong He, Xiao-Juan Huang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Qiong Li, Hao-Kun Mao, Guo-Wei Zhang, Yu-Long Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

10.1073/pnas.2521590123

No. 01

基于纯度约束的可认证量子随机性Certified quantum randomness within purity constraints

★Sci. Adv.

提出一种基于测量不确定性的半器件无关量子随机数生成方案，在纯度约束下估计条件最小熵，无需对光源和测量装置详细建模即可抵御量子攻击，并在商用光纤系统上实现可组合安全的随机性指数扩张。

量子随机数发生器（QRNG）利用量子力学产生真随机性，但实际实现中的器件缺陷可能破坏安全性。我们提出一种基于纯度约束下测量不确定性的半器件无关 QRNG，用于条件最小熵估计。该协议无需对二维光源和可数维测量进行详细建模，并且对测量设备上的量子攻击仍然安全。我们揭示了一种由自然满足的纯度条件产生的隐含不确定性关系，利用测试态定义随机性参数 C，并通过态与测量的酉旋转对称性将其与可提取随机性的解析界联系起来。利用广义熵积累定理，我们将单轮界推广到多轮，并获得对抗相干攻击的可组合安全性。在标准商用光纤系统上实现后，我们的高容错协议实现了指数级安全随机性扩张，并适用于集成光子平台。

Abstract (English)
Quantum random number generators (QRNGs) exploit quantum mechanics to produce true randomness, but practical implementations suffer from device imperfections that can compromise security. We propose a semi–device-independent QRNG based on measurement uncertainty under purity constraints for conditional min-entropy estimation. Our protocol requires no detailed modeling of the two-dimensional source and the countable-dimensional measurement and remains secure against quantum attacks on measurement devices. We uncover an implicit uncertainty relation arising from naturally satisfied purity conditions, define a randomness parameter C using test states, and connect it to an analytical bound on extractable randomness via unitary rotation symmetries of states and measurements. Using the generalized entropy accumulation theorem, we extend the single-round bound to multirounds and obtain composable security against coherent attacks. Implemented on a standard commercial fiber system, our high-tolerance protocol achieves exponential secure randomness expansion and is suitable for integrated-photonic platforms.

Xing Lin, Rong Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang
Science Advances

No. 02

★Sci. Adv.

针对脉冲间相关性这一被忽视的源缺陷，建立相关源下 QKD 安全分析框架，首次给出有限密钥分析，并设计仅需相关范围与真空分量下界的抗相关泄漏源协议，仿真显示其容错性显著优于现有方案。

量子密钥分发（QKD）基于量子力学提供信息论安全性，然而其实现受到光源缺陷的阻碍。其中，传输脉冲之间的相关性对 QKD 的理论安全性构成关键但研究不足的威胁。我们提出一个相关源下 QKD 安全性的通用框架，通过利用广义链式法则扩展并重组 QKD 轮次，实现了首个有限密钥分析。受旁信道安全 QKD 启发，我们设计了一种抵御相关泄漏源的协议，仅需相关范围以及所制备态真空分量的下界。我们的框架也适用于其他 QKD 协议，为解决相关性引发的漏洞提供了通用方法。仿真证明了我们协议的有效性，以及其与现有协议相比显著更优的缺陷容限。这项工作为封堵 QKD 中的安全漏洞、提升其实用性，并确保现实约束下远距离、高性能安全通信迈出了关键一步。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides information-theoretic security based on quantum mechanics, yet its implementation is hindered by source imperfections. Among these, correlations between transmitted pulses present a critical but underexplored threat to QKD’s theoretical security. We propose a general framework for QKD security under correlated sources, achieving the first finite-key analysis by extending and reorganizing QKD rounds using the generalized chain rule. Inspired by side-channel-secure QKD, we design a protocol secure against correlated leakage sources, requiring only the correlation range and lower bounds on the vacuum component of the prepared states. Our framework also applies to other QKD protocols, providing a general approach to address correlation-induced vulnerabilities. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of our protocol and its significantly superior tolerance to imperfections compared to existing protocols. This work provides a crucial step toward closing security loopholes in QKD, enhancing its practicality, and ensuring long-distance, high-performance secure communication under real-world constraints.

Jia-Xuan Li, Yang-Guang Shan, Rong Wang, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

模拟动态散射信道中的量子密钥分发Quantum key distribution over a mimicked dynamic-scattering channel

利用快速波前整形技术在模拟动态散射信道中提升量子密钥分发性能，使量子传输效率平均提高10 dB，并成功建立起安全的量子链路。

自由空间量子密钥分发（QKD）在全球量子网络中发挥着重要作用。然而，自由空间信道会受到大气湍流以及霾、雾、尘等散射效应的影响，这些效应会显著削弱QKD的性能，甚至阻断安全的量子链路。在此，我们证明：利用快速波前整形技术，可以显著提升QKD在动态散射信道上的性能。该系统使量子传输效率平均获得10 dB的提升，并建立起用于QKD的安全量子链路。我们的工作证明了在自由空间动态散射信道中实现QKD的可行性，并增强了复杂信道QKD系统的部署能力。

Abstract (English)
Free-space quantum key distribution (QKD) plays an important role in the global quantum network. However, free space channels suffer from the atmospheric turbulence and scattering effects of haze, fog, and dust, which significantly weaken the performance of QKD or even block the secure quantum link. Here, we prove the performance of QKD over a dynamic scattering channel can be enhanced significantly using a fast wavefront shaping technique. The system achieves on average 10-dB enhancement of quantum transmission efficiency and establishes a secure quantum link for QKD. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of QKD through free-space dynamic scattering channels and enhances the deployment capability of complex-channel QKD system.

基于平面光波回路芯片的偏振不敏感量子密钥分发Polarization-insensitive quantum key distribution using planar lightwave circuit chips

研制出基于平面光波回路的偏振不敏感时间比特解码芯片，从机理上补偿量子信号的偏振扰动，并在1.25 GHz时钟频率、50 km光纤下获得1.34 Mbps的平均安全密钥率。

量子密钥分发（QKD）系统的自稳定对于准确评估窃听者所获取的信息至关重要。我们研制并验证了一种用于QKD的偏振不敏感时间比特解码芯片，它基于平面光波回路（PLC）的混合非对称法拉第-迈克尔逊干涉仪（AFMI）。与现有基于芯片的QKD工作相比，该方案能够从本质上补偿量子信号所受的偏振扰动，因而可在任意温度下工作。我们在时钟频率为1.25 GHz的时间比特QKD系统中对芯片进行了实验验证，并借助优化的分析模型，在50 km光纤信道上获得1.34 Mbps的平均安全密钥率（SKR）。量子比特误码率和SKR在随机偏振扰动下均保持稳定变化，这表明基于PLC的AFMI可用于发展自稳定的QKD系统。

Abstract (English)
Self-stabilizing the quantum key distribution (QKD) system is essential to evaluate eavesdroppers’ information accurately. We develop and verify a polarization-insensitive time-bin decoder chip for QKD with the hybrid asymmetric Faraday-Michelson interferometer (AFMI) based on the planar lightwave circuit (PLC). Compared with existing chip-based QKD works, the scheme can intrinsically compensate for the polarization perturbation to quantum signals and thus work at arbitrary temperatures. We experimentally verify the chips in a time-bin QKD system at the clocking rate of 1.25 GHz and obtain an average secure key rate (SKR) of 1.34 Mbps over a 50 km fiber channel with an optimized analysis model. The steady variations of the quantum bit error and SKR with random polarization disturbance demonstrate that PLC-based AFMIs are available for developing self-stable QKD systems.

Guo-Wei Zhang, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Li Zhang, Fang-Xiang Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wen Liu, Jun-Ming An, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

量子密钥分发系统的通用仿真框架A universal simulating framework for quantum key distribution systems

建立了基于量子算符描述与事件驱动机制的通用 QKD 系统仿真框架，光学器件可自由组合并计入器件缺陷与量子非局域特性，单光子与 HOM 干涉仿真结果与理论吻合。

量子密钥分发（QKD）提供了一种基于物理原理的方式，使远程用户能够安全地协商密钥。仿真是设计和优化 QKD 系统的重要手段。我们基于光子信号与光学器件的量子算符描述，开发了一个通用仿真框架。光学器件可以自由组合，并由光子激发事件驱动，这使其原则上适用于任意 QKD 系统。我们的框架关注光学器件与系统结构的真实特性，在建模时考虑了器件的不完美性以及量子系统的非局域性质。我们仿真了单光子和 Hong-Ou-Mandel（HOM）干涉光学单元，它们是 QKD 系统的基础。使用这一事件驱动框架得到的结果与理论结果吻合良好，表明其用于 QKD 的可行性。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides a physical-based way to conciliate keys between remote users securely. Simulation is an essential method for designing and optimizing QKD systems. We develop a universal simulation framework based on quantum operator descriptions of photon signals and optical devices. The optical devices can be freely combined and driven by the photon excitation events, which make it appropriate for arbitrary QKD systems in principle. Our framework focuses on realistic characters of optical devices and system structures. The imperfections of the devices and the non-local properties of a quantum system are taken into account when modeling. We simulate the single-photon and Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference optical units, which are fundamental of QKD systems. The results using this event-driven framework agree well with the theoretical results, which indicate its feasibility for QKD.

Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Wei Chen, Feng-Yu Lu, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

量子密钥分发（QKD）是一项有望实现信息论安全的技术。相位编码是研制光纤信道实用化QKD系统的重要途径。为提高相位编码的调制速率，本文提出一种新的数字调制方法，并利用实验室现有器件搭建了紧凑、稳健的QKD系统样机，以验证该方法的有效性。系统部署于实验室环境的50 km光纤上，在无人干预的情况下连续运行87 h。系统量子误码率（QBER）保持稳定，平均值为3.22%，安全成码率为8.91 kbps。尽管受法拉第-迈克耳孙干涉仪（FMI）结构限制，演示系统中光子的调制速率仅为200 MHz，但所提方法与基于现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）的电子学方案，对于调制速率达Gbit/s量级的高速QKD系统具有很大潜力。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a technology with the potential capability to achieve information-theoretic security. Phasecoding is an important approach to develop practical QKD systems in fiber channel. In order to improve the phase-coding modulation rate, we proposed a new digital-modulation method in this paper and constructed a compact and robust prototype of QKD system using currently available components in our lab to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method. The system was deployed in laboratory environment over a 50 km fiber and continuously operated during 87 h without manual interaction. The quantum bit error rate (QBER) of the system was stable with an average value of 3.22% and the secure key generation rate is 8.91 kbps. Although the modulation rate of the photon in the demo system was only 200 MHz, which was limited by the Faraday-Michelson interferometer (FMI) structure, the proposed method and the field programmable gate array (FPGA) based electronics scheme have a great potential for high speed QKD systems with Giga-bits/second modulation rate.

No. 01

激光洛伦兹线宽与高斯线宽的同步测量Simultaneous measurement of the Lorentzian and Gaussian linewidths of laser

利用干涉可见度随延时变化的规律，发现其对数含线性项与二次项，分别源于白噪声与闪烁噪声，据此提出同时测量洛伦兹线宽与高斯线宽的方法，并降低了对延时光纤长度的依赖。

线宽是反映单频激光器相干性的关键参数。由白噪声贡献的线宽已得到广泛研究，而非白噪声（主要是闪烁噪声）的影响却难以评估。然而，闪烁噪声可造成远大于洛伦兹分量的线宽展宽。考虑到干涉可见度可以作为相位噪声大小的有效指标，本工作将闪烁噪声量化为高斯线宽，并分析干涉可见度与激光线宽之间的关系。我们发现可见度的对数与延时呈二次依赖关系：线性项源于白噪声，二次项则来自闪烁噪声。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种同时测量洛伦兹线宽与高斯线宽的方法。该方法不仅避免了闪烁噪声对洛伦兹线宽测量的干扰，还提供了一种便捷的方式来评估闪烁噪声的大小。此外，该方法有效降低了线宽测量实验对延时光纤长度的依赖，较短的光纤有助于减小环境扰动。更重要的是，高斯线宽的引入为激光线宽提供了更全面的表征。

Abstract (English)
Linewidth is a key parameter reflecting the coherence of single-frequency lasers. While the linewidth contributed by white noise has been widely studied, the effect of nonwhite noise, mainly flicker noise, is hard to evaluate. However, flicker noise can cause linewidth broadening much larger than the Lorentzian component. Considering that interference visibility can serve as an effective indicator of phase noise magnitude, in this work, we quantify flicker noise as Gaussian linewidth and analyze the relation between interference visibility and laser linewidth. We find that the logarithm of visibility depends quadratically on the delay: the linear term is due to white noise, and the quadratic term arises from flicker noise. Based on this finding, we propose a method to simultaneously measure Lorentzian and Gaussian linewidths. This approach not only avoids flicker noise interference in Lorentzian linewidth measurements but also provides a convenient way to assess the magnitude of flicker noise. In addition, this approach effectively reduces the dependence of the linewidth measurement experiment on the length of the delay fiber, with shorter fibers helping to minimize environmental disturbances. More importantly, the introduction of the Gaussian linewidth provides a more comprehensive characterization of the laser linewidth.

Jian-Yu Ma, Jia-Lin Chen, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

10.1063/5.0312071

No. 02

基于de Finetti约化的侧信道安全量子密钥分发有限密钥分析改进Improved finite-key analysis for side-channel-secure quantum key distribution with de Finetti reduction

提出把相位误差估计在集体攻击与相干攻击下的失败概率联系起来，从而在相干攻击的参数估计中沿用独立同分布假设；相比基于后选择方法的既有分析，仿真给出的密钥率性能更好。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的用户之间能够生成安全密钥。然而，由于实际器件无法以完美精度工作，在真实QKD实现中实现无条件安全仍然是一项挑战。侧信道安全（SCS）QKD为同时实现高实际安全性和高性能提供了良好的解决方案。它保留了测量设备无关的优点，而在源端只需给出各态真空投影概率的上界。然而，SCS QKD针对一般相干攻击的安全性证明具有挑战性。基于后选择方法的现有分析性能较差。为克服这一缺陷，我们不再直接用后选择方法计算密钥率，而是提出一种方法，将相位误差估计在集体攻击与相干攻击下的失败概率相互关联，从而能够在针对相干攻击的参数估计中使用独立同分布假设。我们的仿真表明，我们给出的性能优于先前的分析。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables the generation of secure keys between two distant users. However, since practical devices cannot operate with perfect accuracy, achieving unconditional security in real-world QKD implementations remains a challenge. Side-channel-secure (SCS) QKD gives a good solution to realize both high practical security and performance. It keeps the advantage of measurement-device-independent, and for the source part, it only requires to upper bound the vacuum projecting probability of the states. However, security proof for SCS QKD against general coherent attacks is challenging. The existing analysis based on postselection method gives a bad performance. To overcome this drawback, instead of directly calculating key rate with postselection method, we propose a method correlating the failure probabilities of phase-error estimation against collective and coherent attacks, enabling the usage of the independent and identically distributed assumption in parameter estimation against coherent attacks. Our simulation shows that we give a better performance than previous analysis.

Yang-Guang Shan, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Shuang Wang, Wei Chen, De-Yong He, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han
Physica Scripta

10.1088/1402-4896/ae1fbb

No. 03

基于量子比特的测量设备无关量子密钥分发同步算法Qubit-Based Synchronization Algorithm for Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution

利用 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉特性，在没有额外硬件的情况下实现 MDI-QKD 各方之间的时钟同步，显著降低同步复杂度与成本，有望加速其实际部署。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）因其高性能与安全性被认为是最有前景的协议之一。要在实际中搭建 MDI-QKD 系统，时钟同步是正确生成密钥的关键步骤。然而，随着实际应用的推进，同步的复杂度与成本已成为 MDI-QKD 实施中的重大挑战。本研究提出一种专为 MDI-QKD 设计的基于量子比特的同步算法。利用 Hong-Ou-Mandel 干涉的特性，我们在无需额外硬件的情况下实现了 MDI-QKD 各方之间的时钟同步。该方法的经济性与简洁性有望显著促进 MDI-QKD 的实际部署。

Abstract (English)
Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) is considered one of the most promising protocols due to its high performance and security. To implement the MDI-QKD system in practice, clock synchronization is a crucial step to correctly generate the secret keys. However, as practical applications advance, the complexity and cost of synchronization have become significant challenges for the implementation of MDI-QKD. In this study, we introduce a qubit-based synchronization algorithm specifically designed for MDI-QKD. By utilizing the property of Hong-Ou-Mandel interference, we achieve clock synchronization between parties of MDI-QKD without the need for additional hardware. The cost-effectiveness and simplicity of this approach are expected to significantly facilitate the practical deployment of MDI-QKD.

Zheng-Kai Huang, Jia-Xuan Li, Feng-Yu Lu, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Zhen-Qiang Yin, De-Yong He, Wei Chen, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

直流至1 GHz门频可调的低噪声InGaAs/InP单光子探测器Low noise InGaAs/InP single-photon detector with DC to 1  GHz tunable gate frequency

提出残余噪声辅助的甄别方法，使雪崩信号最大幅度与残余噪声峰值对齐，实现从直流到1 GHz可调门频，20%效率下暗计数约每门5.0×10⁻⁷、后脉冲低于1.0%。

铟镓砷/磷化铟（InGaAs/InP）单光子探测器（SPD）通常工作在门控模式，但单光子雪崩二极管的电容响应会引入尖峰噪声，掩盖雪崩信号。大多数雪崩信号甄别方案无法完全消除尖峰噪声，从而留下残余噪声。受残余噪声限制，这些方案噪声较大且频率调节范围有限。然而，对于量子密钥分发和激光测距等应用而言，低噪声、频率可调的InGaAs/InP SPD对提升系统性能至关重要。在此，我们提出了一种（残余噪声辅助的）甄别方法，使雪崩信号的最大幅度与残余噪声的峰值对齐。该方法将残余噪声从不利因素转变为信号甄别的优势。利用该方法，我们实现了从直流到1 GHz的可调门控频率。此外，该方法能够甄别微弱雪崩信号，使得在低雪崩增益下也能有效进行单光子探测。在整个调谐范围内，在20%探测效率下，暗计数率约为每门5.0×10⁻⁷，后脉冲概率低于1.0%，显著低于以往的实验结果。所提出的SPD具有低噪声和宽可调门控频率范围，为各类应用提供了可靠基础。

Abstract (English)
An InGaAs/InP single-photon detector (SPD) typically operates in gated mode, but the capacitive response of a single-photon avalanche diode introduces spike noise, obscuring the avalanche signal. Most avalanche signal discrimination schemes cannot completely eliminate spike noise, resulting in residual noise. Limited by residual noise, these schemes have large noise and a limited frequency tuning range. However, for applications like quantum key distribution and laser ranging, a low noise, frequency-tunable InGaAs/InP SPD is crucial for enhancing system performance. Here, we propose a (residual noise assisted) discrimination method that aligns the maximum amplitude of the avalanche signal with the peak of the residual noise. This method turns the residual noise from adversity into an advantage for signal discrimination. With this method, we achieve tunable gating frequency from DC to 1 GHz. Additionally, this method enables the discrimination of weak avalanche signals, allowing effective single-photon detection at low avalanche gain. Across the entire tuning range, at a 20% detection efficiency, the dark count rate is approximately 5.0×10 −7 per gate, and the afterpulse probability is less than 1.0%, significantly lower than in previous experiments. The proposed SPD exhibits low noise and a wide tunable gating frequency range, providing a reliable foundation for various applications.

离散相位随机化BB84协议的有限密钥分析Finite key analysis for discrete phase randomized BB84 protocol

针对离散相位随机化BB84协议缺乏有限脉冲数安全性分析的问题，给出两种条件下的安全性分析与参数优化，确认相位数超过30时可按连续相位随机化估算密钥率，相位较少时给出数值方法，性能略降但仍可接受。

量子密钥分发（QKD）是一种依赖量子力学内禀随机性来保证信息论安全性的安全通信方法。BB84是最早也是应用最广泛的QKD协议，其安全性证明至关重要。离散相位随机化BB84协议是诱骗态BB84协议的一种变体，已被证明在高速度QKD系统的发展中具有前景。然而，它仍然缺乏针对有限脉冲数的分析。本文对离散相位BB84协议进行了全面的安全性分析，在不同条件下使用两种不同的方法。分析包括仿真与优化，以确定最佳参数设置。研究确认，对于典型场景，如果离散相位的数量超过30，就可以假定运行的是连续相位随机化过程来计算密钥率。另一方面，对于相对较少的离散取值，我们发展了一种数值方法来计算密钥率。我们确认，在有限脉冲数下其性能有所下降，但仍然可以接受。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a secure communication method that relies on the inherent randomness of quantum mechanics to ensure information-theoretic security. The first and most widely used QKD protocol is BB84, and the proof of BB84's security is vital. The Discrete Phase Randomized BB84 protocol is a variant of the decoy BB84 protocol. It has been proven to be promising in the development of high-speed QKD systems. However, it still lacks an analysis with a finite number of pulses. This paper presents a comprehensive security analysis of the discrete phase BB84 protocol, using two different methods under different conditions. The analysis involves simulations and optimizations to determine the optimal parameter settings. It is confirmed that for typical scenarios, if the number of discrete phases exceeds 30, one can calculate the key rate by assuming that a continuous phase randomization process was in operation. On the other hand, for a relatively smaller number of discrete values, we have developed a numerical method to calculate the key rate. We have confirmed that its performance is reduced but still acceptable with a finite number of pulses.

用于高速测量设备无关量子密钥分发的稳定波长可调多波长激光器Stable and wavelength-tunable multiwavelength laser for high-rate measurement device independent quantum key distribution

研制出输出波长覆盖1270至1610 nm的稳定可调多波长激光器，通过精密温控与稳定驱动电流被动锁定波长，显著降低误码率，使安全密钥率较以往实验近乎翻倍。

测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI QKD）因其对测量单元攻击的免疫性而受到越来越多的关注，但其独特结构限制了安全密钥率。利用波分复用（WDM）技术并降低误码率是提高安全密钥率的有效策略。降低误码率通常需要利用精确的外部参考对波长进行主动反馈控制。然而，对于多波长激光器而言，采用多个参考来稳定每一路波长输出对参考提出了严苛要求，并显著增加了系统复杂度。本文展示了一台稳定的、波长可调的多波长激光器，输出波长范围覆盖1270至1610 nm。通过精确的温度控制和稳定的驱动电流，我们被动锁定激光波长，实现了优异的波长稳定性。这显著降低了误码率，使安全密钥率相较以往实验几乎翻倍。此外，我们的多波长激光器所提供的优异波长稳定性与WDM技术相结合，进一步提升了MDI QKD的安全密钥率。凭借5.1 nm的宽波长调谐范围，该多波长激光器可灵活工作在多个密集波分复用信道。结合高波长稳定性和多波长同时输出，该激光器为高速MDI QKD系统提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

Abstract (English)
Measurement device independent quantum key distribution (MDI QKD) has attracted growing attention for its immunity to attacks at the measurement unit, but its unique structure limits the secret key rate. Utilizing the wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) technique and reducing error rates are effective strategies for enhancing the secret key rate. Reducing error rates often requires active feedback control of wavelengths using precise external references. However, for a multiwavelength laser, employing multiple references to stabilize each wavelength output places stringent demands on these references and significantly increases system complexity. Here, we demonstrate a stable, wavelength-tunable multiwavelength laser with an output wavelength ranging from 1270 to 1610 nm. Through precise temperature control and stable drive current, we passively lock the laser wavelength, achieving remarkable wavelength stability. This significantly reduce the error rate, leading to an almost doubling of the secret key rate compared to previous experiments. Furthermore, the exceptional wavelength stability offered by our multiwavelength laser, combined with the WDM technique, has further boosted the secret key rate of MDI QKD. With a wide wavelength tuning range of 5.1 nm, our multiwavelength laser facilitates flexible operation across multiple dense wavelength division multiplexing channels. Coupled with high wavelength stability and multiple wavelength outputs simultaneously, this laser offers a promising solution for a high-rate MDI QKD system.

Jia-Lin Chen, De-Yong He, Ze-Hao Wang, Shuang Wang, Wen-Jing Ding, Jia-Qi Geng, Zhen-Qiang Yin, Wei Chen, Guan-Jie Fan-Yuan, Guang-Can Guo, Zheng-Fu Han

Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) is a secure communication method that relies on the inherent randomness of quantum mechanics to ensure information-theoretic security. The first and most widely used QKD protocol is BB84, and the proof of BB84's security is vital. The Discrete Phase Randomized BB84 protocol is a variant of the decoy BB84 protocol. It has been proven to be promising in the development of high-speed QKD systems. However, it still lacks an analysis with a finite number of pulses. This paper presents a comprehensive security analysis of the discrete phase BB84 protocol, using two different methods under different conditions. The analysis involves simulations and optimizations to determine the optimal parameter settings. It is confirmed that for typical scenarios, if the number of discrete phases exceeds 30, one can calculate the key rate by assuming that a continuous phase randomization process was in operation. On the other hand, for a relatively smaller number of discrete values, we have developed a numerical method to calculate the key rate. We have confirmed that its performance is reduced but still acceptable with a finite number of pulses.

QKD 系统中 LiNbO3 马赫-曾德尔强度调制器的任意偏置控制Arbitrary bias control of LiNbO3 based Mach-Zehnder intensity modulators for QKD system

建立 RC 电路模型解释铌酸锂马赫-曾德尔强度调制器的偏置漂移，并提出无需反馈的多步偏置稳定方案，可在任意工作点长时间消除漂移而不增加系统复杂度。

量子密钥分发（QKD）可帮助相距遥远的双方共享无条件安全的密钥，而借助诱骗态协议还能提升可实现的密钥率。要在实验中实现 QKD，双方需要利用基于 LiNbO3 的马赫-曾德尔（LNMZ）强度调制器精确地发送若干不同强度的光脉冲。然而，LNMZ 强度调制器的偏置漂移可能影响 QKD 系统的性能。本文提出一个简单的 RC 电路模型来说明 LNMZ 强度调制器中的偏置漂移，并基于该模型提出一种多步偏置稳定方案来控制偏置工作点。实验结果表明，该方案可在长时间范围内消除任意工作点处的偏置漂移。此外，该方案无需任何反馈机制，这意味着它不会带来系统复杂度的任何增加，因而更适合 QKD 系统。

Abstract (English)
Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) can help distant agents to share unconditional secret keys, and the achievable secret key rate can be enhanced with the help of decoy-state protocol. To implement QKD experimentally, the agents are supposed to accurately transmit a number of different intensity pulses with the LiNbO 3 based Mach-Zehnder (LNMZ) intensity modulator. However, the bias drift of LNMZ intensity modulator may affect the performance of a QKD system. In this letter, we reveal a simple RC circuit model to demonstrate the bias drift in the LNMZ intensity modulator. And based on the model, we propose a multi-step bias stable scheme to control the bias working point. Experimental result shows that our scheme can eliminate the bias drift of at arbitrary working point within a long time range. Besides, there is no need of any feedback mechanisms in the scheme. This means our scheme will not lead to any increasement in system complexity, making it more suitable for a QKD system.

面向安全高性能量子密钥分发的强度层析方法Intensity Tomography Method for Secure and High-Performance Quantum Key Distribution

针对随机强度涨落与关联强度涨落造成的调制不精确问题，提出强度层析方法，用本地单光子探测器测量诱骗态以精确标定涨落并紧致界定光子数态的未知密度矩阵，实验与仿真验证其可提升协议性能与实际安全性。

诱骗态方法极大地弥补了量子密钥分发（QKD）领域中多光子脉冲带来的漏洞，近年来几乎被用于所有实际 QKD 系统。然而，实际诱骗态 QKD 的安全性与性能仍受随机强度涨落、关联强度涨落等调制不精确因素的限制。本工作提出一种强度层析方法，用以对抗这些涨落。该方法能够紧致地界定光子数态的未知密度矩阵，并通过用本地单光子探测器测量诱骗态来精确标定涨落。我们通过实验与仿真验证了该层析方法。结果表明，我们的方法能够有效缓解这些涨落带来的缺陷，从而提升协议性能和实际安全性。鉴于这些涨落在实际 QKD 中不可避免，我们的方法将为 QKD 的实际应用铺平道路。

Abstract (English)
Decoy-state method has greatly filled in loopholes from multi-photon pulses in the field of quantum key distribution (QKD) and it has been employed in almost all practical QKD systems in recent years. However, security and performance of the practical decoy-state QKDs are still limited by inaccurate modulations such as random intensity fluctuation and correlated intensity fluctuation. In this work, an intensity tomography method is proposed as a countermeasure against these fluctuations. It has an ability to tightly bound the unknown density matrices of photon-number state and accurately calibrate the fluctuations by measuring the decoy states with a local single-photon detector. We verified the tomography method by experiments and simulations. The results indicated that our method can efficiently mitigate the flaws from these fluctuations to improve the protocol performance and practical security. Noting that these fluctuations are inevitable in practical QKDs, our method would pave the avenue for QKD's practical applications.

离散相位随机化量子密钥分发的有限码长分析Finite-Key Analysis for Quantum Key Distribution with Discrete-Phase Randomization

针对实验难以实现连续相位随机化的问题，基于共轭测量与量子态区分首次给出离散相位随机化双场量子密钥分发的有限码长安全性证明，指出取8个离散相位即可获得满意性能，但有限尺寸效应更显著。

量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个远程用户能够共享信息论安全的密钥。许多QKD协议假设编码态的相位可以在0到2π范围内连续随机化，然而这在实验中可能难以成立。最近提出的双场（TF）QKD尤其如此，它因能显著提高密钥率、甚至突破某些理论上的速率-损耗极限而备受关注。作为直观的解决方案，可以采用离散相位随机化替代连续随机化。然而，针对采用离散相位随机化的QKD协议，有限码长区域的安全性证明仍然缺失。这里，我们发展了一种基于共轭测量与量子态区分的技术，用于分析这种情况下的安全性。结果表明，TF-QKD采用合理数目的离散随机相位，例如来自{0,π/4,π/2,…,7π/4}的8个相位，即可获得令人满意的性能。另一方面，我们发现有限尺寸效应比以往更加显著，这意味着此时应发射更多脉冲。更重要的是，作为TF-QKD在有限码长区域采用离散相位随机化的首个证明，我们的方法同样适用于其他QKD协议。

Abstract (English)
Quantum key distribution (QKD) allows two remote parties to share information-theoretic secret keys. Many QKD protocols assume the phase of encoding state can be continuous randomized from 0 to 2π, which, however, may be questionable in the experiment. This is particularly the case in the recently proposed twin-field (TF) QKD, which has received a lot of attention since it can increase the key rate significantly and even beat some theoretical rate-loss limits. As an intuitive solution, one may introduce discrete-phase randomization instead of continuous randomization. However, a security proof for a QKD protocol with discrete-phase randomization in the finite-key region is still missing. Here, we develop a technique based on conjugate measurement and quantum state distinguishment to analyze the security in this case. Our results show that TF-QKD with a reasonable number of discrete random phases, e.g., 8 phases from {0,π/4,π/2,…,7π/4}, can achieve satisfactory performance. On the other hand, we find the finite-size effects become more notable than before, which implies that more pulses should be emit in this case. More importantly, as a the first proof for TF-QKD with discrete-phase randomization in the finite-key region, our method is also applicable in other QKD protocols.

安全诱骗态量子密钥分发的图样效应标定算法Patterning-Effect Calibration Algorithm for Secure Decoy-State Quantum Key Distribution

针对实际诱骗态量子密钥分发中强度关联涨落引起的图样效应，把研究拓展到关联范围更大的高阶情形，提出通过标定驱动电压来抑制该效应的算法，并在实验上观测到高阶图样效应且成功将其压制。

量子密钥分发（QKD）中的诱骗态方法是抵御致命的光子数分离攻击的有力对策。目前，诱骗态方法已被广泛应用于实际QKD系统。然而，图样效应，即实际QKD系统中强度涨落之间的关联，违背了诱骗态方法的重要假设，严重威胁协议的安全性。此前的工作研究了相邻脉冲之间的图样效应，并从后选择和调制器两个层面提出了应对措施。本工作研究关联范围更大的图样效应，并提出一种通过标定驱动电压来抑制图样效应的算法。按照我们的方法，实验上观测到了高阶图样效应，并利用所提出的标定算法成功将其抑制。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效提升了协议安全性，有望在实际诱骗态QKD系统中得到广泛应用。

Abstract (English)
The decoy-state method for the quantum key distribution (QKD) is a great countermeasure against the fatal photon number splitting attack. At present, the decoy-state method has been widely employed in practical QKD systems. However, the patterning effect, namely the correlated intensity fluctuations in practical QKD systems, violates the important assumption of the decoy-state method and seriously threatens the protocol security. The previous works investigated the patterning effect between the adjacent pulses and proposed the countermeasures from the degree of post selection and modulators. In this work, we investigate the patterning effect with larger correlation range and present an algorithm to calibrate the driving voltages to mitigate the patterning effect. According to our methods, we experimentally observe the higher-order patterning effect and successfully mitigate it by our calibration algorithm. The experiment results indicate that our methods efficiently improve the protocol security and are expected to be widely employed in practical decoy-state QKD systems.

门控单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）是量子密钥分发（QKD）应用中的实用方案。然而，当 SPAD 工作在高于 2 GHz 的频率时，门控频率受到时间抖动和后脉冲概率的限制。我们发现，滤波器失真与信号幅度变化是高频场景下时间抖动的主要机制，并设计了特定的低通滤波器（LPF）和过零鉴别器来有效降低时间抖动。具体而言，LPF 提取雪崩信号并借助其冲激响应形成精确的过零点，过零鉴别器则正确鉴别雪崩信号以实现低时间抖动。当 SPAD 在 2.5 GHz 门控频率、21% 探测效率下工作时，时间抖动与后脉冲概率分别为 44 ps 和 1.4%。我们的结果为更高时钟率的实用 QKD 系统铺平了道路。

Abstract (English)
Gated single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are practical solutions for quantum key distribution (QKD) applications. However, the gating frequency is limited by time jitter and afterpulse probability when SPADs operate at a frequency higher than 2 GHz. We find that filter distortion and variation of signal amplitude are the dominant mechanisms for time jitter in high-frequency scenarios, and design a specific low-pass filter (LPF) and a zero crossing discriminator to reduce the time jitter effectively. Specifically, the LPF extracts avalanche signals and forms accurate zero crossing points by its impulse response, and the zero crossing discriminator correctly discriminates avalanche signals to achieve low time jitter. When the SPAD is operated at a gating frequency of 2.5 GHz with a detection efficiency of 21%, the time jitter and afterpulse probability are 44 ps and 1.4%, respectively. Our results pave the way to practical QKD systems at higher clock rates.

Abstract (English)
Twin-field quantum key distribution can break through the linear bound, and promises higher key rate over longer distance. But there are two main challenges of signal processing when the twin-field protocol is implemented. One is remote generation of twin fields, the other is perfect compensation of the fast phase drift. Here, we introduce the typical methods and strategies to deal with these challenges by analysis of recent experiments, especially the latest twin-field experiment over 833.8 km fiber.

Abstract (English)
Abstract Phase-matching quantum key distribution (PM-QKD) provides a promising solution to surpass the fundamental rate–distance bound without quantum repeaters. In this paper, we insert an additional advantage distillation (AD) step after quantum communication to improve the performance of PM-QKD. Simulation results show that, by splitting the raw key into blocks of only a few bits so as to identify highly correlated bit pairs, the AD method can tolerate high system misalignment errors and improve the secret key rate and transmission distance significantly, which is very promising in current PM-QKD systems.

随机数在从密码任务到数值模拟的各类应用中都有价值。真正的随机性通常被认为只能来自用量子力学描述的量子系统。维度见证使我们能够区分经典与量子情形，并从实验数据评估系统维度。因此，基于维度见证的量子随机数发生器（QRNG）引起了大量研究。这里我们把 Brunner 等人 [Phys. Rev. Lett. 112, 140407 (2014).] 提出的制备-测量型 QRNG 协议推广为一个更一般、更优的协议。在我们的协议中，二维希尔伯特空间的全部互无偏基均可用于约束最小熵，从而在不同的光路损耗和不同的环境扰动下获得更高的随机数产生速率。我们还给出了该协议的原理性实验实现，与先前的方案相比，通过增加光子偏振互无偏基使随机数速率得到提升。我们的方法也可能适用于更高维的量子系统。

Abstract (English)
Random numbers are valuable for applications ranging from cryptographic tasks to numerical simulations. Genuine randomness is generally considered possible only with a quantum system described by quantum mechanics. The dimension witness allows us to distinguish between classical and quantum scenarios, and assess the system dimensions from experimental data. Accordingly, a quantum random number generator (QRNG) based on dimension witnesses has attracted intensive study. Here we extend the prepare-and-measure QRNG protocol proposed by Brunner et al. [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 112 , 140407 ( 2014 ). PRLTAO 0031-9007 10.1103/PhysRevLett.112.140407 ] to a more general and better one. In our protocol, all the mutually unbiased bases of two-dimensional Hilbert space can be used to bound the min-entropy, which leads to a higher random number generation rate in different optical path losses and different environmental disturbances. We also demonstrate a proof-of-principle realization of our protocol, in which the random number rate increases by more photon polarization mutually unbiased bases compared with the previous one. Our method may also be applicable in higher-dimensional quantum systems.

干涉仪是经典光学系统和量子光学系统中的基本元件。提取光子相位时所需的严格稳定性容易受到偏振变化以及环境扰动所引起相移的影响。在此，我们将石英平面光波电路芯片与法拉第旋转镜相结合，实现了偏振无关的干涉仪。两个带有温度控制器的非对称干涉仪串联连接，用以评估单光子干涉。即使存在主动的随机偏振扰动，12小时内的平均干涉可见度仍高于99%，且起伏小于0.5%。实验结果证实，该混合芯片可满足量子密钥分发和纠缠测量等高要求应用的需要。

Abstract (English)
Interferometers are essential elements in classical and quantum optical systems. The strictly required stability when extracting the phase of photons is vulnerable to polarization variation and phase shift induced by environment disturbance. Here, we implement polarization-insensitive interferometers by combining silica planar light-wave circuit chips and Faraday rotator mirrors. Two asymmetric interferometers with temperature controllers are connected in series to evaluate the single-photon interference. Average interference visibility over 12 h is above 99%, and the variations are less than 0.5%, even with active random polarization disturbance. The experiment results verify that the hybrid chip is available for high-demand applications like quantum key distribution and entanglement measurement.
